articles.title: Control of residual maltose in low-alcohol beer produced by non-Saccharomyces yeast with enzymatic treatment
articles.titleZh: 酶处理控制非酵母低醇啤酒中麦芽糖残留
articles.authors: Basu M, Voloshchuk N, Simmons J, Wee J, Elias RJ, Cockburn DW.
articles.abstract: Non-alcoholic and low-alcohol beer (NABLAB) production by maltose-negative non-Saccharomyces yeast (NSY) runs the risk of excessive sweetness due to the high residual maltose in the finished beer which may overshadow the unique flavors produced by the NSY. The goal of this study was to modify the fermentable sugar profile in wort to better suit maltose-negative NSY, resulting in low residual maltose worts while maintaining low ethanol levels. This was achieved by adding amyloglucosidase (AMG) to increase the proportion of glucose by partially hydrolyzing maltose and maltotriose. Two treatments were selected from AMG-treated time-course mash experiment to produce either moderately elevated or highly elevated glucose levels with either barley malt or barley malt extract. Fermentation was then performed using nine different NSY and compared to Saccharomyces cerevisiae. Most NSY produced significantly less ethanol than S. cerevisiae under these conditions, while leaving behind relatively low levels of maltose (<10 g/L). Lower ethanol production was found to be partially driven by diversion of sugar-derived carbon to non-ethanol pathways, including organic acids and glycerol. Overall, the use of high-glucose worts appears to be a promising approach to produce NABLAB by NSY with the potential for improved sensory properties.
articles.abstractZh: 使用麦芽糖阴性非酵母菌 (NSY) 生产的无酒精和低酒精啤酒 (NABLAB) 存在甜度过高的风险，因为成品啤酒中残留的麦芽糖含量较高，可能会掩盖 NSY 生产的独特风味。本研究的目的是修改麦芽汁中的可发酵糖谱，以更好地适应麦芽糖阴性 NSY，从而在保持低乙醇水平的同时产生低残留麦芽糖麦芽汁。这是通过添加淀粉葡萄糖苷酶（AMG）通过部分水解麦芽糖和麦芽三糖来增加葡萄糖的比例来实现的。从 AMG 处理的时程糖化实验中选择两种处理，以使用大麦麦芽或大麦麦芽提取物产生中度升高或高度升高的葡萄糖水平。然后使用九种不同的 NSY 进行发酵并与酿酒酵母进行比较。在这些条件下，大多数 NSY 产生的乙醇明显少于酿酒酵母，同时留下相对较低水平的麦芽糖 (<10 g/L)。研究发现，乙醇产量下降的部分原因是糖源碳转移至非乙醇途径，包括有机酸和甘油。总体而言，t

articles.title: Multi-omics investigation of microbial community dynamics and metabolic regulation in mulberry wine fermentation under temperature and acid stress
articles.titleZh: 温度和酸胁迫下桑葚酒发酵微生物群落动态及代谢调控的多组学研究
articles.authors: Ji M, Gong J, Liu Z, Liu X, Wang X, Ao C, Tan J.
articles.abstract: This study employed an integrated approach of metagenomics and metabolomics to investigate microbial community dynamics during mulberry wine fermentation under varying temperatures (17–29 °C) and pH levels (3.0–4.5). Twenty treatment combinations, spanning 27 days, captured the temporal dynamics of microbial communities and metabolic activity. Environmental stress significantly shaped community assembly, with Saccharomyces cerevisiae acting as the dominant fermentation organism and Lactobacillus spp. associated with organic acids. Core population analysis revealed specialized functions in ethanol production, acid resistance, and flavor biosynthesis. An optimal fermentation efficiency of 82 % and an ethanol content of 9.1 % vol. were achieved with the response surface method, resulting in optimal fermentation conditions of 23 ± 1 °C with a pH of 3.5 ± 0.1. Multi-omics correlation network analysis revealed coordinated associations among gene expression, enzymatic activities, and metabolite profiles, including coordinated expression patterns of flavor compound biosynthesis pathways. This research provides evidence-based optimization strategies for industrial mulberry wine production, enhancing understanding of stress-responsive microbial adaptation mechanisms.
articles.abstractZh: 本研究采用宏基因组学和代谢组学的综合方法来研究不同温度（17-29°C）和 pH 水平（3.0-4.5）下桑葚酒发酵过程中的微生物群落动态。跨越 27 天的 20 种治疗组合捕捉了微生物群落和代谢活动的时间动态。环境压力显着影响了群落的组装，其中酿酒酵母是主要的发酵生物，而乳杆菌是主要的发酵生物。与有机酸有关。核心群体分析揭示了乙醇生产、耐酸性和风味生物合成方面的特殊功能。最佳发酵效率为 82%，乙醇含量为 9.1% vol。通过响应面法实现，最佳发酵条件为 23 ± 1 °C，pH 为 3.5 ± 0.1。多组学相关网络分析揭示了基因表达、酶活性和代谢物谱之间的协调关联，包括风味化合物生物合成途径的协调表达模式。这项研究为工业桑葚酒生产提供了基于证据的优化策略，

articles.title: Polymorphism exploration of Schizosaccharomyces japonicus strains based on single nucleotide polymorphism and phenotypic analysis
articles.titleZh: 基于单核苷酸多态性和表型分析的日本裂殖酵母菌株多态性探索
articles.authors: Zhang Z, Wang C, Wu C, Zhang Y, Wang Q, Song A, Wu Y, Qiu S.
articles.abstract: Strain polymorphism of non-Saccharomyces has not yet been fully explored due to the limitation of genome information compared to Saccharomyces yeast. This study targeted Schizosaccharomyces japonicus (S. japonicus) for polymorphism exploration. On one hand, single nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) primers with short-amplicon target were newly designed based on genome-wide SNP variations, and could discriminate strains from different isolation sources. Primer S. japonicus-3 could classify 195 strains into 13 haplotypes, and the haplotypes TA and TCA checked by primer S. japonicus-3 only presented in S. japonicus isolates from spontaneous fermentation of the Ziqiu variety of grape. On the other hand, high polysaccharide production and high flocculence in S. japonicus correlated with specific haplotypes: GC and TTA were exclusively detected in polysaccharide high producing strains, while TC and CA were uniquely associated with high flocculence phenotypes. This study provides a new method for the strain differentiation of S. japonicus, and would be helpful for the application of S. japonicus in wine industry.
articles.abstractZh: 与酵母菌相比，由于基因组信息的限制，非酵母菌的菌株多态性尚未得到充分探索。本研究针对日本裂殖酵母（S. japonicus）进行多态性探索。一方面，基于全基因组SNP变异，新设计了短扩增子靶标的单核苷酸多态性（SNP）引物，可以区分不同分离来源的菌株。引物S. japonicus-3可将195个菌株分为13个单倍型，引物S. japonicus-3检测到的单倍型TA和TCA仅存在于紫秋葡萄自然发酵的S. japonicus分离株中。另一方面，刺参的高多糖产量和高絮状与特定的单倍型相关：GC和TTA仅在多糖高产菌株中检测到，而TC和CA与高絮状表型唯一相关。本研究为刺参的菌株分化提供了新的方法，有助于刺参在酿酒工业中的应用。

articles.title: Synergistic regulation of microbial metabolism and quality features in liver products using combined ultrasound-pulsed electric field assisted co-fermentation
articles.titleZh: 联合超声脉冲电场辅助共发酵对肝脏产品中微生物代谢和质量特征的协同调节
articles.authors: Xu J, Li X, Zhou C, Sant'Ana AS, Pan D, Cao J, Zhang H, Xia Q.
articles.abstract: Bio-fermentation process is widely used to improve the quality and flavor of meat products, but the mechanisms by which co-applied physical fields synergistically regulate microbial metabolism during fermentation remain insufficiently elucidated. In this study, yeast and lactic acid bacteria were co-inoculated for lamb liver fermentation, to which ultrasound (US), pulsed electric field (PEF), and their combination (US-PEF) were applied to evaluate their effects on the physicochemical properties, sensory characteristics, and metabolome shifts. The results showed that US-PEF significantly reduced pH, total volatile basic nitrogen, and thiobarbituric acid reactive substances by 23.86 %, 73.30 %, and 53.40 %, respectively, relative to the unfermented group, while maintaining color and texture. Additionally, the perceived off-flavor intensity decreased by 52.12 %, and overall flavor improved significantly. Microstructural characterization showed that US-PEF treatment caused localized damage to the microbial cell surface structure, including cytoplasmic loosening and increased vacuolation, corresponding to enhanced membrane permeability and substrate utilization. Untargeted metabolomics revealed clear separation of metabolic profiles among treatments, with differential regulation observed in amino acid and lipid pathways. By increasing membrane permeability and potentially activating microbial enzymes, US-PEF accelerated protein degradation and increased dipeptides and taste-active amino acids, while lowering levels of unsaturated fatty acid precursors and thereby suppressing the formation of off-flavor compounds. These findings elucidate the synergistic regulation by physical fields-assisted fermentation contributed to improving the quality and flavor of livestock by-products.
articles.abstractZh: 生物发酵工艺被广泛应用于改善肉制品的品质和风味，但共同应用的物理场协同调节发酵过程中微生物代谢的机制仍不清楚。在本研究中，酵母和乳酸菌共接种进行羊肝发酵，并应用超声波（US）、脉冲电场（PEF）及其组合（US-PEF）评估它们对理化特性、感官特性和代谢组变化的影响。结果表明，与未发酵组相比，US-PEF 显着降低了 pH 值、总挥发性碱性氮和硫代巴比妥酸反应物质，分别降低了 23.86%、73.30% 和 53.40%，同时保持了颜色和质地。此外，感知的异味强度降低了52.12%，整体风味显着改善。微观结构表征表明，US-PEF 处理对微生物细胞表面结构造成局部损伤，包括细胞质松弛和空泡增加，这与膜通透性和底物利用率的增强相对应。非靶向代谢组学

articles.title: Uncovering genetic and phenotypic diversity connections in Lachancea thermotolerans: impact on wine aromatics
articles.titleZh: 揭示 Lachancea 耐热菌的遗传和表型多样性联系：对葡萄酒芳香的影响
articles.authors: Jacobs TR, Rollero S, Delaherche A, Setati ME, Divol B.
articles.abstract: Lachancea thermotolerans is increasingly valued in winemaking for its ability to enhance acidity through lactic acid production, reduce acetic acid, and improve aroma complexity, among other beneficial traits. It has considerable strain variability offering opportunities, but necessitates thorough characterisation to select strains suited to specific oenological applications. Although high intraspecific genetic and phenotypic diversity has been reported, the relationship between the two remains unclear. This study aimed to genetically profile 20 Lachancea isolates from the SAGWRI microbial collection using microsatellite typing (and SAU-PCR where relevant) and to evaluate their phenotypic diversity in sterile Chenin blanc fermentations. The isolates were successfully differentiated into nine genetic groups. Phenotypic screening also revealed significant variability in fermentation kinetics, primary metabolites, and secondary metabolites, which generally aligned with the genetic groupings —with a few exceptions— indicating a clear genotype-phenotype link. Surprisingly, only five of the strains produced lactic acid, despite it being a metabolic marker of L. thermotolerans. Of these, two strains produced excessively high levels (∼9 g/L), significantly lowering pH. All strains yielded less ethanol and more succinic acid than Saccharomyces cerevisiae strain SafOeno™ CKS102, and several consumed over 50% of initial malic acid. Secondary metabolite profiling showed elevated levels of higher alcohols and fruity esters in some strains. Interestingly, some also produced high levels of terpenes and aldehydes, which are underexplored in L. thermotolerans, suggesting further potential to enhance aroma complexity. These findings advance understanding of L. thermotolerans strain diversity and highlight untapped potential for selecting strains with desirable traits for tailored wine production.
articles.abstractZh: Lachancea 耐热菌在酿酒中越来越受到重视，因为它能够通过产生乳酸来增强酸度、减少乙酸、提高香气复杂性以及其他有益特性。它具有相当大的菌株变异性，提供了机会，但需要进行彻底的表征才能选择适合特定酿酒应用的菌株。尽管已报道了较高的种内遗传和表型多样性，但两者之间的关系仍不清楚。本研究旨在使用微卫星分型（以及相关的 SAU-PCR）对 SAGWRI 微生物保藏中的 20 个 Lachancea 分离株进行基因分析，并评估它们在无菌白诗南发酵中的表型多样性。这些分离株成功分化为九个遗传组。表型筛选还揭示了发酵动力学、初级代谢物和次级代谢物的显着变异，这些变异通常与遗传分组一致（除了少数例外），表明存在明显的基因型-表型联系。令人惊讶的是，尽管乳酸是耐热乳杆菌的代谢标志物，但只有五种菌株产生乳酸。其中，

articles.title: Genotypic and phenotypic diversity of Maudiozyma humilis: the multiple evolutionary trajectories of a domesticated yeast.
articles.titleZh: Maudiozyma humilis 的基因型和表型多样性：驯化酵母的多重进化轨迹。
articles.authors: Lebleux M, Rouil J, Segond D, Marlin T, Howell K, Bechara P, Nidelet T, Arnould L, Sicard D, Devillers H.
articles.abstract: Maudiozyma humilis is the second most frequently encountered yeast species in sourdough bread. Despite its ecological and food relevance, little is known about its evolutionary trajectories and phenotype traits of interest. Here we investigated the genomic and phenotypic diversity of a world-wide collection of 55 M. humilis strains by combining genomic analyses and high-throughput phenotyping of fermentation kinetics and fitness. Population genomic analysis revealed six distinct clades, three diploid and three triploid, with no geographical or substrate-specific structuring. Phylogenetic, loss of heterozygosity (LOH) and allele specific analyses indicated that triploid strains originated from both recent and more ancient hybridization events involving multiple lineages. The absence of the HO gene and mating-type silent cassettes revealed the inability of M. humilis to carry mating-type switching. In addition, high linkage disequilibrium and variable LOH accumulation were observed consistent with a predominantly clonal reproduction. Last, an exceptionally high level of heterozygosity was detected, suggesting that occasional hybridization is the major driver of genetic diversity. Phenotypic characterization in a synthetic sourdough medium revealed variation in fermentation kinetics and fitness statistically associated with the genetic clades. Interestingly, genetic distance between clades and strains better explain the phenotypic variation than difference in ploidy. Altogether, our findings highlight the complex evolutionary history of M. humilis, shaped by hybridization and ploidy variation and reveal that historical contingency shapes the phenotypic landscape of this species. Beyond providing the first analysis of M. humilis evolution, our result challenges the hypothesis that increases in ploidy are necessarily beneficial in domesticated species.
articles.abstractZh: Maudiozyma humilis 是酵母面包中第二常见的酵母种类。尽管它与生态和食物相关，但人们对其进化轨迹和感兴趣的表型特征知之甚少。在这里，我们通过结合基因组分析和发酵动力学和适应性的高通量表型分析，研究了全球 55 个 M. humilis 菌株的基因组和表型多样性。群体基因组分析揭示了六个不同的进化枝，三个二倍体和三个三倍体，没有地理或底物特异性结构。系统发育、杂合性丢失（LOH）和等位基因特异性分析表明，三倍体菌株起源于涉及多个谱系的最近和更古老的杂交事件。 HO 基因和交配型沉默盒的缺失表明 M. humilis 无法进行交配型转换。此外，观察到高度连锁不平衡和可变的 LOH 积累与主要的克隆繁殖一致。最后，检测到异常高水平的杂合性，表明偶尔的杂交是遗传多样性的主要驱动力。苯丙氨酸

articles.title: The FaDOF2-FaMYB4 transcriptional module regulates anthocyanin biosynthesis in strawberry fruit.
articles.titleZh: FaDOF2-FaMYB4 转录模块调节草莓果实中花青素的生物合成。
articles.authors: Wang L, Zhao S, Xu Y, Li S, Cao F, Zhang Z.
articles.abstract: Key messageFaMYB4,encoding a core transcriptional repressor of anthocyanin biosynthesis, is suppressed by the upstream regulator FaDOF2, forming a novel cascade module that regulates strawberry fruit pigmentation. Strawberry fruit coloration is a key quality trait that is primarily determined by anthocyanin accumulation. In this study, we identified FaMYB4 as a core R2R3-MYB transcriptional repressor of anthocyanin biosynthesis, based on the high-quality haploid genome of octoploid cultivated strawberry 'Yanli' and corresponding transcriptome data across multiple fruit developmental stages. The transcription level of FaMYB4 gradually decreases during fruit ripening. Furthermore, FaMYB4 directly binds to the promoters of key anthocyanin biosynthetic genes (FaPAL, FaC4H, and FaANS) and represses their transcription, as demonstrated by DNA affinity purification sequencing, a yeast one-hybrid assay, an electrophoretic mobility shift assay, and a dual-luciferase reporter system. In addition, FaDOF2, a DOF family transcription factor, directly suppresses FaMYB4 transcription by binding to its promoter. In conclusion, our results reveal a FaDOF2-FaMYB4 cascade module that regulates anthocyanin biosynthesis in the octoploid cultivated strawberry, thereby extending the known regulatory network of fruit pigmentation and providing potential molecular targets for breeding improved color traits.
articles.abstractZh: 关键信息FaMYB4编码花青素生物合成的核心转录抑制因子，被上游调节因子FaDOF2抑制，形成调节草莓果实色素沉着的新型级联模块。草莓果实着色是一个关键的品质性状，主要由花青素的积累决定。在本研究中，我们基于八倍体栽培草莓‘艳丽’的高质量单倍体基因组和多个果实发育阶段的相应转录组数据，将FaMYB4确定为花青素生物合成的核心R2R3-MYB转录抑制因子。 FaMYB4的转录水平在果实成熟过程中逐渐降低。此外，FaMYB4 直接结合关键花青素生物合成基因（FaPAL、FaC4H 和 FaANS）的启动子并抑制其转录，这一点通过 DNA 亲和纯化测序、酵母单杂交测定、电泳迁移率变动测定和双荧光素酶报告系统证明。此外，DOF家族转录因子FaDOF2通过与其启动子结合直接抑制FaMYB4转录。总之，我们的结果揭示了调节 anthoc 的 FaDOF2-FaMYB4 级联模块

articles.title: Crystal structure of a fungal dihydroxyacetone kinase reveals a non-canonical ATP-binding site.
articles.titleZh: 真菌二羟基丙酮激酶的晶体结构揭示了一个非典型的 ATP 结合位点。
articles.authors: Wei H, Chen Y, Zhang F, Li Q, Liu P, Cai T, Liu W.
articles.abstract: Dihydroxyacetone kinase (DAK) catalyzes the ATP-dependent phosphorylation of dihydroxyacetone (DHA) and is an important enzyme in artificial starch synthesis. Here, we report the crystal structure of a methylotrophic yeast DAK from Komagataella phaffii (formly Pichia pastoris, PpDAK). ATP was observed at a non-canonical site distinct from the canonical bacterial ATP-binding pocket. Docking further suggested that the canonical pocket remains accessible, indicating flexibility in ATP recognition. Sequence and phylogenetic analyses show that PpDAK clusters within a distinct methylotrophic yeast lineage and that residues surrounding the non-canonical ATP-binding site are conserved among methylotrophic yeasts. In addition, Mg2+ ions were identified in some substrate-binding pockets and docking suggested substantial overlap between Mg2+ and the predicted DHA-binding position. Together, these findings provide structural insights into ATP recognition in fungal DAKs and a framework for future functional studies and enzyme engineering.
articles.abstractZh: 二羟基丙酮激酶（DAK）催化二羟基丙酮（DHA）的ATP依赖性磷酸化，是人工淀粉合成中的重要酶。在这里，我们报道了来自 Komagataella phaffii（以前的毕赤酵母，PpDAK）的甲基营养酵母 DAK 的晶体结构。在不同于典型细菌 ATP 结合袋的非典型位点观察到 ATP。对接进一步表明规范口袋仍然可访问，这表明 ATP 识别的灵活性。序列和系统发育分析表明，PpDAK 簇位于不同的甲基营养酵母谱系内，并且非规范 ATP 结合位点周围的残基在甲基营养酵母中是保守的。此外，在一些底物结合口袋中鉴定出 Mg2+ 离子，对接表明 Mg2+ 与预测的 DHA 结合位置之间存在大量重叠。总之，这些发现为真菌 DAK 中 ATP 识别提供了结构见解，并为未来的功能研究和酶工程提供了框架。

articles.title: Cytoplasmic circular dsDNA is a key constituent of stress granules.
articles.titleZh: 细胞质环状双链 DNA 是应激颗粒的关键成分。
articles.authors: Demeshkina NA, Ferré-D'Amaré AR.
articles.abstract: Stress granules are large cytoplasmic bodies formed in response to environmental insults by eukaryotic cells. Stress granule formation is key for post-stress recovery, and many diseases and infections are characterized by dysregulation of these membraneless organelles. How specific and non-specific macromolecular interactions drive the formation of stress granules and other large assemblies is an area of active research. Stress granules are comprised of dense, ~200 nm cores, and these are known to contain numerous RNAs and proteins. Now, we have discovered that more than half of the nucleic acid content of stress granule cores is circular, double-stranded DNA. We demonstrate cytologically that these extrachromosomal circular DNAs (eccDNAs) colocalize cytoplasmically with canonical stress granule marker proteins in HEK293T cells, and through CRISPR targeting in budding yeast, that they are required for stress granule formation upon stress. This discovery thus reveals a key function for eccDNA in the eukaryotic stress response.
articles.abstractZh: 应激颗粒是真核细胞响应环境侵害而形成的大型细胞质体。应激颗粒的形成是应激后恢复的关键，许多疾病和感染的特征是这些无膜细胞器的失调。特异性和非特异性大分子相互作用如何驱动应力颗粒和其他大型组装体的形成是一个活跃的研究领域。应力颗粒由致密的约 200 nm 核心组成，已知这些核心含有大量 RNA 和蛋白质。现在，我们发现应激颗粒核心的核酸含量一半以上是环状双链DNA。我们从细胞学角度证明，这些染色体外环状 DNA (eccDNA) 与 HEK293T 细胞中的经典应激颗粒标记蛋白在细胞质中共定位，并且通过芽殖酵母中的 CRISPR 靶向，证明它们是应激时应激颗粒形成所必需的。因此，这一发现揭示了 eccDNA 在真核应激反应中的关键功能。

articles.title: De novo biosynthesis of the polymethoxylated flavones eupatilin and jaceosidin in Saccharomyces cerevisiae.
articles.titleZh: 酿酒酵母中多甲氧基黄酮 eupatilin 和 jaceosidin 的从头生物合成。
articles.authors: Liu J, Sun T, Liu Z, Zou Y, Liu Y, Yao X, Wu H, Wang X, Li F, Song W, Qiao Y, Luo X.
articles.abstract: Eupatilin (EUP) and jaceosidin (JAC) are bioactive polymethoxylated flavones (PMFs) derived from Artemisia argyi. However, their sustainable production is hindered by the low abundance of this plant and the challenges of regioselective chemical synthesis. One key obstacle in microbial PMF biosynthesis lies in coordinating precursor supply with P450-dependent oxidation and SAM-dependent O-methylation. In this study, we report the first de novo biosynthesis of EUP and JAC in Saccharomyces cerevisiae using a modular "backbone-first, tailoring-next" strategy. Here, a tyrosine-to-(2S)-naringenin module was coupled with a CYP450 tailoring cascade (FNSII-F3'H-F6H) to produce 6-hydroxyluteolin, followed by product-specific O-methylation via complementary flavonoid O-methyltransferases. Through enzyme screening, precursor-flux optimization, gene-dosage tuning, and NADPH/SAM cofactor engineering, the optimized strains achieved de novo production titers of 27.3 mg/L EUP and 42.2 mg/L JAC. Further optimization of pH and staged-feeding in a 5-L bioreactor increased the mean peak titers to 70.5 mg/L EUP and 63.3 mg/L JAC at 120 h. This work establishes a yeast platform for PMF biosynthesis and provides a general framework for engineering P450- and OMT-dominated flavonoid pathways.
articles.abstractZh: Eupatilin (EUP) 和 Jaceosidin (JAC) 是源自艾叶的生物活性多甲氧基黄酮 (PMF)。然而，这种植物的丰度低和区域选择性化学合成的挑战阻碍了它们的可持续生产。微生物 PMF 生物合成的一个关键障碍在于协调前体供应与 P450 依赖性氧化和 SAM 依赖性 O-甲基化。在这项研究中，我们报告了使用模块化“主链优先，剪裁下一步”策略在酿酒酵母中首次从头生物合成 EUP 和 JAC。在此，将酪氨酸至 (2S)-柚皮素模块与 CYP450 剪裁级联 (FNSII-F3'H-F6H) 耦合以产生 6-羟基木犀草素，然后通过互补的类黄酮 O-甲基转移酶进行产物特异性 O-甲基化。通过酶筛选、前体通量优化、基因剂量调整和NADPH/SAM辅因子工程，优化后的菌株实现了27.3 mg/L EUP和42.2 mg/L JAC的从头生产滴度。进一步优化 5 L 生物反应器中的 pH 值和分阶段补料，将 120 小时时的平均峰滴度提高至 70.5 mg/L EUP 和 63.3 mg/L JAC。这项工作建立了 PMF 生物合成和 pMF 的酵母平台。

articles.title: Discovery of high-efficiency ( <i>S</i>)- <i>N</i>-methylcoclaurine 3'-hydroxylase involved in the biosynthesis of benzylisoquinoline alkaloids in Berberidaceae.
articles.titleZh: 发现小檗科中参与苄基异喹啉生物碱生物合成的高效(S)-N-甲基椰壳碱3'-羟化酶。
articles.authors: Kong L, He X, Gong C, Gao M, Xie Z, Chen R, Xu Z, Zhang L.
articles.abstract: Benzylisoquinoline alkaloids (BIAs) represent a class of plant-derived compounds with significant pharmacological importance. The biosynthesis of most BIAs originates from a common precursor ( S)-reticuline. ( S)- N-methylcoclaurine 3'-hydroxylase (NMCH), encoded by CYP80B members, has always been regarded as a rate-limiting step that restricts the efficient synthesis of ( S)-reticuline, thereby leading to the low accumulation of BIAs. The highly-efficiency NMCH still needs to be further explored. Species within the Berberidaceae family are known to accumulate diverse BIAs at relatively high levels, making them an ideal plant resource for exploring highly active enzymes involved in BIA synthesis. Here, by integrating transcriptome and metabolite analysis across 11 Berberidaceae plants, we mine and characterize candidate genes involved in ( S)-reticuline biosynthesis. We further establish an engineered yeast platform for functional screening of NMCH genes and evaluate the catalytic activity of all CYP80B candidates. Among these, MbNMCH, isolated from Mahonia bealei, exhibits significantly higher catalytic activity for ( S)-reticuline production in yeast compared to previously reported NMCH enzymes. Our findings provide abundant genetic and metabolic information on Berberidaceae plants and identify a highly efficient enzymatic tool for BIA production in microbial cell factories, facilitating the sustainable manufacturing of diverse valuable alkaloids.
articles.abstractZh: 苄基异喹啉生物碱 (BIA) 是一类具有重要药理学重要性的植物源化合物。大多数 BIA 的生物合成源自共同的前体 (S)-网状番荔枝碱。 CYP80B成员编码的(S)-N-甲基鸟蛤碱3'-羟化酶(NMCH)一直被认为是限制(S)-网状番荔枝碱有效合成的限速步骤，从而导致BIA的低积累。高效的NMCH仍需进一步探索。众所周知，小檗科的物种能够以相对较高的水平积累多种 BIA，这使得它们成为探索 BIA 合成中高活性酶的理想植物资源。在这里，通过整合 11 种小檗科植物的转录组和代谢物分析，我们挖掘并表征了参与 (S)-网脉番荔枝碱生物合成的候选基因。我们进一步建立了一个工程酵母平台，用于 NMCH 基因的功能筛选，并评估所有 CYP80B 候选物的催化活性。其中，从Mahonia bealei中分离出来的MbNMCH与之前报道的相比，对酵母中(S)-网脉番荔枝碱的生产表现出显着更高的催化活性

articles.title: Effects of guanidinoacetic acid and live yeast cells on cattle rumen fermentation and greenhouse biogas production in vitro of ten shrub species.
articles.titleZh: 胍基乙酸和活酵母细胞对十种灌木体外牛瘤胃发酵和温室沼气产量的影响。
articles.authors: Huerta FAR, Elghandour MMMY, Ortiz WXS, Fekri A, Palangi V, De Palo P, De Angelis M, Maggiolino A, Salem AZM.
articles.abstract: Enteric gas production during rumen fermentation, enteric methane (CH4), contributes to approximately 14-18% of global greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions and a reduction of 2% to 15% in consumed energy. Therefore, reducing enteric CH4 production may have environmental (CH4 is a potent greenhouse gas), nutritional (decreased energy losses), and economic benefits (enhanced animal productivity). The trial aimed to evaluate the effects of guanidinoacetic acid (GAA) and live yeast cells (YEA) on methane, carbon monoxide (CO), and hydrogen sulfide (H2S) production, and on ruminal fermentation characteristics of ten shrub species. The ruminal fluid was obtained from four three-year-old Charolais bulls (BW = 500 ± 29 kg; mean ± SD), fed with diets based on 100% free-access forage. The experimental additives were as follows: (1) Control (without feed additives), (2) guanidinoacetic acid (GAA; 0.0015 g), and (3) live yeast (YEA; 0.004 g). Production of CH₄, CO, and H₂S was measured at intervals of 2, 4, 6, 24, 28, 30, and 48 h. After completing the gas measurements, the in vitro dry matter degradability (DMD%) was determined. Asymptotic total gas production (b) was decreased with the administration of live yeast to Diospyros texano (P = 0.010) and GAA to Hilaria mutica (P = 0.0002). Opuntia engelmanni supplemented with live yeast resulted in higher gas production at 24 h (P = 0.0004). Adding feed additives to the shrubs increased the DMD% (P = 0.014). The highest and lowest CH4 production was recorded when GAA was added to Mimosa zygophylla and live yeast to Hilaria mutica, respectively (P = 0.002). The interaction between the feed additive and the forage source increased (P 4 production. Supplementation of diets with live yeast and GAA significantly influenced asymptotic CO production, rate of CO production, and Lag phase (P 2S production was affected by the interaction between GAA and live yeast (P = 0.001). In conclusion, live yeast supplementation reduced CH4 and H2S production in forage-based diets, whereas its effects on CO and total gas production were variable and inconsistently reduced.
articles.abstractZh: 瘤胃发酵过程中产生的肠内气体，即肠内甲烷 (CH4)，约占全球温室气体 (GHG) 排放量的 14-18%，并减少了 2% 至 15% 的能源消耗。因此，减少肠道 CH4 的产生可能具有环境效益（CH4 是一种强效温室气体）、营养效益（减少能量损失）和经济效益（提高动物生产力）。该试验旨在评估胍基乙酸 (GAA) 和活酵母细胞 (YEA) 对甲烷、一氧化碳 (CO) 和硫化氢 (H2S) 产生以及十种灌木瘤胃发酵特性的影响。瘤胃液取自四头三岁夏洛莱公牛（BW = 500 ± 29 kg；平均值 ± SD），饲喂基于 100% 自由采食的饲料。实验添加剂如下：(1)对照(不含饲料添加剂)，(2)胍基乙酸(GAA；0.0015g)，和(3)活酵母(YEA；0.004g)。以2、4、6、24、28、30和48小时的间隔测量CH 4 、CO和H 2 S的产生量。完成气体测量后，测定体外干物质降解率（DMD%）。渐近总产气量 (b) 随着管理的进行而减少

articles.title: Role of Pbr1, a putative oxidoreductase, in the ER quality control and folding of yeast Fks1 glucan synthase.
articles.titleZh: Pbr1（一种假定的氧化还原酶）在 ER 质量控制和酵母 Fks1 葡聚糖合酶折叠中的作用。
articles.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
articles.authors: Obara K, Okada H, Tan G, Ohnuki S, Suzuki G, Ohtake H, Kubo K, Ghanegolmohammadi F, Ishizaka S, Yashiroda Y, Okita A, Mishiro-Sato E, Suzuki K, Tamura Y, Ashine R, Ikeda Y, Kamura T, van Leeuwen J, Andrews B, Bi E, Noda NN, Boone C, Ohya Y.
articles.abstract: The biogenesis of multipass membrane proteins challenges the endoplasmic reticulum (ER) quality control, particularly when transmembrane segments contain polar or charged residues required for function. Fks1, the catalytic subunit of yeast β-(1,3)-glucan synthase, exemplifies this challenge because its large multipass transmembrane architecture must support glucan synthesis at the plasma membrane while also undergoing efficient biogenesis in the ER. Here, we investigate the cellular role of PBR1 (YNL181W), an essential gene whose role remains uncharacterized even though its predicted product has similarity to oxidoreductases. By integrating quantitative morphological profiling with global genetic interaction analysis, we found that PBR1 function converges on cell-wall biosynthesis and closely parallels that of FKS1. Partial loss of Pbr1 function caused temperature-sensitive growth defects but also impaired β-(1,3)-glucan synthesis, and weakened cell-wall integrity. Under these conditions, Fks1 failed to accumulate at the cell surface and, instead, accumulated in ER-associated compartments, where it exhibited reduced stability. Biochemical analyses revealed the accumulation of immature Fks1 species, including forms defective in glycosylation, consistent with compromised ER quality control. A spontaneous missense suppressor allele of FKS1 partially restored Fks1 stability and growth, supporting a functional relationship between the two proteins. Pbr1 is a cytosol-facing ER membrane protein that physically associates with Fks1, and structural modeling suggests that it adopts a Rossmann-like fold capable of binding pyridine nucleotides despite divergence from canonical catalytic motifs. Together, these findings identify Pbr1 as an ER-associated, chaperone-like factor required for the folding and maturation of Fks1.
articles.abstractZh: 多通道膜蛋白的生物合成对内质网 (ER) 质量控制提出了挑战，特别是当跨膜片段含有功能所需的极性或带电残基时。 Fks1 是酵母 β-(1,3)-葡聚糖合酶的催化亚基，它体现了这一挑战，因为其大型多通道跨膜结构必须支持质膜上的葡聚糖合成，同时在内质网中进行有效的生物发生。在这里，我们研究了 PBR1 (YNL181W) 的细胞作用，这是一种重要基因，尽管其预测产物与氧化还原酶相似，但其作用仍未得到表征。通过将定量形态学分析与全局遗传相互作用分析相结合，我们发现 PBR1 功能集中在细胞壁生物合成上，并且与 FKS1 的功能非常相似。 Pbr1 功能的部分丧失会导致温度敏感的生长缺陷，但也会损害 β-(1,3)-葡聚糖的合成，并削弱细胞壁的完整性。在这些条件下，Fks1 未能在细胞表面积累，而是积累在 ER 相关区室中，在那里它表现出稳定性降低。生化分析揭示了immat的积累

articles.title: Screening and characterization of indigenous yeast strains from spontaneously fermented strawberry (Fragaria × ananassa Duchesne) juice for potential wine production.
articles.titleZh: 从自然发酵的草莓（Fragaria × ananassa Duchesne）汁中筛选和表征用于潜在葡萄酒生产的本土酵母菌株。
articles.authors: Mao Y, Xu Q, Liu W, Gao X, Zhang L, Zhu Q, Cai J, Zhu L.
articles.abstract: This study aimed to identify and characterize indigenous yeast strains suitable for the fermentation of Fragaria × ananassa Duchesne (strawberry) wine. A total of 58 yeast isolates were obtained from spontaneously fermented strawberry juice. Preliminary screening based on colony morphology on Wallerstein Laboratory (WL) nutrient agar yielded 15 candidate strains. Subsequent evaluation of CO₂ production using Durham tube fermentation assays further narrowed the selection to 12 high-performing isolates. Lysine utilization testing indicated that strain Z-36 belonged to Saccharomyces cerevisiae, whereas the remaining 11 isolates were classified as non-Saccharomyces yeasts. Comprehensive physiological tolerance profiling revealed distinct functional characteristics among the selected strains: strain Z-36 exhibited robust tolerance to multiple stress conditions, including cold stress at 4 °C, ethanol concentrations up to 15% (v/v), sucrose levels of 400 g/L, SO₂ concentrations of 360 mg/L, and low pH, rendering it especially well-suited for demanding fermentation environments; strain Z-1 demonstrated superior thermotolerance at 40 °C; strain Z-50 displayed exceptional resistance to high glucose concentration (400 g/L), strong resistance to common microbial inhibitors, and notably high ester biosynthetic capacity; and both strains Z-25 and Z-36 achieved outstanding ethanol yields. Molecular identification, based on sequencing of the D1/D2 domain of the large subunit rRNA gene, classified the 12 strains as follows: five Pichia fermentans, four Pichia kudriavzevii, two Hanseniaspora spp., and one S. cerevisiae. Integrating morphological, biochemical, physiological, and molecular data, strains Z-36 (S. cerevisiae) and Z-50 (Hanseniaspora sp.) were selected as optimal candidates for strawberry wine fermentation. However, we emphasize that these conclusions are drawn from in vitro screening assays; validation through actual strawberry wine fermentations with chemical and sensory analyses is required to confirm their technological suitability. This work provides a scientifically grounded foundation for the targeted development of starter cultures and informs future studies on strain optimization and mixed-fermentation strategies.
articles.abstractZh: 本研究旨在鉴定和表征适合发酵 Fragaria × ananassa Duchesne（草莓）酒的本土酵母菌株。从自然发酵的草莓汁中总共获得了 58 个酵母分离株。根据沃勒斯坦实验室 (WL) 营养琼脂上的菌落形态进行初步筛选，产生 15 个候选菌株。随后使用达勒姆管发酵测定对二氧化碳产生进行评估，进一步将选择范围缩小到 12 个高性能分离株。赖氨酸利用测试表明菌株Z-36属于酿酒酵母，而其余11个分离株被归类为非酿酒酵母。全面的生理耐受性分析揭示了所选菌株之间独特的功能特征：菌株 Z-36 对多种应激条件表现出强大的耐受性，包括 4 °C 冷应激、乙醇浓度高达 15% (v/v)、蔗糖水平 400 g/L、SO2 浓度 360 mg/L 和低 pH 值，使其特别适合苛刻的发酵环境；菌株 Z-1 在 40 °C 下表现出优异的耐热性；菌株 Z-50 显示出优异的耐高

articles.title: Transposons as Tools for Future Genome Engineering in Yeasts and Filamentous Fungi.
articles.titleZh: 转座子作为未来酵母和丝状真菌基因组工程的工具。
articles.authors: Peng B, Tominaga M, Wang C, Speight RE, Ishii J.
articles.abstract: Transposons are fundamental genetic elements that have profoundly shaped the architecture of eukaryotic genomes. Yeasts and filamentous fungi have emerged as important chassis organisms for bioingredient production in synthetic biology and metabolic engineering. In this review, we summarise the current understanding and future opportunities in the development of transposon-based tools for genome engineering in these fungal systems. Fungal inverted terminal repeat (ITR) DNA transposons, as well as long terminal repeat (LTR) and non-LTR retrotransposons, can accelerate genomic mutagenesis, facilitating the screening of superior genotypes and phenotypes. CRISPR-associated transposons (CASTs) hold considerable potential for site-specific integration of large transgenes, bypassing the limitations imposed by low homologous recombination (HR) efficiency in non-Saccharomyces hosts. Overall, transposon-based tools represent a valuable and underexplored avenue to accelerate genome engineering and strain development in yeasts and filamentous fungi.
articles.abstractZh: 转座子是深刻塑造真核基因组结构的基本遗传元件。酵母和丝状真菌已成为合成生物学和代谢工程中生物成分生产的重要底盘生物。在这篇综述中，我们总结了在这些真菌系统中开发基于转座子的基因组工程工具的当前理解和未来机遇。真菌反向末端重复（ITR）DNA转座子以及长末端重复（LTR）和非LTR反转录转座子可以加速基因组诱变，有利于筛选优良基因型和表型。 CRISPR 相关转座子 (CAST) 在大型转基因的位点特异性整合方面具有巨大的潜力，绕过了非酵母菌宿主中同源重组 (HR) 效率低所带来的限制。总体而言，基于转座子的工具代表了加速酵母和丝状真菌基因组工程和菌株开发的宝贵且尚未开发的途径。

articles.title: Tri-valorization of methanol in a single bioreactor: co-production of enzyme, chemical, and single-cell protein using engineered Pichia pastoris (Komagataella phaffii).
articles.titleZh: 在单个生物反应器中对甲醇进行三价化：使用工程毕赤酵母 (Komagataella phaffii) 共同生产酶、化学品和单细胞蛋白质。
articles.authors: Fang J, Wang S, Liu G, Zhang Y, Li Y, Zhu T.
articles.abstract: The economic viability of methanol-based biomanufacturing, particularly with green methanol as feedstock, is often limited by the low value of single-product processes. Here, we developed an integrated co-production strategy in the methylotrophic yeast Pichia pastoris (Komagataella phaffii) for the simultaneous conversion of methanol into three products: the sweetener erythritol, the industrial biocatalyst β-mannanase, and single-cell protein (SCP) biomass. This new strategy explores the inherent spatial and functional separation between the ER-Golgi secretory pathway for enzyme production and the cytosolic pathway for chemical synthesis, thereby reducing interference between the two pathways. The engineered co-production strain achieved β-mannanase and erythritol titers comparable to those of the corresponding β-mannanase- and erythritol-producing reference strains in both shake-flask and fed-batch fermentor cultures. Furthermore, transcriptomic analysis revealed distinct regulatory responses related to enzyme production and erythritol synthesis, supporting the limited cross-pathway interference between the two pathways. In addition, we showed that ultrafiltration enabled efficient downstream separation of the small-molecule erythritol from the secreted β-mannanase, with recovery efficiencies exceeding 89%. These results demonstrate a feasible strategy for methanol valorization into multiple value-added products and expand the potential of methylotrophic yeasts for integrated biomanufacturing.
articles.abstractZh: 甲醇生物制造的经济可行性，特别是以绿色甲醇为原料的生物制造，往往受到单一产品工艺价值低的限制。在这里，我们在甲基营养酵母毕赤酵母 (Komagataella phaffii) 中开发了一种综合联合生产策略，用于将甲醇同时转化为三种产品：甜味剂赤藓糖醇、工业生物催化剂 β-甘露聚糖酶和单细胞蛋白 (SCP) 生物质。这一新策略探索了酶生产的 ER-高尔基体分泌途径和化学合成的胞质途径之间固有的空间和功能分离，从而减少了这两种途径之间的干扰。工程化共生产菌株在摇瓶和补料分批发酵罐培养物中获得的 β-甘露聚糖酶和赤藓糖醇滴度与相应的产生 β-甘露聚糖酶和赤藓糖醇的参考菌株相当。此外，转录组分析揭示了与酶产生和赤藓糖醇合成相关的不同调节反应，支持这两种途径之间有限的跨途径干扰。此外，我们还表明超滤可以提高效率

articles.title: An advanced genome engineering platform for Komagataella phaffii enabling versatile in vivo DNA assembly and multiplex integration.
articles.titleZh: Komagataella phaffii 的先进基因组工程平台可实现多功能体内 DNA 组装和多重整合。
articles.authors: Choi Y, Kim A, Kang NK.
articles.abstract: BackgroundThe transition toward a sustainable bioeconomy necessitates the development of robust microbial platforms capable of C1 chemical valorization, particularly the conversion of methanol into high-value chemicals. Komagataella phaffii is a premier methylotrophic host for such applications due to its natural methanol utilization pathways and high-density fermentation capabilities. However, its potential as a C1-based synthetic biology chassis has been hampered by inefficient homologous recombination and the technical complexity of multigene pathway integration. To accelerate the design-build-test-learn (DBTL) cycle for methanol-based biomanufacturing, a more sophisticated and high-throughput genome engineering toolkit is required.ResultsWe report the development of an HR-enhanced K. phaffii chassis (dKR) achieved by synergistically deleting Ku70 and overexpressing RAD52 at the chromosomal level. This engineering markedly improved the robustness and reproducibility of CRISPR/Cas9-mediated genome editing, increasing integration efficiency from 15.3% in the wild-type to 68.1% in the dKR chassis when using short 50-bp homology arms. The platform demonstrated exceptional capacity for vector-free multi-fragment assembly, achieving an integration efficiency of 86.5% for nine linear DNA fragments. Furthermore, the implementation of a tRNA-ribozyme CRISPR system enabled simultaneous multi-locus integration at three distinct genomic sites with 44.6% efficiency. Notably, the chassis supported direct in vivo plasmid assembly of ten fragments (9 fragments + 1 backbone) with 44.8% efficiency, effectively bypassing E. coli-based cloning. Functional validation via a carotenoid biosynthetic pathway resulted in β-carotene production while maintaining normal cellular growth and metabolic productivity.ConclusionThis study established a versatile genome-engineering platform that advances K. phaffii from a protein-expression host to a broadly applicable biological engineering chassis. By enabling streamlined cellular design and reproducible multigene integration, the platform supports applications spanning synthetic biology, metabolic engineering, and bioproduction. More broadly, the approach illustrates how rational manipulation of DNA repair pathways can enhance genome engineering performance in non-conventional hosts, providing transferable design principles relevant to biological engineering across multiple domains.
articles.abstractZh: 背景向可持续生物经济的转变需要开发能够实现 C1 化学品增值的强大微生物平台，特别是能够将甲醇转化为高价值化学品。由于其天然的甲醇利用途径和高密度发酵能力，Komagataella phaffii 是此类应用的首要甲基营养宿主。然而，其作为基于 C1 的合成生物学底盘的潜力受到低效同源重组和多基因途径整合技术复杂性的阻碍。为了加速基于甲醇的生物制造的设计-构建-测试-学习（DBTL）周期，需要更复杂和高通量的基因组工程工具包。结果我们报告了通过在染色体水平协同删除Ku70和过表达RAD52来实现HR增强的K.phaffii底盘（dKR）的开发。该工程显着提高了 CRISPR/Cas9 介导的基因组编辑的稳健性和可重复性，当使用短 50 bp 同源臂时，将整合效率从野生型的 15.3% 提高到 dKR 底盘中的 68.1%。该平台展示了卓越的能力

articles.title: High-titer retinal production in Yarrowia lipolytica via redox engineering coupled with intra- and extracellular sequestration.
articles.titleZh: 通过氧化还原工程与细胞内和细胞外隔离相结合，在解脂耶氏酵母中产生高滴度的视网膜。
articles.authors: Song J, Lee H, Song H, Seo D, Song J, Seo SW.
articles.abstract: Retinal is an industrially valuable retinoid widely used in cosmetic and pharmaceutical applications, but its microbial production remains limited due to its chemical instability and potential susceptibility to intracellular redox metabolism. Here, Yarrowia lipolytica was engineered for high-level retinal biosynthesis by integrating targeted alcohol dehydrogenase deletion, precursor enhancement, and lipid-associated sequestration. Deletion of endogenous alcohol dehydrogenases increased retinal accumulation, while expression of ERG20(F87S) improved precursor flux toward carotenoid biosynthesis. Notably, coupling enhanced biosynthetic flux with DGA1 overexpression produced a greater improvement in retinal accumulation than either strategy alone. To further protect the oxidation-sensitive product, a two-phase system using isopropyl myristate (IPM) supplemented with an antioxidant was implemented, enabling efficient in-situ extraction and stabilization during fermentation. As a result, a total retinal titer of 2253 mg/L was achieved, with the product highly concentrated in the IPM phase at 45.1 g/L. Given that IPM is a cosmetic-grade solvent, this approach provides a formulation-compatible product phase, highlighting the potential to integrate microbial production with downstream processing. Overall, this study demonstrates that coordinated metabolic engineering and phase-partitioning strategies are essential for the efficient production of oxidation-sensitive terpenoid aldehydes.
articles.abstractZh: 视黄醛是一种具有工业价值的类维生素A，广泛用于化妆品和制药应用，但由于其化学不稳定性和对细胞内氧化还原代谢的潜在敏感性，其微生物生产仍然有限。在这里，解脂耶氏酵母通过整合靶向乙醇脱氢酶缺失、前体增强和脂质相关隔离，被设计用于高水平的视网膜生物合成。内源性乙醇脱氢酶的缺失增加了视网膜的积累，而ERG20（F87S）的表达则改善了类胡萝卜素生物合成的前体通量。值得注意的是，与单独使用任一策略相比，将增强的生物合成通量与 DGA1 过表达相结合可更大程度地改善视网膜积累。为了进一步保护氧化敏感产品，采用了使用肉豆蔻酸异丙酯 (IPM) 并辅以抗氧化剂的两相系统，从而在发酵过程中实现高效的原位提取和稳定。结果，视网膜总效价达到 2253 mg/L，IPM 相中的产物高度浓缩为 45.1 g/L。鉴于 IPM 是化妆品级溶剂，这种方法提供了配方兼容性

articles.title: Research on the Mechanism of Mating-Type-Specific Gene Expression by Transcription Factor Mata2 in Miso and Soy Sauce Yeast.
articles.titleZh: 味噌和酱油酵母转录因子Mata2交配型特异性基因表达机制的研究。
articles.authors: Ogata T, Koide K, Hoshino S, Hori R, Fukuda M, Kuroki K.
articles.abstract: The mating-type locus of the miso and soy sauce yeast Zygosaccharomyces sp. contains a gene encoding the transcription factor Mata2 (hereafter ZygoMata2), which has a DNA-binding domain containing a high mobility group (HMG)-box not found in the baker's yeast Saccharomyces cerevisiae. To investigate the role of ZygoMata2 in mating-type a expression, we constructed mutant strains of ZygoMATa2 using CRISPR-Cas9. The resulting mutants showed reduced expression of ZygoSTE6, which is specific to mating-type a, and did not mate, suggesting that ZygoMata2 regulates the expression of mating-type a in Zygosaccharomyces sp. Expression of ZygoSTE6 was observed when the HMG-box of ZygoMata2 was exchanged with that of Mat1-Mc, which regulates mating-type expression in Schizosaccharomyces pombe, indicating that ZygoMata2 recognizes its target DNA sequence via the HMG-box. Substitution of the predicted upstream activation sequence (UAS) in ZygoSTE6 with the UAS of a mating-type a-specific gene from another yeast species led to mating-type a-specific gene expression in transformed Zygosaccharomyces sp. yeast, indicating that ZygoMata2 can recognize the UAS of mating-type a-specific genes of other species. We speculated that the flexibility in the binding sequences of ZygoMata2 is due to synergistic or cooperative binding with the DNA-binding protein ZygoMcm1. This hypothesis was supported by replacement of the UAS of ZygoSTE6 with the complete palindrome sequence, P(PAL), and by the results of protein and DNA structure prediction using AlphaFold. Collectively, our study indicates that ZygoMata2 regulates mating-type a-specific gene expression via its HMG-box, which shows flexible recognition of the binding sequence of other HMG-box transcription factors.
articles.abstractZh: 味噌和酱油酵母接合酵母的交配型基因座。含有编码转录因子 Mata2（以下简称 ZygoMata2）的基因，该基因具有 DNA 结合域，其中包含面包酵母酿酒酵母中未发现的高迁移率基团 (HMG) 盒。为了研究 ZygoMata2 在交配型 a 表达中的作用，我们使用 CRISPR-Cas9 构建了 ZygoMATa2 突变株。由此产生的突变体显示 ZygoSTE6 的表达降低，ZygoSTE6 是交配型 a 特有的，并且不交配，这表明 ZygoMata2 调节接合酵母属中交配型 a 的表达。当 ZygoMata2 的 HMG-box 与 Mat1-Mc 的 HMG-box 交换时，观察到 ZygoSTE6 的表达，Mat1-Mc 调节粟酒裂殖酵母中的交配型表达，表明 ZygoMata2 通过 HMG-box 识别其靶 DNA 序列。将 ZygoSTE6 中预测的上游激活序列 (UAS) 替换为来自另一个酵母物种的交配型 a 特异性基因的 UAS，导致转化的 Zygosaccharomyces sp 中出现交配型 a 特异性基因表达。酵母，表明ZygoMata2可以识别其他交配型a特异性基因的UAS

articles.title: A computational framework for building dynamic bioreactor models integrating detailed enzyme kinetics with limited data: beta-ionone production in Saccharomyces cerevisiae as a case study.
articles.titleZh: 用于构建动态生物反应器模型的计算框架，将详细的酶动力学与有限的数据相结合：以酿酒酵母中的 β-紫罗兰酮生产为例。
articles.authors: Sepúlveda-Celis AI, Agosin E, Pérez-Correa JR, Saa PA.
articles.abstract: Kinetic models are useful tools for predicting the dynamic behavior of metabolic systems and to optimize the performance of bioprocesses. However, the difficulty of fitting their parameters to limited data hinders their widespread use. These models have various disparate parameters, are nonlinear, and display complex interactions. To address this challenge, this study introduces a computational framework for constructing bioreactor models integrating detailed enzyme kinetics under data-limited conditions. The framework is illustrated by the construction of a dynamic model that describes the growth kinetics of Saccharomyces cerevisiae and the production of β-ionone, an apocarotenoid extensively utilized in the flavor and fragrance industries, in batch cultivations. The model was initially formulated and described using 78 free kinetic parameters. Through the systematic application of sensitivity and identifiability analyses and reparameterization, the model was reduced to 9-parameter candidate structures. Multi-criteria decision-making techniques were then employed to select a robust model structure. When validated against an independent experimental dataset with condition-specific cofactor adjustment, the final model achieved comparable overall predictive performance compared to the original model structure, with notable improvements for key pathway metabolites, including up to 38% reduction in the normalized mean absolute error for the target product β-ionone. This framework successfully addresses the challenge of constructing predictive kinetic models from limited experiments while maintaining mechanistic interpretability, providing a quantitative tool for identifying metabolic bottlenecks and guiding metabolic engineering interventions.
articles.abstractZh: 动力学模型是预测代谢系统动态行为和优化生物过程性能的有用工具。然而，将其参数拟合到有限数据的困难阻碍了它们的广泛使用。这些模型具有各种不同的参数，是非线性的，并且显示出复杂的相互作用。为了应对这一挑战，本研究引入了一个计算框架，用于构建生物反应器模型，在数据有限的条件下整合详细的酶动力学。该框架通过动态模型的构建来说明，该模型描述了酿酒酵母的生长动力学和β-紫罗兰酮的生产，β-紫罗兰酮是一种广泛用于香精香料行业的类胡萝卜素，在批量培养中。该模型最初是使用 78 个自由动力学参数制定和描述的。通过敏感性和可识别性分析以及重新参数化的系统应用，模型被简化为 9 参数候选结构。然后采用多标准决策技术来选择稳健的模型结构。当针对具有特定条件的独立实验数据集进行验证时

articles.title: Advancing stress biotechnology for robust sustainable bioproduction.
articles.titleZh: 推进应激生物技术以实现稳健的可持续生物生产。
articles.authors: Wang WB, Yuan B, Cheng C, Thongchul N, Zhao XQ.
articles.abstract: Environmental stressors compromise the economic viability of microbial bioproduction, making enhanced microbial robustness essential. While traditional engineering strategies try to maximize cell growth and survival, recent studies reveal that there exists a proper balance between stress tolerance and bioproduction efficiency. Here, we propose the concept of stress biotechnology and summarize relevant advances in yeast research, particularly focusing on global metabolic rewiring, cell lifespan engineering, and artificial membrane-less organelles. Unlike conventional stress biology focusing mainly on stress tolerance mechanisms, stress biotechnology precisely partitions resources to achieve a delicate balance between cellular defense and product synthesis. The integration of rational and random strategies is emphasized, highlighting major random strategies such as adaptive laboratory evolution and CRISPR interference library approaches. Finally, we discuss future perspectives on leveraging artificial intelligence to identify novel stress-tolerance targets and engineer autonomous dynamic circuits. This review provides a foundation for building next-generation intelligent and robust yeast cell factories.
articles.abstractZh: 环境压力会损害微生物生物生产的经济可行性，因此增强微生物的稳健性至关重要。虽然传统的工程策略试图最大化细胞生长和存活，但最近的研究表明，应激耐受性和生物生产效率之间存在适当的平衡。在这里，我们提出了应激生物技术的概念，并总结了酵母研究的相关进展，特别关注全局代谢重连、细胞寿命工程和人工无膜细胞器。与主要关注应激耐受机制的传统应激生物学不同，应激生物技术精确地分配资源，以实现细胞防御和产物合成之间的微妙平衡。强调理性策略和随机策略的结合，重点介绍适应性实验室进化和CRISPR干扰库方法等主要随机策略。最后，我们讨论了利用人工智能来识别新的耐压目标和设计自主动态电路的未来前景。本次审查为构建下一代智能、稳健的y提供了基础

articles.title: FaWRKY21 Enhances Postharvest Resistance to <i>Botrytis cinerea</i> in Strawberry by Activating Jasmonic Acid Biosynthesis.
articles.titleZh: FaWRKY21 通过激活茉莉酸生物合成增强草莓采后对灰葡萄孢的抗性。
articles.journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
articles.authors: Wei M, Chen Y, You Y, Wei Y, Jiang S, Ye J, Chen J, Xu J, Xu F, Ding P, Wu F, Shao X.
articles.abstract: Strawberry (Fragaria × ananassa) is highly susceptible to gray mold caused by Botrytis cinerea. WRKY transcription factors and jasmonic acid (JA) are central to defense against necrotrophs, yet the regulatory interaction in strawberry remains unclear. Here, we characterized FaWRKY21, a terpinen-4-ol-responsive, Group IIc WRKY gene encoding a nuclear-localized protein. Transient overexpression in strawberry fruit enhanced defense against B. cinerea and increased endogenous JA concentrations. This enhanced defense was confirmed in transgenic Arabidopsis plants overexpressing FaWRKY21, where AtPDF1.2 and other defense markers were upregulated. Transcriptomic and qRT-PCR analyses revealed that FaWRKY21 upregulates JA biosynthetic genes, notably FaOPR3II, FaJMT, and FaAOS-C. Yeast one-hybrid, EMSA, and dual-luciferase assays demonstrated direct binding to W-box elements in their promoters and transcriptional activation. Our findings establish FaWRKY21 as a direct activator of JA biosynthesis that positively regulates defense against B. cinerea, offering molecular targets for developing elicitor-based strategies to control postharvest gray mold.
articles.abstractZh: 草莓（Fragaria × ananassa）极易感染灰霉病（Botrytis cinerea）引起的灰霉病。 WRKY 转录因子和茉莉酸 (JA) 是防御坏死生物的核心，但草莓中的调节相互作用仍不清楚。在这里，我们对 FaWRKY21 进行了表征，FaWRKY21 是一种萜品烯-4-醇响应型 IIc 组 WRKY 基因，编码核定位蛋白。草莓果实中的短暂过度表达增强了对灰霉病菌的防御并增加了内源 JA 浓度。这种增强的防御在过度表达 FaWRKY21 的转基因拟南芥植物中得到证实，其中 AtPDF1.2 和其他防御标记上调。转录组和 qRT-PCR 分析表明，FaWRKY21 上调 JA 生物合成基因，特别是 FaOPR3II、FaJMT 和 FaAOS-C。酵母单杂交、EMSA 和双荧光素酶测定证明其启动子中的 W-box 元件直接结合并激活转录。我们的研究结果表明，FaWRKY21 是 JA 生物合成的直接激活剂，可积极调节对灰霉病菌的防御，为开发基于激发子的策略来控制采后灰霉病提供分子靶标。

articles.title: GmMADS17, a MADS-box transcription factor, promotes flowering in soybean.
articles.titleZh: GmMADS17 是一种 MADS-box 转录因子，可促进大豆开花。
articles.authors: Liu W, Wang Y, Xu R, Zhang L, Wang X, Li W, Wang C, Zhang X, Dai H, Zhang Y.
articles.abstract: BackgroundSoybean is an important crop used for oil, grain and feed. Due to its strong photoperiod sensitivity, flowering is a critical developmental process regulated by multiple genes that determines reproductive success and yield of soybean. Therefore, identifying regulatory genes controlling flowering is of great importance for developing widely adapted and high-yielding soybean varieties.ResultsIn this study, we identified a soybean MADS-box transcription factor gene GmMADS17 through transcriptome analysis of two extreme flowering phenotype families derived from a recombinant inbred line (RIL) population of Qihuang 34 and Jidou 17. Functional validation using both overexpression and CRISPR/Cas9-mediated mutagenesis demonstrated that GmMADS17 promotes flowering in soybean. Yeast two-hybrid, bimolecular fluorescence complementation assays and Co-immunoprecipitation assay further revealed that GmMADS17 could interact with 3 GmAP1 proteins (GmAP1a, c and d). In addition, genetic diversity analysis indicated strong selection at the GmMADS17 locus during soybean domestication, characterized by the near fixation of GmMADS17-Hap2, which might be associated with early-flowering in cultivated soybeans.ConclusionsThe results of this study may provide strategic genetic insights for molecular breeding programs aimed at enhancing soybean adaptation.
articles.abstractZh: 研究背景大豆是重要的石油、粮食和饲料作物。由于其强烈的光周期敏感性，开花是一个受多个基因调控的关键发育过程，决定大豆的繁殖成功和产量。因此，鉴定控制开花的调控基因对于开发广泛适应性和高产的大豆品种具有重要意义。结果在本研究中，我们通过对来自岐黄34和吉豆17的重组自交系（RIL）群体的两个极端开花表型家族的转录组分析，鉴定了大豆MADS-box转录因子基因GmMADS17。使用过表达和CRISPR/Cas9介导的诱变进行的功能验证表明，GmMADS17促进开花大豆开花。酵母双杂交、双分子荧光互补分析和免疫共沉淀分析进一步表明，GmMADS17 可以与 3 个 GmAP1 蛋白（GmAP1a、c 和 d）相互作用。此外，遗传多样性分析表明，在大豆驯化过程中，GmMADS17位点存在强烈选择，其特征是GmMADS17-Hap2的近固定，这可能与栽培中的早花有关。

articles.title: Horizontal gene transfer in Saccharomyces cerevisiae and other Saccharomycotina yeasts: a review.
articles.titleZh: 酿酒酵母和其他酵母菌的水平基因转移：综述。
articles.authors: Grassi A, Rogo U, Fambrini M, Pugliesi C, Agnolucci M.
articles.abstract: Species evolution has long been associated exclusively with vertical gene transfer, making genetic variability a result of recombination and spontaneous mutations. Although long considered exclusive to prokaryotes, horizontal gene transfer (HGT), plays an important evolutionary role even in complex eukaryotic lineages. This process can generate novel functions in the host, proving evolutionary paths not predicted by vertical inheritance. This review highlights how HGT has significantly shaped the genome evolution of Saccharomyces cerevisiae, providing key traits relevant to fermentation processes. HGT events from bacteria, alongside introgression from other yeasts, contribute to the genetic diversity and specific adaptations seen in domesticated strains of S. cerevisiae, distinguishing them from wild relatives and influencing their industrial utility. Here we report how the advent of next-generation sequencing (NGS), and the subsequent flood of genomic data, have fundamentally accelerated the discovery and analysis of HGT events across all domains of life. The sheer volume of NGS data has driven the development of sophisticated bioinformatics tools and algorithms specifically designed to detect the phylogenetic and compositional signatures of HGT. We also discuss how detecting HGT events helps to understand yeast genome plasticity and to identify useful "foreign" DNA, which can then be manipulated to create novel yeast strains with enhanced fermentation performance, flavour profiles, or stress tolerance.
articles.abstractZh: 物种进化长期以来一直只与垂直基因转移相关，使得遗传变异成为重组和自发突变的结果。尽管长期以来被认为是原核生物所独有的，但水平基因转移（HGT）即使在复杂的真核生物谱系中也发挥着重要的进化作用。这个过程可以在宿主中产生新的功能，证明垂直遗传无法预测的进化路径。这篇综述强调了 HGT 如何显着塑造酿酒酵母的基因组进化，提供与发酵过程相关的关键性状。来自细菌的 HGT 事件以及来自其他酵母的基因渗入，有助于在酿酒酵母驯化菌株中观察到的遗传多样性和特异性适应，将其与野生近缘种区分开来并影响其工业用途。在这里，我们报告下一代测序 (NGS) 的出现以及随后的大量基因组数据如何从根本上加速了生命各个领域的 HGT 事件的发现和分析。 NGS 数据的庞大数量推动了专门设计的复杂生物信息学工具和算法的开发

articles.title: Mitochondrial localization of key NAD<sup>+</sup>-dependent dehydrogenases explains the exceptionally high biomass yield on ethanol of the yeast <i>Cyberlindnera jadinii</i>.
articles.titleZh: 关键 NAD+ 依赖性脱氢酶的线粒体定位解释了酵母 Cyber​​lindnera jadinii 乙醇的异常高生物量产量。
articles.authors: Warmerdam M, Pijman YO, Pedersen MP, Wattel K, Vieira-Lara MA, Pronk JT.
articles.abstract: Ethanol is an interesting renewable feedstock for microbial biotechnology. Compared to other yeasts, Cyberlindnera jadinii has an exceptionally high biomass yield on ethanol. Simulations with a stoichiometric metabolic model identified an intramitochondrial rather than cytosolic localization of NAD+-dependent alcohol and acetaldehyde dehydrogenases as a possible explanation for this high yield. This hypothesis was tested in a comparative study with Ogataea parapolymorpha, which, like C. jadinii, contains a proton-pumping Complex I NADH dehydrogenase, but shows a lower biomass yield on ethanol. Experiments with an aox null mutant showed that the lower biomass yield of O. parapolymorpha was not caused by in vivo alcohol oxidase activity. Proteome analyses showed that the most abundant ADH isozyme in C. jadinii and O. parapolymorpha contained and lacked a predicted mitochondrial targeting sequence, respectively. The ADH protein with the highest prevalence in ethanol-limited cultures of C. jadinii was predicted to be mitochondrial and accounted for almost 4% of the detected proteome. In subcellular fractionation studies with cells grown under ethanol limitation, ADH showed 10-fold lower specific activity in the mitochondria-enriched fraction of cell homogenates of O. parapolymorpha than in the cytosolic fraction. Conversely, C. jadinii showed a 50% higher ADH activity in the mitochondria-enriched fraction. A low overall recovery of ADH in mitochondria-enriched fractions of C. jadinii was attributed to disruption of the reticulate mitochondrial structures observed in ethanol-grown cells during preparation of cell homogenates. This study demonstrates how subcellular localization of an NAD+-dependent dehydrogenase can influence respiratory energy coupling in yeasts that harbor a Complex I NADH dehydrogenase.ImportanceThis study provides theoretical and experimental evidence that intracellular localization of NAD+-dependent dehydrogenases can be a key factor for respiratory energy coupling in yeasts. Based on this, alteration of the cellular localization of NAD+-dehydrogenases is identified as an interesting metabolic engineering strategy for improving respiratory energy coupling in eukaryotic cell factories.
articles.abstractZh: 乙醇是微生物生物技术的一种有趣的可再生原料。与其他酵母相比，Cyber​​lindnera jadinii 的乙醇生物量产量极高。使用化学计量代谢模型进行的模拟发现，NAD+依赖性酒精和乙醛脱氢酶位于线粒体内而不是胞质内，这可能是这种高产率的解释。这一假设在与 Ogataea parapolymorpha 的比较研究中得到了检验，它与 C. jadinii 一样，含有质子泵复合物 I NADH 脱氢酶，但显示出乙醇生物量较低。使用 aox 无效突变体进行的实验表明，副多形 O. parapolymorpha 的生物量产量较低并不是由体内醇氧化酶活性引起的。蛋白质组分析表明，C. jadinii 和 O. parapolymorpha 中最丰富的 ADH 同工酶分别包含和缺乏预测的线粒体靶向序列。预计在 C. jadinii 的乙醇限制培养物中出现率最高的 ADH 蛋白是线粒体，几乎占检测到的蛋白质组的 4%。在对在乙醇限制下生长的细胞进行的亚细胞分级分离研究中，ADH 显示出 10 倍的低

articles.title: Proteolysis-driven enhancement of texture and bioactivity in milk co-fermented with Lactobacillus delbrueckii ssp. bulgaricus, Lacticaseibacillus paracasei, and Kluyveromyces marxianus.
articles.titleZh: 与德氏乳杆菌共发酵的牛奶中，蛋白质水解驱动的质地和生物活性增强。保加利亚酵母、副干酪乳杆菌和马克斯克鲁维酵母。
articles.authors: Gao F, Deng L, Cui B, Zhang F, Yu J, Mu G, Tuo Y.
articles.abstract: This work aims to elucidate how the inclusion of Kluyveromyces marxianus DPUL-F15 combined with Lactobacillus delbrueckii ssp. bulgaricus DPUL-F36 and Lacticaseibacillus paracasei DPUL-F115 enhances the textural and functional characteristics of fermented milk through accelerated proteolysis. The results revealed that fermented milk inoculated solely with Lactobacillus delbrueckii ssp. bulgaricus DPUL-F36 and Lacticaseibacillus paracasei DPUL-F115 served as the yeast-free control, while the 3-strain co-fermented milk exhibited significantly stronger acidification and proteolytic activities during fermentation and subsequent storage. Likewise, the 3-strain product presented superior gel characteristics, along with enhanced in vitro antihypertensive and antioxidant capacities throughout storage. Peptidomics analysis showed that these observations could be explained by the greater number of casein-derived peptides and the increased abundance of corresponding bioactive peptides, mostly with antihypertensive and antioxidant activities. Notably, prediction using databases such as BIOPEP-UWM indicated that most of these bioactive peptides possessed favorable in vivo activity and umami potential. Molecular docking analysis further identified the key binding residues of these antihypertensive (Tyr), antioxidant (Asp, Asn, Phe, and Ser), and umami peptides (Glu, Ser, and Asn), with hydrogen bonds as the primary interaction. Taken together, co-fermentation with Kluyveromyces marxianus DPUL-F15 enhances proteolysis and enriches casein-derived peptides in fermented milk, consequently optimizing gel texture and improving bioactivities and umami. This unravels a synergistic mechanism of lactic acid bacteria and yeast and supports targeted development of high-value functional fermented milk.
articles.abstractZh: 本工作旨在阐明如何将马克斯克鲁维酵母 DPUL-F15 与德氏乳杆菌 ssp 结合。保加利亚菌 DPUL-F36 和副干酪乳杆菌 DPUL-F115 通过加速蛋白水解增强发酵乳的质地和功能特性。结果表明，发酵乳仅接种德氏乳杆菌 ssp。保加利亚菌DPUL-F36和副干酪乳杆菌DPUL-F115作为无酵母对照，而3株共发酵乳在发酵和随后的储存过程中表现出明显更强的酸化和蛋白水解活性。同样，3 菌株产品呈现出优异的凝胶特性，以及在整个储存过程中增强的体外抗高血压和抗氧化能力。肽组学分析表明，这些观察结果可以通过酪蛋白衍生肽的数量增加和相应生物活性肽的丰度增加来解释，这些肽大多具有抗高血压和抗氧化活性。值得注意的是，使用 BIOPEP-UWM 等数据库的预测表明，大多数这些生物活性肽都具有良好的体内活性和鲜味。

articles.title: Snapshot at Saccharomycopsis fibuligera metabolism for industrial terpenoid production and bioengineering.
articles.titleZh: 用于工业萜类生产和生物工程的 Saccharomycopsis fibuligera 代谢快照。
articles.authors: Lopez-Barbera A, Torrell H, Abasolo N, Canela N, Fernández-Arroyo S.
articles.abstract: BackgroundMicrobial metabolic engineering increasingly depends on identifying robust non-conventional yeast chassis with favorable metabolic traits. Although Saccharomyces cerevisiae remains the main model for isoprenoid engineering, alternative yeasts may provide superior native precursor availability. Here, we report the first comparative metabolomic characterization of Saccharomycopsis fibuligera, focusing on the mevalonate and terpenoid backbone biosynthesis pathways.ResultsLC-MS profiling revealed elevated levels of acetyl-CoA, HMG-CoA, and MVA in S. fibuligera, suggesting strong native flux through the MVA pathway. The universal isoprenoid precursors IPP and DMAPP accumulated at substantially higher levels than in S. cerevisiae, together with enrichment of FPP and ergosterol abundance, indicating efficient channeling toward sterol biosynthesis. Conversely, upper glycolysis metabolites were reduced, while TCA cycle intermediates were enriched, supporting the proposed Crabtree-negative phenotype of S. fibuligera. Amino acid profiling also indicated enhanced nitrogen storage capacity.ConclusionsThese results position S. fibuligera as a metabolically favorable platform with high intrinsic MVA pathway activity and precursor availability for terpenoid production, highlighting its strong potential as an emerging microbial chassis for next‑generation terpenoid bioproduction.
articles.abstractZh: 背景微生物代谢工程越来越依赖于识别具有有利代谢特征的稳健的非传统酵母底盘。尽管酿酒酵母仍然是类异戊二烯工程的主要模型，但替代酵母可以提供卓越的天然前体可用性。在这里，我们报告了 Saccharomycopsis fibuligera 的第一个比较代谢组学特征，重点关注甲羟戊酸和萜类主链生物合成途径。结果LC-MS 分析显示 Saccharomycopsis fibuligera 中乙酰辅酶 A、HMG-CoA 和 MVA 水平升高，表明通过 MVA 途径的强大天然通量。通用类异戊二烯前体 IPP 和 DMAPP 的积累水平明显高于酿酒酵母，同时 FPP 和麦角甾醇丰度也有所富集，表明甾醇生物合成的有效通道。相反，上部糖酵解代谢物减少，而 TCA 循环中间体富集，支持了所提出的 S. fibuligera 的 Crabtree 阴性表型。氨基酸分析还表明氮储存能力增强。结论这些结果将 S. fibuligera 定位为代谢有利的平台，具有高

articles.title: Engineered microorganisms unlock a new era of diterpenoid biomanufacturing: recent advances and future perspectives.
articles.titleZh: 工程微生物开启了二萜生物制造的新时代：最新进展和未来前景。
articles.authors: Han Y, Luo Y, Wang K, Lin L, Gao J, Sun ML, Ji XJ.
articles.abstract: Diterpenoids are natural compounds composed of four isoprene units. They possess diverse biological activities and widespread applications in the cosmetics, food additives and pharmaceutical. With the rapid advancement of synthetic biology, the biomanufacturing of diterpenoids via microbial metabolism has witnessed substantial advancements. Microbial chassis such as Escherichia coli, Saccharomyces cerevisiae, Yarrowia lipolytica and Rhodosporidium toruloides, have been successfully engineered to enable efficient biosynthesis of these compounds, thereby demonstrating substantial potential for industrial-scale applications. In this review, the construction of diterpenoid biosynthetic pathways in microbial cell factories is summarized. The research progress and engineering strategies for efficient microbial synthesis of diterpenoids are discussed, and the key challenges and future directions facilitating the design of high-yield diterpenoid production platforms and their translation into industrial practice are explored.
articles.abstractZh: 二萜类化合物是由四个异戊二烯单元组成的天然化合物。它们具有多种生物活性，在化妆品、食品添加剂和医药领域有着广泛的应用。随着合成生物学的快速发展，通过微生物代谢生产二萜类化合物取得了长足的进步。大肠杆菌、酿酒酵母、解脂耶氏酵母和圆红冬孢子虫等微生物底盘已被成功改造，能够实现这些化合物的高效生物合成，从而展示了工业规模应用的巨大潜力。本文综述了微生物细胞工厂中二萜类化合物生物合成途径的构建。讨论了微生物高效合成二萜类化合物的研究进展和工程策略，并探讨了促进高产二萜类化合物生产平台设计及其转化为工业实践的关键挑战和未来方向。

articles.title: A Minimal Four-Enzyme Suite Enables Biosynthesis of the C<sub>20</sub> Diterpenoid Alkaloid Atisinium.
articles.titleZh: 最小的四酶套件能够生物合成 C<sub>20</sub> 二萜生物碱 Atisinium。
articles.authors: Xie J, Li C, Kang X, Zou Y, Li J, Li M, Zhou J, Li J, Kitaoka N, Chen S, Jia M.
articles.abstract: Diterpenoid alkaloids (DAs) are pharmaceutically important metabolites and mainly occur in the Ranunculaceae. Despite their structural complexity, all DAs originate from C20 diterpenoid scaffolds, making the elucidation of C20-DA biosynthesis pivotal for understanding and engineering this entire alkaloid class. However, the molecular basis for DA core assembly has remained unresolved despite decades of research. Here, we define a minimal four-enzyme suite comprising three cytochrome P450 monooxygenases (CYP701A216, CYP71FH3 and CYP729G3) and one neo-functionalized short-chain dehydrogenase/reductase (AgDAS), that converts ent-atiserene into the C20 atisine-type alkaloid atisinium in Aconitum gymnandrum, via an enzymatic-spontaneous-enzymatic process. Specifically, the multifunctional CYP701A216 and CYP71FH3 act in relay to generate the key intermediate ent-atiseren-19,20-dial, which undergoes spontaneous condensation with ethanolamine to form a hemiaminal. AgDAS then catalyzes atypical imine reduction to generate 15-deoxyatisinium bearing the characteristic atisine skeleton, and CYP729G3 mediates C15 hydroxylation to finalize atisinium biosynthesis. The physiological relevance of these enzymes was further investigated using virus-induced gene silencing in A. gymnandrum, demonstrating the critical role of AgDAS in this biosynthetic pathway. This compact enzyme module is highly conserved across Aconitum and Delphinium within the Ranunculaceae, pointing to an evolutionarily preserved core biosynthetic pathway. Our work establishes the complete molecular logic for DA scaffold assembly and its heterologous reconstitution in tobacco and yeast, further opening routes to the synthetic biology of medicinally relevant diterpenoid alkaloids.
articles.abstractZh: 二萜生物碱（DA）是药学上重要的代谢物，主要存在于毛茛科植物中。尽管结构复杂，但所有 DA 均源自 C20 二萜类支架，这使得 C20-DA 生物合成的阐明对于理解和设计整个生物碱类至关重要。然而，尽管经过数十年的研究，DA 核心组装的分子基础仍未得到解决。在这里，我们定义了一个最小的四酶套件，包含三种细胞色素 P450 单加氧酶（CYP701A216、CYP71FH3 和 CYP729G3）和一种新功能化短链脱氢酶/还原酶（AgDAS），可将 ent-atiserene 转化为乌头中的 C20 atisine 型生物碱 atisinium，通过酶促-自发-酶促过程。具体来说，多功能CYP701A216和CYP71FH3中继作用生成关键中间体ent-atiseren-19,20-dial，该中间体与乙醇胺自发缩合形成半缩醛胺。然后 AgDAS 催化非典型亚胺还原生成具有特征性阿蒂辛骨架的 15-脱氧阿蒂辛，CYP729G3 介导 C15 羟基化以完成阿蒂辛的生物合成。 t 的生理相关性

articles.title: Chemical, colour, and sensory evolution of Schiava wines: Impact of grape freezing and co-inoculum of yeast and malolactic Bacteria.
articles.titleZh: 斯基亚瓦葡萄酒的化学、颜色和感官演变：葡萄冷冻以及酵母和苹果酸乳酸菌共接种的影响。
articles.authors: Darnal A, Ceci AT, Poggesi S, Mimmo T, Boselli E, Longo E.
articles.abstract: 'Schiava' grapes contain peonidin-3-O-glucoside as main anthocyanin, which is associated to colour instability in the wines. A primary objective of this study was to test a potential strategy (grape freezing) to increase the pigments' extraction from these grapes, and/or the colour stability in wine. Evaluated variables were: (1) application of grapes freezing or not; (2) fermentation with or without fermentative maceration; (3) fermentation by inoculum with Saccharomyces cerevisiae, or co-inoculum with S. cerevisiae and Oenococcus oeni. Potential interactions between grape freezing and malolactic fermentation were also evaluated. Without fermentative maceration, wines from frozen grapes presented "light/pink", "pink/salmon" (visual), "nutty/almond", "tropical/banana" (aroma) attributes. Although grape freezing allowed higher initial contents of peonidin-3-O-glucoside in must, no significant differences were found in the wines after storage. Colorimetric parameters were still positively impacted by grape freezing. The profile of free anthocyanins could not alone accurately reflect the colour of the wines, as other relevant factors were significant.
articles.abstractZh: “Schiava”葡萄含有芍药苷-3-O-葡萄糖苷作为主要花青素，这与葡萄酒颜色不稳定有关。这项研究的主要目的是测试一种潜在的策略（葡萄冷冻），以增加从这些葡萄中提取色素和/或葡萄酒中的颜色稳定性。评价变量为：（1）是否应用葡萄冷冻； (2) 进行或不进行发酵浸渍的发酵； (3)接种酿酒酵母，或共接种酿酒酵母和酒球菌进行发酵。还评估了葡萄冷冻和苹果酸乳酸发酵之间的潜在相互作用。在没有发酵浸渍的情况下，冷冻葡萄酿造的葡萄酒呈现出“淡色/粉红色”、“粉红色/鲑鱼味”（视觉）、“坚果/杏仁味”、“热带/香蕉”（香气）属性。尽管葡萄冷冻使得葡萄汁中芍药苷-3-O-葡萄糖苷的初始含量较高，但在储存后的葡萄酒中没有发现显着差异。比色参数仍然受到葡萄冷冻的积极影响。游离花青素的特征并不能单独准确地反映葡萄酒的颜色，因为其他相关因素也很重要。

articles.title: Identifying critical lysines in mammalian histone H3 with high-throughput CRISPR prime editing.
articles.titleZh: 通过高通量 CRISPR prime 编辑识别哺乳动物组蛋白 H3 中的关键赖氨酸。
articles.authors: Price D, Zemlyanskiy G, Trakarnphornsombat W, Forne I, Volkova N, Dubusse L, Cooper AJ, Imhof A, Radzisheuskaya A.
articles.abstract: Histone post-translational modifications are fundamental to genome regulation, yet dissecting the functions of individual histone marks in mammals remains challenging due to the presence of multiple histone gene copies. Here we develop a high-throughput clustered regularly interspaced short palindromic repeats (CRISPR) prime editing platform enabling precise, reversible and combinatorial mutagenesis of canonical and noncanonical histone H3 genes within their native genomic context. Using systematic lysine-to-arginine substitutions benchmarked against synonymous controls, we identify key residues, including H3K4, H3K9, H3K14, H3K18 and H3K79, whose mutation compromises fitness in mouse embryonic stem cells. We further show that H3K56, linked to genome stability in yeast and Drosophila, has a conserved role in mammalian cells. Through analysis of selected double mutants, we uncover functional crosstalk across residues, with combinations such as H3K27R + H3K36R impairing stem cell self-renewal and altering transcription. Altogether, this study establishes a functional map of histone H3 lysines in mammals and provides a broadly applicable platform for systematic dissection of chromatin regulation.
articles.abstractZh: 组蛋白翻译后修饰是基因组调控的基础，但由于存在多个组蛋白基因拷贝，剖析哺乳动物中单个组蛋白标记的功能仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们开发了一个高通量聚类规则间隔短回文重复序列 (CRISPR) Prime 编辑平台，能够在其天然基因组背景下对规范和非规范组蛋白 H3 基因进行精确、可逆和组合诱变。使用以同义对照为基准的系统性赖氨酸到精氨酸替换，我们鉴定了关键残基，包括 H3K4、H3K9、H3K14、H3K18 和 H3K79，这些残基的突变会损害小鼠胚胎干细胞的适应性。我们进一步表明，与酵母和果蝇基因组稳定性相关的 H3K56 在哺乳动物细胞中具有保守的作用。通过对选定的双突变体的分析，我们发现残基之间的功能串扰，例如 H3K27R + H3K36R 等组合会损害干细胞的自我更新并改变转录。总之，这项研究建立了哺乳动物组蛋白 H3 赖氨酸的功能图谱，并为染色质的系统解剖提供了广泛适用的平台

articles.title: Transcription factor MdMYB6L represses anthocyanin biosynthesis of apple skin at low-altitude regions.
articles.titleZh: 转录因子MdMYB6L抑制低海拔地区苹果皮花青素的生物合成。
articles.authors: Wang K, Qin X, Zhang S, Sun Y, Zhang X, Tang Y, Liu D, Xu X, Liu X, Liu X, Song L, Zhao L.
articles.abstract: Key messageTranscriptional repressor MdMYB6L is induced by heat stress and plays a negative regulatory role in apple skin colouration in low-altitude regions. Pericarp colour is a critical economic trait in apple, with the red colouration of apple skin in high-altitude regions being significantly more pronounced than that in low-altitude regions. However, the regulatory mechanisms governing anthocyanin accumulation in the apple pericarp in these regions have not been thoroughly explored. In this study, multiple MYB transcription factors were significantly downregulated in 'Xiangfu' apple fruit under high-altitude climate conditions compared to that in low-altitude regions. MdMYB6L exhibited an inverse expression pattern compared to MdANS, MdCHS, MdDFR, and MdUFGT. MdMYB6L functions as a nuclear-localised transcriptional repressor induced by heat stress. UV treatment and cold stress decreased its expression, with this effect becoming more pronounced when these stressors were alternated. Stable transformation in 'Orin' callus and apple fruit injections of MdMYB6L showed that MdMYB6L was a negative regulator of anthocyanin biosynthesis and inhibited the expression of the above four structural genes. Yeast one-hybrid (Y1H) and dual-luciferase reporter (DLR) assays demonstrated that MdMYB6L directly bound to the promoters of these genes, regulating their expression levels. Our findings indicate that MdMYB6L is the key regulator controlling apple skin colouration under the climate conditions of high- and low-altitude regions, providing a highly valuable candidate for application in breeding apple varieties with a higher nutritional value.
articles.abstractZh: 关键信息转录抑制因子 MdMYB6L 是由热应激诱导的，对低海拔地区的苹果肤色起着负调节作用。果皮颜色是苹果的一个重要经济性状，高海拔地区苹果皮的红色明显比低海拔地区明显。然而，这些地区苹果果皮花青素积累的调控机制尚未得到彻底探索。本研究发现，与低海拔地区相比，高海拔气候条件下“香富”苹果果实中多个MYB转录因子显着下调。与 MdANS、MdCHS、MdDFR 和 MdUFGT 相比，MdMYB6L 表现出相反的表达模式。 MdMYB6L 作为热应激诱导的核定位转录抑制因子发挥作用。紫外线处理和冷应激降低了其表达，当这些应激源交替时，这种效应变得更加明显。 MdMYB6L在'Orin'愈伤组织和苹果果实注射中的稳定转化表明，MdMYB6L是花青素生物合成的负调节因子，并抑制上述四种蛋白的表达。

articles.title: BrRAV8 represses sucrose biosynthesis to promote leaf senescence of flowering Chinese cabbage.
articles.titleZh: BrRAV8 抑制蔗糖生物合成，促进大白菜叶片衰老。
articles.authors: Kang D, Zeng J, Li J, Yue L, Gao Y, Duan X, Yang Y, Kang Y, Yang X, Chai X.
articles.abstract: Flowering Chinese cabbage is highly susceptible to postharvest quality loss, including water loss, yellowing, and nutrient degradation. Sucrose acts as both essential quality indicators and signaling molecules. Although RAV transcription factors are known regulators of plant development and stress responses, the molecular mechanism through which RAV transcription factors regulate leaf senescence via sucrose biosynthesis remains unclear. Herein, we systematically analyzed the expression of 12 sucrose biosynthesis-related genes (7 BrSUSs and 5 BrSPSs), and 14 BrRAVs after 5 days of dark-induced leaf senescence at 23 °C and 70% relative humidity in flowering Chinese cabbage. Notably, after 5 days of dark-induced leaf senescence, the expression of BrSUS1, BrSPS1, and BrSPS4 decreased, whereas BrRAV8 expression increased. Overexpression of BrRAV8 in flowering Chinese cabbage promoted leaf senescence, accompanied by reduced chlorophyll content, decreased levels of soluble sugar and sucrose, and downregulation of BrSUS1, BrSPS1, and BrSPS4. Concurrently, chlorophyll degradation-related genes (BrNYC1 and BrNYE1) and the senescence marker gene (BrSAG12) were upregulated. In contrast, silencing of BrRAV8 delayed senescence, increased chlorophyll and sucrose contents, and reduced the expressions of senescence-associated genes (BrNYC1, BrNYE, and BrSAG12). Furthermore, silencing of BrSUS1, BrSPS1, or BrSPS4 accelerated leaf senescence, characterized by reduced chlorophyll content, elevated expression of BrNYC1, BrNYE1, and BrSAG12, and a decline in soluble sugar and sucrose contents. Using yeast one-hybrid, electrophoretic mobility shift, and dual luciferase assays, we verified that BrRAV8 directly binds to the promoters of BrSUS1, BrSPS1, and BrSPS4 and suppresses their expression. These results demonstrate that BrSUS1, BrSPS1, and BrSPS4 negatively regulate leaf senescence, whereas BrRAV8 functions as a positive regulator. Our study reveals a previously unidentified regulatory module in which BrRAV8 inhibits sucrose accumulation by directly repressing the expressions of BrSUS1, BrSPS1, and BrSPS4, thereby promoting leaf senescence.

articles.title: Expression and characterization of acetylxylan esterase 2 from Fusarium graminearum.
articles.titleZh: 禾谷镰刀菌乙酰木聚糖酯酶 2 的表达和表征。
articles.authors: Bowman MJ, Walls KN, Naumann TA, Vermillion KE.
articles.abstract: Xylan, one of the sugar polymer components of biomass, is complex in the number and types of glycosidic bonds that comprise its structure. Due to this complexity, xylan hydrolysis requires many different enzymatic activities to fully release available sugars for subsequent fermentation to fuels and chemicals. As pretreatment severities are decreased to prevent degradation of biomass carbohydrates, the extent of hydrolysis of xylan bonds is also decreased. Due to the limited hydrolysis associated with lower severity treatments, esterases will be needed to hydrolyze acetyl-, feruloyl-, or coumaryl- groups that can block access to the sugar polymers. Acetylxylan esterases represent a class of enzymes that have the capability to hydrolyze acetyl- groups from xylan. A candidate fungal gene from Fusarium graminearum, XP_011319679.1, was expressed heterologously in Komagataella phaffii. The secreted protein was purified in a multi-step procedure consisting of ammonium sulfate precipitation, anion-exchange chromatography, acetone precipitation, and size exclusion chromatography. The purified protein was 25 kDa as determined by SDS-PAGE. The expressed protein liberated acetate from partially acetylated birchwood xylan but did not hydrolyze the artificial substrate pNP-acetate. The enzyme, herein designated FgAxe2, had kinetic values of: Km 6.4 mM ± 0.7; kcat 12.9 ± 0.6 s-1; Vmax 24.8 ± 1.1 µmol/min/ml acting on partially acetylated birch xylan. The enzyme had activity between pH 3.0 and 7.0 and temperatures 10°C-90°C, with optima at pH 5.0 and 37 °C. Additional studies evaluating the specificity of the enzyme using 1H NMR and LC-MS were also performed.
articles.abstractZh: 木聚糖是生物质的糖聚合物成分之一，构成其结构的糖苷键的数量和类型很复杂。由于这种复杂性，木聚糖水解需要许多不同的酶活性才能完全释放可用的糖，以便随后发酵成燃料和化学品。当降低预处理强度以防止生物质碳水化合物降解时，木聚糖键的水解程度也降低。由于与较低强度的治疗相关的有限水解，需要酯酶来水解可以阻止接近糖聚合物的乙酰基、阿魏酰基或香豆酰基。乙酰木聚糖酯酶代表一类能够水解木聚糖乙酰基的酶。来自禾谷镰刀菌的候选真菌基因 XP_011319679.1 在 Komagataella phaffii 中异源表达。分泌的蛋白质通过硫酸铵沉淀、阴离子交换层析、丙酮沉淀和尺寸排阻层析组成的多步程序进行纯化。经 SDS-PAGE 测定，纯化的蛋白质为 25 kDa。表达的蛋白质从部分产物中释放出乙酸盐

articles.title: Insight of Pichia kudriavzevii for single cell protein production and fermentation into ethanol using Thai banana as an alternative feedstock.
articles.titleZh: 深入了解库德里阿泽维毕赤酵母 (Pichia kudriavzevii) 使用泰国香蕉作为替代原料生产单细胞蛋白质并发酵成乙醇。
articles.authors: Tawong W, Sujipuli K, Boonsrangsom T, Ratanasut K, Khieokhajonkhet A, Khongnapha W, Rinrit A, Pongcharoen P.
articles.abstract: PurposesThe objective of this study was to assess the potential of yeast Pichia kudriavzevii (NUNS-4, NUNS-5, NUNS-6, and TISTR5147) and Saccharomyces cerevisiae TISTR5606 strain to utilize banana, Musa ABB cv. (Kluai Namwa) and Musa sapientum L. cv. (Kluai Khai), biomass through the co-production of single cell protein and ethanol.ResultsAll tested strains grew well on both YPD and banana-based agar, confirming that banana residues can sustain yeast growth. Supplementation with banana biomass significantly enhanced protein and carbohydrate content. Notably, P. kudriavzevii TISTR5147, P. kudriavzevii NUNS-6, and S. cerevisiae TISTR5606 exhibited the highest single cell protein levels (50.85 ± 1.73%, 49.13 ± 1.50%, and 46.96 ± 1.07%, respectively) using Kluai Namwa, compared to controls without banana substrate. Ethanol yields were also increased when banana biomass was included. Co-fermentation of ripe pulp Kluai Khai with YPD resulted in the highest ethanol yields, reaching 77.63 ± 3.11 g/L for P. kudriavzevii NUNS-6, followed by 76.57 ± 4.49 g/L for NUNS-5, 74.17 ± 2.21 g/L for NUNS-4, and 72.32 ± 1.63 g/L for TISTR5147. Therefore, P. kudriavzevii NUNS-6 demonstrated superior efficiency as a dual producer of single-cell protein and ethanol.ConclusionThese findings demonstrate that banana biomass is a cost-effective and sustainable carbon source for single-cell protein and ethanol production. Moreover, the P. kudriavzevii NUNS strains exhibited strong potential for bioconversion of banana residues into high-value products, supporting their applicability in future large-scale biotechnological processes.
articles.abstractZh: 目的本研究的目的是评估酵母 Pichia kudriavzevii（NUNS-4、NUNS-5、NUNS-6 和 TISTR5147）和酿酒酵母 TISTR5606 菌株利用香蕉 Musa ABB cv. 的潜力。 (Kluai Namwa) 和 Musa sapientum L. cv. （Kluai Khai），通过单细胞蛋白质和乙醇共同生产生物质。结果所有测试菌株在 YPD 和香蕉基琼脂上均生长良好，证实香蕉残留物可以维持酵母生长。补充香蕉生物质显着提高了蛋白质和碳水化合物的含量。值得注意的是，与没有香蕉底物的对照相比，使用 Kluai Namwa 的 P. kudriavzevii TISTR5147、P. kudriavzevii NUNS-6 和 S. cerevisiae TISTR5606 表现出最高的单细胞蛋白质水平（分别为 50.85 ± 1.73%、49.13 ± 1.50% 和 46.96 ± 1.07%）。当加入香蕉生物质时，乙醇产量也有所增加。成熟果肉 Kluai Khai 与 YPD 的共同发酵产生了最高的乙醇产量，P. kudriavzevii NUNS-6 达到 77.63 ± 3.11 g/L，其次是 NUNS-5 76.57 ± 4.49 g/L，NUNS-4 74.17 ± 2.21 g/L 和 72.32 ± 1.63 TISTR5147 的克/升。因此，P. kudriavzevii NUNS-6 表现出优越的功效
