articles.title: The VvBZR1-VvHY5 Module Integrates Brassinosteroid and Light Signaling to Regulate Anthocyanin Biosynthesis in Grape.
articles.titleZh: VvBZR1-VvHY5 模块集成油菜素类固醇和光信号传导来调节葡萄中花​​青素的生物合成。
articles.authors: Yang N, Zhou Y, Zhang W, Yin Y, Fang Y, Dong Y, Wang X, Xi Z.
articles.abstract: While both brassinosteroid (BR) and light are known to promote anthocyanin synthesis in grape berries, the mechanism underlying their synergistic action remains elusive. Here, we demonstrated a synergistic relationship between the BR and light signaling pathways in promoting anthocyanin accumulation and identify VvBZR1 and VvHY5 as key components of this regulatory network. Our physiological and molecular data showed that VvBZR1 and VvHY5 activate key genes in anthocyanin biosynthesis, such as VvCHS1 and VvUFGT. Furthermore, overexpression of VvBZR1 or VvHY5 increased anthocyanin content in both grape calli and Arabidopsis stems, and this effect was synergistically enhanced by combined light and 24-Epibrassinolide (EBR) treatment. Mechanistically, VvBZR1 binds to the E-box element in the VvUFGT promoter to activate its transcription, while VvHY5 binds to the G-box element in the VvCHS1 promoter. Yeast two-hybrid (Y2H), bimolecular fluorescence complementation (BiFC), and co-immunoprecipitation (Co-IP) assays confirmed that VvBZR1 and VvHY5 interact both in vivo and in vitro. Notably, a dual-luciferase (LUC) assay revealed that VvBZR1 and VvHY5 direct interaction reciprocally enhances their transcriptional activation capabilities. In summary, our findings establish the VvBZR1-VvHY5 module as a critical positive regulator that integrates BR and light signaling to promote anthocyanin synthesis in grape.
articles.abstractZh: 虽然已知油菜素类固醇 (BR) 和光都可以促进葡萄浆果中花青素的合成，但它们协同作用的机制仍然难以捉摸。在这里，我们证明了 BR 和光信号通路在促进花青素积累方面的协同关系，并将 VvBZR1 和 VvHY5 确定为该调节网络的关键组成部分。我们的生理和分子数据表明，VvBZR1 和 VvHY5 激活花青素生物合成中的关键基因，例如 VvCHS1 和 VvUFGT。此外，VvBZR1 或 VvHY5 的过表达增加了葡萄愈伤组织和拟南芥茎中的花青素含量，并且这种效应通过光和 24-表油菜素内酯 (EBR) 联合处理得到协同增强。从机制上讲，VvBZR1 与 VvUFGT 启动子中的 E-box 元件结合以激活其转录，而 VvHY5 与 VvCHS1 启动子中的 G-box 元件结合。酵母双杂交 (Y2H)、双分子荧光互补 (BiFC) 和免疫共沉淀 (Co-IP) 测定证实 VvBZR1 和 VvHY5 在体内和体外相互作用。值得注意的是，双荧光素酶 (LUC) 测定表明 VvBZR1 和 VvHY5 直接相互作用相互增强

articles.title: Capsaicin inhibits cariogenic <i>Streptococcus mutans-Candida albicans</i> cross-kingdom biofilms.
articles.titleZh: 辣椒素抑制致龋变形链球菌-白色念珠菌跨界生物膜。
articles.authors: Huang X, Bao J, Zhu J, Wu S, Zhai Y, Ren Y.
articles.abstract: ObjectiveThis research aimed to determine whether capsaicin (CAP), a phytochemical in chilli peppers, inhibits cariogenic Streptococcus mutans-Candida albicans cross-kingdom biofilms and their key virulence factors, and to explore underlying mechanisms.DesignThe anti-caries potential of CAP was assessed in S. mutans-C. albicans co-cultures by quantifying viable cell counts, biomass and biofilm metabolic activity. Biofilm microstructure was visualized by confocal laser scanning microscopy with COMSTAT quantification, and CAP-induced transcriptional changes were profiled by qRT-PCR. Matched ethanol vehicle controls were included.ResultsCAP inhibited the growth of both organisms (MIC = 320 µg/mL). At 1/2 MIC (160 µg/mL) and MIC, CAP significantly suppressed biofilm formation, disrupted pre-formed biofilms and decreased acid production and extracellular polysaccharide (EPS) accumulation. In mature biofilms, CAP downregulated key virulence genes associated with EPS biosynthesis (gtfB, gtfC, gtfD) and fungal pathogenicity (HWP1, ERG4, CHT2, SOD3), suggesting potential interference with glucosyltransferase activity, hyphal morphogenesis and membrane-cell wall integrity.ConclusionCAP attenuated key virulence attributes of S. mutans-C. albicans biofilms in vitro, suggesting its potential as a natural adjunct in caries management. However, its efficacy and deliverability require optimization of oral formulations and rigorous in vivo/clinical validation.
articles.abstractZh: 目的 确定辣椒中的植物化学物质辣椒素（CAP）是否能抑制致龋链球菌-白色念珠菌跨界生物膜及其关键毒力因子，并探讨其潜在机制。通过量化活细胞计数、生物量和生物膜代谢活性来进行白色念珠菌共培养。通过共焦激光扫描显微镜和 COMSTAT 定量来观察生物膜微观结构，并通过 qRT-PCR 来分析 CAP 诱导的转录变化。包括匹配的乙醇载体对照。结果CAP 抑制两种生物体的生长（MIC = 320 µg/mL）。在 1/2 MIC (160 µg/mL) 和 MIC 下，CAP 显着抑制生物膜形成、破坏预先形成的生物膜并减少酸产生和细胞外多糖 (EPS) 积累。在成熟生物膜中，CAP 下调与 EPS 生物合成（gtfB、gtfC、gtfD）和真菌致病性（HWP1、ERG4、CHT2、SOD3）相关的关键毒力基因，表明对葡萄糖基转移酶活性、菌丝形态发生和膜细胞壁完整性有潜在干扰。

articles.title: Development, optimization, and application of an episomal plasmid system for Rhodotorula toruloides.
articles.titleZh: 圆红酵母附加型质粒系统的开发、优化和应用。
articles.authors: Shi L, Xu H, Zhao H.
articles.abstract: Rhodotorula toruloides is an emerging oleaginous yeast with strong potential as a microbial cell factory for the production of acetyl-CoA-derived bioproducts. However, engineering of this organism has been limited by the absence of a functional episomal plasmid system, a foundational genetic tool for rapid gene expression, pathway testing, and CRISPR-based genome engineering. Here, we report the first episomal plasmid system for R. toruloides. Through systematic screening of candidate autonomously replicating sequences (ARSs) from diverse sources, we identified multiple functional ARS elements and selected C63F4, a fragment derived from Contig 63 of R. toruloides CBS14, because of its stable performance. The resulting pC63F4 plasmid was maintained episomally, supported GFP reporter expression, exhibited a copy number of 2.39 ± 0.13, and showed good stability during long term cultivation. To overcome poor transformation efficiency, we developed a Cre-loxP-mediated in vivo re-circularization strategy that enabled reliable delivery of the episomal plasmid. Using this improved system, we demonstrated functional episomal expression of metabolic engineering genes and multi-gene pathways for the production of triacetic acid lactone, fatty alcohols, and limonene. Finally, we leveraged this platform to establish a redesigned CRISPR system that enables seamless genome editing in R. toruloides for the first time, while also simplifying marker recycling. Together, this work establishes a long-needed episomal plasmid platform and associated CRISPR toolkit that will accelerate metabolic engineering, synthetic biology, and fundamental studies in R. toruloides.
articles.abstractZh: 圆红酵母是一种新兴的产油酵母，具有作为生产乙酰辅酶A衍生生物产品的微生物细胞工厂的巨大潜力。然而，由于缺乏功能性附加型质粒系统，该生物体的工程受到限制，附加型质粒系统是快速基因表达、通路测试和基于 CRISPR 的基因组工程的基础遗传工具。在这里，我们报告了第一个 R. toruloides 附加型质粒系统。通过对不同来源的候选自主复制序列（ARS）进行系统筛选，我们鉴定了多个功能ARS元件，并选择了C63F4，它是源自R. toruloides CBS14的Contig 63的片段，因为其性能稳定。所得的 pC63F4 质粒保持附加型，支持 GFP 报告基因表达，拷贝数为 2.39 ± 0.13，并在长期培养过程中表现出良好的稳定性。为了克服转化效率差的问题，我们开发了一种 Cre-loxP 介导的体内再环化策略，能够可靠地递送附加型质粒。利用这个改进的系统，我们证明了代谢工程基因和多基因途径的功能性游离表达

articles.title: Metabolic mechanisms underlying osmoprotectant-enhanced xylitol biosynthesis from glucose by Zygoascus hellenicus.
articles.titleZh: 希腊接合子囊渗透保护剂增强葡萄糖生物合成木糖醇的代谢机制。
articles.authors: Zhang J, Ren X, Zhang X, Pei J, Sun L, Huang W, Liu S, Zheng Y, Zhao X.
articles.abstract: Xylitol, a high-value sugar alcohol, holds significant potential for applications in the food and pharmaceutical industries. Biomanufacturing xylitol from low-cost, green feedstocks provides a sustainable alternative to the energy-intensive and highly polluting chemical synthesis process. Current research primarily focuses on xylose-to-xylitol bioconversion, whereas native glucose-to-xylitol converters remain underexplored. In particular, a systematic understanding of their osmotic stress adaptation and metabolic regulation is lacking, which directly impedes the scale-up of xylitol production from low-cost glucose. To address this gap, this study investigated Zygoascus hellenicus, an osmotolerant yeast capable of directly converting glucose to xylitol, and proposed a novel strategy to enhance xylitol production by supplementing exogenous osmoprotectants. Results showed that adding 80 mL/L glycerol or 80 g/L trehalose increased xylitol titers to 28.44 g/L and 23.63 g/L, representing improvements of 41.99% and 17.99%, respectively, compared with the control group. Mechanistic investigations revealed the dual regulatory roles of these osmoprotectants. Physiologically, they enhanced osmotic tolerance, preserved membrane integrity, and stabilized enzyme activity. Metabolically, they significantly activated key enzymes of the pentose phosphate pathway, including glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase and 6-phosphogluconate dehydrogenase (G6PDH and 6PGDH) and inhibited glycolytic enzymes, thereby redirecting carbon flux toward xylitol biosynthesis. Dynamic metabolic flux analysis (dMFA) further confirmed that osmoprotectant treatment substantially increased the metabolic flux through the xylitol synthesis pathway mediated by G6PDH and 6PGDH, while reducing carbon flow in glycolysis. This study provides mechanism-based insights into xylitol production from glucose in a native producer, revealing a green and alternative glucose-based biomanufacturing route.
articles.abstractZh: 木糖醇是一种高价值糖醇，在食品和制药行业具有巨大的应用潜力。利用低成本、绿色原料生物制造木糖醇为能源密集型和高污染的化学合成工艺提供了可持续的替代方案。目前的研究主要集中在木糖到木糖醇的生物转化，而天然葡萄糖到木糖醇的转化器仍未得到充分探索。特别是，缺乏对其渗透胁迫适应和代谢调节的系统了解，这直接阻碍了低成本葡萄糖生产木糖醇的规模化生产。为了解决这一差距，本研究研究了希腊接合子囊（Zygoascus hellenicus），这是一种能够直接将葡萄糖转化为木糖醇的耐渗透酵母，并提出了一种通过补充外源渗透保护剂来提高木糖醇产量的新策略。结果表明，添加80 mL/L甘油或80 g/L海藻糖可使木糖醇效价分别提高至28.44 g/L和23.63 g/L，较对照组分别提高41.99%和17.99%。机理研究揭示了这些渗透保护剂的双重调节作用。从生理上讲，它们增强了操作系统

articles.title: Unraveling the mechanism of action of the PepGAT peptide against Candida albicans through proteomics approaches.
articles.titleZh: 通过蛋白质组学方法揭示 PepGAT 肽对抗白色念珠菌的作用机制。
articles.authors: Gomes FIR, Chaves QLSG, Filho NSS, Mororó JLT, Lima PG, Carneiro RF, Nagano CS, Maia DCBSC, Montenegro RC, Cardoso MH, Mesquita FP, Franco OL, Souza PFN.
articles.abstract: Candida albicans is a major opportunistic human pathogen, frequently implicated in infections with increasing antifungal resistance. As such, the search for new therapeutic alternatives is essential. Therefore, synthetic antimicrobial peptides (SAMPs) have emerged as promising alternatives because resistance development against these molecules appears to occur less frequently than against many conventional antimicrobial drugs. Here, the mechanisms of action of the chitinase-derived synthetic peptide PepGAT, which is bioinspired by the chitinase of Arabidopsis thaliana, were evaluated against C. albicans. Proteomic analysis, enzymatic activity assays, ergosterol interaction studies, and membrane permeability assessments were performed to provide insights into how PepGAT affects C. albicans. Proteomic analysis revealed that PepGAT alters the protein profile of C. albicans cells, disrupting several key pathways involved in cell development, lipid metabolism, and drug resistance. Moreover, PepGAT decreased superoxide dismutase (SOD) activity while increasing catalase (CAT) activity, suggesting an impact on the cellular redox system. Additionally, PepGAT inhibits ergosterol biosynthesis, potentially leading to the formation of membrane pores with a size of at least 6 kDa, as suggested by fluorescence microscopy. Altogether, these findings indicate that PepGAT exhibits multiple mechanisms of action against C. albicans, highlighting its potential as an alternative antifungal agent.
articles.abstractZh: 白色念珠菌是一种主要的机会性人类病原体，经常与抗真菌耐药性增加的感染有关。因此，寻找新的治疗替代方案至关重要。因此，合成抗菌肽 (SAMP) 已成为有前景的替代品，因为与许多传统抗菌药物相比，针对这些分子的耐药性出现频率似乎较低。在此，我们评估了几丁质酶衍生的合成肽 PepGAT（受拟南芥几丁质酶的生物启发）针对白色念珠菌的作用机制。进行了蛋白质组分析、酶活性测定、麦角甾醇相互作用研究和膜通透性评估，以深入了解 PepGAT 如何影响白色念珠菌。蛋白质组学分析表明，PepGAT 改变了白色念珠菌细胞的蛋白质谱，破坏了涉及细胞发育、脂质代谢和耐药性的几个关键途径。此外，PepGAT 降低了超氧化物歧化酶 (SOD) 活性，同时增加了过氧化氢酶 (CAT) 活性，表明对细胞氧化还原系统有影响。此外，PepGAT 抑制麦角甾醇生物合成

articles.title: A targeted drug-repurposing strategy identifies Tavaborole <i>(Kerydin)</i> as a potent fungistatic agent against <i>Candida auris</i>.
articles.titleZh: 靶向药物再利用策略将 Tavaborole (Kerydin) 确定为针对耳念珠菌的有效抑菌剂。
articles.authors: Mazumdar R, Bjelanovic A.
articles.abstract: Candida auris is an emerging multidrug-resistant fungal pathogen posing a major global health threat. In this study, we employed a targeted drug-repurposing strategy to identify novel indications for existing FDA-approved compounds against C. auris, leading to the identification of Tavaborole as a potent fungistatic agent. Tavaborole displayed robust activity across all five tested clades of C. auris, as well as against Candida albicans and Candida glabrata. To investigate drug resistance mechanisms of C. auris, we applied quantitative proteomics analyses following exposure to Tavaborole and Amphotericin B (AmB), complemented by electron microscopy. Proteomic profiling revealed that C. auris mounts distinct but overlapping adaptive responses to antifungal stress, involving stress response pathways, metabolic reprogramming and amino acid biosynthesis. While Tavaborole primarily induced targeted stress adaptation, AmB triggered a broader, multi-pronged resistance response including oxidative stress mitigation, osmolyte production and metabolic remodeling. Shared alterations in glycogen metabolism and amino acid biosynthesis suggest conserved antifungal adaptation mechanisms. Altogether, this study highlights Tavaborole as a promising antifungal candidate against C. auris, sheds novel insights into drug resistance mechanisms employed by the pathogen and delivers a drug-repurposing procedure highly customizable to target other microorganisms.
articles.abstractZh: 耳念珠菌是一种新兴的多重耐药真菌病原体，对全球健康构成重大威胁。在这项研究中，我们采用了靶向药物再利用策略来确定 FDA 批准的现有抗耳念珠菌化合物的新适应症，从而确定 Tavaborole 作为一种有效的抑菌剂。 Tavaborole 在所有五个测试的耳念珠菌分支以及针对白色念珠菌和光滑念珠菌中均表现出强大的活性。为了研究耳念珠菌的耐药机制，我们在接触 Tavaborole 和两性霉素 B (AmB) 后应用定量蛋白质组学分析，并辅以电子显微镜。蛋白质组分析表明，耳念珠菌对抗真菌应激产生独特但重叠的适应性反应，包括应激反应途径、代谢重编程和氨基酸生物合成。 Tavaborole 主要诱导有针对性的应激适应，而 AmB 则引发更广泛、多管齐下的抵抗反应，包括氧化应激缓解、渗透剂产生和代谢重塑。糖原代谢和氨基酸生物合成的共同改变表明保守的抗真菌适应机制。总而言之

articles.title: Castor RcnsLTPC Confers Salt Tolerance in Yeast and Tobacco with Synergistic Enhancement by ZnO-NPs Priming.
articles.titleZh: Castor RcnsLTPC 通过 ZnO-NPs 引发的协同增强赋予酵母和烟草耐盐性。
articles.authors: Han P, Gao B, Han Y, Li Y, Wang J, Lin J.
articles.abstract: Soil salinity severely restricts castor (Ricinus communis L.) seed germination, yet the molecular basis of this trait remains poorly understood. Here, we identified and functionally characterized RcnsLTPC, a nonspecific lipid transfer protein gene strongly induced by salt stress, which encodes a plasma membrane-localized nsLTP1 protein. Promoter analyses indicated that RcnsLTPC is responsive to stress-, hormone-, and light-related signals, supporting its potential role in environmental adaptation. Heterologous expression in Saccharomyces cerevisiae and overexpression in Nicotiana tabacum consistently demonstrated that RcnsLTPC acts as a positive regulator of salt tolerance, improving germination, root development, biomass accumulation, antioxidant capacity, and ion homeostasis under NaCl stress. Notably, ZnO-NPs priming further amplified the protective effects of RcnsLTPC, suggesting a synergistic interaction between nanopriming and gene-mediated stress adaptation. Collectively, these findings establish RcnsLTPC as a key regulator of salt tolerance in castor and provide a conceptual basis for combining nanotechnology with genetic enhancement to improve crop performance on saline soils.
articles.abstractZh: 土壤盐分严重限制蓖麻种子的萌发，但人们对这一性状的分子基础仍知之甚少。在这里，我们鉴定并功能表征了 RcnsLTPC，这是一种由盐胁迫强烈诱导的非特异性脂质转移蛋白基因，它编码质膜定位的 nsLTP1 蛋白。启动子分析表明，RcnsLTPC 对压力、激素和光相关信号有反应，支持其在环境适应中的潜在作用。酿酒酵母中的异源表达和烟草中的过度表达一致证明，RcnsLTPC 作为耐盐性的正调节剂，可改善 NaCl 胁迫下的发芽、根部发育、生物量积累、抗氧化能力和离子稳态。值得注意的是，ZnO-NPs 引发进一步放大了 RcnsLTPC 的保护作用，表明纳米引发和基因介导的应激适应之间存在协同相互作用。总的来说，这些发现确立了 RcnsLTPC 作为蓖麻耐盐性的关键调节剂，并为将纳米技术与遗传增强相结合以提高作物耐盐性的性能提供了概念基础。

articles.title: Development of a noncanonical redox cofactor platform in Saccharomyces cerevisiae.
articles.titleZh: 酿酒酵母非经典氧化还原辅因子平台的开发。
articles.authors: Black WB, McKee K, Richardson KN, Saleh S, Gednov M, Si A, Li H.
articles.abstract: Saccharomyces cerevisiae is a keystone host for biomanufacturing, yet its metabolic engineering is often complicated by the crosstalk between heterologous pathways and native metabolism. In particular, allocating and balancing the universal reducing equivalents nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (phosphate) (NAD(P)H) typically requires laborious genetic modifications. To address this challenge, we established an orthogonal redox cofactor infrastructure in S. cerevisiae based on nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN(H)), which is decoupled from the host's NAD(P)H-based metabolism. Because NMN(H)-dependent pathway networks comprise only a small number of user-defined reactions, their optimization is substantially simplified. First, by rewiring glycolysis to eliminate NAD(P)H generation from glucose, we repurposed glucose as a dedicated electron source for NMNH reducing power. We then demonstrated that NMN(H) selectively drives the reduction of citral to citronellal, both unstable aldehydes, while suppressing the rapid over-reduction to alcohols observed with native cofactors without identifying or disrupting the numerous endogenous alcohol dehydrogenases in resting S. cerevisiae cells. Finally, we engineer S. cerevisiae to accumulate an intracellular NMN+ pool of ∼2.9 mM, comparable to NAD+ intracellular levels, enabling the first self-sustained, new-to-nature redox cofactor system in a eukaryotic organism. This work establishes NMN(H) as a functional third nicotinamide-based redox cofactor in yeast and provides a generalizable eukaryotic platform for orthogonal redox biocatalysis.
articles.abstractZh: 酿酒酵母是生物制造的关键宿主，但其代谢工程通常因异源途径和天然代谢之间的串扰而变得复杂。特别是，分配和平衡通用还原当量烟酰胺腺嘌呤二核苷酸（磷酸盐）（NAD(P)H）通常需要费力的基因改造。为了应对这一挑战，我们在酿酒酵母中建立了基于烟酰胺单核苷酸 (NMN(H)) 的正交氧化还原辅因子基础设施，该基础设施与宿主基于 NAD(P)H 的代谢分离。由于 NMN(H) 依赖的通路网络仅包含少量用户定义的反应，因此它们的优化大大简化。首先，通过重新连接糖酵解以消除葡萄糖中 NAD(P)H 的产生，我们将葡萄糖重新用作 NMNH 还原能力的专用电子源。然后我们证明，NMN(H) 选择性地驱动柠檬醛还原为香茅醛（两种不稳定的醛），同时抑制用天然辅因子观察到的醇的快速过度还原，而不会识别或破坏静止酿酒酵母细胞中的众多内源醇脱氢酶。鳍

articles.title: Development of advanced bioinformatic profiles to improve the detection and functional understanding of fungal acid phosphatases.
articles.titleZh: 开发先进的生物信息学概况，以提高真菌酸性磷酸酶的检测和功能理解。
articles.authors: Gómez-Gallego T, Udaondo Z, Palacios-Ferrer R, Díaz-Martínez L, Ramos JL.
articles.abstract: We have retrieved approximately 9,000 protein sequences annotated as fungal acid phosphatase or phytase from the UniProtKB database. Following stringent quality filtering, a curated dataset comprising 3,058 high-confidence sequences was assembled. Phylogenetic analysis resolved these enzymes into eight distinct clades, representing distinct groups of fungal acid phosphatases: purple acid phosphatases, phytases, and groups containing both phytases and acid phosphatases annotations. Based on this classification, we have developed three representative protein profiles referred to as Prf-A-Fungal_phos, Prf-B-Fungal_phos, and Prf-C-Fungal_phos, each designed to capture the phylogenetic and functional diversity of these enzyme families. Heat-map analyses confirmed the breadth and high specificity of these profiles. Application of these profiles to public protein and metagenomic databases enabled the identification of hundreds of previously uncharacterized fungal proteins, with a broad taxonomic distribution and notable prevalence in the Ascomycota and Basidiomycota phyla. Functional validation through heterologous expression of selected candidates in Saccharomyces cerevisiae confirmed their phosphatase activity, supporting the accuracy of the in silico predictions. By integrating large-scale bioinformatics with experimental validation, this study provides robust tools for the discovery of novel fungal phosphatases and for investigation of their ecological roles in nutrient-limited environments.IMPORTANCEFungal acid phosphatases are critical enzymes in global phosphorus cycling, yet no dedicated bioinformatic tools exist to comprehensively identify and classify them across fungal diversity. Here, we present the first PROSITE generalized profiles specific to fungal acid phosphatases, derived from a curated data set of over 3,000 high-confidence sequences spanning eight phylogenetic groups. These profiles exhibit high specificity and sensitivity, enabling the detection of hundreds of previously uncharacterized proteins from public protein databases. Experimental expression of representative candidates in Saccharomyces cerevisiae confirmed their phosphatase activity, validating our in silico predictions. By bridging large-scale bioinformatics with functional validation, this study delivers robust resources to uncover novel fungal phosphatases and to explore their ecological roles in nutrient-limited environments. The developed profiles will advance metagenomic annotation, support soil and environmental microbiology research, and foster biotechnological innovation in sustainable phosphorus management.
articles.abstractZh: 我们从 UniProtKB 数据库中检索了大约 9,000 个注释为真菌酸性磷酸酶或植酸酶的蛋白质序列。经过严格的质量过滤后，我们组装了包含 3,058 个高置信度序列的精选数据集。系统发育分析将这些酶分解为八个不同的进化枝，代表不同的真菌酸性磷酸酶组：紫色酸性磷酸酶、植酸酶以及同时包含植酸酶和酸性磷酸酶注释的组。基于这种分类，我们开发了三种代表性的蛋白质谱，称为 Prf-A-Fungal_phos、Prf-B-Fungal_phos 和 Prf-C-Fungal_phos，每种蛋白质谱旨在捕获这些酶家族的系统发育和功能多样性。热图分析证实了这些概况的广度和高度特异性。将这些图谱应用于公共蛋白质和宏基因组数据库，能够鉴定出数百种以前未表征的真菌蛋白质，这些蛋白质在子囊菌门和担子菌门中具有广泛的分类分布和显着的流行率。通过在酿酒酵母中异源表达所选候选物进行的功能验证证实了这一点

articles.title: Disruption of the <i>UPC2</i> Gene Enhances Fluconazole Antifungal Activity by Inhibiting <i>HAC1</i> mRNA Splicing in <i>Candida albicans</i>.
articles.titleZh: 白色念珠菌中 UPC2 基因的破坏通过抑制 HAC1 mRNA 剪接增强氟康唑抗真菌活性。
articles.authors: Yu J, Jiang B, Xiong J, Xu X, Xu L, Jiang Y, Lu H.
articles.abstract: Azole resistance in Candida albicans is an increasing clinical challenge. Upc2 is a key transcription factor regulating ergosterol biosynthesis, but its additional roles in azole tolerance remain unclear. This study investigated whether Upc2 contributes to azole resistance through pathways beyond ergosterol synthesis. Chemical sensitivity screening, RNA sequencing, flow cytometry, and molecular assays were performed to compare wild-type C. albicans and the upc2Δ/upc2Δ mutant under fluconazole (FLC) treatment. The UPC2 gene deletion affected physiological processes that are dependent on the calcineurin signaling pathway and led to an overall negative enrichment trend in the unfolded protein response (UPR) pathway gene set. Mechanistically, the UPC2 gene deletion impaired unconventional splicing of HAC1 mRNA, leading to accumulation of unfolded proteins and phenotypically its deletion enhanced sensitivity of C. albicans to FLC in planktonic growth, hyphal development, and biofilm formation. Our findings reveal that Upc2 regulates proteostasis in C. albicans, and its absence enhances FLC efficacy by disrupting the UPR pathway. Targeting Upc2-mediated UPR signaling may represent a promising strategy to combat azole resistance.
articles.abstractZh: 白色念珠菌的唑耐药性是一个日益严峻的临床挑战。 Upc2 是调节麦角甾醇生物合成的关键转录因子，但其在唑类耐受中的其他作用仍不清楚。本研究调查了 Upc2 是否通过麦角甾醇合成以外的途径导致唑类耐药。通过化学敏感性筛选、RNA 测序、流式细胞术和分子测定来比较野生型白色念珠菌和氟康唑 (FLC) 处理下的 upc2Δ/upc2Δ 突变体。 UPC2 基因缺失影响了依赖于钙调神经磷酸酶信号通路的生理过程，并导致未折叠蛋白反应 (UPR) 通路基因组的总体负富集趋势。从机制上讲，UPC2 基因缺失损害了 HAC1 mRNA 的非常规剪接，导致未折叠蛋白的积累，并且在表型上，其缺失增强了白色念珠菌在浮游生长、菌丝发育和生物膜形成中对 FLC 的敏感性。我们的研究结果表明，Upc2 调节白色念珠菌中的蛋白质稳态，其缺失可通过破坏 UPR 途径来增强 FLC 功效。靶向 Upc2 介导的 UPR 信号传导可能代表一个舞会

articles.title: Energy-translation coupling limits anaerobic yeast growth.
articles.titleZh: 能量转化耦合限制了厌氧酵母的生长。
articles.authors: Wang Y, Huang Y, Liu Y, Chen L, Yu X, Shao Z, Chen Y, Li F, Qiu S, Wang Y, Zhuang Y, Wang G.
articles.abstract: Understanding how nutrient-specific limitations shape anaerobic metabolism in Saccharomyces cerevisiae is essential for defining the physiological limits of yeast growth. Integrating chemostat physiology, multi-omic profiling, and targeted metabolic engineering under strictly anaerobic conditions, we show that yeast maintains a conserved maximum glucose uptake (~14 mmol/gDW/h) under carbon (C), nitrogen (N), and phosphorus (P) limitation, while distinct regulatory bottlenecks constrain maximal growth rate: ATP insufficiency under C and P limitation, and aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase scarcity under N limitation. Under these stresses, S. cerevisiae reallocates proteomic resources toward anabolic functions, with nutrient-specific phosphorylation networks compensating for translational stress, most pronounced under N limitation. Building on these insights, a "push-pull" strategy enhancing energy supply (VMA3) and translational capacity (WRS1) increased the maximal anaerobic growth rate by 27.2%, 47.5% and 52.5% under C, N, and P limitation, respectively. These findings reveal energy-translation coupling as the central determinant of anaerobic growth limits and provide a framework for rational strain engineering.
articles.abstractZh: 了解营养特异性限制如何影响酿酒酵母的厌氧代谢对于确定酵母生长的生理极限至关重要。综合恒化器生理学、多组学分析和严格厌氧条件下的靶向代谢工程，我们发现酵母在碳（C）、氮（N）和磷（P）限制下保持保守的最大葡萄糖摄取（~14 mmol/gDW/h），而不同的调节瓶颈限制了最大生长速率：C和P限制下ATP不足，N下氨酰-tRNA合成酶稀缺限制。在这些压力下，酿酒酵母将蛋白质组资源重新分配给合成代谢功能，并用营养特异性磷酸化网络补偿翻译压力，在氮限制下最明显。基于这些见解，增强能量供应 (VMA3) 和转化能力 (WRS1) 的“推拉”策略在 C、N 和 P 限制下分别将最大无氧增长率提高了 27.2%、47.5% 和 52.5%。这些发现揭示了能量转化耦合是厌氧生长限制的核心决定因素，并为比率提供了一个框架

articles.title: LaWRKY23 and LaWRKY65 negatively regulate key terpene synthases (LaTPS39) to repress sesquiterpenoid biosynthesis in Lindera aggregata.
articles.titleZh: LaWRKY23 和 LaWRKY65 负向调节关键萜烯合酶 (LaTPS39)，以抑制乌药中的倍半萜生物合成。
articles.authors: Shi Y, Zhang S, Wei L, Xiao W, Huang J, He F, Chen Y, Chen Z, Zeng W.
articles.abstract: Lindera aggregata is a traditional Chinese medicine with sesquiterpenoids as key bioactive components. Although its genome has been published, the pivotal metabolic genes involved in sesquiterpenoid biosynthesis and their transcriptional regulation remain to be elucidated. This study explored sesquiterpenoid synthesis regulation via multi-omics. Headspace Solid Phase Micro-extraction Gas Chromatography-Mass Spectrometry (HS-SPME-GC-MS) identified 69 sesquiterpenoids, and the roots showed the highest accumulation. Genome-wide analysis revealed 64 terpene synthase (TPS) genes. LaTPS25, LaTPS35, and LaTPS39 were functionally validated to catalyze farnesyl pyrophosphate into sesquiterpenes, such as β-selinene and germacrene D, through in vitro assays and molecular docking. Weighted Gene Co-expression Network Analysis (WGCNA) identified LaTPS39 as a hub gene regulated by three WRKY transcription factors. Yeast One-Hybrid (Y1H), Dual-Luciferase Reporter Assay, and Electrophoretic Mobility Shift Assay (EMSA) confirmed that LaWRKY23 and LaWRKY65 directly bind to the W-box within the LaTPS39 promoter, potentially negatively regulating its expression and inhibiting sesquiterpenoid synthesis. These findings clarify the regulatory mechanism underlying sesquiterpenoid biosynthesis in L. aggregata.
articles.abstractZh: 乌药是一种以倍半萜类化合物为主要生物活性成分的中药。尽管其基因组已公布，但参与倍半萜生物合成的关键代谢基因及其转录调控仍有待阐明。本研究通过多组学探索倍半萜类化合物的合成调控。顶空固相微萃取气相色谱-质谱联用仪(HS-SPME-GC-MS)鉴定出69种倍半萜类化合物，其中根部积累量最高。全基因组分析揭示了 64 个萜烯合酶 (TPS) 基因。通过体外测定和分子对接，对 LaTPS25、LaTPS35 和 LaTPS39 进行了功能验证，可催化法呢基焦磷酸转化为倍半萜，例如 β-selinene 和 germacrene D。加权基因共表达网络分析 (WGCNA) 确定 LaTPS39 是受三个 WRKY 转录因子调控的枢纽基因。酵母单杂交 (Y1H)、双荧光素酶报告基因检测和电泳迁移率变化检测 (EMSA) 证实 LaWRKY23 和 LaWRKY65 直接与 LaTPS39 启动子内的 W-box 结合，可能负向调节其表达并抑制倍半萜类化合物的合成。

articles.title: Metabolic engineering of <i>Vibrio natriegens</i> for the efficient biosynthesis of ergothioneine from sucrose using non-sterile fed-batch fermentation.
articles.titleZh: 纳特里根弧菌的代谢工程，利用非无菌补料分批发酵从蔗糖中高效生物合成麦角硫因。
articles.authors: Liang X, Wang Y, Lv Y, Huang C, Huang Z, Wei J, Jiang S, Dong Z, Zhou Z, Lin M.
articles.abstract: Fast-growing Vibrio natriegens is now recognized as a next-generation chassis for synthetic biology and biotechnology; however, its low transformation efficiency, limited gene editing methods and high fermentation cost are still the main challenges hampering its industrial application. In this study, we established an efficient electroporation transformation and dual-plasmid CRISPR-Cas9 editing system in V. natriegens. Subsequently, the heterologous ergothioneine biosynthetic pathway involving the combination of the superstrong PL lacO1 promoter and weak RBS7 was constructed in V. natriegens. Multiple genes encoding genes involved in byproduct formation and adenosine triphosphate (ATP) degradation were consecutively deleted, while several key genes involved in the S-adenosylmethionine (SAM) cycle and the ATP synthesis pathway were overexpressed to increase ergothioneine production. Finally, fed-batch fermentation was performed using low-cost sucrose as the sole carbon source under high-salinity, non-sterile conditions, resulting in an ergothioneine titer of 1.2 g/L in a 2-L bioreactor. This study not only provides the first successful example of the ergothioneine biosynthesis with engineered V. natriegens strains but also establishes an efficient and economic platform in which V. natriegens is used to produce other high-value compounds.
articles.abstractZh: 快速生长的自然弧菌现已被公认为合成生物学和生物技术的下一代基础；然而，其转化效率低、基因编辑方法有限和发酵成本高仍然是阻碍其工业化应用的主要挑战。在本研究中，我们在V. natriegens中建立了高效的电穿孔转化和双质粒CRISPR-Cas9编辑系统。随后，在V. natriegens中构建了涉及超强PL lacO1启动子和弱RBS7组合的异源麦角硫因生物合成途径。编码参与副产物形成和三磷酸腺苷（ATP）降解的多个基因被连续删除，而参与S-腺苷甲硫氨酸（SAM）循环和ATP合成途径的几个关键基因被过表达以增加麦角硫因的产量。最后，使用低成本蔗糖作为唯一碳源在高盐度、非无菌条件下进行补料分批发酵，在2L生物反应器中产生1.2g/L的麦角硫因效价。该研究不仅提供了麦角硫因生物合成的第一个成功范例

articles.title: Optimization of solid-state fermentation process of diets and its effects on growth performance and intestinal function in growing pigs.
articles.titleZh: 日粮固态发酵工艺优化及其对生长猪生长性能和肠道功能的影响
articles.authors: Ji M, Liu J, Wang Q, Gong T, Zhang J, Li M, Guo X, Yang Y, Li B.
articles.abstract: BackgroundBiological fermentation can improve animal growth performance and meat quality by optimizing feed nutritional properties. However, the complex fermentation parameters require further systematic optimization. This study aimed to establish and optimize a solid-state fermentation (SSF) process, evaluate changes in the feed microbial community and flavor metabolites, and investigate their effects on muscle development and intestinal barrier function in growing pigs. Here, we developed a synergistic SSF strategy for pig feed using combinations of 4 probiotics and 11 enzymatic preparations, 16S rDNA-seq and flavoromics-seq were employed to investigate the dynamic changes in microbial communities and flavor compounds post-fermentation. Subsequently, 32 Duroc × Jinfen White pigs were fed diets containing 10% SSF to assess growth performance, intestinal health and muscle development.ResultsThe optimal fermentation ratio of Bacillus subtilis, Lactobacillus plantarum, Saccharomyces cerevisiae and Aspergillus niger is 1:2:3:3, with a temperature of 36 °C, an inoculation rate of 93%, a moisture content of 72%, and a time of 4.1 days. SSF significantly enhanced the nutritional value of feed by increasing the ash, organic matter (OM), crude protein (CP), and ether extract (EE) content, while simultaneously reducing the concentration of anti-nutritional factors. Sequencing identified 17 differential microbes and 116 flavor compounds, with the relative abundance of Lactobacillus and the Firmicutes significantly increased, 2-octenal and vanillin imparting sweet, fruity, and grassy notes to the feed. Meanwhile, RNA-seq revealed 320 DEGs in muscle tissue following fermented feed supplementation, which are mainly enriched in pathways related to cytochrome P450 drug metabolism and arginine biosynthesis. Additionally, H&E staining results indicated that fermentation significantly increased the villus height, crypt depth, and villus-to-crypt ratio in the small intestine of growing pigs, and the levels of tight junction proteins Claudin-1 and ZO-1 in the jejunum were significantly higher than those in the ctrl group. Subsequent correlation analysis indicated that Firmicutes may influence pig growth performance and IL-6, TNF-α levels by affecting their metabolites.ConclusionOur findings establish and optimize an SSF process that markedly elevates feed nutritional value, enriches beneficial microbes, and fosters the production of unique flavor metabolites. When fed to growing pigs, it effectively enhances growth performance and antioxidant capacity while improving small-intestinal morphology and barrier function.
articles.abstractZh: 研究背景生物发酵可以通过优化饲料营养特性来提高动物生长性能和肉品质。然而，复杂的发酵参数需要进一步系统优化。本研究旨在建立和优化固态发酵（SSF）工艺，评估饲料微生物群落和风味代谢物的变化，并研究它们对生长猪肌肉发育和肠道屏障功能的影响。在这里，我们使用 4 种益生菌和 11 种酶制剂的组合开发了一种猪饲料协同 SSF 策略，采用 16S rDNA-seq 和风味组学-seq 来研究发酵后微生物群落和风味化合物的动态变化。随后，对32头杜洛克×金粉白猪饲喂含10%SSF的日粮，评估其生长性能、肠道健康和肌肉发育。结果枯草芽孢杆菌、植物乳杆菌、酿酒酵母和黑曲霉的最佳发酵比例为1:2:3:3，温度36℃，接种率93%，水分含量72%，时间4.1天。 SSF显着提高了营养价值

articles.title: Peroxisomal Surface Display of Cat2 in <i>Yarrowia lipolytica</i> Enhances the Biosynthesis Acetyl-CoA-Derived Chemicals.
articles.titleZh: 解脂耶氏酵母中 Cat2 的过氧化物酶体表面展示增强了乙酰辅酶 A 衍生化学品的生物合成。
articles.journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
articles.authors: Che J, Liu X, Chai L, Zhou S, Qi Q, Liang Q, Hou J.
articles.abstract: The oleaginous yeast Yarrowia lipolytica is an outstanding chassis for producing high-value chemicals. Its highly active β-oxidation pathway generates a substantial pool of acetyl-CoA within peroxisomes; however, this abundant reservoir remains largely underutilized. Here, we developed a peroxisomal surface-display platform in Y. lipolytica, enabling enhanced biosynthesis of acetyl-CoA-derived chemicals. We first identified three peroxisomal membrane-targeting signals, derived from Pex3, Pex22, and Pex26 for protein display on the cytosolic face of the peroxisome. By anchoring the carnitine acetyl-CoA transferase Cat2 via these membrane-targeting signals, peroxisomal acetyl-CoA was redirected to the cytosol, increasing acetyl-CoA level and mevalonate production up to 2.4-fold and 2.9-fold, respectively. Further engineering improved squalene titers by 47% to 1.62 g/L. The same platform applied to 3-hydroxypropionic acid biosynthesis improved its production by 22% to 12.85 g/L. Our study establishes a peroxisomal surface display platform for harnessing subcellular acetyl-CoA and provides a versatile toolkit for subcellular engineering in Y. lipolytica.
articles.abstractZh: 产油酵母解脂耶氏酵母是生产高价值化学品的杰出基质。其高度活跃的β-氧化途径在过氧化物酶体内产生大量乙酰辅酶A；然而，这一丰富的水库在很大程度上仍未得到充分利用。在这里，我们在解脂耶氏酵母中开发了一个过氧化物酶体表面展示平台，能够增强乙酰辅酶A衍生化学物质的生物合成。我们首先鉴定了来自 Pex3、Pex22 和 Pex26 的三种过氧化物酶体膜靶向信号，用于在过氧化物酶体的胞质表面上展示蛋白质。通过这些膜靶向信号锚定肉毒碱乙酰辅酶A转移酶Cat2，过氧化物酶体乙酰辅酶A被重定向到胞质溶胶，使乙酰辅酶A水平和甲羟戊酸产量分别增加至2.4倍和2.9倍。进一步的工程设计将角鲨烯滴度提高了 47%，达到 1.62 g/L。同样的平台应用于 3-羟基丙酸生物合成，其产量提高了 22%，达到 12.85 g/L。我们的研究建立了一个用于利用亚细胞乙酰辅酶A的过氧化物酶体表面展示平台，并为解脂耶氏酵母的亚细胞工程提供了多功能工具包。

articles.title: Synergistic enhancement of wine aroma and color through co-fermentation with selected indigenous β-glucosidase-producing Hanseniaspora occidentalis.
articles.titleZh: 通过与精选的本地产生 β-葡萄糖苷酶的西汉逊酵母共同发酵，协同增强葡萄酒的香气和颜色。
articles.authors: Fan L, Bai H, Wang Y, Liu Z.
articles.abstract: To address the two major challenges in the Chinese wine industry-flavor homogenization and limited aroma expression-this study investigated indigenous non-Saccharomyces yeasts from Huailai vineyards, evaluating their β-glucosidase activity, stress tolerance, and fermentation performance. Screening of 112 strains from nine genera identified several isolates with high β-glucosidase activity (up to 176.68 U/mL), predominantly belonging to Hanseniaspora occidentalis (H. occidentalis) and Metschnikowia pulcherrima (M. pulcherrima). Based on comprehensive stress tolerance and color stability across different inoculation strategies, two H. occidentalis strains (M23 and S19k) were selected for in-depth fermentation and sensory analysis. Wines produced via sequential inoculation showed significantly enhanced aroma complexity, with 71 volatile compounds and elevated esters/terpenes. Principal component analysis associated these profiles with fruity/floral notes (OAV > 1). β-Glucosidase activity positively correlated with red color intensity. Simultaneous inoculation achieved the highest a⁎ values (61.34) and increased anthocyanin concentration. Sensory evaluation favored sequential fermentations for fruity (7.8) and floral (7.5) attributes. This work provides a strain-specific strategy using selected H. occidentalis isolates to improve regional wine typicity through optimized fermentation protocols.
articles.abstractZh: 为了解决中国葡萄酒行业的两大挑战——风味均质化和香气表达有限——本研究调查了怀来葡萄园的本土非酿酒酵母，评估其β-葡萄糖苷酶活性、胁迫耐受性和发酵性能。对 9 个属的 112 株菌株进行筛选，鉴定出几个具有高 β-葡萄糖苷酶活性（高达 176.68 U/mL）的分离株，主要属于西汉逊酵母 (H. occidentalis) 和一品梅奇尼科维亚 (M. pulcherrima)。基于不同接种策略下的综合胁迫耐受性和颜色稳定性，选择两种H. occidentalis菌株（M23和S19k）进行深度发酵和感官分析。通过连续接种生产的葡萄酒显示出显着增强的香气复杂性，其中含有 71 种挥发性化合物和更高的酯/萜烯含量。主成分分析将这些特征与果香/花香相关联 (OAV > 1)。 β-葡萄糖苷酶活性与红色强度呈正相关。同时接种获得了最高的 a⁎ 值（61.34）并增加了花青素浓度。感官评价有利于连续发酵罐

articles.title: Time-delayed activator-repressor regulation of ginsenoside biosynthesis in Gynostemma pentaphyllum.
articles.titleZh: 绞股蓝中人参皂苷生物合成的延时激活剂-阻遏剂调节。
articles.authors: Huang L, Du J, Chen Y, Jin D, Zhao Y, Xing X, Wang L, Wang Y, Zhou P, Zhao Y, Li P, Lu X.
articles.abstract: Jasmonic acid (JA) signaling is a key regulator of plant secondary metabolism, yet how it balances rapid activation with timely repression of ginsenoside biosynthesis remains unclear in Gynostemma pentaphyllum. Here, we investigated the transcriptional regulation mechanism of ginsenoside biosynthesis by JA-responsive basic helix-loop-helix (bHLH) transcription factors. By integrating transcriptome and phylogenetic analyses with yeast one-hybrid, electrophoretic mobility shift assays, dual-luciferase assays, transgenic hairy root overexpression, and RNA interference, together with metabolite profiling, we identified key regulators and defined their roles in the ginsenoside biosynthesis pathway of G. pentaphyllum. We characterized an antagonistic bHLH pair, GpGAB (g36559, Activator), and GpGIB (g21771, Inhibitor). GpGAB activated ginsenoside biosynthetic genes GpDS, GpPPDS, and GpUGT94AT1, whereas GpGIB repressed the expression of GpDS and GpPPDS. GpGAB also upregulated the expression of GpGIB, with GpGAB responding earlier than GpGIB to JA treatment. Taken together, our results support a model in which GpGAB and GpGIB form a time-delayed negative feedback loop that fine-tunes ginsenoside biosynthesis after JA induction, providing a mechanistic framework for dynamic transcriptional regulation of ginsenoside in G. pentaphyllum.
articles.abstractZh: 茉莉酸 (JA) 信号是植物次生代谢的关键调节因子，但绞股蓝中茉莉酸 (JA) 信号如何平衡快速激活与及时抑制人参皂苷生物合成仍不清楚。在这里，我们研究了 JA 响应性碱性螺旋-环-螺旋 (bHLH) 转录因子对人参皂苷生物合成的转录调控机制。通过将转录组和系统发育分析与酵母单杂交、电泳迁移率变动测定、双荧光素酶测定、转基因毛状根过表达和RNA干扰以及代谢物分析相结合，我们鉴定了关键调节因子并确定了它们在G. pentaphyllum人参皂苷生物合成途径中的作用。我们鉴定了拮抗性 bHLH 对：GpGAB（g36559，激活剂）和 GpGIB（g21771，抑制剂）。 GpGAB 激活人参皂苷生物合成基因 GpDS、GpPPDS 和 GpUGT94AT1，而 GpGIB 抑制 GpDS 和 GpPPDS 的表达。 GpGAB 还上调了 GpGIB 的表达，且 GpGAB 对 JA 治疗的反应早于 GpGIB。总而言之，我们的结果支持一个模型，其中 GpGAB 和 GpGIB 形成一个延时负反馈循环，可以微调人参

articles.title: Enhancing 3-hydroxypropionic acid production in Komagataella phaffii via methanol and formate co-feeding.
articles.titleZh: 通过甲醇和甲酸共饲提高 Komagataella phaffii 中 3-羟基丙酸的产量。
articles.authors: Ul Z, Vázquez F, Sulonen M, Albiol J, Baeza JA, Ferrer P, Guisasola A.
articles.abstract: Komagataella phaffii is a promising cell factory that can use CO2 derived methanol, a sustainable carbon (C1) source, for chemical production. Introducing the ß-alanine biosynthetic pathway alongside a NADP+-dependent formate dehydrogenase (FDH) in K. phaffii enables the production of the platform chemical 3-hydroxypropionic acid (3-HP). Co-feeding of formate and methanol (MeOH) was systematically explored to enhance cellular reducing power and improve 3-HP biosynthesis. Implementing a pulsed formate strategy alongside MeOH resulted in up to a 20.7% increase in 3-HP per gram of MeOH (Yg3-HP gMeOH-1) compared to MeOH alone in shake flask cultivations. This co-feeding strategy likely enhanced NADPH availability through formate oxidation via the introduced NADP⁺-dependent FDH, thereby improving redox balance, as supported by simulation studies based on the K. phaffii genome-scale metabolic model. Similar improvements were demonstrated in repeated batch cultivations at 1-L bioreactor scale, where a formate pulse every 4-hour led to a 25.8% increase in Yg3-HP gMeOH-1 and a 41% increase in volumetric productivity over the control without formate (only MeOH). In addition to the feeding strategy, pH regulation also played a crucial mechanistic role: strict pH control at 5 inhibited growth, due to the predominance of undissociated formic acid, whereas allowing the pH to rise to 6-7 favoured dissociation and supported higher productivity. These findings elucidate the pH dependent nature of formate assimilation and highlight the potential of coupling MeOH and formate co-utilization with dynamic feeding and pH strategies to enhance bioproduction in K. phaffii.
articles.abstractZh: Komagataella phaffii 是一种很有前途的细胞工厂，可以使用二氧化碳衍生的甲醇（一种可持续的碳 (C1) 源）进行化学生产。在 K. phaffii 中引入 β-丙氨酸生物合成途径以及 NADP+ 依赖性甲酸脱氢酶 (FDH)，可以生产平台化学品 3-羟基丙酸 (3-HP)。系统地探索了甲酸和甲醇 (MeOH) 的共饲以增强细胞还原能力并改善 3-HP 生物合成。在摇瓶培养中，与单独使用 MeOH 相比，与 MeOH 一起实施脉冲甲酸策略可使每克 MeOH (Yg3-HP gMeOH-1) 的 3-HP 增加 20.7%。这种共同喂养策略可能通过引入 NADP⁺ 依赖的 FDH 通过甲酸氧化来增强 NADPH 的可用性，从而改善氧化还原平衡，这一点得到了基于 K. phaffii 基因组规模代谢模型的模拟研究的支持。在 1 L 生物反应器规模的重复分批培养中也证明了类似的改进，其中每 4 小时一次甲酸盐脉冲导致 Yg3-HP gMeOH-1 比不含甲酸盐的对照（仅 MeOH）增加 25.8%，体积生产率增加 41%。除了饲喂站

articles.title: Fermented feed-rumen microbiota axis mediates goat kid growth via microbial amino acid synthesis and ruminal epithelial energy metabolism.
articles.titleZh: 发酵饲料-瘤胃微生物群轴通过微生物氨基酸合成和瘤胃上皮能量代谢介导山羊幼仔生长。
articles.authors: Kong F, Liu F, Qian Y, Wang Z, Zhang W, Wang Y, Zhang J, Li Y, Zhang J, Wang S, Dai D, Lin Z, Wang H, Meng C.
articles.abstract: Pretreating feed via fermentation to enhance its nutritional value is effective for young ruminants. This study optimized fermented feed using a microbial consortium of Saccharomyces cerevisiae, Bacillus licheniformis, and Enterococcus faecalis, and explored its mechanisms on growth performance and ruminal function in goat kids. The Bacillus licheniformis is the most critical determinant of the nutritional value of FF. Optimized FF had higher levels of crude protein, calcium, phosphorus, and limiting amino acids (AA). The FF contained viable microbiota with lower diversity but greater evenness. The microbiota was enriched in AA and carbohydrate metabolism by enhancing the abundance of Leuconostoc lactis and Lactococcus lactis. A 40-day feeding trial was then conducted with 20-day-old goat kids. Compared to conventional feed, FF increased feed digestibility, body weight and carcass weight. Mechanistically, FF enhanced the interactions among rumen microbes and increased the gene abundance related to carbohydrate and AA metabolism. The FF then upregulated expression of mitochondrial respiratory chain-related genes in the rumen epithelium, thereby improving epithelial energy metabolism. Overall, this study shows that fermented feed optimized by microbial consortium improves goat kid growth and carcass quality through the fermented feed-rumen microbiota axis, offering a sustainable approach for ruminant production.
articles.abstractZh: 通过发酵对饲料进行预处理以提高其营养价值对于幼龄反刍动物来说是有效的。本研究利用酿酒酵母、地衣芽孢杆菌和粪肠球菌组成的微生物群落优化发酵饲料，并探讨其对山羊幼崽生长性能和瘤胃功能的影响机制。地衣芽孢杆菌是FF营养价值最关键的决定因素。优化的 FF 具有更高水平的粗蛋白、钙、磷和限制性氨基酸 (AA)。 FF 包含多样性较低但均匀度较高的活微生物群。通过提高乳酸明串珠菌和乳酸乳球菌的丰度，丰富了微生物群的 AA 和碳水化合物代谢。然后对 20 天大的小山羊进行了为期 40 天的喂养试验。与传统饲料相比，FF 提高了饲料消化率、体重和胴体重量。从机制上讲，FF 增强了瘤胃微生物之间的相互作用，并增加了与碳水化合物和 AA 代谢相关的基因丰度。然后FF上调瘤胃上皮中线粒体呼吸链相关基因的表达，从而改善上皮能量代谢

articles.title: Genome-wide identification of WRKY gene family reveals its regulatory role in ABA/CBF-mediated cold adaptation in king grass (Pennisetum purpureum × P. americanum).
articles.titleZh: WRKY 基因家族的全基因组鉴定揭示了其在王草 (Pennisetum purpureum × P. americanum) ABA/CBF 介导的冷适应中的调节作用。
articles.authors: Lai X, Xiao Q, Chen Z, Liu S, Yan J, Zhang Y, Yan L.
articles.abstract: BackgroundKing grass is a fast-growing C4 perennial with high biomass potential, yet its productivity is limited by cold stress. WRKY transcription factors (TFs) regulate abiotic stress responses, but their roles in king grass cold adaptation remain unclear.MethodsWRKY TFs were identified genome-wide using BLASTP and HMMER, followed by phylogenetic classification, transcriptome profiling, promoter cis-element analysis, weighted gene co-expression network analysis (WGCNA), molecular docking, and yeast heterologous expression assays.ResultsSixty-two PsiWRKY genes were identified and classified into three groups. Time-series transcriptome analysis across nine cold-stress time points revealed four expression patterns, with 29 genes significantly induced (> 2-fold), mainly during late acclimation (48-72 h). qRT-PCR confirmed RNA-seq trends (R² = 0.742). Functional enrichment and WGCNA analyses indicated that cold-responsive PsiWRKYs coordinate abscisic acid-gibberellin antagonism and sugar metabolism. Molecular docking predicted interactions between PsiWRKY proteins and Calvin cycle enzymes, with PsiWRKY16 and PsiWRKY55 showing the highest structural confidence (pTM > 0.75). Network analysis identified PsiWRKY16 and PsiWRKY50 as hub regulators linking GA signaling genes (GID1/DELLA) with sugar metabolism enzymes such as GAPDH and PRK. Yeast assays quantitatively confirmed enhanced cold tolerance, as heterologous expression of PsiWRKY16 reduced doubling time by 0.56 h and increased area under the curve and carrying capacity by 26.20 and 3.39, respectively, while PsiWRKY50 increased these values by 14.45 and 1.43. Promoter analysis showed enrichment of ABRE and DRE elements (p = 0.00061), and integrative target prediction identified 193 genes co-regulated by WRKY and CBF pathways, supporting ABA-CBF signaling convergence.ConclusionsPsiWRKYs exhibit subgroup-specific and time-resolved responses to cold stress. PsiWRKY16, PsiWRKY50, and PsiWRKY55 are implicated in coordinating hormonal signaling and metabolic reprogramming, providing candidate targets for cold-tolerant breeding in king grass.

articles.title: Global Probiotic Markets Meet Synthetic Biology: Translational Challenges and <i>Escherichia coli</i> Nissle 1917 as a Model Chassis.
articles.titleZh: 全球益生菌市场遇到合成生物学：转化挑战和大肠杆菌 Nissle 1917 作为模型底盘。
articles.authors: Chen J, Chou CP, Liu Y.
articles.abstract: The global probiotic market is expanding rapidly, driven by growing demand for accessible strategies to support gut health, preventive care, and microbiome-based interventions. However, this commercial growth contrasts with the limited number of clinically validated, mechanism-driven products, highlighting a persistent gap between market expansion, scientific evidence, and therapeutic translation. Most current probiotics remain dominated by conventional genera, including Lactobacillus, Bifidobacterium, Bacillus, Saccharomyces, and Streptococcus, whereas live biotherapeutic products (LBPs) remain scarce. Synthetic biology is beginning to address this gap by transforming probiotics from empirically selected strains into programmable microbial platforms that sense disease-associated signals and produce defined therapeutic outputs. Escherichia coli Nissle 1917 (EcN) offers a valuable model chassis for engineered probiotics because of its long history of human use, safety record, genetic tractability, transient gut colonization, and scalable cultivation. As a rare Gram-negative probiotic, EcN naturally produces outer membrane vesicles that support host interaction, immunomodulation, and therapeutic cargo delivery. This review links probiotic market expansion with live biotherapeutic development and uses EcN to discuss emerging engineering strategies, therapeutic opportunities, and remaining translational barriers.
articles.abstractZh: 由于对支持肠道健康、预防保健和基于微生物组的干预措施的可行策略的需求不断增长，全球益生菌市场正在迅速扩张。然而，这种商业增长与临床验证、机制驱动的产品数量有限形成鲜明对比，凸显了市场扩张、科学证据和治疗转化之间持续存在的差距。目前大多数益生菌仍然以传统菌属为主，包括乳杆菌、双歧杆菌、芽孢杆菌、酵母菌和链球菌，而活生物治疗产品 (LBP) 仍然稀缺。合成生物学开始通过将益生菌从经验选择的菌株转化为可编程微生物平台来解决这一差距，该平台可感知疾病相关信号并产生明确的治疗输出。大肠杆菌 Nissle 1917 (EcN) 因其悠久的人类使用历史、安全记录、遗传易处理性、短暂的肠道定植和可扩展的培养，为工程益生菌提供了一个有价值的模型底盘。作为一种罕见的革兰氏阴性益生菌，EcN 天然产生外膜囊泡，支持宿主相互作用、免疫调节和

articles.title: Improvement of myrtle wine quality by proline under tannic acid stress: Combined E-nose and HS-SPME-GC-MS analysis.
articles.titleZh: 单宁酸胁迫下脯氨酸改善桃金娘酒品质：电子鼻和 HS-SPME-GC-MS 分析相结合。
articles.authors: Li M, Wan Y, Chen Y, Liu J, Fan H, Yi M, Fu G.
articles.abstract: Tannic acid can inhibit Saccharomyces cerevisiae metabolism and cellular integrity during myrtle wine fermentation. Proline has been shown to significantly mitigate the stress effects of tannic acid on the S. cerevisiae. This study aimed to investigate the effects of proline on the volatile profile and sensory properties of tannic acid-rich myrtle wine. The results indicated that proline significantly increased the contents of ethanol, organic acids, and phenolic compounds in myrtle wine. GC-MS analysis showed a 15.8% increase in total VOCs in the proline-treated group (PG) compared with the control group (CG), with rOAV analysis identifying isoamyl acetate, ethyl isovalerate, ethyl octanoate, and phenylethyl acetate as potential aroma-active compounds contributing to fruity and floral characteristics. E-nose showed that the response values of W5S, W1S, W2S, W2W, and W3S sensors in PG were increased by 76.2%, 16.2%, 96.4%, 41.25%, and 9.8% compared with CG, respectively. Ultimately, sensory analysis revealed that proline substantially improved the overall sensory quality of myrtle wine. These findings provide valuable theoretical guidance for enhancing the quality of myrtle wine.
articles.abstractZh: 单宁酸可以抑制桃金娘酒发酵过程中酿酒酵母的代谢和细胞完整性。脯氨酸已被证明可以显着减轻单宁酸对酿酒酵母的应激影响。本研究旨在研究脯氨酸对富含单宁酸的桃金娘酒的挥发性成分和感官特性的影响。结果表明，脯氨酸显着提高了桃金娘酒中乙醇、有机酸和酚类化合物的含量。 GC-MS 分析显示，与对照组 (CG) 相比，脯氨酸处理组 (PG) 的总 VOC 增加了 15.8%，rOAV 分析确定乙酸异戊酯、异戊酸乙酯、辛酸乙酯和乙酸苯乙酯是有助于果香和花香特征的潜在香气活性化合物。电子鼻显示，PG中W5S、W1S、W2S、W2W和W3S传感器的响应值与CG相比分别提高了76.2%、16.2%、96.4%、41.25%和9.8%。最终，感官分析表明，脯氨酸显着改善了桃金娘酒的整体感官质量。这些研究结果为提高桃金娘酒的品质提供了有价值的理论指导。

articles.title: MAPS: a marker-free genome integration system for Komagataella phaffii enabling co-production of natural pigments and industrial enzymes.
articles.titleZh: MAPS：Komagataella phaffii 的无标记基因组整合系统，能够共同生产天然色素和工业酶。
articles.authors: Schmid S, Wardell C, Hatzl AM, Steidl T, Geier M, Ebner K, Ellmer-Schaumberger U, Glieder A, Emmerstorfer-Augustin A.
articles.abstract: Marker-free genome engineering remains an important objective in the metabolic engineering of Komagataella phaffii, particularly for the construction of stable and regulatory-compliant industrial production strains. Here, we present MAPS, a marker-free auxiliary plasmid-assisted strain engineering system for K. phaffii, enabling antibiotic-free strain engineering and rapid assembly of multi-gene production strains. MAPS achieved integration efficiencies of up to 1.8% and facilitated the generation of stable recombinant strains without permanent selection markers. As a proof-of-principle application, we established a co-production platform combining intracellular biosynthesis of natural pigments with secretion of an industrial enzyme in a single fermentation process. Using beetroot (Beta vulgaris) betalain pigments as model metabolites and Candida antarctica lipase B (CalB) as an enzyme, strains were engineered for simultaneous pigment biosynthesis and protein secretion. This work further establishes betanin biosynthesis in K. phaffii. Formation of fully glycosylated betanin was confirmed by absorption spectroscopy and HPLC-MS analysis and required co-overexpression of Dorotheanthus bellidiformis betanidin-5-O-glucosyltransferase (DbGT) together with ascorbic acid supplementation. Using a derepressible promoter, CalB secretion was assessed before and after methanol-induced pigment production. Bioreactor cultivations yielded up to 215 mg L-1 betalain pigments in the culture supernatant. Importantly, betalain co-production did not adversely affect CalB secretion in shake-flask or bioreactor cultivations, and CalB could be efficiently purified from pigment-containing supernatants, demonstrating compatibility with downstream processing. Together, these results establish MAPS as a versatile platform for marker-free engineering of K. phaffii and its applicability for constructing multi-product production strains combining enzyme secretion and metabolite biosynthesis in a single microbial host.
articles.abstractZh: 无标记基因组工程仍然是 Komagataella phaffii 代谢工程的一个重要目标，特别是对于构建稳定且符合法规的工业生产菌株。在这里，我们推出了 MAPS，一种用于 K. phaffii 的无标记辅助质粒辅助菌株工程系统，能够实现无抗生素菌株工程和多基因生产菌株的快速组装。 MAPS 实现了高达 1.8% 的整合效率，并促进了无需永久选择标记的稳定重组菌株的生成。作为原理验证应用，我们建立了一个联合生产平台，将天然色素的细胞内生物合成与单一发酵过程中工业酶的分泌相结合。使用甜菜根 (Beta vulgaris) 甜菜红素色素作为模型代谢物，使用南极假丝酵母脂肪酶 B (CalB) 作为酶，对菌株进行工程改造，以同时进行色素生物合成和蛋白质分泌。这项工作进一步建立了法菲甜菜碱的生物合成。通过吸收光谱和 HPLC-MS 分析证实了完全糖基化甜菜苷的形成，并且需要 Dorotheanthus 的共过表达

articles.title: Metabolomic differentiation of industrial baker's yeasts reveals yeast product formulation-associated metabolic and flavor signatures during dough fermentation and bread baking.
articles.titleZh: 工业面包酵母的代谢组学差异揭示了面团发酵和面包烘焙过程中与酵母产品配方相关的代谢和风味特征。
articles.authors: Han NR, Lim N, Byun JA, Yun EJ, Cheong YE, Song S, Shim S, Kim KH.
articles.abstract: Saccharomyces cerevisiae (baker's yeast) plays a pivotal role in breadmaking by driving dough leavening and generating key flavor and aroma compounds. However, the metabolic mechanisms by which yeast product formulation type-fresh versus active dry-is associated fermentation behavior and bread quality remain insufficiently understood. In this study, six commercial S. cerevisiae strains were systematically characterized through enzymatic profiling, genetic identification, and integrated metabolomic analysis to elucidate product-associated metabolic differences. The VITEK 2 system revealed distinct enzymatic phenotypes, notably the α-glucosidase activity unique to the L'hirondelle LHIS White (Lesaffre; ADLL) strain, which corresponded with enhanced maltose utilization. Internal transcribed spacer sequencing confirmed that even yeasts from the same manufacturer represent genetically distinct strains, reflecting divergent genetic backgrounds across commercial products. Non-volatile metabolomic profiling identified 94 metabolites, with fresh yeast accumulating protective amino acids-including γ-aminobutyric acid, cysteine, and threonine-whereas active dry yeast strains showed markedly lower levels of these compounds, reflecting stress-adaptive regulation (p-value <0.05). In contrast, volatile metabolite analysis by solid-phase microextraction-gas chromatography/mass spectrometry demonstrated yeast product formulation-associated aroma profiles: fresh yeast product formulation predominantly produced fusel alcohols and aldehydes such as 3-methyl-1-butanol and nonanal through amino acid catabolism, whereas active dry yeast favored fatty acid esterification, generating complex fruity esters such as phenylethyl acetate and ethyl decanoate. These divergent metabolic patterns persisted after baking, resulting in stable yeast product formulation-associated aroma signatures. Collectively, this integrative metabolomic and biochemical investigation provides mechanistic insight into how yeast product formulation type and genetic background collectively influences fermentation metabolism and sensory properties, offering a scientific foundation for targeted strain selection and yeast product formulation optimization in industrial bread production.
articles.abstractZh: 酿酒酵母（面包酵母）通过驱动面团发酵并产生关键的风味和香气化合物，在面包制作中发挥着关键作用。然而，酵母产品配方（新鲜型与活性干型）与发酵行为和面包质量相关的代谢机制仍不清楚。在这项研究中，通过酶分析、遗传鉴定和综合代谢组学分析对六种商业酿酒酵母菌株进行了系统表征，以阐明与产品相关的代谢差异。 VITEK 2 系统揭示了不同的酶表型，特别是 L'hirondelle LHIS White（乐斯福；ADLL）菌株特有的 α-葡萄糖苷酶活性，这与麦芽糖利用率的提高相对应。内部转录间隔区测序证实，即使来自同一制造商的酵母也代表遗传上不同的菌株，反映了商业产品之间不同的遗传背景。非挥发性代谢组学分析鉴定出 94 种代谢物，新鲜酵母积累保护性氨基酸（包括 γ-氨基丁酸、半胱氨酸和苏氨酸），而活性干酵母菌株则显示出显着的保护性氨基酸（包括 γ-氨基丁酸、半胱氨酸和苏氨酸）。

articles.title: Modulation of grape must vitamin content by oenological treatments affects Saccharomyces cerevisiae fermentation performance and wine volatile composition.
articles.titleZh: 通过酿酒处理调节葡萄汁维生素含量会影响酿酒酵母的发酵性能和葡萄酒的挥发性成分。
articles.authors: Garces F, Picart J, Bosaro M, Riviere E, Morge C, Alexandre H, Roullier-Gall C.
articles.abstract: This study explores the impact of oenological treatments with fining agents or yeast-based nutrients on the vitamin content of grape musts, and thus on the fermentative performance of Saccharomyces cerevisiae yeasts and the volatile composition of wine. Products such as bentonites and oenological carbons were shown to deplete several B-group vitamins from the must, while yeast derivatives were able to release significant amounts. Bentonite was used to modulate the vitamin B1 (thiamine) content of a real must and different yeast inoculation procedures were evaluated: active dry yeast and cells precultivated in order to modulate their physiological state and intracellular B1 pool. A significant impact of initial thiamine on fermentative activity was observed, while the effect of inoculation seemed to be linked to the adaptation of yeasts to liquid medium rather than intracellular B1. Thiamine availability was linked to an overall increase in volatile compound production. B1 addition to a bentonite treated must restored the volatile profile of the untreated control, suggesting that thiamine depletion is a major factor underlying the effects of bentonite treatment on wine volatile composition. These results allowed to identify the mechanisms by which fining agents can modify wine characteristics while confirming thiamine's importance in vinification processes.
articles.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了使用澄清剂或酵母营养物质进行酿酒处理对葡萄汁维生素含量的影响，从而对酿酒酵母的发酵性能和葡萄酒的挥发性成分产生影响。膨润土和酿酒碳等产品被证明会消耗葡萄汁中的多种 B 族维生素，而酵母衍生物能够释放大量维生素。使用膨润土来调节真实葡萄汁中的维生素 B1（硫胺素）含量，并评估不同的酵母接种程序：活性干酵母和预培养的细胞，以调节其生理状态和细胞内 B1 库。观察到初始硫胺素对发酵活性的显​​着影响，而接种的效果似乎与酵母对液体培养基的适应有关，而不是与细胞内 B1 的适应有关。硫胺素的可用性与挥发性化合物产量的总体增加有关。在膨润土中添加 B1 必须恢复未处理对照的挥发性特征，这表明硫胺素消耗是膨润土处理对葡萄酒挥发性成分影响的一个主要因素

articles.title: Non-targeted flavor metabolomics reveals the regulatory mechanism of LAB-yeast mixed fermentation on the flavor profile of cheese flavoring.
articles.titleZh: 非靶向风味代谢组学揭示了 LAB-酵母混合发酵对奶酪调味品风味特征的调节机制。
articles.authors: Fang S, Song J, Xia Y, Chen M, Zhong F.
articles.abstract: Compared with natural cheese, enzymatic hydrolysis-fermentation-coupled cheese flavoring (EHFCCF) suffered from acidity and flavor imbalance, linked to insufficient ethyl esters. To address this issue, yeasts were introduced to supply alcohols as precursors for ethyl ester formation via ester synthase-catalyzed condensation. LAB+Yeast mixed and sequential fermentation were designed considering metabolic timing and substrate competition. Mixed fermentation enhanced the flavor intensity of EHFCCF, increasing the total volatile compounds content by 9.41-fold and free amino acids content by 85.71%, while generating 18 novel flavor compounds. LAB+Yeast sequential fermentation resulted in superior ethyl esters production, with ethyl hexanoate, ethyl decanoate, and ethyl octanoate contents increasing by 2.12-, 4.38-, and 1.96-fold versus LAB+Yeast mixed. Metabolomic analysis identified 5 core pathways and 14 differential metabolites. LAB+Yeast sequential fermentation promoted ethyl esters and inhibited excess organic acids via regulating metabolic timing and TCA cycle, providing mechanistic insights into the regulation of EHFCCF flavor by LAB-yeast mixed fermentation.
articles.abstractZh: 与天然奶酪相比，酶水解发酵耦合奶酪调味料（EHFCCF）存在酸度和风味不平衡的问题，这与乙酯不足有关。为了解决这个问题，引入酵母来提供醇作为通过酯合酶催化缩合形成乙酯的前体。 LAB+酵母混合和顺序发酵的设计考虑了代谢时间和底物竞争。混合发酵增强了EHFCCF的风味强度，使总挥发性化合物含量增加了9.41倍，游离氨基酸含量增加了85.71%，同时产生了18种新型风味化合物。 LAB+酵母顺序发酵产生了优异的乙酯产量，与LAB+酵母混合相比，己酸乙酯、癸酸乙酯和辛酸乙酯含量分别增加了2.12、4.38和1.96倍。代谢组学分析确定了 5 条核心途径和 14 种差异代谢物。 LAB+酵母顺序发酵通过调节代谢时间和TCA循环促进乙酯生成并抑制过量有机酸，为LAB-酵母混合发酵调节EHFCCF风味提供了机制见解。

articles.title: Progresses of transposon research in <i>Saccharomyces cerevisiae</i>.
articles.titleZh: 酿酒酵母转座子研究进展。
articles.authors: Lin W, Lv Y, Zhang Y, Jin Z, Liu L, Zhang D.
articles.abstract: Transposons are mobile genetic elements that have attracted sustained scientific interest since their discovery in maize, evolving into indispensable tools in genetic research. Saccharomyces cerevisiae serves as a preferred model for transposon studies, benefiting from a mature genetic manipulation system, a well-characterized genome, and cellular mechanisms that resemble those of higher organisms. This review summarizes recent advances and application strategies of transposons in S. cerevisiae. We begin by classifying transposons based on their transposition mechanisms, with a focus on representative systems including the Tn, hAT, Ty, piggyBac (PB), Tc1/mariner and CRISPR-associated transposon (CAST) families, detailing their molecular mechanisms. We further discuss the applications of endogenous and engineered transposons in yeast, address key challenges such as insertion bias and genomic instability, and summarize corresponding engineering strategies aimed at enhancing their efficiency and specificity. Our goal is to provide a roadmap for developing transposons into efficient, precise, and low-off-target genome-editing tools, thereby advancing the construction of yeast cell factories.
articles.abstractZh: 转座子是一种可移动的遗传元件，自从在玉米中发现以来，它一直吸引着科学界的兴趣，并逐渐发展成为遗传研究中不可或缺的工具。酿酒酵母是转座子研究的首选模型，受益于成熟的遗传操作系统、良好表征的基因组以及类似于高等生物的细胞机制。本文综述了转座子在酿酒酵母中的最新进展和应用策略。我们首先根据转座子机制对转座子进行分类，重点关注包括 Tn、hAT、Ty、piggyBac (PB)、Tc1/mariner 和 CRISPR 相关转座子 (CAST) 家族在内的代表性系统，详细介绍了它们的分子机制。我们进一步讨论了内源和工程转座子在酵母中的应用，解决插入偏倚和基因组不稳定性等关键挑战，并总结了旨在提高其效率和特异性的相应工程策略。我们的目标是为将转座子开发成高效、精确、低脱靶的基因组编辑工具提供路线图，从而推进酵母细胞事实的构建

articles.title: Real-Time Biomass Estimation in High-Density Yeast Fermentations Using Soft Sensor Modeling.
articles.titleZh: 使用软传感器建模实时估计高密度酵母发酵中的生物量。
articles.authors: Del Hierro AG, Checa-Barrera JL, Moreno-Cid JA, Casey E.
articles.abstract: Accurate biomass monitoring remains a bottleneck in industrial fermentation, where conventional offline methods, gravimetric dry cell weight (DCW) and spectrophotometric optical density at 600 nm (OD600), are incompatible with real-time process control. Online optical probes operating at 860 nm (OD860) provide continuous, non-invasive monitoring, but their signals become increasingly nonlinear due to multiple light scattering, limiting direct interpretation without mathematical transformation. This study develops and validates interpretable soft sensor regression models that convert nonlinear OD860 signals into DCW and OD600 across three industrially relevant yeast species, Pichia pastoris, Kluyveromyces marxianus, and Yarrowia lipolytica. Fed-batch datasets from 19 independent batches were used to evaluate 14 candidate models, including nonlinear and spline-based functions. Model performance was assessed by the nested leave-one-batch-out cross-validation (LOBO-CV) to prevent information leakage from batch-correlated data. Model selection followed a parsimony criterion, retaining the simplest model within 5% of the minimum cross-validated RMSE. For DCW prediction, selected models achieved cross-validated coefficients of determination (R2) of 0.85-0.91 across species; OD600 predictions were less accurate (R2 CV = 0.49-0.90), reflecting dilution-driven noise amplification inherent to high-density spectrophotometric measurements. A dual-model strategy is presented, pairing software-optimized implementations with simplified piecewise-linear equations suitable for calculator-based deployment in industrial environments.
articles.abstractZh: 准确的生物量监测仍然是工业发酵的瓶颈，传统的离线方法、细胞重量干重 (DCW) 和 600 nm 处的分光光度光密度 (OD600) 与实时过程控制不兼容。在 860 nm (OD860) 下运行的在线光学探头可提供连续、非侵入性监测，但由于多重光散射，其信号变得越来越非线性，限制了无需数学转换的直接解释。本研究开发并验证了可解释的软传感器回归模型，该模型可将三种工业相关酵母物种（毕赤酵母、马克斯克鲁维酵母和解脂耶氏酵母）的非线性 OD860 信号转换为 DCW 和 OD600。来自 19 个独立批次的补料批次数据集用于评估 14 个候选模型，包括非线性和基于样条的函数。通过嵌套留一批次交叉验证（LOBO-CV）评估模型性能，以防止批次相关数据的信息泄漏。模型选择遵循简约准则，将最简单的模型保留在最小交叉验证 RMSE 的 5% 以内。对于 DCW 预测，选定的模型

articles.title: Synergistic HMGN1 and VP64 Fusions Potentiate High-Precision and PAM-Flexible Base Editing.
articles.titleZh: HMGN1 和 VP64 的协同融合可增强高精度和 PAM 灵活的碱基编辑。
articles.authors: Luo X, Qu Y, Ye Z, Li Z, Zhang Y, Luo L, Li S, Zhao W, Wang M, Bock R, Wan J, Tan J.
articles.abstract: RNA-guided CRISPR-derived base editors (BEs) have revolutionized genome editing by enabling targeted base substitutions. However, their application is frequently constrained by the stringent requirement for PAM sequences and low editing precision (bystander editing). Here, we present a robust strategy to overcome these limitations by coupling SpRY, a near-PAM-less Cas9 variant, with truncated CDA1 cytidine deaminases. While this combination enables precise editing of virtually any cytosine in the genome, it initially exhibited suboptimal efficiency. To address this, we systematically screened a diverse panel of candidate DNA-binding proteins and identified that the synergistic fusion of HMGN1 and VP64 substantially enhances editing activity without compromising precision. Importantly, this enhanced editing efficiency was achieved without markedly increasing off-target effects. Our new BEs demonstrated robust performance not only in yeast but also in rice, suggesting broad applicability in gene therapy, precision breeding, and fundamental research.
articles.abstractZh: RNA 引导的 CRISPR 衍生碱基编辑器 (BE) 通过实现靶向碱基替换，彻底改变了基因组编辑。然而，它们的应用经常受到对 PAM 序列的严格要求和低编辑精度（旁观者编辑）的限制。在这里，我们提出了一种强有力的策略，通过将 SpRY（一种近乎无 PAM 的 Cas9 变体）与截短的 CDA1 胞苷脱氨酶偶联来克服这些限制。虽然这种组合几乎可以精确编辑基因组中的任何胞嘧啶，但它最初表现出次优效率。为了解决这个问题，我们系统地筛选了多种候选 DNA 结合蛋白，并发现 HMGN1 和 VP64 的协同融合可在不影响精度的情况下显着增强编辑活性。重要的是，这种增强的编辑效率是在没有显着增加脱靶效应的情况下实现的。我们的新BE不仅在酵母中而且在水稻中都表现出了强大的性能，这表明其在基因治疗、精准育种和基础研究中具有广泛的适用性。

articles.title: Metabolic engineering of <i>Saccharomyces cerevisiae</i> for co-production of ergothioneine, salidroside and gadusol.
articles.titleZh: 用于联产麦角硫因、红景天苷和加杜索的酿酒酵母的代谢工程。
articles.authors: Zhang L, Xiao S, Wang D, Zhang P, Xu R, Hu L, Kang Z.
articles.abstract: Ergothioneine (EGT), salidroside and gadusol are high-value cosmetic ingredients valued for their moisturizing, skin-brightening and ultraviolet (UV)-protective properties. Leveraging Saccharomyces cerevisia, a GRAS organism already widely used in cosmetics, we engineered a single strain for their simultaneous co-production. We first identified the 5-histidylcysteine sulfoxide synthase domain reaction as rate-limiting and addressed the poor solubility of ergothioneine biosynthesis protein 1 (EGT1) by screening heterologous homologs and optimizing EGT1 through solubility-enhancing fusions and structure-guided stabilization, increasing EGT titer in shake flask from 34 to 132 mg L-1. Multicopy integration of the optimized pathway into the ribosomal DNA (rDNA) locus further boosted EGT production to 690 mg L-1 in a 5-L bioreactor. Subsequently, biosynthetic pathways for salidroside and gadusol were introduced, yielding a tri-product strain that achieved final titers of 1329 mg L-1 EGT, 224 mg L-1 salidroside and 556 mg L-1 gadusol in fed-batch fermentation. This work establishes a multifunctional yeast cell factory capable of simultaneous co-production of multiple premium cosmetic actives, offering a scalable and sustainable platform for next-generation ingredient development.
articles.abstractZh: 麦角硫因 (EGT)、红景天苷和加杜索是高价值的化妆品成分，因其保湿、亮肤和紫外线 (UV) 防护特性而受到重视。利用酿酒酵母（一种已广泛应用于化妆品中的 GRAS 生物体），我们设计了一种单一菌株用于同时联合生产。我们首先确定 5-组氨酰半胱氨酸亚砜合酶结构域反应为限速反应，并通过筛选异源同源物并通过增强溶解度的融合和结构引导稳定化优化 EGT1，将摇瓶中的 EGT 效价从 34 mg L-1 提高到 132 mg L-1，解决了麦角硫因生物合成蛋白 1 (EGT1) 溶解度差的问题。将优化的途径多拷贝整合到核糖体 DNA (rDNA) 基因座中，进一步将 5 L 生物反应器中的 EGT 产量提高到 690 mg L-1。随后，引入了红景天苷和gadusol的生物合成途径，产生了三产物菌株，在补料分批发酵中最终滴度为1329 mg L-1 EGT、224 mg L-1红景天苷和556 mg L-1 gadusol。这项工作建立了一个多功能酵母细胞工厂，能够同时联产多种优质化妆品活性物质。

articles.title: Microbial architecture and metabolic profiles in <i>Xiaoqu</i>: insights into traditional glutinous rice wine fermentation.
articles.titleZh: 《小曲》中的微生物结构和代谢特征：传统糯米酒发酵的见解。
articles.authors: Peng B, Shu J, Chen B, Li C, Han Y.
articles.abstract: Xiaoqu is a traditionally propagated multi-species starter used in Chinese sweet glutinous rice wine fermentation and represents a low-temperature solid-state fermentation system distinct from Japanese pure-culture Aspergillus oryzae koji and Western malt-based saccharification platforms. Unlike defined inoculation systems, Xiaoqu functions as a process-shaped microbial architecture assembled through repeated ecological selection under artisanal production conditions. This review synthesizes current knowledge regarding the microbial ecology, guild organization, fermentation trajectories, and metabolite modulation associated with Xiaoqu-mediated glutinous rice wine production. Xiaoqu communities are typically structured around amylolytic molds, fermentative yeasts, non-Saccharomyces yeasts, and lactic acid bacteria (LAB), which collectively regulate saccharification, acidification, ethanol restraint, and flavor formation through coupled ecological and metabolic interactions. We propose a process-phytochemical selection framework, presented as a literature-derived conceptual hypothesis, to explain how botanical inputs, matrix properties, and processing conditions jointly shape microbial succession, interaction topology, and metabolic trajectories. The review further develops an architecture-to-trajectory perspective in which sugar-acid-ethanol coupling emerges as a systems-level phenotype governed by guild interactions, cross-feeding, feedback regulation, and environmental constraints rather than by individual taxa alone. Functional redundancy, hybrid starter systems, temporal trajectory analysis, and safety constraints associated with toxigenic risks are also discussed as key factors influencing fermentation robustness, reproducibility, and sensory stability. Finally, we highlight the need for architecture-preserving control strategies integrating strain-level multi-omics, synthetic-community reconstruction, and trajectory-oriented process analysis to support mechanistic understanding and controllable design of Xiaoqu-mediated fermentations.
articles.abstractZh: 小曲是一种用于中国甜糯米酒发酵的传统繁殖的多品种发酵剂，代表了一种不同于日本纯培养米曲霉和西方麦芽糖化平台的低温固态发酵系统。与既定的接种系统不同，小曲的功能是在手工生产条件下通过反复生态选择组装而成的过程型微生物结构。这篇综述综合了与小曲介导的糯米酒生产相关的微生物生态学、行会组织、发酵轨迹和代谢物调节的最新知识。小曲群落通常由淀粉分解霉菌、发酵酵母、非酿酒酵母和乳酸菌 (LAB) 组成，它们通过生态和代谢相互作用共同调节糖化、酸化、乙醇抑制和风味形成。我们提出了一个过程植物化学选择框架，以文献衍生的概念假设的形式提出，以解释植物输入、基质特性和加工条件如何共同塑造微生物

articles.title: Mitochondria directly interact with the nuclear pore complex.
articles.titleZh: 线粒体直接与核孔复合体相互作用。
articles.authors: Menendez-Montes I, Marin-Vicente C, Mukherjee S, Ahmed MS, Gomez MJ, Anene-Nzelu CG, Lee CJM, Koslowski S, Solmonson A, Tassin T, Ali SR, Pessoa P, Elnwasany A, Lam NT, Thet S, Calvo E, Cardoso AC, Pereira AHM, Xiao F, Wang P, Mohamed A, El-Feky H, Elghamry A, Gancedo-Alonso G, Nguyen NUN, Hsu CC, Westfall AK, DeBerardinis R, Foo RS, Kinter M, Pressé S, Xing C, Szweda L, Aroumougame A, Sanchez-Cabo F, Enriquez JA, Torres M, Vazquez J, Sadek HA.
articles.abstract: Mitochondria regulate cellular processes through direct and indirect interactions with other organelles. A well-studied example has been contact with the endoplasmic reticulum at mitochondrial-associated endoplasmic reticulum membranes1, which control pathways including redox and calcium homeostasis2,3. Recent studies have also reported direct mitochondria-nuclear membrane contacts in cancer cells and yeast that promote pro-survival signalling4,5. Here we identify direct interactions between mitochondria and nuclear pores. Using two unbiased proteomic screens, GST pulldown and BioID, we found that VDAC1 was the top mitochondrial candidate that interacts with the filamentous nuclear pore protein RANBP2. In vitro RANBP2 CRISPR knockout, RANBP2 truncation or site-directed mutagenesis of RANBP2-VDAC1 interacting amino acids resulted in reduced mitochondria-nucleus proximity and decreased nuclear ATP and phosphocreatine levels. This was accompanied by a decline in the levels of the nuclear phosphoproteome and downregulation of pathways involved in histone modification, cellular differentiation and transcriptional regulation in vitro. Moreover, deletion of the RANBP2 C-terminal domain in vivo in mice resulted in embryonic lethality due to cardiac and neural crest differentiation defects. Collectively, these results describe a mechanism by which mitochondria directly interact with the nuclear pore complex, a phenomenon critical for regulation of nuclear energetics and cellular differentiation. Undoubtedly, additional roles of this interaction remain to be revealed.
articles.abstractZh: 线粒体通过与其他细胞器的直接和间接相互作用来调节细胞过程。一个经过充分研究的例子是线粒体相关内质网膜与内质网的接触1，它控制包括氧化还原和钙稳态在内的途径2,3。最近的研究还报道了癌细胞和酵母中线粒体与核膜的直接接触，促进了促生存信号传导 4,5。在这里，我们确定了线粒体和核孔之间的直接相互作用。使用两种无偏蛋白质组筛选（GST pulldown 和 BioID），我们发现 VDAC1 是与丝状核孔蛋白 RANBP2 相互作用的顶级线粒体候选者。体外 RANBP2 CRISPR 敲除、RANBP2 截短或 RANBP2-VDAC1 相互作用氨基酸的定点诱变导致线粒体-细胞核接近度降低以及核 ATP 和磷酸肌酸水平降低。伴随着核磷酸蛋白质组水平的下降以及参与组蛋白修饰、细胞分化和体外转录调节的途径的下调。此外，RANBP2 C 端结构域的缺失

articles.title: Regional physicochemical filtering shapes microbiome-metabolome coupling at the Huangshui interface during Nongxiangxing Baijiu fermentation.
articles.titleZh: 农香型白酒发酵过程中，区域物理化学过滤塑造了黄水界面微生物组与代谢组的耦合。
articles.authors: Cheng W, Li N, Huang Y, Wei C, Li R, Zhang Y, Chang Q, Jiang C.
articles.abstract: IntroductionHuangshui (HS), the liquid fraction that accumulates at the bottom of fermentation pits, serves as a key ecological interface linking microbial diversity and metabolism between fermented grains and pit mud during fermentation. Although HS is increasingly recognized as a reservoir of microorganisms and flavor precursors, how regional heterogeneity shapes its microbiome-metabolome coupling remains unclear.MethodsHS samples derived from nine representative Nongxiangxing Baijiu (NXB) production regions were compared using physicochemical characterization, amplicon sequencing, volatile metabolomics, and ecological association analysis.ResultsThe results showed marked regional differences in acidity, nitrogen availability, mineral nutrient content, and organic acid composition, indicating distinct fermentation microenvironments. Lactic acid dominated the acid pool in all samples, whereas short- and medium-chain fatty acids varied substantially among regions, suggesting differences in carbon flux allocation and chain elongation activity. Bacterial communities were dominated by Lactobacillus, methanogenic archaea, and Caproiciproducens, whereas fungal communities were enriched with fermentative yeasts (Pichia, Saccharomyces, and Kazachstania). A total of 162 volatile organic compounds were identified, with esters as the predominant aroma class, showing clear regional differentiation. Furthermore, integrated correlation and network analyses indicated that regional physicochemical factors acted as ecological filters, shaping microbial guild assembly and volatile metabolite patterns.DiscussionLactobacillus emerged as a central taxon associated with acid-ester balance, whereas methanogenic and chain-elongating taxa were linked to carbon redistribution and medium-chain fatty acid formation. Further, these findings support the revised view of HS as an active metabolic interface, highlighting its potential for origin discrimination and precise fermentation control in NXB production.
articles.abstractZh: 简介黄水（HS）是发酵坑底部积累的液体部分，是发酵过程中连接发酵谷物和坑泥之间微生物多样性和代谢的关键生态界面。尽管HS越来越被认为是微生物和风味前体的储存库，但区域异质性如何影响其微生物组-代谢组耦合仍不清楚。方法采用理化表征、扩增子测序、挥发性代谢组学和生态关联分析对来自9个代表性农香型白酒（NXB）产区的HS样品进行比较。结果结果显示酸度、氮利用率、矿质营养素含量和有机酸组成存在显着的区域差异，表明不同的发酵微环境。乳酸在所有样品的酸库中占主导地位，而短链和中链脂肪酸在不同区域之间差异很大，表明碳通量分配和链伸长活性存在差异。细菌群落以乳杆菌、产甲烷古菌和 Caproici Producens 为主，而真菌群落则丰富

articles.title: Sustainable microbial production of retinol in Yarrowia lipolytica: From strain engineering to formulation.
articles.titleZh: 解脂耶氏酵母中视黄醇的可持续微生物生产：从菌株工程到配方。
articles.authors: Hong S, Lee D, Kim H, Park JH, Hong J, Shin WS, Kim YK, Yun HL, Oh K, Jung JY, Jin H, Lee P, Hahn JS.
articles.abstract: Retinol (vitamin A) is traditionally produced by chemical synthesis, but growing demand for sustainable alternatives has increased interest in microbial production. However, the intrinsic instability of retinol complicates both biosynthesis and downstream processing, requiring integrated strategies for product recovery and stabilization. In this study, we report the first purification and formulation of microbially produced retinol. We previously engineered Yarrowia lipolytica for retinol production and improved retinol recovery by supplementing the fermentation with Tween 80 and the antioxidant butylated hydroxytoluene (BHT). Here, retinol production was further enhanced 3.2-fold in shake flasks by increasing acetyl-CoA supply and pathway flux. To address purification challenges, we developed an extraction strategy for retinol encapsulated in micelles using n-hexane and ethanol, followed by two additional ethanol extractions. Replacing Tween 80 with the more hydrophilic Tween 20 improved purification efficiency. The engineered strain produced 7.16 g/L retinol in a 5-L fermenter supplemented with Tween 20 and BHT, and retinol was purified to 48.6% purity, demonstrating the importance of co-designing fermentation conditions with downstream processing. A prototype formulation containing 10% retinol was developed and validated for cytotoxicity and stability. Life cycle assessment quantified the carbon footprint and identified key environmental contributors. Together, this work establishes an integrated approach combining metabolic engineering, fermentation design, and downstream processing to enable sustainable microbial production of unstable high-value compounds such as retinol.
articles.abstractZh: 视黄醇（维生素 A）传统上是通过化学合成生产的，但对可持续替代品的需求不断增长，增加了人们对微生物生产的兴趣。然而，视黄醇的内在不稳定性使生物合成和下游加工变得复杂，需要采取综合策略来回收和稳定产品。在这项研究中，我们首次报道了微生物产生的视黄醇的纯化和配方。我们之前对解脂耶氏酵母进行了改造，用于生产视黄醇，并通过在发酵过程中添加吐温 80 和抗氧化剂丁基羟基甲苯 (BHT) 来提高视黄醇回收率。在这里，通过增加乙酰辅酶A的供应和途径通量，摇瓶中视黄醇的产量进一步提高了3.2倍。为了解决纯化难题，我们开发了一种使用正己烷和乙醇提取封装在胶束中的视黄醇的策略，然后进行两次额外的乙醇提取。用亲水性更强的 Tween 20 代替 Tween 80 提高了纯化效率。该工程菌株在补充有吐温 20 和 BHT 的 5 L 发酵罐中产生了 7.16 g/L 视黄醇，并且视黄醇纯化至 48.6% 的纯度，这证明了视黄醇的重要性。
