articles.title: Harnessing yeasts for sustainable methanol valorization: Metabolic and fermentation engineering strategies.
articles.titleZh: 利用酵母实现可持续的甲醇增值：代谢和发酵工程策略。
articles.authors: Choi Y, Park Y, Lin Y, Min H, Lee D, Kwon J, Kim S, Joo JC, Kang NK.
articles.abstract: Methanol has emerged as a sustainable C1 feedstock owing to its compatibility with existing infrastructure and the potential for renewable production from CO₂ and green hydrogen. Methylotrophic yeasts, including Komagataella phaffii (also known as Pichia pastoris) and Ogataea polymorpha, can natively assimilate methanol and therefore represent attractive hosts for biomanufacturing. However, industrial application of methanol-based processes remains constrained by cytotoxicity, redox imbalance, and limited productivity compared to sugar-based fermentations. To address these challenges, extensive metabolic engineering strategies have been implemented to enhance methanol assimilation and redirect carbon flux toward value-added products. Over the past decade, remarkable progress has been achieved through the development of synthetic methylotrophy in non-methylotrophic yeasts, the expansion of product portfolios to glycans, fatty acid derivatives, polyketides, terpenoids, organic acids, and polyols, and the integration of multi-omics tools for systems-level design. This review summarizes recent advances in methanol assimilation enhancement, synthetic pathway construction, and fermentation engineering, highlighting strategies such as metabolic engineering and dynamic bioprocess control. In addition, current challenges and future perspectives are discussed with an emphasis on overcoming toxicity, improving efficiency, and establishing advanced methylotrophic yeasts as robust cell factories for sustainable C1-based biomanufacturing.
articles.abstractZh: 由于甲醇与现有基础设施的兼容性以及利用二氧化碳和绿色氢气进行可再生生产的潜力，甲醇已成为一种可持续的 C1 原料。甲基营养酵母，包括 Komagataella phaffii（也称为毕赤酵母）和 Ogataea polymorpha，可以天然同化甲醇，因此是生物制造的有吸引力的宿主。然而，与糖基发酵相比，基于甲醇的工艺的工业应用仍然受到细胞毒性、氧化还原失衡和有限生产​​率的限制。为了应对这些挑战，已经实施了广泛的代谢工程策略，以增强甲醇同化并将碳通量重新导向增值产品。在过去的十年中，通过在非甲基营养酵母中开发合成甲基营养，将产品组合扩展到聚糖、脂肪酸衍生物、聚酮化合物、萜类化合物、有机酸和多元醇，以及用于系统级设计的多组学工具的集成，取得了显着的进展。本文综述了甲醇同化增强、合成途径构建和发酵技术的最新进展。

articles.title: Heterologous Expression and In Vivo Functional Analysis of OsTPS2 in Yeast, Tobacco, and Rice.
articles.titleZh: OsTPS2 在酵母、烟草和水稻中的异源表达和体内功能分析。
articles.authors: Li H, Li S, Zhang X, Luo Y.
articles.abstract: Casbene-type macrocyclic diterpenes possess a range of biological activities, with casbene and neocembrene serving as key precursor compounds. While there is an abundance of research on casbene synthase, in-depth studies in vivo on neocembrene synthase are relatively scarce. This study presents the first functional validation in vivo of OsTPS2 as a primary neocembrene synthase in rice, as demonstrated through both transient tobacco expression and yeast-induced expression systems. Comparative analysis with the OsTPS28 gene revealed that OsTPS2 produces a higher content of neocembrene. Furthermore, the overexpression of OsTPS2 in rice resulted in an increased neocembrene content within the leaves. Additionally, both OsTPS2 and OsTPS28 were found to induce the synthesis of geranylgeraniol in yeast. Geranylgeraniol exhibits antifungal properties against Rhizoctonia solani and Phomopsis sp., with EC50 values of 56.67 ± 3.78 µg/mL and 89.75 ± 12.75 µg/mL, respectively. Geranylgeraniol also displayed antifungal activity against Alternaria solani (Ell. et Mart.) Jones et Grout, albeit to a lesser extent. The findings of this study provide a scientific foundation for the metabolic engineering of neocembrene and offer novel perspectives on enhancing the nutritional value of rice.
articles.abstractZh: Casbene型大环二萜具有一系列生物活性，其中casbene和neocembrene是关键的前体化合物。虽然对casbene合酶的研究非常丰富，但对新松烯合酶的体内深入研究相对较少。本研究首次对 OsTPS2 作为水稻中的主要新松烯合酶进行了体内功能验证，这一点通过烟草瞬时表达和酵母诱导表达系统得到了证明。与OsTPS28基因的比较分析表明，OsTPS2产生更高含量的新松烯。此外，OsTPS2在水稻中的过度表达导致叶片内新松烯含量增加。此外，OsTPS2 和 OsTPS28 均被发现可诱导酵母中香叶基香叶醇的合成。香叶基香叶醇对立枯丝核菌和拟茎点霉具有抗真菌特性，EC50 值分别为 56.67 ± 3.78 µg/mL 和 89.75 ± 12.75 µg/mL。香叶基香叶醇还表现出针对 Alternaria solani (Ell. et Mart.) Jones et Grout 的抗真菌活性，尽管程度较小。本研究结果为代谢工程提供了科学基础。

articles.title: Heterologous expression of wild-type and Lys99Ala mutant L-asparaginase from Lachancea thermotolerans in Pichia pastoris: culture optimization and laboratory-scale bioreactor production.
articles.titleZh: 巴斯德毕赤酵母中 Lachancea 耐热菌野生型和 Lys99Ala 突变体 L-天冬酰胺酶的异源表达：培养优化和实验室规模生物反应器生产。
articles.authors: Çaloğlu Susamaz B, Koschorreck K, Urlacher VB, Binay B.
articles.abstract: L-Asparaginase (L-ASNase) is an enzyme of significant therapeutic value within the pharmaceutical industry, primarily due to its clinical efficacy in treating acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL). Despite its benefits, the clinical application of commercially available bacterial-derived L-ASNases is frequently impeded by severe hypersensitivity reactions and immunogenicity. This limitation has necessitated the exploration of novel L-ASNase variants and the development of alternative heterologous expression systems that minimize adverse immune responses. As unicellular eukaryotic models, yeast-based expression platforms represent a robust alternative for the production of therapeutic proteins. In the present study, the asnase gene from Lachancea thermotolerans (L. thermotolerans, LtASNase), along with its Lys99Ala mutant variant was heterologously expressed in Pichia pastoris (P. pastoris). To maximize yield, cultivation parameters were systematically optimized, followed by scale-up in a bioreactor under stabilized conditions. Initial shake-flask cultivations of the wild-type and mutant LtASNase yielded maximum whole-cell activities of 191 U gDCW-1 (628 U L- 1) and 57 U gdcw- 1 (174 U L⁻¹) over induction periods of three and two days, respectively. Process optimization identified the ideal conditions as pH 6.0 and 20 °C for the wild-type enzyme, and pH 7.5 and 16 °C for the mutant. Notably, bioreactor-scale expressions facilitated 4- and 7-fold increase in volumetric whole-cell activity for the wild-type and mutant enzymes, compared to shake-flask results. These findings suggest that P. pastoris is a viable host for microbial LtASNase production, achieving yields higher than established Escherichia coli (E. coli) systems; however, further investigation into secretory expression pathways is required to provide cost-effective production.
articles.abstractZh: L-天冬酰胺酶 (L-ASNase) 是一种在制药行业具有重要治疗价值的酶，主要是由于其治疗急性淋巴细胞白血病 (ALL) 的临床功效。尽管有其优点，但市售的细菌衍生的 L-ASNases 的临床应用经常受到严重的过敏反应和免疫原性的阻碍。这种限制使得必须探索新的 L-ASNase 变体并开发替代的异源表达系统，以最大限度地减少不良免疫反应。作为单细胞真核模型，基于酵母的表达平台代表了生产治疗性蛋白质的强大替代方案。在本研究中，来自耐热拉昌氏菌（L.thermotolerans，LtASNase）的asnase基因及其Lys99Ala突变体在巴斯德毕赤酵母（P.pastoris）中异源表达。为了最大限度地提高产量，系统地优化了培养参数，然后在稳定条件下在生物反应器中进行放大。野生型和突变型 LtASNase 的初始摇瓶培养产生了 191 U gDCW-1 (628 U L-1) 和 57 U gdcw-1 (174 U L-1) 的最大全细胞活性。

articles.title: Parallel gene amplification by Cas9 nickase for generating functionally heterogeneous cell populations.
articles.titleZh: 通过 Cas9 切口酶进行并行基因扩增，以生成功能异质的细胞群。
articles.authors: Takesue H, Okada S, Ito T.
articles.abstract: Genetic diversity underlies adaptive evolution. Because genes often act in concert to execute biological processes, the dosage stoichiometry among cooperating genes represents an additional layer of diversity beyond sequence variation. We therefore hypothesized that combinatorial randomization of gene copy numbers could generate cell populations enriched for functional heterogeneity and evolutionary potential. To test this idea, we extended our previously developed Cas9 nickase-based gene amplification method, break-induced replication-mediated tandem repeat expansion (BITREx), to simultaneously target multiple genes. Applying parallel BITREx to three carotenogenic genes introduced into the budding yeast Saccharomyces cerevisiae, we generated a cell population exhibiting broad variation in both absolute copy numbers and their stoichiometric ratios. This population enabled the identification of elite genotypes-specific copy number combinations that conferred enhanced β-carotene production. These results suggest that parallel BITREx is a versatile strategy for increasing functional heterogeneity in cell populations, with potential applications in both basic and applied research.
articles.abstractZh: 遗传多样性是适应性进化的基础。由于基因通常协同作用来执行生物过程，因此合作基因之间的剂量化学计量代表了序列变异之外的额外一层多样性。因此，我们假设基因拷贝数的组合随机化可以产生功能异质性和进化潜力丰富的细胞群。为了测试这个想法，我们扩展了之前开发的基于 Cas9 切口酶的基因扩增方法，即断裂诱导复制介导的串联重复扩增 (BITREx)，以同时靶向多个基因。将平行的 BITREx 应用于引入芽殖酵母酿酒酵母的三个胡萝卜素基因，我们生成了一个在绝对拷贝数和化学计量比方面表现出广泛变化的细胞群。该群体能够鉴定精英基因型特异性拷贝数组合，从而增强 β-胡萝卜素的产量。这些结果表明，并行 BITREx 是一种增加细胞群功能异质性的通用策略，在基础和应用研究中都有潜在的应用。

articles.title: Production of redox-active organic electrolyte candidates using the oleaginous yeast Yarrowia lipolytica as a heterologous cell factory.
articles.titleZh: 使用产油酵母解脂耶氏酵母作为异源细胞工厂生产氧化还原活性有机电解质候选物。
articles.authors: Bejenari M, Bech KR, Westphal KR, Muff J, Wimmer R, Sørensen JL.
articles.abstract: Fungal quinone polyketides are promising bio-electrolyte candidates for aqueous organic redox flow batteries (AORFBs) but are difficult to produce efficiently and at scale in native filamentous fungi. Here, we engineered Yarrowia lipolytica as a heterologous host to biosynthesize toluquinol and gentisyl alcohol by reconstructing and validating the biosynthetic gene cluster from Aspergillus hancockii. Comparative pathway analysis revealed loss of activity in one of the annotated CYP450 monooxygenases, the function of which was restored through orthology-guided sequence truncation, although at lower efficiency than that of the corresponding ortholog from Aspergillus clavatus. We achieved titers of 1.1 g/L toluquinol and 1.4 g/L gentisyl alcohol from the strains expressing the A. hancockii pathway in shake flask cultures. Furthermore, titers of up to 1.8 g/L gentisyl alcohol were achieved upon expression of a hybrid pathway incorporating the CYP450 from A. clavatus, thereby underscoring the possibility of improving product formation through complementation with cross-species enzymes. Subsequent cyclic voltammetry confirmed the redox activity of heterologously produced quinones and revealed a quasi-reversible redox process. Overall, these results establish a scalable heterologous production platform for fungal quinones with redox-active properties, streamlining their systematic evaluation as AORFBs electrolytes.
articles.abstractZh: 真菌醌聚酮化合物是用于水性有机氧化还原液流电池（AORFB）的有前景的生物电解质候选物，但难以在天然丝状真菌中高效和大规模生产。在这里，我们通过重建和验证汉考克曲霉的生物合成基因簇，将解​​脂耶氏酵母设计为异源宿主，以生物合成甲苯喹诺和龙胆醇。比较途径分析揭示了一种注释的 CYP450 单加氧酶的活性丧失，其功能通过直系同源引导的序列截断得以恢复，尽管其效率低于来自棒曲霉的相应直系同源物。我们在摇瓶培养物中表达汉考克放线菌途径的菌株获得了 1.1 g/L 甲苯喹诺和 1.4 g/L 龙胆醇的滴度。此外，在表达包含来自 A.clavatus 的 CYP450 的杂合途径时，滴度高达 1.8 g/L 龙胆醇，从而强调了通过与跨物种酶互补来改善产物形成的可能性。随后的循环伏安法证实了异源产生的醌的氧化还原活性和rev

articles.title: Regulation of EC precursors in Huangjiu: Multi-omics deciphers the mechanism of synthetic microbial communities.
articles.titleZh: 黄酒中 EC 前体的调控：多组学破译合成微生物群落的机制。
articles.authors: Tian S, Niu H, Zhang Y, Du G, Wang Y, Li M, Li Y, Liu Q.
articles.abstract: Ethyl carbamate, a Group 2 A carcinogen, is naturally formed during Huangjiu brewing and poses a significant challenge in enhancing the quality and safety of the final product. Synthetic microbial communities can regulate the formation of ethyl carbamate during fermentation and effectively reduce its levels in Huangjiu. However, the underlying relationship between microbial communities and the formation of ethyl carbamate precursors remains to be elucidated. In this study, we employed integrated metatranscriptomic and metabolomic analyses to investigate the potential metabolic functions of microorganisms during fermentation with synthetic microbial communities, focusing on three key aspects: microbial composition, functional genes, and metabolites. Metabolomic analysis identified six key metabolites during fermentation: urea, arginine, citrulline, ornithine, homoarginine, and homocitrulline. Metatranscriptomic analysis revealed that total sugars, urea, and citrulline were the main factors driving microbial community succession during Huangjiu fermentation. Limosilactobacillus fermentum and Saccharomyces cerevisiae were identified as the core functional species driving Huangjiu fermentation and were involved in regulating the formation of ethyl carbamate precursors. Furthermore, we successfully reconstructed the metabolic network for ethyl carbamate precursor formation. These findings contribute to refining the theoretical framework for the transport and metabolism of ethyl carbamate precursors, thereby enabling the effective regulation of ethyl carbamate formation. Consequently, this study provides a theoretical foundation for the targeted safety enhancement of other fermented alcoholic foods through the application of synthetic microbial communities.
articles.abstractZh: 氨基甲酸乙酯是一种 2A 类致癌物质，在黄酒酿造过程中自然形成，对提高最终产品的质量和安全性提出了重大挑战。合成微生物群落可以调节发酵过程中氨基甲酸乙酯的形成，有效降低黄酒中氨基甲酸乙酯的含量。然而，微生物群落与氨基甲酸乙酯前体形成之间的潜在关系仍有待阐明。在本研究中，我们采用综合宏转录组学和代谢组学分析来研究合成微生物群落发酵过程中微生物的潜在代谢功能，重点关注三个关键方面：微生物组成、功能基因和代谢物。代谢组学分析确定了发酵过程中的六种关键代谢物：尿素、精氨酸、瓜氨酸、鸟氨酸、高精氨酸和高瓜氨酸。宏转录组分析表明，总糖、尿素和瓜氨酸是黄酒发酵过程中微生物群落演替的主要驱动因素。发酵硅酸乳杆菌和酿酒酵母被鉴定为驱动黄酒发酵的核心功能菌种

articles.title: SmMYC complexes cooperative mediate methyl jasmonate regulates tanshinone biosynthesis in Salvia miltiorrhiza.
articles.titleZh: SmMYC 复合物协同介导茉莉酸甲酯调节丹参中丹参酮的生物合成。
articles.authors: Yao SC, Liao JQ, Yu HM, Yang RW, Jiang YY, Deng XX, Zhang X, Shen G, Pan RL, Deng Y, Lv R, Zhang L.
articles.abstract: The traditional Chinese medicine Salvia miltiorrhiza is widely used in the treatment of cardiovascular diseases due to its rich of phenolic acids and tanshinones. Among S. miltiorrhiza from different producing areas in China, the Sichuan ecotype (S. m.-SC) has the highest accumulation of phenolic acids, while the lack of tanshinones content seriously restricts its quality and downstream industrial development. It is urgent to develop the quality improvement cultivation technology and explore the regulation mechanism of tanshinone biosynthesis. Herein, we systematically evaluated the interaction between exogenous hormones and tanshinone accumulation in S. m.-SC, and found that Methyl jasmonate (MeJA) could significantly increase the accumulation of tanshinones in S. m.-SC. Based on the integration of pan-transcriptome datasets led to the construction of a tanshinones core metabolic regulatory network and SmMYC3 is a novel discovered positive regulator of tanshinone biosynthesis following SmMYC2a/2b. Yeast one-hybrid (Y1H) and Dual-LUC experiments showed that SmMYC3 directly binds to the G-box elements in the promoters of tanshinone biosynthesis genes (SmGGPPS1, SmKSL1, and SmCYP76AH1). Unexpectedly, SmMYC3-SmMYC2b/SmMYC3 complex identified via yeast two-hybrid (Y2H), Bimolecular fluorescence complementation (Bi-FC) and Dual-LUC experiments has robust enhance the transcriptional activation of the tanshinone metabolism genes upon the involvement of MeJA signaling. This work further expanded the molecular network of MYC transcription factor regulating tanshinone metabolism, clarified the regulatory mechanism of tanshinone biosynthesis mediated by MeJA, and drew a new blueprint for the application of MeJA in the increase of tanshinone content in S. miltiorrhiza.
articles.abstractZh: 中药丹参因其富含酚酸和丹参酮而被广泛用于治疗心血管疾病。我国不同产地的丹参中，四川生态型（S. m.-SC）酚酸积累量最高，而丹参酮含量的缺乏严重制约了其品质和下游产业发展。亟待发展品质改良栽培技术，探索丹参酮生物合成调控机制。在此，我们系统地评估了外源激素与S. m.-SC中丹参酮积累之间的相互作用，发现茉莉酸甲酯（MeJA）可以显着增加S. m.-SC中丹参酮的积累。基于泛转录组数据集的整合，构建了丹参酮核心代谢调控网络，SmMYC3是继SmMYC2a/2b之后新发现的丹参酮生物合成正调节因子。酵母单杂交 (Y1H) 和 Dual-LUC 实验表明，SmMYC3 直接与丹参酮生物合成基因（SmGGPPS1、SmKSL1 和 SmCYP76AH）启动子中的 G-box 元件结合

articles.title: Yeast bioaugmentation fosters medium-chain carboxylates and polyhydroxyalkanoates production from cheese whey.
articles.titleZh: 酵母生物强化促进奶酪乳清中链羧酸盐和聚羟基脂肪酸酯的生产。
articles.authors: Luo L, Vecchione D, Aponte M, Blaiotta G, Pradhan N, Dessì P.
articles.abstract: This study investigated polyhydroxyalkanoates (PHA) production from carboxylic acids obtained by yeast-assisted cheese whey (CW) fermentation. A three-stage hybrid strategy was employed. First, a lactose-fermenting yeast (Kluyveromyces marxianus) was inoculated into raw or sterilized CW to produce ethanol and/or lactic acid. Second, these intermediates were converted to carboxylic acids, with an emphasis on caproic acid, using a chain-elongating microbial culture. Batch and fermenter experiments under different operating conditions produced four distinct fermentation products with total carboxylic acid and alcohol concentrations from 4.5 to 14.1 g C/L, and a caproic acid fraction ranging from 17.8 to 72.5%. Finally, synthetic solutions simulating these complex acid mixtures were used as feedstocks for fed-batch PHA synthesis by Cupriavidus necator. The process achieved a maximum cell dry weight (CDW) of 6.54 ± 0.17 g/L with a PHA content of 44.21 ± 1.67%. The PHA contained variable proportions of polyhydroxybutyrate (PHB) and polyhydroxyvalerate (PHV), and high PHV fractions (21.91-27.56% w/w) were specifically linked to the presence of propionate and valerate in the feedstock. Yields of 0.79 ± 0.06 g CDW/g C consumed, and 0.36 ± 0.03 g PHA/g C consumed were achieved. This work investigates a novel proof-of-concept pathway for the valorization of CW into a tailored bioplastic, establishing a clear link between upstream fermentation control and the final material properties of the poly(3-hydroxybutyrate-co-3-hydroxyvalerate) (PHBV) copolymer using simulated fermentates.
articles.abstractZh: 本研究调查了通过酵母辅助奶酪乳清 (CW) 发酵获得的羧酸生产聚羟基脂肪酸酯 (PHA)。采用了三阶段混合策略。首先，将乳糖发酵酵母（马克斯克鲁维酵母）接种到未加工或灭菌的CW中以产生乙醇和/或乳酸。其次，使用链延长微生物培养物将这些中间体转化为羧酸，重点是己酸。不同操作条件下的批量和发酵罐实验产生了四种不同的发酵产物，总羧酸和酒精浓度为4.5至14.1 g C/L，己酸分数为17.8至72.5%。最后，模拟这些复杂酸混合物的合成溶液被用作由 Cupriavidus necator 进行补料分批 PHA 合成的原料。该工艺获得的最大细胞干重 (CDW) 为 6.54 ± 0.17 g/L，PHA 含量为 44.21 ± 1.67%。 PHA 含有不同比例的聚羟基丁酸酯 (PHB) 和聚羟基戊酸酯 (PHV)，高 PHV 分数 (21.91-27.56% w/w) 与原料中丙酸酯和戊酸酯的存在有明确关系。伊娥

articles.title: Yeast culture promotes butyrate produced fibrolytic bacteria as intracellular hydrogen sink in the rumen.
articles.titleZh: 酵母培养促进丁酸盐产生的纤维溶解细菌作为瘤胃中的细胞内氢汇。
articles.authors: Wang L, Li F, Ma Z, Ungerfeld EM, Zhang T, Zhang Z, Liu X, Zhang Q, Zhang X.
articles.abstract: BackgroundYeast culture (YC) supplementation is widely adopted to mitigate rumen pH depression and alleviate the inhibition of fiber degradation under starch-rich diets. Yet, the underlying microbial mechanisms, particularly how yeast culture orchestrates fibrolytic communities and affects metabolic hydrogen flow in the rumen, remain a critical knowledge gap. Accordingly, elucidating the microbial basis by which yeast culture modulates fiber degradation and hydrogen utilization under starch-rich diets is of both theoretical and practical importance.MethodsWe conducted a study with growing lambs receiving starch-rich diets that differed only in yeast culture supplementation (CON 0%, YC 1%). We evaluated their growth performance, apparent total-tract digestibilities, rumen fermentation end-products, and the rumen metagenome.ResultsThe YC treatment increased the lambs' final body mass (P = 0.02), average daily gain (P = 0.03), digestibilities of neutral detergent fiber (P ConclusionYeast culture supplementation promoted the proliferation of a distinct butyrogenic consortium that degrades fiber while apparently disposing intracellularly metabolic hydrogen generated during fermentation, rather than releasing it as H2. These findings provide a microbial basis for understanding how yeast culture improves fermentation efficiency under starch-rich diets and suggest that selecting yeast culture products capable of promoting butyrogenic fibrolytic bacteria may be beneficial for ruminant performance and rumen stability. articles.abstractZh: 背景酵母培养物 (YC) 补充剂被广泛采用来减轻瘤胃 pH 值降低并减轻富含淀粉日粮下纤维降解的抑制。然而，潜在的微生物机制，特别是酵母培养物如何协调纤维溶解群落并影响瘤胃中的代谢氢流，仍然是一个关键的知识空白。因此，阐明酵母培养物在富含淀粉日粮下调节纤维降解和氢利用的微生物基础具有重要的理论和实践意义。方法我们对接受富含淀粉日粮的生长羔羊进行了一项研究，其差异仅在于酵母培养物的补充（CON 0%，YC 1%）。我们评估了它们的生长性能、表观全消化道消化率、瘤胃发酵终产物和瘤胃宏基因组。 结果 YC 处理增加了羔羊的最终体重 (P = 0.02)、平均日增重 (P = 0.03)、中性洗涤纤维的消化率 (P 结论酵母培养物补充促进了独特的丁酸生成菌群的增殖，该菌群降解纤维，同时明显处理发酵过程中产生的细胞内代谢氢，

articles.title: Heat-Damaged Fruits of 'Čačanska Lepotica' as a Raw Material for Plum Spirit Production: Possibilities for Improving Product Quality.
articles.titleZh: 作为李子酒生产原料的“Čačanska Lepotica”热损伤果实：提高产品质量的可能性。
articles.authors: Popović B, Nikićević N, Tešević V, Urošević I, Mitrović O, Leposavić A, Korićanac A.
articles.abstract: Because of the rising occurrence of extremely hot summers linked to climate change, there is a mass appearance of heat-damaged fruits of 'Čačanska Lepotica', which are unsuitable for fresh consumption and processing into products in which the fruits' appearance is a critical quality attribute. To address this issue, the aim of the study was to examine the possibility of producing plum spirits from such fruits as one of the potential ways to utilize them. Heat-damaged fruits were processed in nine different ways, including a traditional one. All produced plum spirits met legal requirements. GC-MS analysis of 39 volatile compounds revealed that the plum spirits made from heat-damaged fruits had different aromatic profiles depending on the processing method applied. However, the plum spirit produced in the traditional way had various sensory defects; the most notable were a lack of freshness and a distinctly unpleasant 'cooked plum' aroma. Modifications to the production method led to an improvement in the sensory characteristics of the plum spirits. The obtained results indicate that modifications in small distilleries should include fruit crushing, stone removal and usage of baker's yeast. In large distilleries, though, the best sensory characteristics for plum spirits made from heat-damaged fruits could be obtained using a production method that includes fruit pulping with stone removal and spontaneous alcoholic fermentation, with one additional step: lowering the pH of the mash before alcoholic fermentation to 3.0.
articles.abstractZh: 由于与气候变化相关的极热夏季越来越多，“Čačanska Lepotica”热损伤水果大量出现，这些水果不适合新鲜食用和加工成以水果外观为关键质量属性的产品。为了解决这个问题，该研究的目的是探讨从这些水果中生产李子酒的可能性，作为利用它们的潜在方法之一。热损伤的水果有九种不同的加工方式，其中包括传统的加工方式。所有生产的梅酒均符合法定要求。对 39 种挥发性化合物的 GC-MS 分析表明，根据所采用的加工方法，由热损伤水果制成的李子酒具有不同的芳香特征。然而，传统方法生产的梅酒存在各种感官缺陷；最值得注意的是缺乏新鲜度和明显令人不快的“熟李子”香气。生产方法的改进改善了李子酒的感官特性。获得的结果表明，小型酿酒厂的改造应包括水果粉碎、去石和使用面包师

articles.title: Optimization of fermentation medium for advancing postbiotic antibacterial activity.
articles.titleZh: 优化发酵培养基以提高生后抗菌活性。
articles.authors: Garrote-Achou C, Cantalejo-Díez MJ, Flandes-de-Cía A.
articles.abstract: Antimicrobial postbiotic compounds have attracted increasing interest due to their potential applications in the food industry, particularly as candidates for biopreservation strategies. From a technological perspective, process optimization represents a valuable strategy for improving the production of postbiotic compounds and supporting the development of efficient fermentation bioprocesses. This study aimed to optimize the culture medium to enhance the antibacterial activity of a postbiotic derived from Pediococcus acidilactici CECT 9879. Plackett-Burman design (PBD) was first used to screen carbon and nitrogen sources, followed by one-factor-at-a-time (OFAT) experiments to evaluate yeast-derived ingredients and MRS-derived basal medium components, and response surface methodology based on a central composite design (CCD-RSM) for final medium optimization. Significant linear, quadratic, and interaction effects of key medium components, particularly yeast-derived ingredients and sodium acetate, were identified, indicating well-defined optimal concentration ranges. Under optimized composition, the minimum inhibitory concentration (MIC) against Escherichia coli decreased from 48.33 ± 2.89% (v/v) in the non-optimized medium to 31.67 ± 2.89% (v/v). The results highlight the role of nutrient optimization in modulating postbiotic antibacterial activity during fermentation and provide insights that may contribute to improving process efficiency in the agri-food sector.
articles.abstractZh: 抗菌后生元化合物由于其在食品工业中的潜在应用，特别是作为生物保存策略的候选者，引起了越来越多的兴趣。从技术角度来看，工艺优化是改善后生元化合物生产和支持高效发酵生物工艺开发的重要策略。本研究旨在优化培养基，以增强源自乳酸片球菌 CECT 9879 的后生元的抗菌活性。首先使用 Plackett-Burman 设计 (PBD) 筛选碳源和氮源，然后通过一次单因素 (OFAT) 实验评估酵母源成分和 MRS 源基础培养基成分，并基于中心复合设计 (CCD-RSM) 的响应面方法进行最终培养基优化。确定了关键培养基成分（特别是酵母衍生成分和乙酸钠）的显着线性、二次和相互作用效应，表明明确的最佳浓度范围。优化组合下，对大肠杆菌的最低抑菌浓度（MIC）从48.33下降

articles.title: 10 years of CRISPR/CAS genomic engineering in Yarrowia lipolytica.
articles.titleZh: 解脂耶氏酵母 CRISPR/CAS 基因组工程 10 年。
articles.authors: Dias RG, Freitas FPM, Barbosa SL, Assis JVMG, Entringer TL, Fonseca JSC, Romanizio ME, Pimentel BBZ, Campos-Galvão MEM, Vieira NM, Fietto LG, Zsögön A, da Silveira WB.
articles.abstract: Yarrowia lipolytica is a versatile cell factory widely used in bioprocesses for producing lipids, organic acids, and other high-value compounds. Historically, its genetic engineering was constrained by low homologous recombination (HR) efficiency and the predominance of non-homologous end joining (NHEJ), limiting strain development and metabolic pathway optimization. The advent of CRISPR-Cas technologies has revolutionized genome editing in Y. lipolytica, enabling precise, efficient, and multiplexed modifications. Innovations such as pCAS1yl and pCRISPRyl plasmids, along with genomic Cas9 integration, have enhanced targeted editing efficiency. CRISPR applications now extend to metabolic engineering for lipids, itaconic acid, erythritol, and other compounds. Beyond canonical Cas9, alternative systems, including CRISPRa, Cas12a, base editors, and sgRNA libraries, provide increased flexibility and functional diversity. Central to these approaches is the rational design of guide RNAs (gRNAs), supported by bioinformatics platforms such as CHOPCHOP v3, CRISPOR, CCTop, and Cas-OFFinder, which assist in target site selection, off-target prediction, and editing optimization. This review summarizes the main CRISPR/Cas9 applications in Y. lipolytica, highlighting key engineered strains and emphasizing the critical role of bioinformatics in improving editing strategies. We also propose a pipeline for systematic gRNA design based on published evidence and discuss future perspectives, including the integration of machine learning, artificial intelligence, and emerging CRISPR variants to further advance yeast metabolic engineering.
articles.abstractZh: 解脂耶氏酵母是一种多功能细胞工厂，广泛用于生产脂质、有机酸和其他高价值化合物的生物过程。从历史上看，其基因工程受到同源重组（HR）效率低和非同源末端连接（NHEJ）占主导地位的限制，限制了菌株的开发和代谢途径的优化。 CRISPR-Cas 技术的出现彻底改变了解脂耶氏酵母的基因组编辑，实现了精确、高效和多重修饰。 pCAS1yl 和 pCRISPRyl 质粒等创新以及基因组 Cas9 整合增强了靶向编辑效率。 CRISPR 应用现已扩展到脂质、衣康酸、赤藓糖醇和其他化合物的代谢工程。除了规范的 Cas9 之外，替代系统（包括 CRISPRa、Cas12a、碱基编辑器和 sgRNA 文库）可提供更高的灵活性和功能多样性。这些方法的核心是引导 RNA (gRNA) 的合理设计，并得到 CHOPCHOP v3、CRISPOR、CCTop 和 Cas-OFFinder 等生物信息学平台的支持，这些平台有助于靶位点选择、脱靶预测和编辑优化。本次审核总和

articles.title: Building a programmable protein factory: Recent advances in expression element engineering for Komagataella phaffii.
articles.titleZh: 构建可编程蛋白质工厂：Komagataella phaffii 表达元件工程的最新进展。
articles.authors: Song Y, Zeng Z, Pan L, Liao A, Liu N, Huang J, Tian H, Wang X.
articles.abstract: The methylotrophic yeast Komagataella phaffii (formerly Pichia pastoris) has become one of the most widely adopted eukaryotic platforms for heterologous protein production, with more than 5000 recombinant proteins successfully expressed across the biopharmaceutical, industrial enzyme, and food biotechnology sectors. The efficiency of this expression system depends on the coordinated performance of four categories of genetic elements, namely promoters, transcription terminators, signal peptides, and expression vectors. Although significant advances have been achieved in engineering each element individually, existing reviews have largely addressed these components in isolation, leaving researchers without an integrated framework for rational expression cassette design. Here, we bridge this gap by providing a unified analysis of recent progress across all four element categories. At the transcriptional level, the promoter landscape has expanded well beyond the classical methanol-inducible pAOX1 and constitutive pGAP through strategies that include transcription factor binding site remodeling, nucleosome positioning manipulation, chimeric construction, and heterologous core promoter mining. Equally important yet historically overlooked, transcription terminators have been shown to span a 17-fold activity range through systematic characterization of 72 endogenous and synthetic sequences, establishing terminator identity as an independent determinant of protein yield. At the translocation level, signal peptide engineering through directed evolution, modular fusion, and codon optimization has yielded variants with up to 14-fold improvements in secretion efficiency, underscoring that the optimal leader sequence is highly cargo-dependent. Underpinning these regulatory and secretory advances, vector technology has evolved from monolithic integrative plasmids to modular cloning (MoClo) and Golden Gate assembly platforms, CRISPR-enabled multi-locus integration toolkits, and the recently released licence-free OPENPichia system. By integrating these four element categories within a unified analytical framework, this review establishes practical guidelines for combinatorial cassette design and identifies critical knowledge gaps-including the lack of quantitative models for cross-element interactions and the absence of standardized benchmarking conditions-whose resolution will accelerate the rational engineering of high-performance K. phaffii production strains.
articles.abstractZh: 甲基营养酵母 Komagataella phaffii（以前称为毕赤酵母）已成为最广泛采用的异源蛋白质生产真核平台之一，在生物制药、工业酶和食品生物技术领域成功表达了 5000 多种重组蛋白。该表达系统的效率取决于四类遗传元件的协调性能，即启动子、转录终止子、信号肽和表达载体。尽管在单独设计每个元件方面已经取得了重大进展，但现有的评论在很大程度上孤立地解决了这些组件，使研究人员没有合理表达盒设计的集成框架。在这里，我们通过对所有四个要素类别的最新进展进行统一分析来弥补这一差距。在转录水平上，通过转录因子结合位点重塑、核小体定位操作、嵌合构建和异源核心启动子等策略，启动子景观已经远远超出了经典的甲醇诱导型 pAOX1 和组成型 pGAP。

articles.title: Effects of Different Yeast Strains on Fermentation Characteristics, Volatile Flavor Compounds, and Sensory Quality of Xinjiang <i>Ziziphus jujuba</i> 'Huizao' Wine.
articles.titleZh: 不同酵母菌株对新疆大枣‘徽枣’酒发酵特性、挥发性风味物质及感官品质的影响。
articles.authors: Zhao B, Huang L, Zuo Q, Fan Y, Adnan MY, Wang S, Shao F.
articles.abstract: Xinjiang Ziziphus jujuba 'Huizao' wine, a characteristic fruit wine in China, is facing industrial bottlenecks such as flavor homogenization and lack of specialized fermentation yeasts, which limits its high-quality development. To solve these problems, four laboratory-preserved indigenous yeast strains (NZ5, NZ6, BH4, BH2) were compared with four commercial strains (FR, RW, RA, SY) in terms of fermentation dynamics, volatile flavor compound synthesis (HS-SPME-GC-MS/GC-FID), and sensory quality to screen the optimal yeast for Ziziphus jujuba 'Huizao' wine fermentation. Molecular identification revealed that NZ5 and NZ6 belong to Saccharomyces cerevisiae, while BH4 and BH2 are closely related to Pichia kudriavzevii, respectively, indicating their non-Saccharomyces characteristics with distinct metabolic potentials. The results showed that indigenous strains exhibited significantly superior performance to commercial strains: (1) Saccharomyces strains NZ5 and NZ6 had higher fermentation efficiency, with 12.5-25% shorter fermentation cycles and 14% higher cumulative CO2 release than commercial strains; (2) Non-Saccharomyces strain BH4 synthesized the most diverse volatile flavors (99 compounds), with ethyl acetate content reaching 314.92 mg/L, which was 13-fold higher than that of commercial yeast FR (24.09 mg/L). Meanwhile, its phenethyl alcohol content reached 3.12 mg/L, 7.2 times that of commercial yeast RW; (3) Sensory evaluation showed that BH4-fermented wine had the highest score (88.59), significantly higher than commercial strains (63.57-67.67). In conclusion, BH4 is the optimal strain for improving the flavor quality of Xinjiang Ziziphus jujuba 'Huizao' wine, and NZ5/NZ6 are suitable for efficient industrial fermentation. This study provides valuable microbial resources and technical guidance for the quality improvement and industrial development of Xinjiang characteristic fruit wine.

articles.title: Evaluation of fermentation performance of yeast strains isolated from Passiflora ligularis.
articles.titleZh: 从西番莲中分离的酵母菌株的发酵性能评价。
articles.authors: Feng S, Zhu Q, Cai J, Xu Q, Li J, Sun Q, Mao Y, Zhu L.
articles.abstract: This study aimed to identify high-performing yeast strains suitable for the fermentation of Passiflora ligularis wine (PLW). A total of thirty indigenous yeast isolates were obtained from spontaneous fermentation samples of P. ligularis fruit. Strain selection was conducted through systematic evaluation of key oenological traits, including CO₂ evolution rate, ethanol yield, ester synthesis capacity, hydrogen sulfide (H₂S) production, and antagonistic activity against common spoilage microorganisms. Based on these criteria, several strains with excellent fermentation performance have been selected. Molecular identification confirmed that one isolate belonged to Saccharomyces cerevisiae (designated FSQ-1), while the remaining seven were non-Saccharomyces yeasts, six strains of Pichia kluyveri and one strain of Hanseniaspora uvarum. Comprehensive stress tolerance profiling revealed that all eight strains exhibited robust growth under challenging enological conditions: temperature range 4-40 °C, pH 2.5, high osmolarity (400 g/L sucrose), elevated ethanol concentration (12% v/v), and high SO₂ levels (400 mg/L). Furthermore, all strains efficiently assimilated standard carbon sources and nitrogen sources. Collectively, S. cerevisiae FSQ-1 demonstrated the most favorable combination of fermentation efficiency, metabolic stability, and stress resilience, positioning it as the leading candidate starter culture for PLW production. This work contributes to the development of regionally adapted, functionally characterized yeast resources for PLW manufacturing.
articles.abstractZh: 本研究旨在鉴定适合西番莲酒（PLW）发酵的高性能酵母菌株。从橐吾果实的自然发酵样品中获得了总共 30 个本土酵母分离株。通过对关键酿酒学特性的系统评估进行菌株选择，包括二氧化碳释放速率、乙醇产量、酯合成能力、硫化氢 (H2S) 产生以及对常见腐败微生物的拮抗活性。根据这些标准，选择了几种具有优异发酵性能的菌株。分子鉴定证实，一株属于酿酒酵母（命名为 FSQ-1），其余七株为非酿酒酵母、六株克鲁维毕赤酵母（Pichia kluyveri）和一株Hanseniaspora uvarum。全面的胁迫耐受性分析显示，所有八个菌株在具有挑战性的酿酒条件下均表现出强劲的生长：温度范围 4-40 °C、pH 2.5、高渗透压（400 g/L 蔗糖）、升高的乙醇浓度（12% v/v）和高 SO2 水平（400 mg/L）。此外，所有菌株都有效地同化标准碳源和

articles.title: Impact of direct cell-cell contact in a three-species wine yeast consortium.
articles.titleZh: 三种葡萄酒酵母菌群中细胞与细胞直接接触的影响。
articles.authors: Asmus JJ, Naidoo-Blassoples RK, Bauer FF.
articles.abstract: Wine fermentations provide a model ecosystem for studying microbial interactions between yeast species. This includes antagonistic, neutral and synergistic interactions, in which nutrient competition, metabolic exchange, and killer toxin production were identified as factors impacting ecosystem functioning. Several studies have shown that physical contact between cells of different species also affects ecosystem functioning; however, the mechanisms by which cell-cell contact elicits such responses remains poorly understood. The molecular impact of physical contact was evaluated using membrane bioreactors to physically separate species while allowing metabolic exchange. However, bioreactor designs have been limited in such studies to evaluating two-species binary interactions. Therefore, we evaluated the impact of direct cell-cell contact on the physiology and gene expression of Saccharomyces cerevisiae within a yeast consortium including Lachancea thermotolerans and Torulaspora delbrueckii. A membrane bioreactor allowed continuous media exchange between separate fermentation vessels. Yeast growth, extracellular metabolites, and S. cerevisiae transcriptional profiles were monitored at two timepoints. Direct cell contact favored S. cerevisiae growth and resulted in significantly different amino acid profiles, while indirect (metabolic) contact favored T. delbrueckii growth at the expense of L. theromotolerans. In addition, transcriptional analysis revealed that treatment-specific gene regulation differed from responses previously reported for two-species systems of these yeasts, e.g., strong induction of HPF1, while similarities included upregulation of high-affinity hexose transporters (e.g., HXT6 and 7) and downregulation of sporulation genes. These results indicate that cell-cell contact impacts ecosystem dynamics and nutrient uptake and promotes distinct gene expression responses in S. cerevisiae within a multispecies wine consortium. KEY POINTS: • Multispecies consortium moves beyond binary yeast interaction studies. • S. cerevisiae growth and amino acid profiles differ in direct and indirect contact. • Direct contact elicits unique S. cerevisiae gene expression, e.g., HPF1 upregulation.

articles.title: Synergistic fungal-enzymatic fermentation of corn straw enhances nutritional value, microbial stability, and bio-feed quality.
articles.titleZh: 玉米秸秆的协同真菌酶发酵可提高营养价值、微生物稳定性和生物饲料质量。
articles.authors: Zhang H, Abbas Z, Li H, Zhu Y, Hu X, Si D.
articles.abstract: Valorizing mature, dry corn straw into nutritional animal feed is constrained by its recalcitrant lignocellulosic matrix, while conventional silage methods face stability and logistical limitations. Existing enzymatic and bacterial approaches often lack synergistic efficacy and fail to mitigate pathogen risk in dry biomass systems. We engineered a two-stage fungal-enzymatic fermentation strategy employing a consortium of Aspergillus niger LFB-AN14, Coriolopsis trogii LFB-F1, Bacillus subtilis LFB-BS7, and Pediococcus acidilactici A62, integrated with cellulase, xylanase, and laccase under optimized conditions (1% inoculation, 5:5:1:1 ratio, 37 °C, 21 days). Our results demonstrated that the bacterial-enzyme co-treatment (Group A3) significantly reduced fiber content, with neutral detergent fiber (NDF) and acid detergent fiber (ADF) decreasing by 22.6% and 29.1%, respectively, compared to the control (p 50% abundance) and inhibition of pathogenic Enterobacter spp. Structural analyses (SEM, FTIR) confirmed extensive lignocellulose deconstruction, particularly through carbonyl and hydroxyl functional groups. Metagenomic analysis revealed upregulated Auxiliary Activity (AA) enzymes and cellulosome modules, elucidating the mechanistic basis for enhanced degradation. KEGG enrichment highlighted enhanced aromatic compound metabolism and yeast proliferation, reflecting superior metabolic efficiency. This integrated fungal-enzymatic approach establishes a safe, scalable, and metabolically efficient strategy for transforming agricultural residues into high-quality bio-feed, resolving key challenges in fiber digestibility, pathogen control, and storage stability for sustainable livestock production.
articles.abstractZh: 将成熟、干燥的玉米秸秆用于营养性动物饲料受到其顽固的木质纤维素基质的限制，而传统的青贮方法面临稳定性和后勤方面的限制。现有的酶和细菌方法通常缺乏协同功效，并且无法减轻干燥生物质系统中的病原体风险。我们设计了一种两阶段真菌酶发酵策略，采用黑曲霉 LFB-AN14、Coriolopsis trogii LFB-F1、枯草芽孢杆菌 LFB-BS7 和乳酸片球菌 A62 的联合体，在优化条件下（1% 接种、5:5:1:1 比例、37 °C、 21 天）。我们的结果表明，细菌-酶共处理（A3 组）显着降低了纤维含量，与对照（p 50% 丰度）和抑制致病性肠杆菌相比，中性洗涤纤维（NDF）和酸性洗涤纤维（ADF）分别降低了 22.6% 和 29.1%。结构分析（SEM、FTIR）证实了木质纤维素的广泛解构，特别是通过羰基和羟基官能团。宏基因组分析显示辅助活性 (AA) 酶上调

articles.title: Yeast cryoinjury in frozen dough: A review on ice crystal-induced hierarchical classification of multi-pathway damage and targeted defense mechanisms.
articles.titleZh: 冷冻面团中的酵母冷冻损伤：冰晶诱导的多途径损伤分级分类和靶向防御机制的综述。
articles.authors: Wang T, Zhang X, Bao Y, Ke J, Xie G, Zhou L, Pan F.
articles.abstract: Yeast survival rate is a key limiting factor for the quality stability of frozen dough. Ice crystal formation and growth act as the primary cause of yeast cryoinjury under freezing stress. They impair yeast cells through three interconnected pathways, including mechanical disruption, osmotic imbalance, and oxidative stress, thereby weakening cell vitality and fermentation capacity. This review proposes a novel cryoinjury hierarchy model. It clarifies that the three damage pathways do not function in parallel but exhibit dynamically dominant roles under varying freezing conditions. In low-sugar systems, mechanical disruption dominates and couples with osmotic imbalance. In high-sugar systems, the damage hierarchy is reversed. Osmotic stress serves as the primary trigger, accompanied by ice crystal mechanical damage and ethanol-mediated oxidative stress. Meanwhile, this review summarizes targeted defense systems against diverse freezing injuries. Core mechanisms involve physical protection, osmotic and protein homeostasis regulation, and oxidative stress balance. A systematic condition-damage-defense theoretical framework is established. It provides solid theoretical references for exploring yeast cryoinjury mechanisms and optimizing the quality stability of frozen dough.
articles.abstractZh: 酵母存活率是冷冻面团质量稳定性的关键限制因素。冰晶的形成和生长是冷冻应激下酵母低温损伤的主要原因。它们通过三个相互关联的途径损害酵母细胞，包括机械破坏、渗透失衡和氧化应激，从而削弱细胞活力和发酵能力。本综述提出了一种新颖的冷冻损伤层次模型。它阐明了三种损伤途径并不并行发挥作用，而是在不同的冷冻条件下表现出动态主导作用。在低糖系统中，机械破坏占主导地位，并与渗透压失衡相伴。在高糖系统中，损害等级是相反的。渗透应激是主要触发因素，伴随着冰晶机械损伤和乙醇介导的氧化应激。同时，本文总结了针对不同冻伤的针对性防御系统。核心机制涉及物理保护、渗透压和蛋白质稳态调节以及氧化应激平衡。建立了系统的状况-损伤-防御理论框架。为电子行业的发展提供了坚实的理论参考

articles.title: A yeast-based platform for etoposide production via yatein bioconversion.
articles.titleZh: 一种基于酵母的平台，通过耶汀生物转化生产依托泊苷。
articles.authors: Gautron N, Perrin J, Lopez-Vazquez AL, Melin C, Unlubayir M, Tiger K, Nicolas C, Cuello C, Clastre M, Papon N, Giglioli-Guivarc'h N, Guillonneau L, Gillaizeau I, Hano C, Jillian M, Besseau S, Courdavault V.
articles.abstract: Etoposide, a semisynthetic derivative of podophyllotoxin originally isolated from the rhizomes of mayapple (Podophyllum peltatum) and indian Podophyllum (P. hexandrum) plants, is one of the most powerful chemotherapeutic agents used to treat various types of solid tumors and blood malignancies. Despite its clinical importance, its supply is recurrently constrained due to a heavy reliance on plant extraction, where low natural precursor abundance and increasing climate-related pressures limit production scalability. Developing alternative manufacturing routes has therefore become a major objective, though reconstruction of this complex biosynthetic pathway has long posed significant challenges, even with recent advances in synthetic biology and metabolic engineering. Yeast has emerged as a robust cellular chassis for reconstituting, either partially or entirely, plant secondary metabolite pathways, and enabling cost-effective bioproduction. Here, we established an integrated biotechnological strategy for the sustainable production of advanced etoposide intermediates using engineered yeast cell factories. By combining pathway refactoring, gene copy number optimization, and tailored co-enzyme compatibility, we established an efficient heterologous pathway converting yatein into (-)-4'-desmethyl-epipodophyllotoxin (4'dEPT) in yeast. Iterative strain engineering improved metabolic flux distribution, leading to enhanced titers and accelerated production kinetics, while process engineering proved essential to maximizing overall system performance. Finally, we also demonstrated the viability of coupling bioproduction in cell factories with downstream, semisynthetic conversion by successfully isolating bioreactor-derived 4'dEPT and converting it into etoposide. In parallel, identifying resilient plant resources that can accumulate high levels of YAT provides a complementary strategy for securing the precursor supply at scale. Overall, this report validates the concept of a hybrid etoposide production platform integrating controlled plant biomass sourcing, engineered yeast cell factories, and chemical transformation steps.
articles.abstractZh: 依托泊苷是鬼臼毒素的半合成衍生物，最初从鬼臼（Podophyllum peltatum）和印度鬼臼（P. hexandrum）植物的根茎中分离出来，是用于治疗各种类型实体瘤和血液恶性肿瘤的最强大的化疗药物之一。尽管其临床重要性，但由于严重依赖植物提取，其供应经常受到限制，而植物提取的天然前体丰度较低，且与气候相关的压力日益增加，限制了生产规模。因此，开发替代生产路线已成为一个主要目标，尽管合成生物学和代谢工程最近取得了进展，但这种复杂的生物合成途径的重建长期以来一直面临着重大挑战。酵母已成为一种强大的细胞底盘，可部分或全部重建植物次生代谢途径，并实现具有成本效益的生物生产。在这里，我们建立了一个综合生物技术策略，利用工程酵母细胞工厂可持续生产先进的依托泊苷中间体。通过结合通路重构、基因拷贝数优化和定制c

articles.title: Dual-channel optogenetics in yeast for multiplexed light-based control of cellular processes and pathways.
articles.titleZh: 酵母中的双通道光遗传学用于细胞过程和途径的多重光控制。
articles.authors: Tan LYH, Lin Z, Yeoh JW, Zhang J, Poh CL.
articles.abstract: Optogenetics which involves the use of light to control cell functions on a genetic level has found utility in studying cell physiology, biomaterials and metabolic engineering. S. cerevisiae is an industrially relevant model organism that is used in many applications, but due to the large number of genes required and issues relating to cross-activation between different colours, optogenetics for different wavelengths of light have not been multiplexed in S. cerevisiae. In this paper, we develop a compact red light responsive optogenetic system for S. cerevisiae that requires only a single gene and no exogenous cofactors. Through engineering modular protein domains, we reduce the cross-activation of our system by blue light. We integrate our red light optogenetic system with EL222 blue light optogenetics to establish dual channel optogenetics in S. cerevisiae and demonstrate its utility for engineering biology through the light-based control of flavonoid luteolin synthesis and flocculation for ease of product extraction. We also demonstrate our system's potential for the development of living materials by producing dual-coloured optogenetic patterns using S. cerevisiae. This work expands optogenetic applications in S. cerevisiae from single-light to multi-light systems, introducing the potential to multiplex different colours of light for dynamic, orthogonal control of separate cell processes.
articles.abstractZh: 光遗传学涉及利用光在基因水平上控制细胞功能，它在研究细胞生理学、生物材料和代谢工程中具有实用性。酿酒酵母是一种工业相关的模式生物，用于许多应用，但由于需要大量基因以及与不同颜色之间交叉激活相关的问题，不同波长光的光遗传学尚未在酿酒酵母中多重化。在本文中，我们为酿酒酵母开发了一种紧凑的红光响应光遗传学系统，该系统仅需要单个基因且不需要外源辅因子。通过设计模块化蛋白质结构域，我们减少了蓝光对系统的交叉激活。我们将红光光遗传学系统与 EL222 蓝光光遗传学相结合，在酿酒酵母中建立双通道光遗传学，并通过基于光的黄酮类木犀草素合成和絮凝控制以方便产品提取，展示其在工程生物学中的实用性。我们还通过使用酿酒酵母产生双色光遗传学图案来展示我们的系统开发生物材料的潜力。这项工作前

articles.title: Engineering yeast metabolism for robust bioproduction under industrial conditions.
articles.titleZh: 对酵母代谢进行改造，以在工业条件下实现稳健的生物生产。
articles.authors: Araújo J, Domingues L.
articles.abstract: Yeast industrial bioproduction is often constrained by stress, substrate variability, and metabolic imbalance. This review provides a critical overview of recent advances in engineering yeast metabolism for robust performance under industrial conditions, increasingly defined by the use of renewable and heterogeneous feedstocks, which impose additional physiological and metabolic challenges. We highlight strategies that have gained particular relevance in the current literature, including the engineering of redox homeostasis and central carbon metabolism, detoxification and stress mitigation pathways, and the reduction of metabolic burden. The increasing contribution of systems biology and multi-omics, alongside dynamic and synthetic regulatory strategies, is also addressed. Finally, we explore the potential of naturally robust yeast chassis and outline future directions for resilient, sustainable, and scalable bioproduction systems.
articles.abstractZh: 酵母工业生物生产常常受到压力、底物变异和代谢失衡的限制。这篇综述对酵母代谢工程的最新进展进行了重要概述，以在工业条件下实现稳健的性能，工业条件下，工业条件下越来越多地通过使用可再生和异质原料来定义，这带来了额外的生理和代谢挑战。我们重点介绍在当前文献中特别相关的策略，包括氧化还原稳态和中心碳代谢的工程、解毒和压力缓解途径以及代谢负担的减轻。还讨论了系统生物学和多组学的日益增长的贡献，以及动态和综合监管策略。最后，我们探索了天然强大的酵母底盘的潜力，并概述了弹性、可持续和可扩展的生物生产系统的未来方向。

articles.title: Evaluating <i>Lachancea thermotolerans</i> for table olive fermentation: performance under pH and NaCl stress conditions.
articles.titleZh: 评估 Lachancea thermotolerans 的食用橄榄发酵：pH 和 NaCl 胁迫条件下的性能。
articles.authors: Gil-Flores P, Penco-Parra D, Bautista-Gallego J.
articles.abstract: This study evaluates the biotechnological potential of Lachancea thermotolerans, a non-Saccharomyces yeast species commonly characterized by its ability to produce L-lactic acid, for its application in Spanish-style table olive fermentation. A total of sixty-six L. thermotolerans strains were assessed under varying pH and NaCl conditions, two key stress factors in table olive processing. Growth performance was determined through the analysis of growth curves and compared with those of Wickerhamomyces anomalus and Candida boidinii, two yeast species commonly isolated from table olive fermentations. To characterize strain behavior under stress conditions, growth parameters derived from the models were further analyzed using Principal Component Analysis and hierarchical clustering. These approaches enabled the classification of strains according to their tolerance to pH and salt stress, as well as the identification of groups with distinct growth kinetics. The results revealed significant variability among L. thermotolerans strains, highlighting a strain-dependent response to environmental stressors. A subset of strains exhibited high tolerance to both pH and NaCl conditions, demonstrating stable growth performance and suggesting a strong adaptive capacity. These findings support the potential application of selected L. thermotolerans strains as promising candidates for controlled table olive fermentation processes.
articles.abstractZh: 本研究评估了 Lachancea thermotolerans（一种非酵母菌属酵母菌种，其通常具有产生 L-乳酸的能力）在西班牙式食用橄榄发酵中的应用的生物技术潜力。在不同的 pH 值和 NaCl 条件（食用橄榄加工中的两个关键应激因素）下对总共 66 个耐热乳杆菌菌株进行了评估。通过分析生长曲线来确定生长性能，并与异常威克哈姆酵母和博伊丁假丝酵母（通常从食用橄榄发酵中分离出的两种酵母）进行比较。为了表征应力条件下的应变行为，使用主成分分析和层次聚类进一步分析了从模型导出的生长参数。这些方法能够根据菌株对 pH 和盐胁迫的耐受性进行分类，并识别具有不同生长动力学的群体。结果揭示了耐热乳杆菌菌株之间的显着变异，强调了对环境应激源的菌株依赖性反应。菌株的一个子集对 pH 值和 NaCl 条件表现出高度耐受性，证明

articles.title: Genome-wide identification of the MYB gene family and identification of candidate genes that involved in anthocyanin synthesis in cowpea (Vigna unguiculata [L.] Walp).
articles.titleZh: 对豇豆 (Vigna unguiculata [L.] Walp) MYB 基因家族进行全基因组鉴定，并鉴定参与花青素合成的候选基因。
articles.authors: Xia L, Wang K, Guan F, Shi B, Yang X, Xie Y, Wan X, Zhang J.
articles.abstract: MYB transcription factors are important for plant growth development and abiotic stress response, especially in anthocyanin synthesis. However, the comprehensive genome-wide analysis of the MYB gene family in cowpea is unclear. In this study, 227 VuMYB genes were identified in cowpea, including 62 1R-VuMYB, 161 2R-VuMYB, and 4 3R-VuMYB. Phylogenetic analysis showed that 2R-VuMYB genes could be divided into 26 groups, where members of the same subfamily exhibited relatively conserved motifs. The co-linearity analysis showed that 66 segmental duplication events were found in VuMYB genes, and 130 orthologous groups were identified among MYB synteny genes in legume plants. By comparative transcriptome and protein interaction analysis, 2 genes (VuMYB84 and VuMYB132) were identified as potentially involved in cowpea pod anthocyanin synthesis. Subcellular localization and transcriptional activation experiments showed that VuMYB84 and VuMYB132 located in the nucleus, which had transcriptional activation activity. Sequence analysis and yeast two-hybridization showed that VuMYB84 and VuMYB132 contained WER motifs (DEEDLIIRLHKLLGNRWSLIAGR), which could interact with VubHLH3. In conclusion, our results provide a systematic analysis of the VuMYB gene family and ideas for the VuMYB gene family's involvement in the regulation of cowpea anthocyanin biosynthesis.
articles.abstractZh: MYB转录因子对于植物生长发育和非生物胁迫响应非常重要，特别是在花青素合成中。然而，对豇豆 MYB 基因家族的全面全基因组分析尚不清楚。本研究在豇豆中鉴定出 227 个 VuMYB 基因，其中 62 个 1R-VuMYB、161 个 2R-VuMYB 和 4 个 3R-VuMYB。系统发育分析表明，2R-VuMYB基因可分为26个组，同一亚家族的成员表现出相对保守的基序。共线性分析表明，豆科植物VuMYB基因中发现了66个片段重复事件，并且在MYB同线性基因中鉴定出了130个直系同源群。通过比较转录组和蛋白质相互作用分析，确定 2 个基因（VuMYB84 和 VuMYB132）可能参与豇豆荚花青素的合成。亚细胞定位和转录激活实验表明，VuMYB84和VuMYB132位于细胞核内，具有转录激活活性。序列分析和酵母双杂交表明，VuMYB84和VuMYB132含有WER基序（DEEDLIIRLHKLLGNRWSLIAGR），可以与VubHLH3相互作用。总之，欧

articles.title: Virus-Like Particles: From Fundamental Concepts to Cutting-Edge Applications - A Comprehensive Review of Production, Engineering, and Clinical Translation.
articles.titleZh: 病毒样颗粒：从基本概念到前沿应用 - 生产、工程和临床转化的全面回顾。
articles.authors: Lotfi MS, Jafari S, Razmyeki M, Hashemzadeh MS.
articles.abstract: Virus-like particles (VLPs) are non-infectious nanoparticles that resemble native viruses, and are highly immunogenic because of their repetitive surface geometry and efficient lymph node drainage. Although their effectiveness in prophylactic vaccines cannot be denied, the range of VLP applications has increased manifold. This is a comprehensive review of the whole VLP pipeline, including production and clinical translation. We present a critical comparison of expression systems, such as prokaryotic, yeast, baculovirus/insect cell (BEVS), mammalian, and emerging systems, with trade-offs in terms of yield, authenticity, and scalability. The article explores the more complex engineering approaches to functionalizing VLPs through genetic fusion and chemical conjugation, which allow functional antigen display, cell-specific targeting, and encapsulation of various cargo. In addition to vaccination, we discuss the latest uses of targeted drug delivery, cancer therapy, gene editing, and molecular imaging. Lastly, the review focuses on the critical issues of manufacturing scalability, analytical characterization, and regulatory pathways to clinical translation. This analysis combines the key principles with the leading-edge technologies to highlight the transformative nature of VLPs as versatile nanotechnologies capable of enhancing preventive and precision medicine.
articles.abstractZh: 病毒样颗粒（VLP）是类似于天然病毒的非传染性纳米颗粒，并且由于其重复的表面几何形状和有效的淋巴结引流而具有高度免疫原性。尽管不能否认它们在预防性疫苗中的有效性，但 VLP 的应用范围已经扩大了很多倍。这是对整个 VLP 管道（包括生产和临床转化）的全面回顾。我们对原核、酵母、杆状病毒/昆虫细胞 (BEVS)、哺乳动物和新兴系统等表达系统进行了关键比较，并在产量、真实性和可扩展性方面进行了权衡。本文探讨了通过基因融合和化学缀合实现 VLP 功能化的更复杂的工程方法，从而实现功能性抗原展示、细胞特异性靶向和各种货物的封装。除了疫苗接种外，我们还讨论了靶向药物输送、癌症治疗、基因编辑和分子成像的最新用途。最后，审查重点关注制造可扩展性、分析表征和临床转化监管途径等关键问题。该分析结合了 k

articles.title: Analysis of microbial structure and function in fermented grains during the fermentation process of Congjiang WeiJiu based on high-throughput sequencing.
articles.titleZh: 基于高通量测序分析从江味酒发酵过程中酒醅微生物结构与功能
articles.authors: Shao L, Li S, Yang L, Wei S, Shen G, Shi L, Zhu J, Ding B, Liu Y, Shi Y, Liu Y.
articles.abstract: BackgroundWeiJiu was a traditional specialty liquor from the Zhuang ethnic villages in Congjiang County, Qiandongnan Miao and Dong Autonomous Prefecture, Guizhou Province. It was brewed using glutinous Xianghe rice, mountain spring water, and ancestral koji as raw materials. Its core production processes consist of five stages: (1) raw material preparation; (2) spreading, cooling and yeast mixing; (3) fermentation and liquor extraction; (4) simmering treatment; (5) sealing and aging. WeiJiu had a dark brown color, a mellow, soft, and sweet taste, and featured the characteristic of becoming more aromatic as it ages. As an intangible cultural heritage item of Qiandongnan Prefecture, its craftsmanship inheritance had long been confined to an empirical paradigm. Due to the lack of research on the composition and function of the microbial community in Congjiang WeiJiu, the microbial changes and metabolite changes during the fermentation process, its quality characteristics and brewing mechanism remain unclear. Therefore, in-depth understanding of the brewing mechanism and essentially improving its quality and production was an urgent priority for research related to Congjiang WeiJiu.MethodIn this study, the fermented grains of Congjiang WeiJiu at various fermentation stages: CQ: early fermentation stage (7 d), ZQ: middle fermentation stage (11 d) and WQ: late fermentation stage (15 d) were used as the research objects. High-throughput sequencing technology was employed to analyze microbial community structure and diversity. Functional annotations were performed against KEGG and CAZys databases to explore metabolic pathways and carbohydrate-active enzyme (CAZys) characteristics.ResultsThe microbial community exhibited significant stage-specific succession synchronized with fermentation processes. At the phylum level, Bacillota and Pseudomonadota dominated in CQ, Bacillota became predominant in ZQ, and Actinomycetota increased significantly in WQ. At the genus level, Aspergillus, Saccharomyces, and Hyphopichia served as core functional genera in respective stages. Functional annotations showed stage-specific expression of metabolic pathways: KEGG pathways focused on energy and amino acid metabolism (in CQ), carbohydrate metabolism (in ZQ), and stress adaptation (in WQ). CAZys families corresponded to fermentation substrates degradation (GH28, AA1 in CQ), macromolecule conversion (GH13, CBM50 in ZQ), and metabolite modification (GH18, GH16 in WQ). Core functional bacteria enhanced adaptability through evolutionary mechanisms such as horizontal gene transfer, genome streamlining, and plasmid-mediated gene acquisition. The unique simmering process and smoked cellar storage shaped the distinct microbial community and flavor, differing from traditional Luzhou-flavor liquor in yeast succession, lactic acid bacteria metabolism, and mold survival period.
articles.abstractZh: 背景味酒是产自贵州省黔东南苗族侗族自治州从江县壮族村寨的传统名酒。以香河糯米、山泉水、祖传曲为原料酿制而成。其核心生产流程由五个阶段组成：（1）原料准备； (2)摊铺、冷却和酵母混合； (3)发酵、提酒； (4)文火处理； (5)密封和老化。味酒色泽黑褐色，味醇、软、甜，具有越陈越香的特点。作为黔东南州的非物质文化遗产项目，其技艺传承长期局限于经验范式。由于缺乏对从江味酒微生物群落组成和功能的研究，发酵过程中微生物的变化和代谢物的变化，其品质特性和酿造机理尚不清楚。因此，深入了解从江味酒的酿造机理，从根本上提高其品质和产量，是从江味酒相关研究的当务之急。

articles.title: CsMYB6 promotes crocins biosynthesis in response to JA signaling in Crocus sativus L.
articles.titleZh: CsMYB6 响应番红花中的 JA 信号，促进藏红花素生物合成。
articles.authors: Wang S, Lin C, Shi X, Zhou A, Chen T, Zheng Y, Shao Q, Zhang L, Ding L, Xing B.
articles.abstract: Crocins has been identified as the key bioactive compound in saffron. The plant hormone jasmonate promotes the accumulation of crocins in saffron, but its regulatory mechanism remains unclear. MYB transcription factors are essential for regulating plant development and metabolic processes. In this study, a MeJA-responsive R2R3-MYB transcription factor, CsMYB6, was identified. The expression of CsMYB6 showed a strong correlation with the expression of key genes involved in crocins biosynthesis. Overexpression of CsMYB6 in Crocus sativus stigmas enhanced crocin content and upregulated the expression levels of key enzyme genes involved in crocins biosynthesis. Yeast one-hybrid assays confirmed the interaction between CsMYB6 and CsZ-ISO3/CsCCD2 promoters. Dual-LUC assays demonstrated that CsMYB6 binds to and activates the promoter of CsZ-ISO3/CsCCD2. These findings reveal a novel regulatory role of CsMYB6 in MeJA-mediated crocins biosynthesis and propose a "MeJA-CsMYB6-CsZ-ISO3/CsCCD2-crocins" regulatory model, enriching the regulatory network of crocins biosynthesis and laying a foundation for further exploration of the molecular mechanisms underlying saffron secondary metabolism.
articles.abstractZh: 藏红花素已被确定为藏红花中的关键生物活性化合物。植物激素茉莉酸促进藏红花中藏红花素的积累，但其调节机制尚不清楚。 MYB 转录因子对于调节植物发育和代谢过程至关重要。在这项研究中，鉴定出了 MeJA 响应性 R2R3-MYB 转录因子 CsMYB6。 CsMYB6的表达与藏红花素生物合成中涉及的关键基因的表达具有很强的相关性。 CsMYB6在番红花柱头中的过度表达提高了藏红花素含量并上调了参与藏红花素生物合成的关键酶基因的表达水平。酵母单杂交测定证实了 CsMYB6 和 CsZ-ISO3/CsCCD2 启动子之间的相互作用。双 LUC 测定表明 CsMYB6 结合并激活 CsZ-ISO3/CsCCD2 的启动子。这些发现揭示了CsMYB6在MeJA介导的藏红花素生物合成中的新调控作用，并提出了“MeJA-CsMYB6-CsZ-ISO3/CsCCD2-crocins”调控模型，丰富了藏红花素生物合成的调控网络，为进一步探索藏红花次生代谢的分子机制奠定了基础。

articles.title: Fermentation in breadmaking: enhancing digestibility and nutritional value for gastrointestinal health.
articles.titleZh: 面包制作中的发酵：提高胃肠道健康的消化率和营养价值。
articles.authors: Ribet L, Dessalles R, Clement H, Nyhan L, Baptista NT, Wang Y, Arendt EK, Durand-Dubief M.
articles.abstract: Fermentation is a traditional food process that has been used for ages, notably contributing to the production of bread, one of the main staple foods. The aim of this review is to explore how fermentation may be leveraged to enhance the digestibility and nutritional value of bread, addressing potential gastrointestinal disorders related to its consumption. Emerging gastrointestinal disorders such as non-celiac gluten or wheat sensitivity and irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) are discussed, highlighting the complex and often poorly understood, nature of these conditions involving both physiological and psychological aspects. Yeasts and lactic acid bacteria used in the bread making process can positively influence bread characteristics through the enhancement of mineral bioaccessibility or the reduction of triggering components like gluten and FODMAPs, especially when selecting microorganisms with targeted properties. However, the characterization and selection of these microorganisms require further standardization, and the clinical implications need to be firmly established as the strength of the evidence remains insufficient. The review also discusses the potential for fermentation to generate beneficial metabolites, such as exopolysaccharides (EPS) and short-chain fatty acids (SCFA). While these compounds show promise, their actual content, stability, and bioavailability in baked bread require further investigation. Overall, fermentation appears as a versatile transformative tool for the creation of digestible and nutritionally enhanced bread. Yet well-designed human studies are needed to substantiate the clinical benefits and better define the conditions where modification through fermentation may provide gastrointestinal health advantages.
articles.abstractZh: 发酵是一种历史悠久的传统食品加工工艺，尤其有助于生产面包（主要主食之一）。本综述的目的是探讨如何利用发酵来提高面包的消化率和营养价值，解决与其食用相关的潜在胃肠道疾病。讨论了新出现的胃肠道疾病，例如非腹腔麸质或小麦敏感性和肠易激综合症（IBS），强调了这些涉及生理和心理方面的疾病的复杂性且通常知之甚少。面包制作过程中使用的酵母和乳酸菌可以通过增强矿物质的生物可及性或减少麸质和 FODMAP 等触发成分，对面包特性产生积极影响，特别是在选择具有目标特性的微生物时。然而，这些微生物的表征和选择需要进一步标准化，而且由于证据强度仍然不足，临床意义也需要牢固确立。该评论还讨论了发酵的潜力

articles.title: Genetic dissection of cadmium accumulation in tea plants under nonphytotoxic field conditions.
articles.titleZh: 非植物毒性田间条件下茶树镉积累的遗传剖析。
articles.journal: Journal of genetics and genomics = Yi chuan xue bao
articles.authors: Luo S, Zhang X, Zhang W, Ren Y, Gao D, Ye X, Fernie AR, Wen W.
articles.abstract: Cadmium (Cd) accumulation in tea plants (Camellia sinensis) under chronic, nonphytotoxic field conditions poses a persistent food safety challenge; however, the genetic basis of this process remains uncharacterized. To dissect the genetic architecture of this trait, we quantify leaf Cd content and perform genome-wide association studies (GWAS) across 207 diverse tea accessions which have been cultivated for decades. Quantification analysis of Cd content reveals substantial natural variation in Cd content between young leaves (YL) and mature leaves (ML) under nonphytotoxic environment, with 38.2% of the 173 accessions with paired data intrinsically accumulating more Cd in YL than in ML. GWAS identify 112 quantitative trait loci associated with Cd accumulation. By further integrating the results of GWAS with Cd-responsive transcriptome profiling, we prioritize 14 high-confidence candidate genes. One of these candidate genes, CsHIPP6, which encodes a heavy metal-associated isoprenylated plant protein, is selected for further functional investigation. Heterologous expression in yeast and Arabidopsis demonstrates that CsHIPP6 enhances Cd tolerance and significantly reduces Cd accumulation. Our findings elucidate the genetic architecture underlying long-term Cd accumulation in perennial crops and highlight CsHIPP6 as a valuable target for breeding low-Cd tea cultivars to ensure beverage safety amidst rising environmental contamination.
articles.abstractZh: 在长期、无植物毒性的田间条件下，茶树（Camellia sinensis）中镉（Cd）的积累构成了持续的食品安全挑战；然而，这一过程的遗传基础仍然未知。为了剖析这一性状的遗传结构，我们量化了叶片中的镉含量，并对种植了数十年的 207 种不同的茶叶品种进行了全基因组关联研究 (GWAS)。 Cd含量的定量分析揭示了在非植物毒性环境下幼叶(YL)和成熟叶(ML)之间Cd含量的显着自然变化，173个具有配对数据的材料中，38.2%的材料在YL中固有地积累了比ML中更多的Cd。 GWAS 鉴定了 112 个与 Cd 积累相关的数量性状位点。通过进一步将 GWAS 的结果与 Cd 响应转录组分析相结合，我们优先考虑了 14 个高置信度候选基因。选择这些候选基因之一 CsHIPP6，它编码与重金属相关的异戊二烯化植物蛋白，用于进一步的功能研究。在酵母和拟南芥中的异源表达表明 CsHIPP6 增强了 Cd 耐受性并显着减少了 Cd 积累

articles.title: Glyoxysomal Citrate Synthase Functions in Fluoride Accumulation in Tea Plants by Mediating Citrate Biosynthesis.
articles.titleZh: 乙醛酸柠檬酸合酶通过介导柠檬酸生物合成在茶树中氟化物积累中发挥作用。
articles.journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
articles.authors: Liu Y, Cao D, Hu X, Ma L, Bai F, Yan X, Jin X.
articles.abstract: The tea plant is known as a fluoride hyperaccumulator, with excessive fluoride accumulating in its leaves and posing a potential threat to human health. Previous studies have pinpointed that certain genes contributed to fluoride accumulation in tea plants; however, the role of key regulatory genes remains largely unexplored. Here, we characterized a Camellia sinensis glyoxysomal citrate synthase (CsgCS) gene and found that its expression levels exhibited a strong positive correlation with fluoride content. Functional validation revealed that CsgCS enhanced fluoride tolerance and accumulation in yeast and A. thaliana. In tea plants, transient CsgCS overexpression increased fluoride accumulation, whereas its silencing reduced leaf fluoride levels. Additionally, exogenous citrate improved fluoride tolerance and accumulation in Arabidopsis, reducing ROS accumulation, enhancing ROS scavenging, and upregulating fluoride tolerance and stress-responsive genes. Collectively, this study reveals that CsgCS mediates fluoride accumulation in tea plants and provides valuable insights for breeding low-fluoride tea cultivars.
articles.abstractZh: 茶树被称为氟化物超积累植物，过量的氟化物在其叶子中积累，对人类健康构成潜在威胁。先前的研究已经指出，某些基因有助于茶树中氟化物的积累。然而，关键调控基因的作用在很大程度上仍未得到探索。在这里，我们对茶树乙醛酸柠檬酸合酶（CsgCS）基因进行了表征，发现其表达水平与氟含量呈强正相关。功能验证表明，CsgCS 增强了酵母和拟南芥的氟化物耐受性和积累。在茶树中，短暂的 CsgCS 过度表达会增加氟化物的积累，而其沉默会降低叶片氟化物的水平。此外，外源柠檬酸盐改善了拟南芥的氟耐受性和积累，减少了ROS积累，增强了ROS清除能力，并上调了氟耐受性和应激反应基因。总的来说，这项研究揭示了 CsgCS 介导茶树中氟化物的积累，并为培育低氟茶品种提供了宝贵的见解。

articles.title: Identification of the <i>PmNAC</i> Gene Family in <i>Pinus massoniana</i>: <i>PmNAC82</i> Modulates Wood Biosynthesis by Activating SCW-Related Genes.
articles.titleZh: 马尾松中PmNAC基因家族的鉴定：PmNAC82通过激活SCW相关基因调节木材生物合成。
articles.authors: Yao S, Song Y, Li Q, Chen Y, Cheng X, Wang D, Yu Q, Ji K.
articles.abstract: The NAC transcription factor superfamily is one of the most prominent plant-specific regulatory gene families, extensively participating in multiple metabolic processes that govern plant growth, tissue development and stress adaptation. Masson pine (Pinus massoniana Lamb.) is a native dominant conifer widely cultivated across South China, whose timber resources possess great exploitation potential in pulp manufacturing and the paper industry. In this study, a total of 98 non-redundant NAC family members were mined at the genome-wide level. Functional validation revealed that PmNAC82, a member belonging to the VND evolutionary subgroup, acts as a core regulatory factor controlling wood formation. Subcellular localization tests confirmed PmNAC82 exclusively resides in the cell nucleus. Heterologous genetic transformation in poplar demonstrated that this gene positively regulates the accumulation of lignin and cellulose. Furthermore, through RT-qPCR, yeast one-hybrid assays, and EMSA, we confirmed that PmNAC82 can bind to the promoters of PtrMYB3, PtrMYB21 and PmCesA7. These findings provide a solid foundation for further investigation into the molecular functions of NAC genes in Masson pine as well as their potential application towards molecular breeding strategies aimed at improving wood quality.
articles.abstractZh: NAC转录因子超家族是最著名的植物特异性调控基因家族之一，广泛参与控制植物生长、组织发育和逆境适应的多种代谢过程。马尾松（Pinus Massoniana Lamb.）是华南地区广泛栽培的本土优势针叶树，其木材资源在制浆造纸工业中具有巨大的开发潜力。在这项研究中，在全基因组水平上挖掘了总共 98 个非冗余 NAC 家族成员。功能验证表明，PmNAC82 属于 VND 进化亚群的成员，是控制木材形成的核心调控因子。亚细胞定位测试证实 PmNAC82 仅存在于细胞核中。杨树的异源遗传转化表明该基因正向调节木质素和纤维素的积累。此外，通过RT-qPCR、酵母单杂交实验和EMSA，我们证实PmNAC82可以与PtrMYB3、PtrMYB21和PmCesA7的启动子结合。这些发现为进一步研究NAC基因在Mass中的分子功能提供了坚实的基础。

articles.title: Integrated RNA-Seq and DAP-Seq Analyses Identify a DntMYB1-Centered Regulatory Module Controlling Purple Flower Formation in Nobile-Type <i>Dendrobium</i>.
articles.titleZh: 集成 RNA-Seq 和 DAP-Seq 分析确定了以 DntMYB1 为中心的调控模块，控制金钗型石斛兰中紫色花的形成。
articles.authors: Yin Y, Wu J, Li J, Tan Z, Fan J, Zhuang H, Li Z, Fu H, Xu C.
articles.abstract: Flower color is a key ornamental trait in Nobile-type Dendrobium, yet the molecular basis underlying purple flower formation remains poorly understood. In this study, a white-flowered paternal cultivar and its purple-flowered filial line were used to investigate the regulatory mechanism of purple floral pigmentation. Comparative phenotypic analysis showed that floral color divergence was established early during flower development, and anthocyanidin profiling of full-bloom petals revealed that purple flowers accumulated substantially higher levels of most anthocyanidins than white flowers, with delphinidin- and cyanidin-derived anthocyanidins together accounting for 80.26% and 94.56% of the total anthocyanidins in white- and purple-flowered materials, respectively. Transcriptome profiling identified a total of 21,235 differentially expressed genes (DEGs), with significant enrichment of phenylpropanoid- and flavonoid-related pathways, and MYB transcription factors prominently represented among the candidate regulators across the three comparison groups. Among them, DntMYB1 was identified as a C1 subgroup R2R3-MYB associated with floral pigmentation, and transient overexpression assays in Phalaenopsis hybrid V3 and a Nobile-type Dendrobium hybrid supported its positive role in visible purple pigmentation. By integrating RNA-seq and DAP-seq analyses, we identified 3205 candidate downstream targets of DntMYB1 and established a DntMYB1-centered regulatory module. Among these candidates, one Dnt4CL1 gene and one DntF3'H1 gene were validated as robust direct targets of DntMYB1 through yeast one-hybrid, EMSA, and dual-luciferase assays. These findings suggest that DntMYB1 is associated with purple flower formation by coordinately regulating both upstream precursor metabolism and downstream anthocyanin biosynthesis, providing new insight into the molecular regulation of flower color in Nobile-type Dendrobium and useful candidate genes for ornamental trait improvement.
articles.abstractZh: 花色是金钗型石斛兰的一个关键观赏性状，但紫色花形成的分子基础仍然知之甚少。本研究以白花父本品种及其紫花子系为对象，研究紫色花色素沉着的调控机制。比较表型分析表明，花的颜色分化在花发育早期就已形成，对盛开花瓣的花青素分析显示，紫色花中积累的大多数花青素水平显着高于白花，飞燕草素和花青素来源的花青素分别占白花和紫色花材料中总花青素的80.26%和94.56%。转录组分析共鉴定出 21,235 个差异表达基因 (DEG)，其中苯丙素和类黄酮相关途径显着富集，并且 MYB 转录因子在三个比较组的候选调节因子中占显着比例。其中，DntMYB1被鉴定为与花色素沉着相关的C1亚组R2R3-MYB，并进行瞬时过表达分析。

articles.title: Mannosylinositol Phosphorylceramide Biosynthesis Is Required for Cell Surface Adaptation to Ethanol Stress in Saccharomyces cerevisiae.
articles.titleZh: 酿酒酵母细胞表面适应乙醇应激需要甘露糖醇磷酸神经酰胺生物合成。
articles.authors: Sugihara S, Susami R, Koga A, Ito S, Nakagawa T, Tani M.
articles.abstract: Saccharomyces cerevisiae exhibits a remarkable ability to tolerate high concentrations of ethanol during fermentation, yet the molecular basis underlying this adaptive trait remains incompletely understood. Here, we identify the biosynthesis of the complex sphingolipid mannosylinositol phosphorylceramide (MIPC) as a key determinant of ethanol tolerance in S. cerevisiae. Cells lacking the MIPC synthases Csg1 and Csh1 exhibited pronounced ethanol hypersensitivity and loss of viability. This defect was associated with impaired maintenance of cell wall integrity under ethanol stress and was further exacerbated by disruption of the Rim101 transcription factor or the cell wall integrity MAP kinase Slt2 pathway. Notably, ethanol exposure triggered Rim101-dependent eisosome remodeling specifically in MIPC-deficient cells, indicating altered plasma membrane organization in response to ethanol stress. Hypersensitivity of MIPC-deficient cells extended to alcohols with different carbon chain lengths, suggesting a broader defect in alcohol-induced cellular stress responses. Consistent with these defects, MIPC-deficient cells showed reduced growth and survival under high-glucose fermentative conditions that promote ethanol production. Together, our findings demonstrate that MIPC biosynthesis supports cell surface adaptation to ethanol stress by maintaining cell wall integrity and regulating plasma membrane organization, providing new insights into ethanol tolerance and its relevance to fermentation performance.
articles.abstractZh: 酿酒酵母在发酵过程中表现出耐受高浓度乙醇的非凡能力，但这种适应性特征背后的分子基础仍不完全清楚。在这里，我们确定复杂鞘脂甘露糖肌醇磷酸神经酰胺（MIPC）的生物合成是酿酒酵母乙醇耐受性的关键决定因素。缺乏 MIPC 合酶 Csg1 和 Csh1 的细胞表现出明显的乙醇过敏和活力丧失。这种缺陷与乙醇胁迫下细胞壁完整性的维持受损有关，并且由于 Rim101 转录因子或细胞壁完整性 MAP 激酶 Slt2 途径的破坏而进一步加剧。值得注意的是，乙醇暴露特别在 MIPC 缺陷细胞中触发了 Rim101 依赖性 eisosome 重塑，表明质膜组织因乙醇应激而发生改变。 MIPC 缺陷细胞对不同碳链长度的酒精过敏，表明酒精诱导的细胞应激反应存在更广泛的缺陷。与这些缺陷一致，MIPC 缺陷细胞在高葡萄糖发酵条件下表现出生长和存活率降低

articles.title: Metabolic Engineering Strategies for Flavonoid Biosynthesis in Saccharomyces cerevisiae: Current Advances and Future Perspectives.
articles.titleZh: 酿酒酵母类黄酮生物合成的代谢工程策略：当前进展和未来展望。
articles.authors: Cheng X, Han M, Zhang G, Qiao W, Wang L, Ma Y.
articles.abstract: Flavonoids are a class of plant secondary metabolites with diverse physiological activities, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects. Growing demand for these compounds now exceeds the capacity of traditional plant extraction methods. Advances in the elucidation of flavonoid biosynthetic pathways, combined with progress in synthetic biology, have enabled the use of engineered microorganisms for sustainable flavonoid production. Saccharomyces cerevisiae, with its well-developed genetic toolkit, high safety profile, and eukaryotic protein modification machinery, has emerged as an ideal chassis for the heterologous biosynthesis of flavonoids. This review systematically outlines the structural classification and biosynthetic pathways of flavonoids, summarizes recent advances in pathway reconstruction, and provides a quantitative comparison of metabolic engineering strategies in S. cerevisiae. We further discuss the key bottlenecks that currently hinder scale‑up from laboratory flasks to industrial bioreactors and propose that future research should focus on intelligent regulatory systems. When combined with rational design of metabolic networks and microbial consortia, such systems can enable adaptive balancing between growth and product synthesis under industrial-scale environmental fluctuations. Collectively, these intelligent engineering strategies will advance S. cerevisiae as an efficient and scalable platform for flavonoid biomanufacturing.
articles.abstractZh: 黄酮类化合物是一类植物次生代谢产物，具有多种生理活性，包括抗氧化和抗炎作用。现在对这些化合物不断增长的需求超出了传统植物提取方法的能力。类黄酮生物合成途径阐明的进展，加上合成生物学的进展，使得利用工程微生物进行可持续类黄酮生产成为可能。酿酒酵母凭借其完善的遗传工具包、高安全性和真核蛋白质修饰机制，已成为类黄酮异源生物合成的理想基础。该综述系统地概述了黄酮类化合物的结构分类和生物合成途径，总结了途径重建的最新进展，并对酿酒酵母中的代谢工程策略进行了定量比较。我们进一步讨论了目前阻碍从实验室烧瓶扩大到工业生物反应器的关键瓶颈，并建议未来的研究应集中在智能监管系统上。当与代谢网络和微生物群落的合理设计相结合时，

articles.title: Multi-omics insights into key aroma compound formation during Chinese bayberry wine fermentation by Pichia kluyveri ZFM-0524.
articles.titleZh: 克鲁维毕赤酵母 ZFM-0524 对杨梅酒发酵过程中关键香气化合物形成的多组学见解。
articles.authors: Liu S, Cao M, Zhao Y, Xu Y, Zhang L, Cai Y, Gu Q.
articles.abstract: Pichia kluyveri, a representative non-Saccharomyces yeast, has emerged as a promising starter for enhancing aroma complexity in fruit wine fermentation; however, its molecular basis of aroma modulation, particularly in Chinese bayberry wine, remains poorly understood. In this study, an integrated multi-omics approach was applied to investigate aroma formation and its associated metabolic pathways in bayberry wine fermented by P. kluyveri ZFM-0524. Comprehensive volatile profiling revealed that P. kluyveri ZFM-0524 significantly enriched acetate esters, resulting in a more complex aroma profile than those obtained with Saccharomyces cerevisiae Lalvin ICV D254, Starmerella davenportii DQ-5, and Hanseniaspora uvarum BF-13. Genome analysis (12.43 Mb, 3009 predicted genes) and functional annotation indicated strong metabolic potential in carbohydrate utilization and amino acid catabolism. Flavoromics analysis identified eight key aroma compounds. Transcriptomic profiling further suggested that the synthesis and metabolism of these compounds during fermentation may be closely associated with key pathways such as glycolysis, the citric acid cycle, and amino acid biosynthesis and metabolism. Critical aroma-associated genes, including AAT2, ACS1, ADHs, and AROs, were identified as potential contributors to aroma metabolism. This study provides a systems-level understanding of aroma formation in bayberry wine fermented by P. kluyveri and suggests pathway-level regulatory associations underlying strain-specific aroma enhancement, offering a theoretical basis for precision fermentation using non-Saccharomyces yeasts.
articles.abstractZh: 克鲁维毕赤酵母（Pichia kluyveri）是一种代表性的非酿酒酵母，已成为增强果酒发酵中香气复杂性的有前景的发酵剂；然而，其香气调节的分子基础，尤其是杨梅酒中的分子基础，仍然知之甚少。在本研究中，采用综合多组学方法研究 P. kluyveri ZFM-0524 发酵杨梅酒中的香气形成及其相关代谢途径。全面的挥发性分析表明，克鲁维酵母 ZFM-0524 显着富集乙酸酯，从而产生比酿酒酵母 Lalvin ICV D254、Starmerella davenportii DQ-5 和 Hanseniaspora uvarum BF-13 更复杂的香气特征。基因组分析（12.43 Mb，3009 个预测基因）和功能注释表明碳水化合物利用和氨基酸分解代谢方面具有强大的代谢潜力。风味组学分析确定了八种关键香气化合物。转录组分析进一步表明，这些化合物在发酵过程中的合成和代谢可能与糖酵解、柠檬酸循环、氨基酸生物合成和代谢等关键途径密切相关

articles.title: Overexpression of the BAHD Acyltransferase-Like Protein gene OsDCR Enhances Salt Tolerance in Rice.
articles.titleZh: BAHD 酰基转移酶样蛋白基因 OsDCR 的过度表达增强了水稻的耐盐性。
articles.authors: Liu X, Li L, Xu M, Lu N, Zhang Y, Wang X, Shi R, Wang F, Ji J, Gao Q, Zhu M, Dai H.
articles.abstract: Salt stress is a major environmental challenge for global rice production because it disrupts ionic balance and induces oxidative damage. We investigated the role of the rice BAHD-acyltransferase-like protein gene OsDCR in the salt stress response and found that OsDCR-overexpressing plants showed enhanced salt tolerance. In contrast, CRISPR/Cas9-mediated-knockout rice lines were sensitive to salt stress. OsDCR-OE plants also exhibited reduced oxidative stress and high ABA accumulation under 150 mM NaCl, and quantitative RT-PCR analysis revealed that the expression of OsDCR was induced by salt stress and high temperature. Additionally, we identified a proline-rich protein, OsPRP3, as an interaction partner of OsDCR by yeast two-hybrid, LCI and Co-IP assays. Similar to OsDCR, OsPRP3 also positively regulated rice salt tolerance and acted downstream of OsDCR. Taken together, our findings suggest that OsDCR functions as a positive regulator of salt tolerance by modulating ABA biosynthesis and interacting with OsPRP3. Our results regarding the molecular role of OsDCR provide novel insights for developing salt-tolerant rice cultivars.
articles.abstractZh: 盐胁迫是全球水稻生产面临的主要环境挑战，因为它破坏离子平衡并诱发氧化损伤。我们研究了水稻 BAHD 酰基转移酶样蛋白基因 OsDCR 在盐胁迫反应中的作用，发现 OsDCR 过表达的植物表现出增强的耐盐性。相比之下，CRISPR/Cas9 介导的基因敲除水稻品系对盐胁迫敏感。 OsDCR-OE植物在150 mM NaCl下也表现出氧化应激减少和ABA积累高，定量RT-PCR分析表明OsDCR的表达是由盐胁迫和高温诱导的。此外，我们通过酵母双杂交、LCI 和 Co-IP 测定，鉴定出富含脯氨酸的蛋白 OsPRP3 作为 OsDCR 的相互作用伴侣。与 OsDCR 类似，OsPRP3 也正向调节水稻耐盐性并在 OsDCR 下游发挥作用。综上所述，我们的研究结果表明，OsDCR 通过调节 ABA 生物合成并与 OsPRP3 相互作用，起到耐盐性的正调节作用。我们关于 OsDCR 分子作用的结果为开发耐盐水稻品种提供了新的见解。
