articles.title: <i>In situ</i> continuous evolution of native transporter HGT1 unlocks xylose utilization in <i>Kluyveromyces lactis</i>.
articles.titleZh: 天然转运蛋白 HGT1 的原位连续进化解锁了乳酸克鲁维酵母中的木糖利用。
articles.authors: Chen X, Chen S, Zhou J, Du G, Zhang G.
articles.abstract: Efficient xylose valorization is a prerequisite for the industrial application of K luyveromyces lactis in lignocellulosic biorefining, yet the inefficiency of transmembrane transport remains a significant bottleneck. To address this, a comprehensive "mining-evolving-engineering" strategy was established. Phylogenetic analysis and functional verification identified RAG1 and HGT1 as the predominant xylose transporters. To enhance their performance, a CRISPR-Cas9-mediated in vivo continuous evolution (CTRLE) system was developed in K. lactis, characterized by a continuous mutation window exceeding 300 bp and a broad mutational spectrum encompassing all possible transitions and transversions. Application of this system yielded a superior evolved mutant with significantly enhanced growth kinetics for xylose utilization, where the biomass accumulation within 72 h increased by 20% relative to the parental strain, representing a 100% improvement over the wild-type. The isolation of this variant validates the efficacy of the targeted mutagenesis strategy and marks the first successful application of an in vivo continuous evolution system in K. lactis. Molecular dynamics (MD) simulations further elucidated the structural mechanisms by which key mutations alter substrate affinity. This work provides robust chassis strains for xylose fermentation and establishes a versatile paradigm for membrane protein engineering in non-conventional yeasts.
articles.abstractZh: 有效的木糖增值是乳酸克鲁维酵母在木质纤维素生物精炼中工业应用的先决条件，但跨膜运输的低效率仍然是一个重要的瓶颈。为了解决这个问题，制定了全面的“采矿-进化-工程”战略。系统发育分析和功能验证确定 RAG1 和 HGT1 是主要的木糖转运蛋白。为了增强其性能，在乳酸克鲁维酵母中开发了 CRISPR-Cas9 介导的体内连续进化 (CTRLE) 系统，其特点是连续突变窗口超过 300 bp，突变谱涵盖所有可能的转换和颠换。该系统的应用产生了一种优异的进化突变体，其木糖利用的生长动力学显着增强，其中72小时内的生物量积累相对于亲本菌株增加了20%，比野生型提高了100%。该变体的分离验证了靶向诱变策略的有效性，并标志着体内连续进化系统在乳酸克鲁维酵母中的首次成功应用。分子动力学（MD）模拟fu

articles.title: Effects of sugar alcohols on freeze-thaw tolerance of frozen dough: Focus on ice crystal growth, fermentation properties and gluten aggregation.
articles.titleZh: 糖醇对冷冻面团冻融耐受性的影响：关注冰晶生长、发酵特性和面筋聚集。
articles.authors: Yang L, Wang S, Lu L, Peng J, Xiao H, Wu Y, Yin X, Gong J, Lin Q.
articles.abstract: Freeze-thaw (F/T) deterioration of frozen dough needs urgent resolution. To tackle this challenge, this study examined the effects of erythritol, xylitol, sorbitol on frozen dough F/T tolerance via ice crystal state, yeast fermentation and gluten aggregation compared to sucrose/trehalose. Results demonstrated that steamed bread with 3.5% erythritol, xylitol and sorbitol had a higher specific volume (increased by 55.00%, 46.88%, and 51.88%, respectively) and a lower hardness than the control after three F/T. Sugar alcohols demonstrated superior improvement compared to sucrose/trehalose. Specifically, sugar alcohols increased bound water content and ice crystal growth rate (0.326 mm/s to 0.369 mm/s). After three F/T, sugar alcohols increased the dough gas production from 610 mL to 723 mL compared to the control. Sugar alcohols preserved the gluten network by stabilizing protein secondary structure and mitigating glutenin depolymerization. This study provides a theoretical basis for how sugar alcohols enhance the F/T tolerance of frozen dough.
articles.abstractZh: 冷冻面团的冻融（F/T）变质问题亟待解决。为了应对这一挑战，本研究通过冰晶状态、酵母发酵和面筋聚集，与蔗糖/海藻糖相比，检查了赤藓糖醇、木糖醇、山梨糖醇对冷冻面团 F/T 耐受性的影响。结果表明，添加3.5%赤藓糖醇、木糖醇和山梨醇的馒头经过3次F/T处理后，比对照馒头的比容较高（分别增加了55.00%、46.88%和51.88%），硬度较低。与蔗糖/海藻糖相比，糖醇表现出卓越的改进。具体来说，糖醇增加了结合水含量和冰晶生长速率（0.326 mm/s 至 0.369 mm/s）。经过 3 个 F/T 后，与对照相比，糖醇将面团气体产量从 610 mL 增加到 723 mL。糖醇通过稳定蛋白质二级结构和减轻麦谷蛋白解聚来保护谷蛋白网络。该研究为糖醇如何增强冷冻面团的F/T耐受性提供了理论基础。

articles.title: Glutamate dehydrogenases in fungi: From biology to biotechnology.
articles.titleZh: 真菌中的谷氨酸脱氢酶：从生物学到生物技术。
articles.authors: Pathan EK, Sapkota H, Dasgupta S, Punekar NS.
articles.abstract: Glutamate dehydrogenases (GDH; EC 1.4.1.2 and EC 1.4.1.4) play a pivotal role in fungal nitrogen metabolism by catalyzing the reversible conversion of 2-ketoglutarate to L-glutamate. In fungi, NAD- as well as NADP-dependent GDHs function at the interface of ammonia assimilation and glutamate catabolism, contributing to growth, differentiation, and morphogenesis. The evolution of fungi to adapt and occupy various ecological niches is closely aligned to the diversity of regulations of the functions of GDHs, their localisation and biochemical characteristics. This review explores the biochemical, molecular, and structural studies on fungal GDHs, emphasizing their catalytic diversity, coenzyme specificity, and regulatory mechanisms, including phosphorylation, thiol modulation, and allosteric control. Structural elucidations of NADP-GDHs from Aspergillus niger, Aspergillus terreus, and Candida albicans provide new insights into cofactor binding, substrate recognition, and inhibitor interactions. Molecular analyses reveal distinct evolutionary trajectories for NAD- and NADP-GDHs across fungal taxa, with GDH-mediated transitions linked to morphogenetic processes such as the yeast-to-hypha (Y-H) switch, highlighting GDHs as promising antifungal drug targets. The comprehensive survey of fungal GDHs presented here emphasises their biochemical versatility, evolutionary significance, and translational potential in agriculture, biosensor development and in industry. The review also highlights gaps in our understanding of fungal GDHs and potential areas for further research.
articles.abstractZh: 谷氨酸脱氢酶（GDH；EC 1.4.1.2 和 EC 1.4.1.4）通过催化 2-酮戊二酸可逆转化为 L-谷氨酸，在真菌氮代谢中发挥关键作用。在真菌中，NAD 和 NADP 依赖性 GDH 在氨同化和谷氨酸分解代谢的界面发挥作用，有助于生长、分化和形态发生。真菌适应和占据各种生态位的进化与GDH功能、其定位和生化特性的多样性调控密切相关。本综述探讨了真菌 GDH 的生化、分子和结构研究，强调其催化多样性、辅酶特异性和调控机制，包括磷酸化、硫醇调节和变构控制。来自黑曲霉、土曲霉和白色念珠菌的 NADP-GDH 的结构阐明为辅因子结合、底物识别和抑制剂相互作用提供了新的见解。分子分析揭示了 NAD-和 NADP-GDH 在真菌类群中的不同进化轨迹，GDH 介导的转变与形态发生过程（例如酵母到菌丝）相关

articles.title: Systematic Engineering of <i>Komagataella phaffii</i> for Efficient Kestose Biosynthesis: Integrating Expression Optimization with Secretory Pathway Engineering.
articles.titleZh: 用于高效 Kestose 生物合成的 Komagataella phaffii 系统工程：表达优化与分泌途径工程相结合。
articles.journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
articles.authors: Liao S, Li J, Ling X, Meng S, Zou J, Chen D, Ren J, Lu R, Qin S, Feng JX, Qin X.
articles.abstract: Kestose is the smallest fructooligosaccharide (FOS) with superior bioactivity and sweetness relative to other FOS variants. Its enzymatic synthesis from sucrose relies on β-fructofuranosidase (β-Ffase), but efficient heterologous production of this enzyme remains challenging. Here, the yeast Komagataella phaffii was engineered for enhanced secretion of β-Ffase as an efficient biocatalyst. Initial optimization of transcriptional elements increased extracellular enzyme titer by 8.1-fold, but significant intracellular accumulation persisted. Targeted engineering of the secretory pathway, including modulation of endoplasmic reticulum-associated degradation (ERAD) and vesicle trafficking, further improved secretion efficiency. The highest-yielding strain, BA2-2, achieved a 15.2-fold increase in extracellular activity (80.3 ± 5.6 U/mL) and reduced intracellular retention to 12.3% in shake-flask cultures. Application of highly secreted β-Ffase from this strain in a one-pot bioconversion strategy enabled sucrose conversion to 248.9 ± 20.6 g/L kestose with a productivity of 4.08 ± 0.28 g/L/h. Collectively, these results validate a systematic engineering strategy that combines expression optimization with secretory pathway engineering, enabling the development of an efficient microbial platform for industrial kestose production.
articles.abstractZh: Kestose 是最小的低聚果糖 (FOS)，相对于其他 FOS 变体，具有优异的生物活性和甜味。其从蔗糖的酶促合成依赖于β-呋喃果糖苷酶（β-Ffase），但这种酶的高效异源生产仍然具有挑战性。在这里，酵母 Komagataella phaffii 被设计用于增强 β-Ffase 的分泌，作为一种有效的生物催化剂。转录元件的初步优化使胞外酶滴度增加了 8.1 倍，但胞内酶的积累仍然存在。分泌途径的靶向工程，包括调节内质网相关降解（ERAD）和囊泡运输，进一步提高了分泌效率。在摇瓶培养中，产量最高的菌株 BA2-2 的细胞外活性增加了 15.2 倍（80.3 ± 5.6 U/mL），并将细胞内保留率降低至 12.3%。在一锅生物转化策略中应用该菌株高度分泌的 β-Ffase，能够将蔗糖转化为 248.9 ± 20.6 g/L 酮糖，生产率为 4.08 ± 0.28 g/L/h。总的来说，这些结果验证了结合表达选择的系统工程策略

articles.title: Aspartate-Glutamate Carrier 1 (<i>SLC25A12</i>) Deficiency: Malate-Aspartate Shuttle Failure, Neurodevelopmental Epileptic Encephalopathy, and Ketone-Based Metabolic Therapy.
articles.titleZh: 天冬氨酸-谷氨酸载体 1 (SLC25A12) 缺乏：苹果酸-天冬氨酸穿梭失败、神经发育性癫痫性脑病和酮类代谢疗法。
articles.authors: Murano M, Iaconisi GN, Monné M, Ahmed A, Fiermonte G, Capobianco L, Dolce V.
articles.abstract: Aspartate-glutamate carrier 1 (AGC1) deficiency is a rare neurometabolic disorder caused by biallelic pathogenic variants in SLC25A12. Clinically, it is characterized by early-onset developmental and epileptic encephalopathy, often associated with hypomyelination and reduced brain N-acetylaspartate. AGC1 loss reduces malate-aspartate shuttle flux, limiting cytosolic NAD+ regeneration and impairing neuronal redox coupling, ATP supply, and aspartate-dependent biosynthesis during brain development. We integrate human genetics with mechanistic evidence from mammalian, Drosophila melanogaster, and Saccharomyces cerevisiae models to describe conserved transport principles and species-specific regulation underlying selective central nervous system vulnerability. We review the management of AGC1 deficiency, focusing on ketogenic therapy. Published reports show reproducible seizure reduction and, in some patients, improved myelination and N-acetylaspartate. However, these responses are heterogeneous and appear to depend on the timing, duration, and stability of ketosis. Preclinical evidence suggests that β-hydroxybutyrate may contribute to metabolic support in AGC1 deficiency. Prospective studies should test disease modification using standardized endpoints plus MRI/1H-MRS and ketosis measures.
articles.abstractZh: 天冬氨酸-谷氨酸载体 1 (AGC1) 缺陷是一种罕见的神经代谢紊乱，由 SLC25A12 的双等位基因致病性变异引起。临床上，其特点是早发性发育性和癫痫性脑病，通常与髓鞘形成不足和脑内 N-乙酰天冬氨酸减少有关。 AGC1 缺失会减少苹果酸-天冬氨酸穿梭通量，限制胞质 NAD+ 再生，并损害大脑发育过程中的神经元氧化还原偶联、ATP 供应和天冬氨酸依赖性生物合成。我们将人类遗传学与哺乳动物、果蝇和酿酒酵母模型的机械证据相结合，以描述选择性中枢神经系统脆弱性背后的保守运输原理和物种特异性调节。我们回顾了 AGC1 缺乏症的治疗，重点关注生酮疗法。已发表的报告显示，癫痫发作可重复减少，并且在某些患者中，髓鞘形成和 N-乙酰天冬氨酸得到改善。然而，这些反应是异质的，并且似乎取决于酮症的时间、持续时间和稳定性。临床前证据表明，β-羟基丁酸可能有助于 AGC1 缺乏症的代谢支持。前景

articles.title: Identification of Multiple <i>PlOSCs</i> Involved in the Biosynthesis Pathway of Triterpenoids in <i>Paeonia lactiflora</i>.
articles.titleZh: 芍药中参与三萜生物合成途径的多个P1OSCs的鉴定。
articles.authors: Zhao Y, Guo J, Zhang J, Wang J, Huang L.
articles.abstract: Triterpenoid saponins are important bioactive compounds synthesized through the isoprenoid pathway, in which 2,3-oxidosqualene serves as a precursor of triterpenoid saponins. In this study, we identified and characterized eight oxidosqualene cyclase (PlOSC) genes in Paeonia lactiflora using molecular cloning and bioinformatic analyses. Full-length cDNAs of PlOSCs (PlOSC1-PlOSC8) were cloned, and the protein sequences exhibited significant similarities to known cyclases, including β-amyrin synthase and cycloartenol synthase. Phylogenetic analysis revealed distinct groups of PlOSCs corresponding to lupeol, β-amyrin, and cycloartenol synthases. Sequence alignment confirmed the presence of highly conserved motifs, including the "SDCTAE" and "QW" motifs, which are crucial for cyclization and stability in PlOSCs. To determine the functional roles of PlOSCs, we conducted functional expression studies in Saccharomyces cerevisiae. The results showed that PlOSC3 and PlOSC6 are monofunctional β-amyrin synthases that produce β-amyrin in yeast culture, as confirmed through GC-MS analysis. Further investigation of PlOSC gene expression in various tissues indicated that PlOSC3 was predominantly expressed in roots, whereas PlOSC6 was highly expressed in leaves. Corresponding metabolite analyses revealed that triterpenoid accumulation was significantly higher in roots than in leaves, suggesting tissue-specific biosynthesis and accumulation patterns in triterpenoid biosynthesis. These findings contribute to our understanding of the regulation of triterpenoid biosynthesis in P. lactiflora and provide insights into the functional roles of OSCs in triterpenoid and nortriterpenoid formation.

articles.authors: Cai J, Zhang L, Zhou H, Li X, Jiang S.
articles.abstract: Fermented soybean paste, a traditional high-salt condiment, faces challenges in standardization and quality control due to its reliance on natural fermentation. This study systematically evaluated the effects of a defined starter culture, Tetragenococcus halophilus CICC 10286, on soybean paste fermentation by comparing natural fermentation (NF) and fortified fermentation (FF). Compared with NF, FF maintained a higher moisture in the later stage (NF-LS: 50.30%; FF-LS: 60.08%) and lower total acid levels in the middle and later stages (NF-MS: 1.58 g/100 g; FF-MS: 0.96 g/100 g; NF-LS: 2.23 g/100 g; FF-LS: 1.11 g/100 g). Although protein degradation was more pronounced in the FF group at the midpoint (p Tetragenococcus and halotolerant bacteria, such as Halomonas, at the midpoint, and increased the relative abundance of the aroma-producing yeast Zygosaccharomyces (NF-MS: 37.73%; FF-MS: 65.11%). Functional prediction based on PICRUSt2 suggested a higher predicted abundance of genes involved in pyruvate metabolism and branched-chain amino acid degradation in the FF group. These findings demonstrate that T. halophilus CICC 10286, as a starter culture, can effectively modulate the fermentation of soybean paste, providing a scientific basis for developing standardized and quality-controlled fermentation processes.
articles.abstractZh: 发酵豆酱作为传统的高盐调味品，由于依赖自然发酵，在标准化和质量控制方面面临挑战。本研究通过比较自然发酵 (NF) 和强化发酵 (FF)，系统评估了特定发酵剂（嗜盐四联球菌 CICC 10286）对豆酱发酵的影响。与NF相比，FF后期保持较高的水分（NF-LS：50.30%；FF-LS：60.08%），中后期总酸含量较低（NF-MS：1.58 g/100 g；FF-MS：0.96 g/100 g；NF-LS：2.23 g/100 g；FF-LS：1.11克/100 克）。尽管蛋白质降解在中点的 FF 组中更为明显（p 四联球菌和耐盐细菌，如 Halomonas，在中点），并且增加了产香酵母接合酵母的相对丰度（NF-MS：37.73％；FF-MS：65.11％）。基于 PICRUSt2 的功能预测表明，参与丙酮酸代谢和支链氨基酸降解的基因的预测丰度更高这些结果表明，T. halophilus CICC 10286 作为发酵剂可以有效调节发酵。

articles.title: Juice turbidity and fermentation method: key drivers of aroma complexity in Italian Riesling grape spirit production.
articles.titleZh: 果汁浊度和发酵方法：意大利雷司令葡萄烈酒生产中香气复杂性的关键驱动因素。
articles.authors: Wang H, Bi J, Liu G, Gao T, Bai W, Liang Y, Song Y, Qin Y.
articles.abstract: Juice turbidity and fermentation mode are key factors affecting aroma formation in grape spirit production, but their combined effects remain unclear. In this study, Italian Riesling juice under two turbidity conditions (clear and turbid) was fermented either spontaneously or with commercial yeast, generating four treatments. Physicochemical properties, volatile compounds, odor activity values, and sensory characteristics of base wines and grape spirits were compared. Both factors significantly influenced base-wine composition and these differences were reflected in the distillates. Spontaneous fermentation increased aroma diversity and complexity, whereas inoculated fermentation produced a more uniform volatile profile. Clear juice favored floral and fruity esters, while turbid juice promoted fermentation-derived aroma precursors. Distillation further amplified treatment-dependent volatile differences, resulting in distinct aromatic styles. These results show that juice turbidity and fermentation mode jointly shape aroma development from fermentation to distillation and provide guidance for targeted aroma modulation in Italian Riesling grape spirit production.
articles.abstractZh: 果汁浊度和发酵方式是影响白酒生产中香气形成的关键因素，但其综合影响尚不清楚。在这项研究中，意大利雷司令汁在两种浊度条件（澄清和浑浊）下进行自然发酵或使用商业酵母发酵，产生四种处理。比较了基酒和白酒的理化性质、挥发性化合物、气味活性值和感官特征。这两个因素都显着影响基酒的成分，这些差异反映在馏出物中。自然发酵增加了香气的多样性和复杂性，而接种发酵产生了更均匀的挥发性特征。清澈的果汁有利于花香和果香的酯类，而浑浊的果汁则有利于发酵产生的香气前体。蒸馏进一步放大了处理依赖性挥发性差异，产生了独特的芳香风格。这些结果表明，果汁浊度和发酵模式共同影响从发酵到蒸馏的香气发展，为意大利雷司令葡萄烈酒生产中的针对性香气调制提供指导。

articles.title: Lipid-derived flavor compounds in dry sausages: yeast esterase-mediated free fatty acid release and ester synthesis.
articles.titleZh: 干香肠中的脂质衍生风味化合物：酵母酯酶介导的游离脂肪酸释放和酯合成。
articles.authors: Sui Y, Jiang B, Zhang Z, Yan F, Kong B, Liu H, Chen Q.
articles.abstract: The role of yeast in lipid-derived flavor formation in dry sausage was investigated. Among six screened yeast strains, four exhibited strong lipolytic activity and were selected for sausage fermentation. Yeast inoculation improved physicochemical properties, including water activity, color stability, and tenderness, while promoting the release of free fatty acids (FFAs) and the accumulation of alcohols and esters, especially ethyl esters. Debaryomyces hansenii HG2 and Torulaspora delbrueckii HG7 showed the highest lipid-hydrolyzing activity (total FFAs: 120.00 and 120.81 mg/100 g, respectively) and ester-producing capacity (1066.76 and 883.30 μg/kg, respectively) and were further investigated for ester synthesis pathways. Ester formation mainly occurred via esterase-mediated esterification and alcoholysis, with optimal activity at pH 4.8 and a preference for medium-chain fatty acids (C8-C12). This study addresses a key gap in understanding yeast-mediated ester synthesis in dry sausage, providing a theoretical basis and practical strains for employing yeast starters to modulate flavor of fermented meats.
articles.abstractZh: 研究了酵母在干香肠中脂质衍生风味形成中的作用。筛选的6株酵母菌株中，有4株表现出较强的脂肪分解活性，被选用于香肠发酵。酵母接种改善了理化特性，包括水分活度、颜色稳定性和嫩度，同时促进游离脂肪酸 (FFA) 的释放以及醇和酯（尤其是乙酯）的积累。 Debaryomyces hansenii HG2 和 Torulaspora delbrueckii HG7 显示出最高的脂质水解活性（总 FFA：分别为 120.00 和 120.81 mg/100 g）和酯生产能力（分别为 1066.76 和 883.30 μg/kg），并进一步研究了酯合成途径。酯的形成主要通过酯酶介导的酯化和醇解发生，在 pH 4.8 时具有最佳活性，并且优先选择中链脂肪酸 (C8-C12)。这项研究解决了理解干香肠中酵母介导的酯合成的关键差距，为利用酵母发酵剂调节发酵肉的风味提供了理论基础和实践菌株。

articles.title: Strategies for Regulating the Color, Texture and Flavor Characteristics of Fermented Meat Products by <i>Lactiplantibacillus plantarum</i> and <i>Saccharomyces cerevisiae</i>.
articles.titleZh: 植物乳杆菌和酿酒酵母调节发酵肉制品颜色、质地和风味特征的策略。
articles.authors: Li X, Wang S, Zou H, Du S, Li Y, Li J, Liu M, Bai H, Wang H, Chen X.
articles.abstract: The effects of direct inoculation of compound culture starter (Lactiplantibacillus plantarum and Saccharomyces cerevisiae) on the color, texture, and flavor qualities of fermented pork liver, sausage, and jerky were investigated. The results showed that inoculation with Lactiplantibacillus plantarum and Saccharomyces cerevisiae could significantly increase the lightness value (L*) and chroma value (C*) values of meat products and promote the color development of products. Meanwhile, it can also improve the tenderness of the products. The post-inoculation fermentation process enhanced the diversity and concentration of flavor compounds, improving the overall flavor of the product, and a total of 11 characteristic flavor compounds were identified. Inoculated fermentation reduced the levels of pentanal and methanethiol, which were unpleasant odor components in pork liver. In addition, inoculation fermentation could reduce the concentration of nonanal, which contributes to rancid fat odor in jerky. Inoculated fermentation enriched the flavor profile of meat products through the dual effects of "removing gamey flavor and enhancing aroma". The results also showed that, after inoculation, the umami taste of meat products was enhanced, and bitter and sour tastes were inhibited. In conclusion, Lactiplantibacillus plantarum and Saccharomyces cerevisiae could serve as an excellent culture starter for industrial production, providing a feasible path for green and healthy meat processing.
articles.abstractZh: 研究了直接接种复合发酵剂（植物乳杆菌和酿酒酵母）对发酵猪肝、香肠和肉干颜色、质地和风味品质的影响。结果表明，接种植物乳杆菌和酿酒酵母可显着提高肉制品的明度值（L*）和色度值（C*）值，促进产品显色。同时，还可以提高产品的嫩度。接种后发酵过程增强了风味化合物的多样性和浓度，改善了产品的整体风味，共鉴定出11种特征风味化合物。接种发酵降低了猪肝中难闻气味成分戊醛和甲硫醇的含量。此外，接种发酵可以降低壬醛的浓度，壬醛是造成肉干中酸败脂肪气味的原因之一。接种发酵通过“去腥味、增香气”的双重作用，丰富了肉制品的风味特征。结果还表明，接种后，

articles.title: Yeast-powered microfluidic pump based on a four-parameter fermentation model.
articles.titleZh: 基于四参数发酵模型的酵母动力微流体泵。
articles.authors: Kim J, Kim K, Baeck S, Park JY.
articles.abstract: Baker's yeast is a common microorganism that is well-known for its fermentation activities. The fermentation process naturally produces CO2, leading to a gradual increase in internal pressure within sealed environments. Meanwhile, passive pumps are rising in the microfluidics field for their simplicity, low energy requirements, and suitability for portable and disposable devices. Here, we harnessed yeast fermentation as a biological power source for a passive pump, enabling fluid flow in microfluidic systems. This approach introduces a cost-effective solution and extends the concept of passive pumping into the realm of biological systems. The custom mechanical pump operates by converting the gas pressure generated by fermentation into continuous fluid movement. The dynamics of gas production within the pump were analyzed experimentally to characterize performance over time. The resulting six-parameter and four-parameter equations accurately capture the experimental trends within the validated operating range. This model was further extended to a simplified two-parameter form-using only yeast mass and sucrose concentration-making the pump setup more intuitive. This biologically driven pump concept holds potential for expansion into autonomous microfluidic devices, especially for space orbital experiment modules, educational tools, or low-resource settings where external power sources are limited.
articles.abstractZh: 面包酵母是一种常见的微生物，以其发酵活性而闻名。发酵过程自然产生二氧化碳，导致密封环境内的内部压力逐渐增加。与此同时，被动泵因其简单性、低能耗以及适用于便携式和一次性设备而在微流体领域兴起。在这里，我们利用酵母发酵作为被动泵的生物动力源，使微流体系统中的流体流动。这种方法引入了一种经济有效的解决方案，并将被动泵的概念扩展到生物系统领域。定制机械泵的工作原理是将发酵产生的气压转化为连续的流体运动。通过实验分析泵内气体产生的动态，以表征随时间变化的性能。由此产生的六参数和四参数方程准确地捕捉了经过验证的操作范围内的实验趋势。该模型进一步扩展到简化的双参数形式——仅使用酵母质量和蔗糖浓度——使泵设置更加直观。这种生物驱动

articles.title: Construction of Synthetic Microbial Community with Core Microorganisms for Soy Sauce Fermentation.
articles.titleZh: 酱油发酵核心微生物合成微生物群落的构建。
articles.authors: Chen P, Du G, Chen J, Fang F.
articles.abstract: Core microbes and succession of the microbial community greatly influence soy sauce fermentation process. This study identified seven functionally important core microbes, including Weissella paramesenteroides, Lactiplantibacillus plantarum, Tetragenococcus halophilus, Pediococcus pentosaceus, Zygosaccharomyces rouxii, Candida orthopsilosis, and Aspergillus oryzae for soy sauce fermentation, based on dominant taxa, co-occurrence relationships, and volatile-associated taxa analysis. Four distinct fermentation phases were identified for soy sauce fermentation based on metagenomics and metabolomics data correlation analyses. Acceptable fermentation performance and comparable soy sauce flavor compounds were achieved using a temporal synthetic microbial community for fermentation. The synthetic microbial community was assembled with inoculation of dominant lactic acid bacteria (LAB) in the immediate early phase, other LAB in early and middle phases, and yeasts in the late phase. Glutamate and 4-ethylguaiacol were identified as soy sauce fermentation indicators for early to middle and late fermentation phases, respectively. These results may provide a possible solution for achieving precise control over the brewing process and improving the flavor and quality of soy sauce.
articles.abstractZh: 核心微生物和微生物群落的演替对酱油发酵过程影响很大。本研究基于优势类群、共现关系和挥发性相关类群分析，鉴定了七种功能重要的核心微生物，包括副肠膜韦斯氏菌、植物乳杆菌、嗜盐四联球菌、戊糖片球菌、鲁氏接合酵母、直丝念珠菌和米曲霉，用于酱油发酵。根据宏基因组学和代谢组学数据相关分析，确定了酱油发酵的四个不同的发酵阶段。使用临时合成微生物群落进行发酵，获得了可接受的发酵性能和可比较的酱油风味化合物。合成微生物群落是通过在早期阶段接种优势乳酸菌（LAB）、在早期和中期接种其他 LAB、在晚期接种酵母菌来组装的。谷氨酸和4-乙基愈创木酚分别被确定为酱油发酵早期、中期和后期的发酵指标。这些结果可能为实现Prec提供可能的解决方案

articles.title: Enhancing microbial safety and flavor of fermented peppers through inoculation of distinct lactic acid bacteria and yeasts.
articles.titleZh: 通过接种不同的乳酸菌和酵母来增强发酵辣椒的微生物安全性和风味。
articles.authors: Chen Z, Tang X, Liu W, Shen Y, Luo Y.
articles.abstract: This study investigated effects of inoculated lactic acid bacteria (LAB) and yeasts on fermented pepper characteristics. Nine of 16 fermented peppers were selected based on sensory evaluation. Physicochemical analysis found that Saccharomyces cerevisiae Ky and its combination with Pediococcus pentosaceus AO consumed the most reducing sugars, while co-fermentation of Zygosaccharomyces bisporus P11 with Limosilactobacillus fermentum AD enhanced nutritional component production. P. pentosaceus AO and L. fermentum AD exhibited strong antibacterial activity against foodborne pathogens, thereby altering microbiota and reducing pathogenic bacterial abundance in fermented peppers. Volatile metabolomics detected 138 compounds, with esters exceeding 30%. Correlation analysis linked 31 microorganisms to 43 compounds. Cyberlindnera rhodanensis M4 greatly impacted flavor via producing multiple esters. Samples M4, P11_AD and M4_AS contained 30, 25 and 10 of the top two most abundant esters, respectively. Overall, LAB enhanced microbial safety, whereas yeasts improved flavor. These findings support developing high-quality fermented peppers with defined starter cultures.
articles.abstractZh: 本研究调查了接种的乳酸菌 (LAB) 和酵母对发酵辣椒特性的影响。根据感官评价，选出 16 种发酵辣椒中的 9 种。理化分析发现，酿酒酵母Ky及其与戊糖片球菌AO的组合消耗的还原糖最多，而双孢接合酵母P11与发酵硅酸乳杆菌AD的共发酵则增强了营养成分的产量。 P.pentosaceus AO和L.fermentum AD对食源性病原体表现出强大的抗菌活性，从而改变发酵辣椒中的微生物群并减少致病菌丰度。挥发性代谢组学检测到 138 种化合物，其中酯类化合物超过 30%。相关分析将 31 种微生物与 43 种化合物联系起来。 Cyber​​lindnera rhodanensis M4 通过产生多种酯极大地影响了风味。样品 M4、P11_AD 和 M4_AS 分别含有 30、25 和 10 种含量最高的两种酯。总体而言，乳酸菌增强了微生物安全性，而酵母则改善了风味。这些发现支持开发具有特定发酵剂的高质量发酵辣椒。

articles.title: Identification of key MYB transcription factors mediating MeJA-induced eupatilin accumulation by regulating AYFOMT2 expression in Artemisia argyi.
articles.titleZh: 通过调节艾叶中 AYFOMT2 的表达来鉴定介导 MeJA 诱导的尤帕提林积累的关键 MYB 转录因子。
articles.authors: Peng S, Yang Y, Zhang Q, Feng W, Li J, Chen M, Huang B, Liu D, Miao Y.
articles.abstract: Methoxylated flavones in Artemisia argyi, especially eupatilin, are important bioactive components with antibacterial, anti-inflammatory, and anti-tumor activities. Exogenous treatment with methyl jasmonate (MeJA) significantly promoted the contents of methoxylated flavones in A. argyi. However, the molecular regulatory mechanism underlying MeJA-induced methoxylated flavone biosynthesis remains largely unclear in A. argyi. In this study, transcriptional analysis following MeJA treatment revealed that key genes involved in the flavonoid biosynthetic pathway, including PAL, CHI, and CHS, as well as the critical flavonoid O-methyltransferase gene AYFOMT2, were significantly induced. Meanwhile, the MYB transcription factor family exhibited the most pronounced response to MeJA induction. Based on expression profiling, three key candidate genes, AYMYB13, AYMYB15, and AYMYB16, were screened and identified. To further characterize their regulatory mechanism in methoxylated flavones biosynthesis, yeast one-hybrid and dual-luciferase assays confirmed that AYMYB13, AYMYB15, and AYMYB16 directly bind to the promoter of AYFOMT2, thereby promoting the accumulation of eupatilin. Futhermore, overexpression of these three MYB transcription factors in A. argyi calli significantly increased the content of eupatilin. Our study demonstrated that AYMYB13, AYMYB15, and AYMYB16 were key regulators for activating the expression of AYFOMT2 in MeJA-induced methoxylated flavones accumulation. These findings will provide a theoretical foundation for improving eupatilin content and biosynthetic efficiency in A. argyi.
articles.abstractZh: 艾叶中的甲氧基黄酮，尤其是艾帕提林，是重要的生物活性成分，具有抗菌、抗炎、抗肿瘤等活性。外源茉莉酸甲酯(MeJA)处理显着提高了艾叶中甲氧基黄酮的含量。然而，艾草中 MeJA 诱导的甲氧基化黄酮生物合成的分子调控机制仍不清楚。在这项研究中，MeJA 处理后的转录分析表明，参与类黄酮生物合成途径的关键基因，包括 PAL、CHI 和 CHS，以及关键的类黄酮 O-甲基转移酶基因 AYFOMT2，均被显着诱导。同时，MYB 转录因子家族对 MeJA 诱导表现出最明显的反应。基于表达谱，筛选并鉴定了三个关键候选基因AYMYB13、AYMYB15和AYMYB16。为了进一步表征其在甲氧基化黄酮生物合成中的调节机制，酵母单杂交和双荧光素酶测定证实AYMYB13、AYMYB15和AYMYB16直接结合到AYFOMT2的启动子，从而促进eupatilin的积累。此外，以上

articles.title: Metabolic engineering of Saccharomyces cerevisiae to enhance resistance toward microbial toxicity in agave extracts.
articles.titleZh: 酿酒酵母的代谢工程可增强龙舌兰提取物对微生物毒性的抵抗力。
articles.authors: Lee S, Rosales J, La Torre M, Lu ML, Jozwiak A, Wheeldon I.
articles.abstract: Agave, which thrives in arid regions of North Americas, is a promising alternative feedstock for biofuel production due to its high sugar content and drought tolerance. A major challenge to using agave as a feedstock for bioprocessing is its toxicity. Saponins, natively produced glycosides, disrupt cell membranes and are highly toxic to Saccharomyces cerevisiae even at low concentrations. To enable agave as a feedstock, we combined rational engineering with adaptive laboratory evolution (ALE) to create new S. cerevisiae strains with high tolerance to agave extracts. Heterologous overexpression of tomatinase from Fusarium oxysporum improved tolerance up to 10% agave extracts. In parallel, 27 serial passages of ALE resulted in evolved strains that can grow in 4% extracts and produce ethanol equivalent to the starting strains. Whole genome sequencing revealed mutations in coding sequences of multidrug efflux pumps (PDR5 and PDR1) and a non-coding sequence adjacent to α-glucosidase gene (IMA3), suggesting roles in resistance to saponins. Combining both approaches - tomatinase overexpression and evolved strains - yielded a high-tolerant strain that produced ethanol in 20% agave extracts. Our dual approach to strain engineering demonstrates an effective multi-level strategy of developing microbial hosts with increased resistances to toxicity feedstock components, ultimately enabling new bioprocesses.
articles.abstractZh: 龙舌兰生长在北美干旱地区，由于其高糖含量和耐旱性，是一种很有前途的生物燃料生产替代原料。使用龙舌兰作为生物加工原料的一个主要挑战是其毒性。皂苷是天然产生的糖苷，会破坏细胞膜，即使在低浓度下也对酿酒酵母具有剧毒。为了使龙舌兰成为原料，我们将合理工程与适应性实验室进化（ALE）相结合，创造出对龙舌兰提取物具有高耐受性的新酿酒酵母菌株。来自尖孢镰刀菌的番茄酶的异源过度表达提高了高达 10% 龙舌兰提取物的耐受性。与此同时，ALE 的 27 次连续传代产生了进化菌株，可以在 4% 提取物中生长并产生与起始菌株相当的乙醇。全基因组测序揭示了多药外排泵（PDR5和PDR1）的编码序列以及与α-葡萄糖苷酶基因（IMA3）相邻的非编码序列的突变，表明其在皂苷抗性中的作用。将番茄酶过度表达和进化菌株这两种方法结合起来，产生了一种高耐受菌株，可以在 20% 龙舌兰提取物中产生乙醇

articles.title: Modulation of beer fermentation time and yeast metabolite generation using audible sound with elevated particle motion.
articles.titleZh: 使用可听声音和增强的颗粒运动来调节啤酒发酵时间和酵母代谢物的产生。
articles.authors: Adadi P, Harris A, Bremer P, Silcock P, Ganley ARD, Jowett T, Jeffs AG, Eyres GT.
articles.abstract: Studies on the impact of audible sound on yeast growth and metabolism during beer fermentation have focused mainly on the pressure component of sound, with limited attention to particle motion. This study investigated three sound treatments (800-2000 Hz 140 dBRMS re 1 μPa2 @ 1 m, 800-2000 Hz 110 dBRMS re 1 μPa2 @ 1 m, and 4000-10,000 Hz 140 dBRMS re 1 μPa2 @ 1 m) with elevated particle motion, compared to a no-sound control (91 dB), assessing yeast cells in suspension, extracellular metabolites and volatile organic compounds (VOCs). The 800-2000 Hz treatment significantly reduced fermentation time by ∼46 h (p < 0.05), while the 4000-10,000 Hz treatment showed a ∼ 30-h reduction, though not statistically significant (p = 0.08). Both high-intensity treatments retained more yeast in suspension and increased metabolite abundance, with minimal impact on the VOC profile of the final beer. These findings suggest that sound frequency and intensity, particularly particle motion, can influence yeast performance and accelerate fermentation without compromising beer flavor.
articles.abstractZh: 关于啤酒发酵过程中可听声音对酵母生长和代谢影响的研究主要集中在声音的压力分量上，而对颗粒运动的关注有限。本研究调查了三种声音处理（800-2000 Hz 140 dBRMS re 1 μPa2 @ 1 m、800-2000 Hz 110 dBRMS re 1 μPa2 @ 1 m 和 4000-10,000 Hz 140 dBRMS re 1 μPa2 @ 1 m），与无声音对照 (91 dB) 相比，评估了悬浮液中的酵母细胞，细胞外代谢物和挥发性有机化合物（VOC）。 800-2000 Hz 处理使发酵时间显着缩短约 46 小时（p < 0.05），而 4000-10,000 Hz 处理则缩短约 30 小时，但不具有统计学意义（p = 0.08）。两种高强度处理都保留了更多的酵母悬浮液并增加了代谢物丰度，对最终啤酒的 VOC 特征影响最小。这些发现表明，声音的频率和强度，特别是粒子运动，可以影响酵母性能并加速发酵，而不会影响啤酒风味。

articles.title: Multi-omics-guided discovery of CYP5035 enables heterologous production and engineering of pachymic acid in yeast.
articles.titleZh: CYP5035 的多组学指导发现使得酵母中茯苓酸的异源生产和工程成为可能。
articles.authors: Liu C, Liu C, Shen B, Zhong C, Xie J, Zheng M, Jin J.
articles.abstract: Pachymic acid is a key bioactive triterpenoid of Poria cocos, a medicinal fungus widely used in traditional Chinese medicine, and is responsible for its anti-tumor and anti-inflammatory activities. However, its low natural abundance and reliance on pine wood-based cultivation limit large-scale production and therapeutic application. Methyl jasmonate (MeJA) is known to stimulate triterpenoid biosynthesis in plants and fungi. In this study, we treated liquid-cultured Poria cocos mycelia with MeJA and integrated transcriptomic and targeted metabolomic analyses to identify a cytochrome P450 gene, CYP5035, whose expression strongly correlates with pachymic acid accumulation. We then functionally validated CYP5035 by heterologous expression in Saccharomyces cerevisiae. Subsequent metabolic engineering of the yeast strain-through redox partner optimization and dynamic flux redirection-significantly enhanced pachymic acid production. Our work not only reveals the molecular basis of MeJA-induced triterpenoid synthesis but also establishes a sustainable microbial platform for the green and efficient production of pachymic acid.
articles.abstractZh: 茯苓酸是茯苓（一种中药中广泛使用的药用真菌）的关键生物活性三萜类化合物，具有抗肿瘤和抗炎活性。然而，其自然丰度较低以及对松木种植的依赖限制了大规模生产和治疗应用。茉莉酸甲酯 (MeJA) 已知可刺激植物和真菌中的三萜生物合成。在这项研究中，我们用 MeJA 处理液体培养的茯苓菌丝体，并整合转录组学和靶向代谢组学分析，以确定细胞色素 P450 基因 CYP5035，其表达与茯苓酸积累密切相关。然后，我们通过在酿酒酵母中的异源表达对 CYP5035 进行功能验证。随后的酵母菌株代谢工程——通过氧化还原伙伴优化和动态通量重定向——显着增强了茯苓酸的产量。我们的工作不仅揭示了MeJA诱导三萜类化合物合成的分子基础，而且为绿色高效生产茯苓酸建立了可持续的微生物平台。

articles.title: Optimization of Kombucha Fermentation from Green Tea and Pineapple Juice: Chemical, Physicochemical, and Bioactive Profiles for Functional Beverage Development.
articles.titleZh: 绿茶和菠萝汁的康普茶发酵优化：功能饮料开发的化学、物理化学和生物活性特征。
articles.authors: Frota Gaban SV, Queiroz Nogueira SS, Marlon Mota Marques F, Porro C, Alves Filho EG, Silva LMA, Canuto KM.
articles.abstract: This study evaluated the metabolic evolution and functional quality of green tea-based kombucha and pineapple juice-based kombucha fermented with the same symbiotic culture of bacteria and yeasts. Beverages were monitored over 0, 3, 5, and 7 days of fermentation using nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy alongside complementary physicochemical and color analyses to elucidate changes in organic acids, amino acids, and phenolic compounds. Both beverages showed progressive pH reduction to approximately 3.4, increased titratable acidity, and lightning of color (increased L, decreased a and b*) over time. Sucrose content decreased progressively in both systems, accompanied by ethanol production followed by oxidation to acetic, gluconic, and succinic acids, which increased significantly (p < 0.05). Pineapple juice-based kombucha exhibited higher total acid production and faster acidification, while green tea kombucha maintained greater stability in malic and citric acids. Among nitrogenous and phenolic compounds, epicatechin gallate (ECG) and epigallocatechin-3-gallate (EGCG) peaked at day 5 before declining due to oxidative degradation; theanine and alanine showed transient increases, indicating microbial synthesis and assimilation. Caffeine remained relatively stable throughout fermentation. Antioxidant activity measured by the ABTS assay revealed significantly higher radical scavenging capacity in green tea kombucha (10.36 μmol TE/g at day 0 to 10.33 μmol TE/g at day 7) compared to pineapple kombucha (1.90 μmol TE/g to 3.00 μmol TE/g over the same period). Overall, day 5 was identified as the optimal fermentation point, balancing acid production, pH reduction, and preservation of bioactive compounds, supporting the development of functional kombucha beverages from both tea and fruit matrices.
articles.abstractZh: 本研究评估了用相同的细菌和酵母共生培养物发酵的绿茶康普茶和菠萝汁康普茶的代谢进化和功能质量。使用核磁共振波谱以及补充的物理化学和颜色分析对发酵的 0、3、5 和 7 天的饮料进行监测，以阐明有机酸、氨基酸和酚类化合物的变化。随着时间的推移，两种饮料的 pH 值逐渐降低至约 3.4，可滴定酸度增加，颜色变亮（L 增加，a 和 b* 减少）。两个系统中的蔗糖含量逐渐下降，同时产生乙醇，然后氧化成乙酸、葡萄糖酸和琥珀酸，这些酸、葡萄糖和琥珀酸显着增加（p < 0.05）。菠萝汁康普茶表现出更高的总酸产量和更快的酸化速度，而绿茶康普茶在苹果酸和柠檬酸中保持了更高的稳定性。在含氮和酚类化合物中，表儿茶素没食子酸酯 (ECG) 和表没食子儿茶素-3-没食子酸酯 (EGCG) 在第 5 天达到峰值，然后由于氧化降解而下降；茶氨酸和丙氨酸短暂增加

articles.title: Starter cultures for sourdough production: rational selection, mixed-strain starter cultures, and strain monitoring.
articles.titleZh: 用于酵母生产的发酵剂：合理选择、混合菌株发酵剂和菌株监测。
articles.journal: Critical reviews in food science and nutrition
articles.authors: Pradal I, Weckx S, De Vuyst L.
articles.abstract: Sourdough is a flour-water mixture fermented by lactic acid bacteria (LAB) and yeasts. The addition of starter culture strains allows steering the fermentation process toward sourdoughs with tailored properties. However, the rational selection of candidate starter culture strains for sourdough production is of crucial importance, yet challenging. This review aimed to (i) describe the microbial diversity of non-starter culture-inoculated sourdoughs as source for starter culture strains for future use, (ii) examine LAB and yeast metabolism (carbohydrate, amino acid, and ester metabolism) and sourdough bread characteristics (flavor, rheology, nutritional and other health properties) as a target to screen and select strains, (iii) explore the interactions between LAB and yeasts and their implications for the use of starter cultures, and (iv) discuss how the different process parameters (raw material, oxygen, fermentation and storage duration and temperature) should be adapted for different starter culture strains. Furthermore, the techniques available for strain selection and starter culture strain monitoring are summarized, highlighting their current use, their challenges, and perspectives. Overall, a successful starter culture-initiated sourdough production process requires rational strain selection encompassing multiple complementary techniques and optimized process conditions. In addition, mixed-strain starter cultures, composed of LAB and yeast strains, show potential for enhancing sourdough quality.
articles.abstractZh: 酸面团是由乳酸菌 (LAB) 和酵母发酵的面粉和水的混合物。添加发酵剂菌株可以将发酵过程引导至具有定制特性的酸面团。然而，合理选择用于酸面团生产的候选发酵剂菌株至关重要，但也具有挑战性。本综述旨在 (i) 描述非发酵剂接种的酸面团的微生物多样性，作为未来使用的发酵剂菌株的来源，(ii) 检查 LAB 和酵母代谢（碳水化合物、氨基酸和酯代谢）以及酸面团面包特性（风味、流变学、营养和其他健康特性），作为筛选和选择菌株的目标，(iii) 探索 LAB 和酵母之间的相互作用及其对发酵剂使用的影响，以及(iv) 讨论如何针对不同的发酵剂菌株调整不同的工艺参数（原材料、氧气、发酵和储存时间以及温度）。此外，还总结了可用于菌株选择和发酵剂培养菌株监测的技术，强调了它们当前的用途、挑战和前景

articles.title: Sustainable biosynthesis of silver nanoparticles from vinegar bacteria fermentation waste: characterization, bioactivity and food packaging potential.
articles.titleZh: 从醋细菌发酵废物中可持续生物合成银纳米颗粒：表征、生物活性和食品包装潜力。
articles.authors: Akbaş P, Adıgüzel AO, Kaya E, Adıgüzel SK, Uğurtay E.
articles.abstract: Silver nanoparticles (AgNPs) have emerged as promising agents with significant potential for biotechnological applications, particularly in active packaging systems and wound-healing dressings, owing to their broad-spectrum antimicrobial activity and ability to enhance product safety, shelf life, and infection control. In this context, AgNPs were successfully synthesized via a green synthesis method, offering an environmentally friendly, sustainable, and low-cost approach, using Acetobacter sp. (strains 1A, 1B, 2B, 2D, 3A) and Komagataeibacter sp. (strain X1) isolated from homemade vinegars in the province of Samsun. The synthesis of nanoparticles was verified by the presence of surface plasmon resonance (SPR) peaks formed at 414-432 nm in the reaction mixture. The scanning electron microscopy (SEM) analysis showed that AgNPs were spherical in shape and varied in size between 20 and 100 nm depending on the bacterial isolate used in the synthesis. DLS analysis revealed that all synthesized AgNPs exhibited hydrodynamic diameters ranging from 85.05 to 179.1 nm with PDI values between 0.274 and 0.402, indicating moderately monodisperse to heterogeneous distributions depending on the bacterial isolate. Zeta potential measurements demonstrated that AgNPs had negatively charged surfaces with moderate to high colloidal electrostatic stability (- 12.3 to - 31.8 mV). The antimicrobial activity of the obtained AgNPs was tested against Gram-negative and Gram-positive bacteria, with a low inhibition concentration (16 µg/mL) particularly observed in the ESBL-positive E. coli strain. Antioxidant tests revealed that AgNPs synthesized using Komagataeibacter sp. X1 (KX1-AgNP) exhibited the highest activity and effectively neutralized DPPH radicals by 56.01%. Cytotoxicity studies showed that AgNPs preserved fibroblast cell viability at low concentrations but exhibited toxic effects at high doses. Packaging analyses showed that X1-film effectively preserved food by significantly reducing total viable, psychrotrophic, and yeast-mold counts during storage. These results indicate that biosynthesized AgNPs possess strong antimicrobial and antioxidant properties, with vinegar bacteria serving as an efficient, eco-friendly, and cost-effective source. This strategy offers promising potential for sustainable applications in food packaging and nanotechnology.
articles.abstractZh: 银纳米颗粒（AgNP）已成为一种有前途的制剂，在生物技术应用中具有巨大潜力，特别是在活性包装系统和伤口愈合敷料中，因为它们具有广谱抗菌活性，并且能够提高产品安全性、保质期和感染控制。在此背景下，利用醋杆菌属，通过绿色合成方法成功合成了纳米银颗粒，提供了一种环境友好、可持续且低成本的方法。 （菌株 1A、1B、2B、2D、3A）和 Komagataeibacter sp。 （菌株 X1）从萨姆松省的自制醋中分离出来。通过反应混合物中 414-432 nm 处形成的表面等离子共振 (SPR) 峰的存在来验证纳米颗粒的合成。扫描电子显微镜 (SEM) 分析表明，AgNP 呈球形，尺寸在 20 至 100 nm 之间变化，具体取决于合成中使用的细菌分离株。 DLS 分析表明，所有合成的 AgNP 的流体动力学直径范围为 85.05 至 179.1 nm，PDI 值在 0.274 至 0.402 之间，表明根据条件的不同，具有中等单分散到异质分布。

articles.title: The Role of Mannose in Saccharomyces pastorianus Flocculation During Industrial Brewing Fermentations.
articles.titleZh: 甘露糖在工业酿造发酵过程中巴斯德酵母絮凝中的作用。
articles.authors: Mehta DV, Serviss MT, Schneider KR, Goodrich R, MacIntosh AJ.
articles.abstract: Yeast flocculation is a phenomenon in which yeast zymolectins bind to mannose on adjacent cells resulting in aggregation within fermentation media. Flocculation has been extensively studied and is often assumed to occur only after media sugars are depleted as these are thought to competitively bind to zymolectins. However, yeast within the brewing industry have often been observed flocculating prematurely or staying suspended after media sugars were depleted. In this study, the mechanism of yeast (Saccharomyces pastorianus) flocculation was further investigated, specifically, how flocculation ability, zymolectins, and mannose associated with yeast cells changed throughout fermentation. It was observed that yeast flocculation behavior changed throughout fermentation despite no changes in zymolectin concentrations (as measured using bound fluoroprobes) independent of media sugar concentration. However, a strong positive correlation was observed between yeast flocculation ability and mannose concentration which increased as the fermentation progressed. This implies that the changes observed in flocculation behavior during fermentation may be more dependent on cell mannose rather than media sugars or lectins. These results have implications for yeast immobilization and flocculation control schemes. This research enhances the current understanding of the yeast flocculation mechanism with applications in brewing, bioethanol production, pharmaceutical production, precision fermentation, and cell biomass industries.
articles.abstractZh: 酵母絮凝是酵母酶凝集素与相邻细胞上的甘露糖结合导致在发酵培养基内聚集的现象。絮凝已被广泛研究，并且通常被认为仅在培养基糖耗尽后发生，因为这些糖被认为与酶凝集素竞争性结合。然而，经常观察到酿造工业中的酵母过早絮凝或在培养基糖耗尽后保持悬浮状态。在本研究中，进一步研究了酵母（Saccharomyces Pastorianus）絮凝的机制，特别是与酵母细胞相关的絮凝能力、酶凝集素和甘露糖在整个发酵过程中如何变化。据观察，尽管酶凝集素浓度（使用结合荧光探针测量）没有变化，但与培养基糖浓度无关，酵母絮凝行为在整个发酵过程中发生了变化。然而，酵母絮凝能力与甘露糖浓度之间存在很强的正相关性，且随着发酵的进行而增加。这意味着发酵过程中观察到的絮凝行为的变化可能更依赖于细胞甘露糖而不是细胞甘露糖。

articles.title: A specific 296 bp insertion in the DFR1 promoter activates ethylene-mediated anthocyanin biosynthesis during autumn leaf senescence in Quercus aliena.
articles.titleZh: DFR1 启动子中特定的 296 bp 插入在栎树秋季叶子衰老过程中激活乙烯介导的花青素生物合成。
articles.authors: Pei Z, Jiang X, Zeng W, Huang Y, Che Y, Zhang H, Liu Y, Yang Q, Li G.
articles.abstract: Red-leaf ornamental trees are commonly characterized by the enrichment of anthocyanins. Quercus aliena, a dominant native oak species in China, displays striking autumn foliage with yellow to red colors. However, the molecular regulation of anthocyanin biosynthesis during leaf senescence remains largely unknown. In this study, we identified a 296 bp insertion in the promoter of Dihydroflavonol 4-Reductase (DFR1) from the red-leaf Q. aliena cultivar 'Qiuyun', which was significantly associated with high anthocyanin accumulation. We established a highly efficient method for genetic transformation in Q. aliena calli and verified the function of DFR1. Yeast one-hybrid library screening identified ETHYLENE INSENSITIVE 3 (EIN3) that can directly bind to the EIN3-binding site in the 296 bp insertion and activate DFR1 expression. Together with a dual-luciferase assay and EMSA, we reported for the first time that EIN3 could directly activate the structural gene DFR1 during anthocyanin biosynthesis. DFR1 expression is markedly induced in EIN3-overexpressing oak calli compared with the wild type. In addition, exogenous ethephon induced anthocyanin accumulation in autumn leaves in the red cultivar, rather than in the yellow cultivar without the insertion. In summary, our findings demonstrate a practical and effective approach for validating gene function in vivo, and provide new insight into the regulatory mechanisms involved in anthocyanin biosynthesis during leaf senescence.
articles.abstractZh: 红叶观赏树的共同特点是富含花青素。外栎是中国主要的本土橡树树种，秋天的叶子呈现出引人注目的黄色到红色。然而，叶片衰老过程中花青素生物合成的分子调控仍然很大程度上未知。在本研究中，我们在红叶栎品种“秋云”的二氢黄酮醇 4-还原酶 (DFR1) 启动子中发现了 296 bp 的插入，该插入与高花青素积累显着相关。我们建立了一种高效的异种愈伤组织遗传转化方法，并验证了DFR1的功能。酵母单杂交文库筛选鉴定出 ETHYLENE INSENSITIVE 3 (EIN3) 可以直接与 296 bp 插入中的 EIN3 结合位点结合并激活 DFR1 表达。结合双荧光素酶测定和EMSA，我们首次报道EIN3可以在花青素生物合成过程中直接激活结构基因DFR1。与野生型相比，EIN3 过表达橡树愈伤组织中 DFR1 表达显着诱导。此外，外源乙烯利诱导红崇拜秋叶中花青素的积累

articles.title: Chemical genetics reveals Leishmania KKT2 and CRK9 kinase activity is required for cell cycle progression.
articles.titleZh: 化学遗传学揭示利什曼原虫 KKT2 和 CRK9 激酶活性是细胞周期进程所必需的。
articles.authors: Carnielli JBT, Brannigan JA, Ramos PZ, Jones NG, Couñago RM, Sjö P, Lima APCA, Wilkinson AJ, Mottram JC.
articles.abstract: Protein kinases are key regulators of the eukaryotic cell cycle and have consequently emerged as attractive targets for drug development. Their well-defined active sites make them particularly amenable to inhibition by small molecules, underscoring their druggability. The Leishmania kinome, shaped by diverse evolutionary processes, harbours a unique repertoire of potential drug targets. Here, we used the cysteine-directed protein kinase probe SM1-71 to identify four essential protein kinases MPK4, MPK5, MPK7 and AEK1 as candidates for covalent kinase inhibitor development, as well as CLK1/CLK2 for which covalent inhibitors have already been identified. We leveraged the absence of natural analog-sensitive (AS) kinases in L. mexicana to establish an in vivo chemical-genetic AS kinase platform for investigating essential functions of protein kinases. Using CRISPR-Cas9-mediated precision genome editing, we endogenously engineered two kinetochore-associated protein kinases, KKT2 and KKT3, and cyclin-dependent kinase CRK9, to generate AS kinases. We show that KKT2 and CRK9 kinase activities are essential for both promastigote and intracellular amastigote survival; KKT2 kinase activity being required for progression through mitosis at a stage preceding mitotic spindle assembly, while CRK9 kinase activity is required for S phase, consistent with its role in trans-splicing. This study demonstrates the utility of AS chemical genetics in Leishmania and identifies KKT2 and CRK9 as having critical roles in Leishmania cell cycle regulation and therefore being promising drug targets.
articles.abstractZh: 蛋白激酶是真核细胞周期的关键调节因子，因此已成为药物开发的有吸引力的靶标。它们明确的活性位点使它们特别容易受到小分子的抑制，从而强调了它们的成药性。利什曼原虫激酶组由不同的进化过程形成，拥有独特的潜在药物靶点。在这里，我们使用半胱氨酸定向蛋白激酶探针 SM1-71 鉴定了四种必需蛋白激酶 MPK4、MPK5、MPK7 和 AEK1 作为共价激酶抑制剂开发的候选者，以及已鉴定出共价抑制剂的 CLK1/CLK2。我们利用 L. mexicana 中天然类似物敏感 (AS) 激酶的缺乏建立了体内化学遗传 AS 激酶平台，用于研究蛋白激酶的基本功能。使用 CRISPR-Cas9 介导的精确基因组编辑，我们内源性地改造了两种着丝粒相关蛋白激酶 KKT2 和 KKT3，以及细胞周期蛋白依赖性激酶 CRK9，以生成 AS 激酶。我们发现 KKT2 和 CRK9 激酶活性对于前鞭毛体和细胞内无鞭毛体的存活至关重要； KKT2 激酶活性为

articles.title: Do seconds make a difference? Investigating strain-specific behavior of yeast in dynamic glucose environments.
articles.titleZh: 几秒钟有什么不同吗？研究酵母在动态葡萄糖环境中的菌株特异性行为。
articles.authors: Blöbaum L, Bünker M, Schmitz J.
articles.abstract: BackgroundWhen applied for industrial-scale bioproduction, cells are subjected to ever-changing cultivation environments due to bioreactor heterogeneities, which can significantly influence their growth and production behavior. Cultivating and comparing cells and strains under conditions representative of an actual bioprocess instead of laboratory environments is therefore necessary for developing more reliable production strains. Scale-down bioreactors provide an experimental approach for this endeavor, yet they are limited in their temporal resolution and flexibility when it comes to environmental dynamics. Thus, the impact of second-scale differences in dynamic environments on microbial producers remains unexplored. This study uses the advantages of microfluidic single-cell cultivation to compare the growth behavior and intracellular parameters of three yeast strains under dynamic cultivation conditions with alternating phases of glucose excess and limitation at the timescale of seconds aiming to uncover strain-specific performance under as well as adaptation to fluctuating, bioprocess-relevant environments.ResultsAcross all three strains, a consistent trend was observed: decreasing glucose availability resulted in reduced growth rates, lower ATP levels, diminished glycolytic flux, and smaller cell sizes. Notably, cells already reached approximately 50% of their maximal growth rate when exposed to growth-promoting glucose conditions for only 10% of the time. Importantly, both growth rate and cell size exhibited an adaptation phase rather than an immediate response to oscillatory glucose supply. Longer exposure to favorable conditions shortened the adaptation phase and resulted in higher adapted growth rates and larger cell sizes.ConclusionBy leveraging microfluidic single-cell cultivation, this study provides unprecedented temporal resolution of environmental dynamics, enabling direct, strain-specific comparison of cellular responses and adaptation to rapidly changing cultivation environments. Seconds do make a difference. Our findings demonstrate that growth rate is a highly conserved trait under environmental perturbations, which points to an intrinsic robustness of the investigated strains and highlights adaptation as a key determinant of performance in dynamic environments. Together, these insights have important implications for the design of future single-cell experiments and for the development of robust bioprocesses operating under dynamic conditions.
articles.abstractZh: 背景当应用于工业规模的生物生产时，由于生物反应器的异质性，细胞面临不断变化的培养环境，这会显着影响其生长和生产行为。因此，为了开发更可靠的生产菌株，有必要在代表实际生物过程而不是实验室环境的条件下培养和比较细胞和菌株。缩小规模的生物反应器为这一努力提供了一种实验方法，但在环境动力学方面，它们的时间分辨率和灵活性受到限制。因此，动态环境中的二阶差异对微生物生产者的影响仍有待探索。本研究利用微流控单细胞培养的优势，比较了三种酵母菌株在动态培养条件下的生长行为和细胞内参数，其中葡萄糖过量和限制的交替阶段以秒为单位，旨在揭示菌株在波动的生物过程相关环境下的特异性性能以及对生物过程相关环境的适应。结果在所有三种菌株中，观察到一致的趋势：减少

articles.title: EL222-Based Optogenetic Gene Regulation in Methylotrophic Yeasts: Mechanisms, Applications, and Future Directions.
articles.titleZh: 甲基营养酵母中基于 EL222 的光遗传学基因调控：机制、应用和未来方向。
articles.authors: Joon R, Phutela R, Khare P.
articles.abstract: Methylotrophic yeasts such as Pichia pastoris are widely used for heterologous protein production because they contain strong and tightly regulated promoters. However, the use of methanol as an inducer presents several practical challenges, including toxicity, flammability, high oxygen demand during fermentation, and increased production costs. To overcome these limitations, researchers have been working on redesigning the AOX1 regulatory system and developing alternative induction strategies that do not rely on methanol. One promising approach is optogenetics, which uses light to control gene expression in a non-invasive way. These systems rely on light-sensitive proteins such as phytochromes, cryptochromes, LOV-domain proteins, and UVR8, allowing gene activity to be regulated in a precise and reversible manner without adding chemical inducers to the culture medium. This review brings together key advances in yeast optogenetics, with a focus on the EL222 system, highlighting its implementation for light-controlled heterologous protein production in P. pastoris and its broad application in synthetic biology and metabolic engineering in Saccharomyces cerevisiae. The growing versatility and scalability of EL222-based circuits highlight their potential to reshape both fundamental research and industrial bioprocessing through safer, more controllable, and energy-efficient gene regulation strategies.
articles.abstractZh: 甲基营养酵母（例如巴斯德毕赤酵母）广泛用于异源蛋白质生产，因为它们含有强大且严格调控的启动子。然而，使用甲醇作为诱导剂存在一些实际挑战，包括毒性、可燃性、发酵过程中的高需氧量以及生产成本增加。为了克服这些限制，研究人员一直致力于重新设计 AOX1 调控系统并开发不依赖甲醇的替代诱导策略。一种有前途的方法是光遗传学，它利用光以非侵入性方式控制基因表达。这些系统依赖于光敏蛋白，如光敏色素、隐花色素、LOV 结构域蛋白和 UVR8，允许以精确和可逆的方式调节基因活性，而无需在培养基中添加化学诱导剂。本综述汇集了酵母光遗传学的关键进展，重点关注 EL222 系统，重点介绍了其在毕赤酵母中光控异源蛋白质生产的实现及其在酿酒酵母合成生物学和代谢工程中的广泛应用。不断增长的多功能性

articles.title: Fermentation-Driven Yeast Encapsulation as a Natural Strategy for Stabilizing and Delivering Mulberry Anthocyanins.
articles.titleZh: 发酵驱动的酵母封装作为稳定和提供桑葚花青素的天然策略。
articles.journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
articles.authors: Li Z, Yin X, Wang J, Zhu J, Tang S, Luan F, Sun J, Bai W.
articles.abstract: Mulberry anthocyanins possess desirable bioactivities but suffer from poor stability and low bioavailability, limiting their application. Here, a anthocyanin-protective yeast, Hanseniaspora opuntiae DYG5 (DYG5), was identified, and a fermentation-adsorption (FA) strategy was developed in which naturally inactivated yeast acts as a food-grade carrier for anthocyanin stabilization and delivery. Compared with Saccharomyces cerevisiae (SY), DYG5 exhibited faster adsorption kinetics and a 25% higher adsorption capacity. Structural characterization (SEM, TEM, BET/DFT, and FTIR) indicated that fermentation-induced cell wall remodeling resulted in a distinct adsorption pattern. Functionally, DYG5 significantly enhanced anthocyanin stability under light, thermal, and extreme pH conditions. In simulated digestion, DYG5 FA retained over 83% of anthocyanins and maintained detectable C3G and C3R, indicating improved stability and sustained release. Overall, this study demonstrates a fermentation-integrated yeast-based strategy that offers a natural, food-grade route for enhancing anthocyanin stability and modulating its release behavior in functional food applications.
articles.abstractZh: 桑葚花青素具有良好的生物活性，但稳定性差、生物利用度低，限制了其应用。在这里，鉴定了一种花青素保护酵母，仙人掌汉森氏菌 DYG5 (DYG5)，并开发了发酵吸附 (FA) 策略，其中自然灭活的酵母充当花青素稳定和输送的食品级载体。与酿酒酵母（SY）相比，DYG5表现出更快的吸附动力学和高25%的吸附容量。结构表征（SEM、TEM、BET/DFT 和 FTIR）表明发酵诱导的细胞壁重塑导致了独特的吸附模式。从功能上来说，DYG5 显着增强了花青素在光、热和极端 pH 条件下的稳定性。在模拟消化中，DYG5 FA 保留了超过 83% 的花青素，并保持了可检测到的 C3G 和 C3R，表明稳定性和缓释性得到改善。总体而言，这项研究展示了一种基于酵母的发酵整合策略，该策略提供了一种天然的食品级途径，可增强花青素的稳定性并调节其在功能性食品应用中的释放行为。

The central objective was to fill the current knowledge gap regarding dynamic flavor development in mixed fermentations, particularly in systems where probiotic LAB may contribute both functional and aromatic benefits. Microbial viability was monitored using propidium monoazide quantitative PCR (PMA-qPCR); volatile compounds were profiled by headspace solid-phase microextraction coupled to gas chromatography-mass spectrometry (HS-SPME/GC-MS); and sensory acceptance was evaluated with 62 untrained panelists using a 9-point hedonic scale. F19 displayed strong viability throughout fermentation (5-7 log CFU/mL), with significant increases after 58 days in the control and passion fruit formulations (p L. paracasei F19 enhances aroma diversity and remains viable in fruit-based sour beers, with passion fruit providing the most promising sensory and functional profile for innovative probiotic craft beer development.
articles.abstractZh: 这项研究调查了水果基质和益生菌菌株副干酪乳杆菌亚种如何发挥作用。副干酪 F19 (F19) 与酿酒酵母 US-05 相互作用，在 Catharina 酸啤酒发酵过程中影响挥发物形成、微生物活力和感官结果。核心目标是填补当前关于混合发酵动态风味开发的知识空白，特别是在益生菌乳酸菌可能同时发挥功能和芳香功效的系统中。使用单叠氮化丙啶定量 PCR (PMA-qPCR) 监测微生物活力；通过顶空固相微萃取与气相色谱-质谱联用 (HS-SPME/GC-MS) 分析挥发性化合物； 62 名未经培训的小组成员使用 9 点享乐量表对感官接受度进行了评估。 F19 在整个发酵过程中表现出强大的活力（5-7 log CFU/mL），58 天后在对照和百香果配方中显着增加（副干酪乳杆菌 F19 增强了香气多样性，并在水果酸啤酒中保持活力，百香果为创新益生菌精酿啤酒开发提供了最有前途的感官和功能特征

articles.title: Genetic Diversity analysis of industrial Saccharomyces cerevisiae strains and their correlation with fermentation performance.
articles.titleZh: 工业酿酒酵母菌株遗传多样性分析及其与发酵性能的相关性。
articles.authors: Lei L, Bin Q, Yu C, Qin X, Shan X, Wu R, Cao S.
articles.abstract: Sugarcane molasses serves as a vital non-food feedstock for ethanol fermentation, and its efficient utilisation depends on breeding of excellent microbial strains. Therefore, identification of industrial strains for ethanol fermentation is central to improving fermentation efficiency. To identify high-efficiency ethanol-fermenting strains, we developed a method for preparing high-throughput polymerase chain reaction (PCR) templates within 3 min using seven industrial Saccharomyces cerevisiae strains, integrating single-cell morphology and phenotypic variations in ethanol fermentation. Method specificity was confirmed by amplifying and sequencing the internal transcribed spacer region, and the efficiency was validated by extracting genomic DNA using cetyltrimethylammonium bromide (CTAB). Subsequent genetic diversity analysis using random amplified polymorphic DNA (RAPD) with eight effective primers screened from twenty-two random primers revealed genetic similarity coefficients ranging between 0.47 and 0.96. The high-yield strains 1015-04-01 and 1002-03-03 showed the highest similarity (0.96), whereas strain 1015-04-01 and the low-yield strain 1415 exhibited the lowest similarity (0.47). Unweighted pair group method with arithmetic mean (UPGMA) cluster analysis demonstrated that the high-yield strain 1016-02-04, and strains 1415 and 1313 formed a major cluster, and the low-yield strains 1415 and 1313 formed a distinct subcluster; four other high-yield strains constituted a separate cluster, indicating certain genetic differences between high- and low-yield strains, together with partial genetic overlap. The RAPD results exhibited a certain correlation with differences in final ethanol concentration and single-cell morphology, providing preliminary genetic marker references for the rapid identification and screening of high-performance strains used in ethanol fermentation from sugarcane molasses.
articles.abstractZh: 甘蔗糖蜜是乙醇发酵的重要非食品原料，其高效利用有赖于优良微生物菌株的选育。因此，乙醇发酵工业菌株的鉴定对于提高发酵效率至关重要。为了鉴定高效乙醇发酵菌株，我们开发了一种使用七种工业酿酒酵母菌株在 3 分钟内制备高通量聚合酶链式反应 (PCR) 模板的方法，整合了乙醇发酵中的单细胞形态和表型变化。通过对内部转录间隔区进行扩增和测序来确认方法的特异性，并通过使用十六烷基三甲基溴化铵 (CTAB) 提取基因组 DNA 来验证方法的效率。随后使用随机扩增多态性 DNA (RAPD) 和从 22 个随机引物中筛选出的 8 个有效引物进行的遗传多样性分析显示，遗传相似系数在 0.47 至 0.96 之间。高产菌株1015-04-01和1002-03-03的相似度最高（0.96），而菌株1015-04-01和低产菌株1415的相似度最低（0.96）。

articles.title: Methanol-based biosynthesis of p-coumaric acid by engineered Pichia pastoris.
articles.titleZh: 工程毕赤酵母基于甲醇的对香豆酸生物合成。
articles.authors: Chen M, Fang J, Wang S, Liu G, Zhang Y, Li Y, Jia K, Zhu T.
articles.abstract: p-Coumaric acid (p-CA) is a key aromatic precursor for the biosynthesis of flavonoids, stilbenoids, and other high-value phenylpropanoids. While microbial production of p-CA typically relies on sugar-based substrates, methanol offers a sustainable and cost-effective alternative, though its use for aromatic biosynthesis remains unexplored. Here, we report the first de novo production of p-CA from methanol using engineered methylotrophic yeast Pichia pastoris. Through heterologous expression of a tyrosine ammonia-lyase and implementing a balanced push-pull strategy in the shikimate pathway using feedback-resistant variants of DAHP synthase (ARO4) and chorismate mutase (ARO7), carbon flux from methanol-derived C3 and C4 precursors was effectively redirected toward aromatic biosynthesis. Shake-flask studies revealed strong gene-dosage-dependent p-CA production, but strains with high-copy numbers suffered metabolic burden under high-density fermentation. Fed-batch bioreactor cultivation demonstrated that a moderate-copy strain achieved the highest titer of 704 ± 6 mg/L, outperforming high-copy variants in robustness and scalability. This study establishes P. pastoris as a promising chassis for methanol-based aromatic production and highlights the critical trade-off between pathway amplification and cellular fitness in C1 biomanufacturing.

articles.title: Optimization of pretreatment and enzymatic hydrolysis using commercial and isolated bacterial enzyme cocktail for bioethanol production from corn husk through yeast co-culture batch fermentation.
articles.titleZh: 使用商业和分离的细菌酶混合物优化预处理和酶水解，通过酵母共培养分批发酵从玉米壳生产生物乙醇。
articles.authors: Samantaray B, Mishra RR, Mohapatra S, Rath S, Behera BC, Thatoi H.
articles.abstract: This study assesses the impact of physicochemical pretreatment, enzymatic hydrolysis, and co-culture fermentation strategies on bioethanol production from corn husk biomass (CHB). Under optimal alkali pretreatment conditions (1.75% alkali, 4.0 g substrate concentration, 120 °C, 10 h), 35% lignin removal was achieved, with 48% cellulose and 39% hemicellulose recovery. In contrast, acid pretreatment resulted in 30% lignin removal, 45% cellulose recovery, and 34% hemicellulose recovery, showing lower efficiency than alkali pretreatment. During ultrasonication alkali pretreatment enhanced cellulose and hemicellulose exposure up to 51 and 46% and delignification up to 49%. Enzymatic hydrolysis of pretreated corn husk biomass was performed using commercial enzymes [Celluclast 1.5 L (700 EGU or 854 U mL-1) and Viscozyme (13.4 FBG/mL)] and isolated bacterial enzymes, including cellulase from Bacillus licheniformis (9.3 ± 0.3 U mL-1) and xylanase from Enterobacter asburiae PQ396173 (7.0 ± 0.4 U mL-1). The developed enzyme cocktail in ratio 3:2:3:1 (v/v; U mL-1) (Celluclast: Viscozyme: native cellulase: native xylanse) using a cocktail of native and commercial enzymes, yielded total reducing sugar of 740 mg g-1 glucose and 54.6 mg g-1 xylose. Fermentation of hydrolysate prepared with commercial enzymes using monoculture of Saccharomyces cerevisiae and Pichia pastoris yielded 17.6 g L-1 and 12.2 g L-1 bioethanol separately. Co-cultured yeasts produced 26.8 g L-1 ethanol at 96 h of incubation, exceeding monoculture yields. The fermentation with integration of commercial and isolated bacterial enzyme cocktails yielded the highest bioethanol output of 37.3 g L-1 at 96 h incubation, indicating that enzymatic saccharification with a combination of commercial and native enzyme cocktails results in maximum bioethanol production.

articles.title: SmYABBY1, a Light-Inducible Transcription Factor, Positively Regulates Anthocyanin Biosynthesis in Eggplant (<i>Solanum melongena</i> L.).
articles.titleZh: SmYABBY1 是一种光诱导转录因子，可正向调节茄子 (Solanum melongena L.) 中的花青素生物合成。
articles.authors: Shi S, Yang G, Gu Z, Xue Q, Liu Y, Ye L.
articles.abstract: Anthocyanin biosynthesis in eggplant (Solanum melongena L.) is highly light-dependent, and insufficient light severely impairs fruit coloration, which restricts the development of the eggplant industry. SmMYB75 is a key positive regulator of anthocyanin biosynthesis, but its regulatory partners remain unclear. In this study, seven SmYABBY genes were identified from the eggplant genome, all containing conserved zinc finger and YABBY domains. Expression analysis showed that SmYABBY1 was predominantly expressed in fruit peel and significantly induced by light, with a peak at 4 h after light exposure. The yeast two-hybrid and bimolecular fluorescence complementation assays indicated that SmYABBY1 interacts with SmMYB75 and the light signaling regulator SmCOP1 in the nucleus. The heterologous overexpression of SmYABBY1 in Arabidopsis enhanced anthocyanin accumulation and upregulated the expression of anthocyanin structural genes. Transient co-expression in tobacco leaves further demonstrated that SmYABBY1 synergistically enhances SmMYB75-mediated anthocyanin biosynthesis. The yeast one-hybrid and Dual-LUC assays revealed that SmYABBY1 does not directly bind to the promoters of SmMYB75, SmDFR, and SmANS but indirectly promotes their transcriptional activity. Our results illustrate that SmYABBY1 acts as a transcriptional co-activator, interacting with SmMYB75 to promote anthocyanin accumulation, while SmCOP1 is involved in this regulatory process. This study provides a molecular basis for improving eggplant coloration under suboptimal light conditions.

articles.title: A Transcriptomic Study of the Effects of Tea Tree Essential Oil on the Pathogenicity of <i>Candida albicans</i>.
articles.titleZh: 茶树精油对白色念珠菌致病性影响的转录组研究。
articles.authors: Zhou Y, Xu J, Su C, Wu W, Yi F.
articles.abstract: Candida albicans is a common opportunistic pathogen. Long-term use of azole antifungals faces challenges like resistance, necessitating novel agents. Tea tree oil (TTO), a natural broad-spectrum antimicrobial, shows promise, but its molecular mechanisms, particularly concerning novel cell death pathways, require clarification. This study comprehensively evaluated the antifungal mechanism of TTO against C. albicans using transcriptomics. Antifungal susceptibility assays were conducted to assess the effects of TTO and its components (4-terpineol, terpenes, and γ-pinene) on the growth of C. albicans hyphae and biofilms. Fluorescent labeling and biochemical analysis were employed to detect ferroptosis markers. Transcriptomic results indicate that TTO induces 423 differentially expressed genes and systematically inhibits the development of C. albicans hyphae through mechanisms such as oxidative stress, iron homeostasis disruption, disruption of cell wall integrity, and interference with ergosterol metabolism. Notably, the significant enrichment of redox enzyme activity and iron ion binding functions, along with changes in the glutathione metabolic pathway, suggest that ferroptosis may be involved in this process. Subsequent studies revealed that the compound 4-pinene most effectively inhibits the pathogenicity of C. albicans by suppressing its adhesion, hyphae formation, and biofilm formation, whereas terpinene induces the accumulation of reactive oxygen species (ROS) and increases lipid peroxidation in C. albicans; furthermore, following treatment with an iron-mediated apoptosis inhibitor, terpinene enhances the viability of the treated C. albicans cells.

articles.title: Biological-chemical method for synthesizing <i>p</i>-menthane-3,8-diol.
articles.titleZh: 生物化学法合成p-薄荷烷-3,8-二醇。
articles.authors: Zuo X, Zhang H, Zhang Z, Ma Y, Zhang C, Lu W.
articles.abstract: The cyclic monoterpene p-menthane-3,8-diol exhibits highly effective mosquito-repellent activity. Current industrial production of PMD depends on chemically synthesized citronellal as a precursor. To provide a green, sustainable alternative for citronellal supply, we engineered a Saccharomyces cerevisiae strain for efficient de novo biosynthesis of citronellal. By enhancing geraniol synthesis, systematically redesigning the endogenous oxidoreductase system, and implementing metabolic optimization strategies, a citronellal titer of 0.13 g/L was achieved in shake-flask cultivation. By integrating this microbial fermentation step with subsequent chemical catalysis, we established a biological-chemical method for PMD production, achieving a final PMD yield of 0.64 g/L. This work represents the first semisynthetic route from glucose to PMD via a biological-chemical method, offering a novel and sustainable paradigm for PMD manufacture.
articles.abstractZh: 环状单萜对薄荷烷-3,8-二醇具有高效的驱蚊活性。目前PMD的工业生产依赖于化学合成的香茅醛作为前体。为了为香茅醛供应提供绿色、可持续的替代品，我们设计了一种酿酒酵母菌株，用于高效地从头生物合成香茅醛。通过增强香叶醇合成、系统地重新设计内源氧化还原酶系统以及实施代谢优化策略，在摇瓶培养中获得了0.13 g/L的香茅醛效价。通过将该微生物发酵步骤与随后的化学催化相结合，我们建立了 PMD 生产的生物化学方法，最终 PMD 产量达到 0.64 g/L。这项工作代表了第一个通过生物化学方法从葡萄糖到 PMD 的半合成路线，为 PMD 制造提供了一种新颖且可持续的范例。

articles.title: Computational-Aided Mutagenesis of Lipase CRL1 with Promoted Stability and Activity for Biosynthesis of Vitamin E Succinate.
articles.titleZh: 脂肪酶 CRL1 的计算辅助诱变可提高维生素 E 琥珀酸酯生物合成的稳定性和活性。
articles.journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
articles.authors: Shao W, Zhang Y, Wang J, Gao B, Chu J, Gao Z.
articles.abstract: Vitamin E succinate (VES) is a particularly potent form of vitamin E derivatives in daily supplements. The promising biocatalyst crude lipase CRL (Candida rugosa lipase) could produce vitamin E succinate but suffers from low yield due to limited thermostability. This study integrated computational-aided virtual mutagenesis and combinatorial mutations of lipase CRL1. A combinatorial variant 6M (K85P/V86W/T108V/T132W/F344I/V454L) synchronously enhanced thermostability and pH stability, and half-lives were 322.7 min (60 °C) and 201.2 min (70 °C), representing a 6.35-fold and 7.31-fold increase compared to WT, respectively. 6M's lipase activity was 2 times that of WT, and the catalytic efficiency (kcat/Km) showed a 6.8-fold improvement over that of WT. Mutant 6M could generate vitamin E succinate with an improved yield of 77.8% (60 °C, 12 h). The synergistically functional modifications of the lipase pave the way for the mutated lipase to become a highly promising and robust biocatalyst for industrial applications.
articles.abstractZh: 维生素 E 琥珀酸酯 (VES) 是日常补充剂中维生素 E 衍生物的一种特别有效的形式。有前途的生物催化剂粗脂肪酶 CRL（念珠菌脂肪酶）可以生产维生素 E 琥珀酸酯，但由于热稳定性有限，产量较低。本研究整合了脂肪酶 CRL1 的计算辅助虚拟诱变和组合突变。组合变体6M（K85P/V86W/T108V/T132W/F344I/V454L）同步增强了热稳定性和pH稳定性，半衰期分别为322.7分钟（60℃）和201.2分钟（70℃），与WT相比分别增加了6.35倍和7.31倍。 6M的脂肪酶活性是WT的2倍，催化效率（kcat/Km）比WT提高了6.8倍。突变体6M可以生成维生素E琥珀酸酯，产率提高77.8%（60℃，12h）。脂肪酶的协同功能修饰为突变脂肪酶成为工业应用中极具前景和强大的生物催化剂铺平了道路。

articles.title: Efficient vitamin A production in Lipomyces starkeyi through metabolic engineering of the β-carotene and retinoid pathways.
articles.titleZh: 通过 β-胡萝卜素和类视黄醇途径的代谢工程，在斯塔克油脂酵母中高效生产维生素 A。
articles.authors: Kinoshita A, Sato R, Higuchi H, Kobayashi S, Koketsu K, Watanabe T, Takaku H.
articles.abstract: BackgroundVitamin A, an essential micronutrient, is critical for vision, immune function, and cellular differentiation. Traditional vitamin A production methods, primarily based on chemical synthesis, pose significant environmental challenges. Microbial fermentation offers a sustainable alternative, but microbial production of vitamin A has yet to match chemical synthesis in terms of yield and cost-effectiveness. Oleaginous yeasts, such as Lipomyces starkeyi, which can synthesize high levels of acetyl-CoA and lipids, represent promising platforms for producing high-value lipophilic compounds, such as vitamin A.ResultsL. starkeyi was engineered for the first time to produce vitamin A by introducing key enzymes in the β-carotene and retinoid biosynthetic pathways. This approach included integrating genes encoding lycopene cyclase/phytoene synthase (McCarRP), phytoene desaturase (McCarB), and β-carotene 15,15'-dioxygenase (MbBlh). Further optimization of the mevalonate pathway enabled the production of over 600 mg/L vitamin A in a 3-L fed-batch fermentation. Fe2⁺ supplementation improved yield, while a two-phase culture system using dodecane and butylated hydroxytoluene enhanced vitamin A recovery, with over 90% recovered in the extracellular phase.ConclusionsThis study establishes L. starkeyi as a promising host for sustainable vitamin A production. Although significant improvements in yield were achieved, further optimization of pathway regulation and fermentation conditions is needed to reach economically competitive levels. These findings provide a foundation for developing L. starkeyi as a platform for large-scale production of vitamin A and other valuable terpenoids.
articles.abstractZh: 背景维生素 A 是一种必需的微量营养素，对于视力、免疫功能和细胞分化至关重要。主要基于化学合成的传统维生素 A 生产方法带来了重大的环境挑战。微生物发酵提供了一种可持续的替代方案，但维生素 A 的微生物生产在产量和成本效益方面尚未与化学合成相媲美。产油酵母，如斯达克油脂酵母，可以合成高水平的乙酰辅酶A和脂质，是生产高价值亲脂性化合物（如维生素 A）的有前景的平台。 starkeyi 首次通过在 β-胡萝卜素和类维生素A生物合成途径中引入关键酶来生产维生素 A。该方法包括整合编码番茄红素环化酶/八氢番茄红素合酶 (McCarRP)、八氢番茄红素去饱和酶 (McCarB) 和 β-胡萝卜素 15,15'-双加氧酶 (MbBlh) 的基因。甲羟戊酸途径的进一步优化使得在 3 L 补料分批发酵中能够生产超过 600 mg/L 的维生素 A。 Fe2+ 的补充提高了产量，而使用十二烷和丁基羟基甲苯的两相培养系统则增强了维生素

articles.title: Engineering Yarrowia lipolytica as a next-generation biomanufacturing platform for sustainable lignocellulosic biorefineries.
articles.titleZh: 将解脂耶氏酵母设计为可持续木质纤维素生物精炼厂的下一代生物制造平台。
articles.authors: Zhong Y, Pan X, Shi A, Gonzalez R, Qi Q, Cui Z.
articles.abstract: Faced with fossil fuel depletion, lignocellulosic biomass has emerged as a critical renewable feedstock for a sustainable bioeconomy; this review showcases the unique metabolic capabilities of the non-conventional oleaginous yeast Yarrowia lipolytica as an innovative biomanufacturing platform for the valorization lignocellulosic biomass, specifically highlighting recent engineering progresses in pentose utilization pathways enabling high-efficiency co-fermentation of hexose and pentose sugars to maximize conversion yields. Furthermore, the review critically explores advanced strategies, including adaptive laboratory evolution (ALE) and rational metabolic engineering, to fortify Y. lipolytica tolerance against toxic inhibitors prevalent in lignocellulosic hydrolysates, overcoming a major bioconversion bottleneck. The application of these engineered strains for the efficient, lignocellulose-based production of high-value biochemicals-such as lipids, organic acids, and terpenoids-is comprehensively discussed, demonstrating its versatility and economic potential. Finally, current challenges and future research trajectories for optimizing Y. lipolytica as a robust chassis in sustainable lignocellulosic biorefineries are outlined.
articles.abstractZh: 面对化石燃料枯竭，木质纤维素生物质已成为可持续生物经济的关键可再生原料；本综述展示了非传统产油酵母解脂耶氏酵母作为木质纤维素生物质增值的创新生物制造平台的独特代谢能力，特别强调了戊糖利用途径的最新工程进展，使己糖和戊糖能够高效共发酵，以最大限度地提高转化率。此外，该综述批判性地探索了先进的策略，包括适应性实验室进化（ALE）和合理的代谢工程，以增强解脂耶氏酵母对木质纤维素水解产物中普遍存在的有毒抑制剂的耐受性，克服主要的生物转化瓶颈。全面讨论了这些工程菌株在基于木质纤维素的高价值生化产品（例如脂质、有机酸和萜类化合物）的高效生产中的应用，展示了其多功能性和经济潜力。最后，优化解脂耶氏酵母作为可持续发展的稳健基础的当前挑战和未来研究轨迹

articles.title: Fungal ribosomally synthesized and post-translationally modified peptides (F-RiPPs): Biosynthesis, genome mining, structural diversity, and translational potential as targeted anticancer ADC payloads.
articles.titleZh: 真菌核糖体合成和翻译后修饰肽 (F-RiPP)：生物合成、基因组挖掘、结构多样性和作为靶向抗癌 ADC 有效负载的转化潜力。
articles.authors: Gopukumar ST, Saha M, Das P, Sheela P, Komala M, Harish J, Sundaram KM, Shamshad S, Das U.
articles.abstract: Fungal RiPPs (F-RiPPs) are a diverse class of natural products that have transitioned from notorious mycotoxins to promising therapeutic agents. This review summarizes the biosynthesis, structural diversity, and biomedical relevance of major F-RiPP families, including amatoxins and phallotoxins, dikaritins, epichloëcyclins, and recently identified asperigimycins. Key post-translational modifications, such as peptide cyclization, N-methylation, and oxidative cross-linking, enhance stability, cellular uptake, and biological activity. Recent advances in genome mining and molecular networking have accelerated the discovery of cryptic F-RiPP biosynthetic gene clusters and enabled functional validation through heterologous expression in fungal and yeast hosts. Pharmacologically, F-RiPPs act through distinct mechanisms, including inhibition of RNA polymerase II, disruption of cytoskeletal dynamics, membrane perturbation, and induction of apoptosis, often with high potency in preclinical cancer models. Importantly, amanitin-based antibody-drug conjugates have entered early-phase clinical trials, demonstrating the translational potential of this peptide class. The review concludes by discussing current challenges in discovery and production, and emerging strategies to expand F-RiPPs as a new source of targeted anticancer therapeutics.
articles.abstractZh: 真菌 RiPP (F-RiPP) 是一类多样化的天然产物，已从臭名昭著的霉菌毒素转变为有前途的治疗剂。本综述总结了主要 F-RiPP 家族的生物合成、结构多样性和生物医学相关性，包括鹅膏毒素和鬼笔毒素、双卡里丁、表氯环素和最近发现的曲霉素。关键的翻译后修饰，例如肽环化、N-甲基化和氧化交联，可增强稳定性、细胞摄取和生物活性。基因组挖掘和分子网络的最新进展加速了神秘 F-RiPP 生物合成基因簇的发现，并通过真菌和酵母宿主中的异源表达实现了功能验证。从药理学角度来看，F-RiPP 通过不同的机制发挥作用，包括抑制 RNA 聚合酶 II、破坏细胞骨架动力学、膜扰动和诱导细胞凋亡，通常在临床前癌症模型中具有高效能。重要的是，基于鹅膏蕈碱的抗体药物偶联物已进入早期临床试验，证明了该肽类的转化潜力。审查以讨论结束

articles.title: Identification and Sensory Characterization of Umami Peptides During Lager Beer Fermentation.
articles.titleZh: 啤酒发酵过程中鲜味肽的鉴定和感官表征。
articles.authors: Wu Y, Tian W, Zhao W, Luo J, Yuan X, Xie J, Zhong B, Zhao D.
articles.abstract: Despite increasing interest in beer-derived umami peptides, their formation during lager beer fermentation and their potential roles in receptor recognition and sensory perception remain insufficiently understood. Therefore, this study combined peptidomics, in silico screening, receptor-oriented analysis, and sensory evaluation to investigate the dynamic changes in umami-related peptides throughout lager beer fermentation and to explore their possible sensory relevance. Peptide profiles varied markedly across the fermentation process, indicating continuous proteolysis and dynamic restructuring of the peptide pool. From these profiles, candidate umami peptides were screened, and representative short peptides with plausible receptor-binding characteristics were selected for further evaluation. These peptides showed measurable taste activity and were mainly associated with modulation of the umami-bitterness-aftertaste dimension, whereas their effects on aroma and overall balance were limited. In addition, the abundance of umami-related peptides was positively associated with perceived umami intensity. Overall, the results suggest that fermentation-derived peptides may contribute to taste perception in lager beer and provide a basis for further studies on flavor-oriented brewing and process regulation.
articles.abstractZh: 尽管人们对啤酒衍生的鲜味肽越来越感兴趣，但它们在啤酒发酵过程中的形成及其在受体识别和感官知觉中的潜在作用仍然不够充分。因此，本研究结合肽组学、计算机筛选、受体导向分析和感官评价，研究啤酒发酵过程中鲜味相关肽的动态变化，并探讨其可能的感官相关性。整个发酵过程中的肽谱显着变化，表明肽库的持续蛋白水解和动态重组。从这些谱中筛选候选鲜味肽，并选择具有合理受体结合特性的代表性短肽进行进一步评估。这些肽表现出可测量的味觉活性，主要与鲜味-苦味-余味维度的调节相关，而它们对香气和整体平衡的影响有限。此外，鲜味相关肽的丰度与感知的鲜味强度呈正相关。总的来说，结果表明发酵衍生的肽可能有助于
