articles.title: Functional Divergence of the PAL Gene Family in Salt and Cadmium Stress Responses of Populus alba.
articles.titleZh: 白杨盐和镉胁迫反应中 PAL 基因家族的功能差异。
articles.authors: Xue J, Zhang XX, Wang YW, Wang SY, Yang YB, Zhang YX, Duan BH, Gai MY, Li H, Yang HL.
articles.abstract: Phenylalanine ammonia-lyase (PAL) is the rate-limiting enzyme initiating the phenylpropanoid metabolic pathway and plays a central role in regulating plant secondary metabolism and stress responses. In this study, five PoalbPAL genes were identified from the Populus alba genome through genome-wide analysis. Enzyme kinetic assays demonstrated catalytic activity in PoalbPAL1, 2, 4, and 5, with notable differences in catalytic efficiency, whereas PoalbPAL3 was catalytically inactive. Transcriptome and metabolome integrative analysis revealed that PoalbPAL1, 2, and 5 were coordinately upregulated under salt stress, channeling phenylpropanoid metabolism toward flavonoid biosynthesis and promoting the accumulation of antioxidant metabolites such as naringenin. In contrast, cadmium stress rapidly activated PoalbPAL2 and PoalbPAL5, preferentially directing metabolic flux toward lignin monomer synthesis, thereby restricting Cd2+ influx through cell wall reinforcement. Heterologous expression in yeast further validated the functional divergence of PoalbPAL members in response to salt and cadmium stress. This study reveals the functional divergence of PAL gene family members in coordinating distinct phenylpropanoid metabolic responses to salt and cadmium stress, providing valuable gene resources and theoretical insights for genetic improvement of stress resistance in woody plants.
articles.abstractZh: 苯丙氨酸解氨酶（PAL）是启动苯丙素代谢途径的限速酶，在调节植物次生代谢和胁迫反应中发挥着核心作用。在这项研究中，通过全基因组分析从白杨基因组中鉴定出了五个 PoalbPAL 基因。酶动力学分析表明 PoalbPAL1、2、4 和 5 具有催化活性，催化效率存在显着差异，而 PoalbPAL3 则无催化活性。转录组和代谢组综合分析表明，PoalbPAL1、2和5在盐胁迫下协同上调，将苯丙素代谢引导至类黄酮生物合成，并促进柚皮素等抗氧化代谢物的积累。相比之下，镉胁迫迅速激活 PoalbPAL2 和 PoalbPAL5，优先将代谢流导向木质素单体合成，从而限制 Cd2+ 通过细胞壁强化流入。酵母中的异源表达进一步验证了 PoalbPAL 成员响应盐和镉胁迫的功能差异。这项研究揭示了 PAL 基因家族成员在协调 d 方面的功能差异

articles.title: Integrated Fermentation Engineering Enables High-Level Leghemoglobin Production in Kluyveromyces marxianus via Metabolic Rewiring of Central Carbon Metabolism and Amino Acid Utilization.
articles.titleZh: 集成发酵工程通过中心碳代谢和氨基酸利用的代谢重新连接，使马克斯克鲁维酵母能够生产高水平的豆血红蛋白。
articles.authors: Chen H, Jiang X, Chen A, Zen J, Ren H, Yu Y, Zhou J, Xia J, Lu H.
articles.abstract: Leghemoglobin (LBA), a hemoprotein critical for food industry applications, faces production challenges in microbial systems due to inefficient heme-globin assembly and metabolic constraints. Here, the food-safe yeast Kluyveromyces marxianus Tra-23 was validated as an excellent chassis, demonstrating robust growth and high LBA expression in bioreactor cultivation. Subsequently, key fermentation parameters-including medium composition, pH, temperature, and feeding strategy-were systematically optimized to enhance LBA biosynthesis. In 5-L bioreactors, the optimized processes elevated the LBA titer to 10.1 g/L, representing a 64.7% increase over initial conditions (6.13 g/L). Additionally, the specific glucose consumption rate (qs) increased by approximately 10%, while the specific LBA production rate (qp) rose over 100%. Notably, the optimized approach extended the cellular high productivity phase and enhanced the product yield from 0.011 g/g glucose to 0.026 g/g glucose. Furthermore, targeted metabolomics analysis of central carbon and amino acid metabolism provided mechanistic insights into the improved production performance. The optimized strategy reshaped the cellular metabolic network, enhanced carbon conversion efficiency toward LBA synthesis, and thereby improved the production performance of the microbial cell factory. These results highlight the potential of coordinated control of nutritional and physical parameters to enhance LBA biosynthesis in K. marxianus, providing a promising strategy for industrial production.
articles.abstractZh: 豆血红蛋白 (LBA) 是一种对食品工业应用至关重要的血红蛋白，由于血红蛋白组装效率低下和代谢限制，在微生物系统中面临着生产挑战。在这里，食品安全酵母马克斯克鲁维酵母 Tra-23 被验证为优秀的底盘，在生物反应器培养中表现出强劲的生长和高 LBA 表达。随后，对关键发酵参数（包括培养基成分、pH、温度和补料策略）进行系统优化，以增强 LBA 生物合成。在 5 L 生物反应器中，优化后的工艺将 LBA 滴度提高至 10.1 g/L，比初始条件 (6.13 g/L) 提高了 64.7%。此外，特定葡萄糖消耗率（qs）增加了约10％，而特定LBA生产率（qp）上升了100％以上。值得注意的是，优化的方法延长了细胞的高生产力阶段，并将产物产量从 0.011 g/g 葡萄糖提高到 0.026 g/g 葡萄糖。此外，对中心碳和氨基酸代谢的针对性代谢组学分析为提高生产性能提供了机制见解。优化策略重塑细胞代谢

articles.title: Lineage-Specific Adaptive Strategies Shape the Response of de Novo Lager Yeast Hybrids to High-Gravity Fermentation.
articles.titleZh: 谱系特异性的适应性策略塑造了 de Novo Lager 酵母杂交体对高重力发酵的响应。
articles.authors: Albillos-Arenal S, Zavaleta V, Jeria F, González-Venegas D, Peña TA, Villarreal P, Cubillos FA.
articles.abstract: Lager beer is the most widely consumed fermented beverage worldwide and is produced by the yeast Saccharomyces pastorianus, which originated from hybridization between S. cerevisiae (Sc) and S. eubayanus (Se). Although the genetic factors underlying fermentation performance in de novo hybrids are well understood, how chimeric genomes evolve in relation to the parental background and stabilize under industrial stresses remains unclear. Here, we subjected representative novel hybrids derived from distinct parental lineages to long-term experimental evolution for 250 generations under conditions mimicking high-gravity brewing. We observed a clear pattern of the "rule of declining adaptability", driven by diminishing-returns epistasis, whereby hybrids with lower initial fitness exhibited the greatest evolutionary gains. Overall, 38 of 69 evolved lines produced more CO2 than their ancestral strains. Adaptive trajectories were strongly influenced by the Sc genetic background, while the Se contribution appeared comparatively limited, highlighting the dominant role of the Sc subgenome in determining brewing performance and evolvability. Genomic analysis of representative hybrids revealed different evolutionary strategies. The evolved HB3-I line (beer Sc parent) showed a large-scale chromosomal rearrangement with few coding-sequence changes, consistent with fine-tuning of an already adapted background. In contrast, HB44-II (bioethanol Sc parent) accumulated multiple gene-disruptive mutations affecting multiple pathways, indicating broader regulatory rewiring. These genomic changes were accompanied by transcriptional shifts in carbon metabolism, nutrient-responsive pathways and membrane-related functions. Together, our results provide a controlled framework for replaying yeast domestication, demonstrating that the adaptive potential of synthetic lager hybrids depends on their lineage, which is mainly shaped by the S. cerevisiae parental background.
articles.abstractZh: 贮藏啤酒是全球消费最广泛的发酵饮料，由巴斯德酵母生产，该酵母起源于酿酒酵母 (Sc) 和 S. eubayanus (Se) 的杂交。尽管从头杂交中发酵性能的遗传因素已被充分了解，但嵌合基因组如何与亲本背景相关的进化以及在工业压力下的稳定仍不清楚。在这里，我们对来自不同亲本谱系的代表性新型杂交品种在模拟高重力酿造的条件下进行了 250 代的长期实验进化。我们观察到“适应性下降规则”的明显模式，这是由收益递减上位性驱动的，其中初始适应度较低的杂交体表现出最大的进化收益。总体而言，69 个进化品系中有 38 个比其祖先品系产生更多的二氧化碳。适应性轨迹受到Sc遗传背景的强烈影响，而Se的贡献似乎相对有限，凸显了Sc亚基因组在决定酿造性能和进化性方面的主导作用。代表性杂种的基因组分析揭示了 d

articles.title: Pseudogene revival drives repeated adaptation in fission yeast.
articles.titleZh: 假基因的复兴驱动裂变酵母的反复适应。
articles.authors: Wu Z, Liu X, Xu H, Han GZ.
articles.abstract: Repeated (parallel or convergent) evolution is often taken as evidence of adaptation and is relevant to the predictability of evolution. However, much remains unknown about the genetic basis of repeated evolution. Here, we use genome editing to progressively knock out all the complete transposable elements, a rich source of mutations, in the fission yeast Schizosaccharomyces pombe. While progressive knockout has no apparent effect on the biology or fitness of S. pombe under normal conditions, certain transposable element knockout strains exhibit growth arrest under acid challenge. We next perform parallel replay experiments by evolving S. pombe strains with a single transposable element and without transposable element under acid stress. Adaptation occurs rapidly and repeatedly. We do not detect any new transposable element insertions at appreciable frequencies, indicating that the observed repeated adaptation is not driven by transposable element insertions. Instead, revival mutations in SPBC409.08, a pseudogene that encodes a putative transporter of the major facilitator superfamily, repeatedly undergo hard or soft selective sweeps and drive adaptation in all the replicates. Although the revival mutations exhibit a trend of diminishing returns, they also repeatedly become fixed in all evolved wild-type populations. This work unveils the significance of pseudogene revival on repeated evolution and thus evolutionary predictability.
articles.abstractZh: 重复（平行或趋同）进化通常被视为适应的证据，并且与进化的可预测性相关。然而，关于重复进化的遗传基础仍然有很多未知之处。在这里，我们使用基因组编辑逐步敲除裂殖酵母裂殖酵母中所有完整的转座元件，这是突变的丰富来源。虽然渐进性敲除在正常条件下对粟酒裂殖酵母的生物学或适应性没有明显影响，但某些转座元件敲除菌株在酸攻击下表现出生长停滞。接下来，我们通过在酸胁迫下进化具有单个转座元件和没有转座元件的粟酒裂殖酵母菌株来进行平行重播实验。适应过程迅速且反复发生。我们没有以明显的频率检测到任何新的转座元件插入，这表明观察到的重复适应不是由转座元件插入驱动的。相反，SPBC409.08（一种编码主要促进子超家族的假定转运蛋白的假基因）中的复兴突变反复经历硬或软选择性扫描并驱动所有重复中的适应。阿尔斯

articles.title: Research on the Preparation and Application of Lyoprotectants for Hanseniaspora uvarum BF-345 Derived from Indigenous Grape Juice.
articles.titleZh: 葡萄汁汉逊孢菌 BF-345 冻干保护剂的制备及应用研究。
articles.authors: Song Q, Yang J, Peng T, Tong H, Zhou X, Wang J.
articles.abstract: BackgroundThe extensive use of imported commercial Saccharomyces cerevisiae active dry powder preparations has led to a serious homogenization of wine products in China.ObjectiveIn recent years, there has been growing interest in developing and applying indigenous non-Saccharomyces yeasts to enhance the diversity and distinctive character of wines.MethodsIn this study, a promising indigenous strain, Hanseniaspora uvarum BF-345, previously isolated from local grape juice, was investigated due to its desirable fermentation properties, robust stress tolerance, and high β-glucosidase activity. Response surface methodology (RSM) was employed to optimize the composition of a cryoprotectant formulation for the vacuum freeze-drying of BF-345.ResultsThe optimal protectant formulation was determined as follows: 5.63% skim milk powder, 12.89% maltitol, and 7.02% sucrose. Under these conditions, the viability of the freeze-dried cells reached 85.2%, representing a 27.3% increase compared to the pre-optimized formulation.ConclusionThe prepared active dry yeast complied with the Chinese national standard GB/T 20886.2-2021 and maintained a viability above 70% after 6 months of sealed storage at 4°C.HighlightsIn micro-vinification trials with cabernet sauvignon, the fermentation system inoculated with the freeze-dried powder exhibited higher yeast cell counts and more favorable fermentation kinetics than that inoculated with a liquid seed culture.
articles.abstractZh: 背景进口商业酿酒酵母活性干粉制剂的大量使用导致中国葡萄酒产品严重同质化。目的近年来，人们对开发和应用本土非酿酒酵母以增强葡萄酒的多样性和独特性越来越感兴趣。方法在本研究中，对一种有前景的本土菌株Hanseniaspora uvarum BF-345进行了研究，该菌株先前从当地葡萄汁中分离出来，由于其理想的发酵特性、强大的抗逆性耐受性和高β-葡萄糖苷酶活性。采用响应面法(RSM)对BF-345真空冷冻干燥冷冻保护剂配方进行优化。结果确定最佳保护剂配方为：脱脂奶粉5.63%、麦芽糖醇12.89%、蔗糖7.02%。在此条件下，冻干细胞的活力达到85.2%，较优化前的配方提高了27.3%。结论制备的活性干酵母符合中国国家标准GB/T 20886.2-2021，4℃密封保存6个月后活力仍保持在70%以上。

articles.title: Structural and biochemical characterization of yeast Tcd enzymes installing the post-transcriptional modification ct6A in tRNA.
articles.titleZh: 在 tRNA 中安装转录后修饰 ct6A 的酵母 Tcd 酶的结构和生化特征。
articles.authors: Hirschmann J, Sonntag R, Heiss M, Wegrzyn E, Heinemeyer W, Carell T, Huber EM.
articles.abstract: Post-transcriptional modifications near the anticodon of transfer ribonucleic acids (tRNAs) ensure translation fidelity and accuracy. For instance, at position 37, the universally conserved and essential nucleoside N6-threonylcarbamoyladenosine (t6A) supports decoding of ANN triplets. In some organisms t6A is converted to cyclic t6A (ct6A), but only little is known about this ATP-dependent reaction and the corresponding threonylcarbamoyladenosine dehydratases (Tcds). We here show that yeast Tcds localize to the outer mitochondrial membrane and co-purify with tRNAs recognizing ANN codons. Depending on the number of TCD genes in the genome, the proteins form V-shaped hetero- or homodimers, of which at least one subunit binds and modifies tRNAs. The C-terminal, monomeric domain shares similarities with Cas9-endonucleases and assists tRNA recognition, while the N-terminal domain mediates dimerization and contains the active site. Structure-based mutagenesis and activity assays imply that yeast Tcds lack a catalytic cysteine and do not covalently bind their substrate as proposed for Escherichia coli TcdA.
articles.abstractZh: 转移核糖核酸 (tRNA) 反密码子附近的转录后修饰可确保翻译保真度和准确性。例如，在第 37 位，普遍保守的必需核苷 N6-苏氨甲酰基腺苷 (t6A) 支持 ANN 三联体的解码。在一些生物体中，t6A 转化为环状 t6A (ct6A)，但人们对这种 ATP 依赖性反应和相应的苏氨酰氨基甲酰腺苷脱水酶 (Tcds) 知之甚少。我们在这里表明，酵母 Tcd 定位于线粒体外膜，并与识别 ANN 密码子的 tRNA 共同纯化。根据基因组中 TCD 基因的数量，蛋白质形成 V 形异二聚体或同二聚体，其中至少一个亚基结合并修饰 tRNA。 C 端单体结构域与 Cas9 核酸内切酶相似，有助于 tRNA 识别，而 N 端结构域介导二聚化并包含活性位点。基于结构的诱变和活性测定表明，酵母 Tcd 缺乏催化半胱氨酸，并且不会像大肠杆菌 TcdA 那样共价结合其底物。

articles.title: Synthesis of Amines for Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients Using the Whole-Cell Factory Saccharomyces Cerevisae.
articles.titleZh: 使用全细胞工厂酿酒酵母合成活性药物成分的胺。
articles.journal: Chembiochem : a European journal of chemical biology
articles.authors: Kwiatos N, Ossel S, Mutti FG.
articles.abstract: Whole-cell biocatalysis offers a sustainable alternative to traditional chemical synthesis for producing pharmaceutically relevant, often chiral, amines and amino acids. Saccharomyces cerevisiae has emerged as a privileged microbial chassis due to its robustness, ease of genetic manipulation, and GRAS status. This concise review summarizes recent advances in metabolic and genetic engineering of S. cerevisiae for amine biocatalysis, focusing on strategies to overcome bottlenecks such as enzyme gene expression, cofactor regeneration, and precursor channeling. The first section covers state-of-the-art methods for engineered strain construction, including genomic editing, optimization of gene expression (copy number, promoters, terminators, codon usage), and metabolic engineering (pathway balancing, compartmentalization, cofactor supply, transport proteins, auxiliary enzymes, and enzyme targeting via signal peptides), all enhancing product yields and enabling complex amine synthesis. The central section critically discusses compound families accessible via engineered S. cerevisiae, including various amines, amino alcohols, and amino acids such as l-carnitine, ergothioneine, halogenated tryptamine, serotonin, psilocybin, spermidine, l-ornithine, and mycosporine derivatives. Bioproduction of complex alkaloids, such as tropine derivatives (hyoscyamine and scopolamine) and ergot alkaloids, is also reviewed. Finally, current challenges and future perspectives are outlined, highlighting the integration of systems and synthetic biology tools to establish S. cerevisiae as a scalable platform for industrial amine production.
articles.abstractZh: 全细胞生物催化为传统化学合成提供了一种可持续的替代方案，用于生产药学相关的（通常是手性的）胺和氨基酸。酿酒酵母因其稳健性、易于基因操作和 GRAS 状态而成为一种特殊的微生物底盘。这篇简明的综述总结了酿酒酵母胺生物催化代谢和基因工程的最新进展，重点关注克服酶基因表达、辅因子再生和前体通道等瓶颈的策略。第一部分涵盖了工程菌株构建的最先进方法，包括基因组编辑、基因表达优化（拷贝数、启动子、终止子、密码子使用）和代谢工程（途径平衡、区室化、辅因子供应、转运蛋白、辅助酶和通过信号肽的酶靶向），所有这些都提高了产品产量并实现复杂胺的合成。中心部分批判性地讨论了通过工程酿酒酵母可获得的化合物家族，包括各种胺、氨基醇和氨基酸，如左旋肉碱、麦角硫因、卤化物

articles.title: The bZIP Transcription Factor PjbZIP1 Enhances Resistance to Powdery Mildew in Paeonia jishanensis by Directly Activating PjICS Involved in the SA Pathway.
articles.titleZh: bZIP 转录因子 PjbZIP1 通过直接激活参与 SA 途径的 PjICS 增强吉山芍药对白粉病的抗性。
articles.authors: Zhao XC, Li M, Niu JY, Zhang YH, Ren Y, Yu Q, Yu YH.
articles.abstract: Paeonia jishanensis is a wild tree peony germplasm resource in China that has strong resistance to powdery mildew. Domesticated peony varieties exhibit compromised immunity to powdery mildew pathogens. The present study investigated the function of PjbZIP1 through expression analysis, virus-induced gene silencing (VIGS), and overexpression in Arabidopsis. Structural analysis identified a canonical basic region/leucine zipper (bZIP) motif at the C-terminal region of PjbZIP1. In P. jishanensis plants, PjbZIP1 expression was upregulated under powdery mildew infection, exogenous salicylic acid (SA) treatment, and methyl jasmonate exposure. Gene-silenced PjbZIP1 plants exhibited increased susceptibility to powdery mildew, whereas transgenic PjbZIP1 overexpression enhanced resistance. In addition, VIGS and overexpression of PjbZIP1 affected SA synthesis and the induction of genes associated with the plant defense signaling pathway. Among the candidate genes involved in SA-regulated defense responses, PjbZIP1 significantly upregulated the expression of PjICS, which encodes a key enzyme for SA biosynthesis. Yeast one-hybrid, firefly luciferase complementation imaging, and electrophoretic mobility shift assays demonstrated in vitro and in vivo that PjbZIP1 interacts with PjICS. Transcription of PjICS was induced in P. jishanensis infected with powdery mildew and was significantly enhanced in overexpressed PjbZIP1 plants. These findings establish that PjbZIP1 enhances powdery mildew resistance in tree peony by regulating the PjICS-mediated SA signaling defense pathway. These findings establish PjbZIP1 as a critical regulator of SA-mediated resistance to powdery mildew in P. jishanensis, providing genetic tools for breeding disease-resistant cultivars.
articles.abstractZh: 吉山芍药是我国野生牡丹种质资源，具有较强的抗白粉病能力。驯化的牡丹品种对白粉病病原体的免疫力较低。本研究通过表达分析、病毒诱导基因沉默 (VIGS) 和拟南芥中的过表达研究了 PjbZIP1 的功能。结构分析确定了 PjbZIP1 C 末端区域的典型碱性区域/亮氨酸拉链 (bZIP) 基序。在稷山松植物中，PjbZIP1 表达在白粉病感染、外源水杨酸 (SA) 处理和茉莉酸甲酯暴露下上调。基因沉默的 PjbZIP1 植物对白粉病的易感性增加，而转基因 PjbZIP1 过表达则增强了抗性。此外，VIGS 和 PjbZIP1 的过度表达影响 SA 合成以及与植物防御信号通路相关的基因的诱导。在参与 SA 调节的防御反应的候选基因中，PjbZIP1 显着上调 PjICS 的表达，PjICS 编码 SA 生物合成的关键酶。酵母单杂交、萤火虫荧光素酶互补成像和电泳检测

articles.title: The MYB41-MYB74 module and VOZ1 transcription factor synergistically regulate aliphatic suberin monomer biosynthesis in Chenopodium quinoa.
articles.titleZh: MYB41-MYB74 模块和 VOZ1 转录因子协同调节藜麦中脂肪族木栓质单体的生物合成。
articles.journal: The Plant journal : for cell and molecular biology
articles.authors: Wang Z, Huang H, Lü S, Wang P, Yang X, Ma C.
articles.abstract: Suberin is a biopolymer barrier mainly deposited on roots to protect plants against drought stress. Suberin monomers are composed of long-chain and very-long-chain fatty acids and their derived compounds. The mechanisms of suberin biosynthesis are well investigated in Arabidopsis, rice, and tomato. However, it remains unclear whether these mechanisms are conserved in halophytes. Here, we performed a systematic characterization of suberin biosynthesis in Chenopodium quinoa, a typical halophyte, and found that quinoa roots produce the typical suberin monomers in endodermis as found in other species. Aliphatic suberin biosynthesis in quinoa was upregulated during development or after exogenous abscisic acid (ABA) treatment. RNA-seq analysis showed that CqMYB41a/b and CqMYB74a/b were significantly induced in quinoa roots after exogenous ABA treatment. Overexpression of these MYB genes caused an ectopic and dramatic accumulation of aliphatic suberin monomers in tobacco leaves. We found both CqMYB41a/b and CqMYB74a/b could directly regulate the expression of each other, suggesting that ABA regulates quinoa suberin biosynthesis via a CqMYB41a/b-CqMYB74a/b module-cascade with positive feedback. Additionally, we also characterized two new regulators of suberin biosynthesis in quinoa, CqVOZ1a/b, localized to both the endoplasmic reticulum (ER) and nucleus. Further analysis by stable transformation in the Arabidopsis voz1-1 voz2-1 double mutant and transient expression in tobacco revealed that CqVOZ1a/b function in the nucleus to regulate flowering and suberin monomer production. Yeast one-hybrid (Y1H) and transcription activation analysis showed that CqVOZ1a/b could directly activate the expression of suberin biosynthesis related genes and CqMYB74a/b. However, high-dose overexpression of CqVOZ1a/b in Arabidopsis inhibited suberin monomer production and MYB74 expression. Furthermore, transcription activation analysis revealed that CqVOZ1 compete with CqMYB41 to negatively regulate CqMYB74 expression. Collectively, these findings indicate that CqVOZ1a/b may play an important role in maintaining suberin monomer homeostasis.
articles.abstractZh: 木栓质是一种生物聚合物屏障，主要沉积在根部，以保护植物免受干旱胁迫。木栓质单体由长链和超长链脂肪酸及其衍生化合物组成。木栓质生物合成的机制在拟南芥、水稻和番茄中得到了很好的研究。然而，目前尚不清楚这些机制在盐生植物中是否保守。在这里，我们对藜麦（一种典型的盐生植物）的木栓质生物合成进行了系统表征，发现藜麦根在内皮层中产生与其他物种相同的典型木栓质单体。藜麦中的脂肪族木栓质生物合成在发育过程中或外源脱落酸（ABA）处理后上调。 RNA-seq 分析表明，外源 ABA 处理后，藜麦根中 CqMYB41a/b 和 CqMYB74a/b 受到显着诱导。这些 MYB 基因的过度表达导致烟叶中脂肪族木栓质单体的异位和大量积累。我们发现 CqMYB41a/b 和 CqMYB74a/b 都可以直接调节彼此的表达，这表明 ABA 通过具有正向供给的 CqMYB41a/b-CqMYB74a/b 模块级联调节藜麦木栓质生物合成

articles.title: Theanine supplementation in tea wine production: Accelerated fermentation, refined aroma profile, and enhanced sensory quality
articles.titleZh: 茶酒生产中补充茶氨酸：加速发酵、提炼香气、增强感官品质
articles.authors: Zou C, Liu S, Tang Z, Wei Y, Wang Y, Chen J, Wang F, Xu Y, Yin J.
articles.abstract: Tea wine, a popular beverage in China, is hampered by sluggish fermentation due to assimilable nitrogen deficiency in tea infusion. This study systematically evaluated the effects of different nitrogen sources (theanine, glutamate, diammonium phosphate, and ammonium sulfate) on tea wine production. Results demonstrated that nitrogen supplementation significantly enhanced yeast growth and fermentation efficiency. Theanine proved most effective, shortening the fermentation duration by 37.5% and increasing the maximum ethanol concentration by 13% compared to the control. It also refined the volatile profile by promoting a balanced synthesis of fruity esters (ethyl hexanoate and isoamyl acetate) and limiting excessive ethyl acetate. Moreover, theanine-supplemented tea wine achieved the highest overall sensory acceptability score (7.69), which was 15.6% greater than the control, and exhibited significantly improved clarity. This study demonstrates that theanine is an ideal nitrogen source for producing high-quality tea wine efficiently.
articles.abstractZh: 茶酒是中国的一种流行饮料，但由于茶汤中可同化氮的缺乏，导致发酵缓慢。本研究系统评价了不同氮源（茶氨酸、谷氨酸、磷酸二铵和硫酸铵）对茶酒生产的影响。结果表明，补充氮显着提高了酵母的生长和发酵效率。茶氨酸被证明是最有效的，与对照相比，发酵时间缩短了 37.5%，最大乙醇浓度增加了 13%。它还通过促进果味酯（己酸乙酯和乙酸异戊酯）的平衡合成并限制过量的乙酸乙酯来改善挥发性特征。此外，添加茶氨酸的茶酒获得了最高的总体感官可接受性得分（7.69），比对照高出15.6%，并且透明度显着提高。本研究表明茶氨酸是高效生产高品质茶酒的理想氮源。

articles.title: Volatile and Sensory Profiles of Young Red Wines Treated with Yeast and Grape Polysaccharides After Malolactic Fermentation.
articles.titleZh: 苹果酸乳酸发酵后用酵母和葡萄多糖处理的新红葡萄酒的挥发性和感官特征。
articles.authors: Curiel-Fernández M, Cano-Mozo E, Ayestarán B, Guadalupe Z, Doco T, Pérez-Magariño S.
articles.abstract: Volatile compounds contribute to wine aroma and can interact with polyphenols, polysaccharides (PS), and proteins. This work evaluated the effects of adding different PS extracts obtained from winery by-products, must and wine on the volatile composition and sensory attributes of young red wines. These results highlight the effect of the wine matrix on the impact of PS on the volatile composition. The highest concentrations of volatile compounds were reached in wines with higher phenolic content and mainly those treated with PS extracts contained higher proportions of low-molecular-weight PS (55-68%). These PS extracts maintained high concentrations of compounds related to fruity and floral aromas, such as ethyl esters of fatty acids (8-23%), alcohol acetates (9-23%), and terpenes (11-43%). In addition, the PS extracts from winery by-products and wines improved taste sensations in young red wines, mainly those with high acidity, by reducing acidity, bitterness and astringency. Therefore, PS extracts obtained from by-products have the capacity to modulate the volatile composition and mouthfeel of red wines with high phenolic content, excess acidity or astringency.
articles.abstractZh: 挥发性化合物赋予葡萄酒香气，并可与多酚、多糖 (PS) 和蛋白质相互作用。这项工作评估了添加从酿酒厂副产品、葡萄汁和葡萄酒中提取的不同 PS 提取物对年轻红葡萄酒的挥发性成分和感官特性的影响。这些结果强调了葡萄酒基质对 PS 对挥发性成分影响的影响。酚类含量较高的葡萄酒中挥发性化合物的浓度最高，并且主要是经过 PS 提取物处理的葡萄酒中低分子量 PS 的比例较高（55-68%）。这些 PS 提取物保留了与果香和花香相关的高浓度化合物，例如脂肪酸乙酯 (8-23%)、醋酸醇酯 (9-23%) 和萜烯 (11-43%)。此外，来自酿酒厂副产品和葡萄酒的 PS 提取物通过降低酸度、苦味和涩味，改善了年轻红葡萄酒（主要是高酸度葡萄酒）的味觉。因此，从副产物中获得的PS提取物能够调节酚类含量高、酸度过高或涩味过多的红葡萄酒的挥发性成分和口感。

articles.title: Anhydrotetracycline-Inducible Metabolic Flux Adaptation for 3-Hydroxypropionic Acid Production in <i>Pichia pastoris</i>.
articles.titleZh: 毕赤酵母中脱水四环素诱导的 3-羟基丙酸生产代谢通量的适应。
articles.authors: Haneef S, Zhou YJ, Bai F.
articles.abstract: Microbial cell factories are vital for the sustainable production of chemicals, fuels, and pharmaceuticals, yet their performance depends on the precise control of gene expression to balance metabolic flux between cell growth and production. While the regulation of metabolic networks through constitutive gene expression can promote high-level production, it also imposes a metabolic burden that adversely affects cellular growth. Here, we developed a versatile and high-efficiency inducible platform for the methylotrophic yeast Pichia pastoris, which enables dynamic gene expression for 3-hydroxypropionic acid (3-HP) production from sole methanol. We first constructed an anhydrotetracycline (aTc) inducible promoter library of diverse strengths modified from the constitutive promoter PGCW14. The promoter library consisted of 32 inducible promoters with the activated strengths ranging from 2.5% to 84.7% of PGCW14. Second, we dynamically regulated key genes in the 3-HP biosynthesis pathway by aTc inducible promoters, including malonyl-CoA reductase gene (MCR) from Chloroflexus aurantiacus with strong promoters RM5 and RM6, endogenous malonyl-CoA carboxylase gene ACC1 with the very strong promoter RM1, and transmembrane permease PpMFS with the medium promoter RM12. The final engineered strain SHP18 produced 3.7 g/L 3-HP in a shake flask by using methanol as the sole carbon source. This modular aTc inducible promoter toolkit provided finely graded transcriptional control in P. pastoris, which offers a broadly applicable strategy for cell factory design.
articles.abstractZh: 微生物细胞工厂对于化学品、燃料和药品的可持续生产至关重要，但其性能取决于基因表达的精确控制，以平衡细胞生长和生产之间的代谢通量。虽然通过组成型基因表达调节代谢网络可以促进高水平的生产，但它也会带来代谢负担，对细胞生长产生不利影响。在这里，我们为甲基营养酵母毕赤酵母开发了一种多功能、高效的诱导平台，该平台能够实现从单一甲醇生产 3-羟基丙酸 (3-HP) 的动态基因表达。我们首先构建了一个由组成型启动子 PGCW14 修饰的具有不同强度的脱水四环素 (aTc) 诱导型启动子库。启动子库由32个诱导型启动子组成，激活强度范围为PGCW14的2.5%至84.7%。其次，我们通过aTc诱导型启动子动态调控3-HP生物合成途径中的关键基因，包括来自橙色绿屈菌的丙二酰辅酶A还原酶基因（MCR），具有强启动子RM5和RM6，内源性丙二酰辅酶A羧化酶基因ACC1，具有非常强的启动子。

articles.title: Applications of multiomics technologies to thermotolerant yeasts in industrial fermentation.
articles.titleZh: 多组学技术在工业发酵中耐热酵母中的应用。
articles.authors: Rao X, Li M, Li L, Yuan Q, Wang X, Cao W, Qiu S, Luo X.
articles.abstract: Yeast is widely used in food fermentation, biofuel production, biomedicine. Its growth in high-temperature environments critically affects production efficiency and cost. Conventional strains are susceptible to cellular damage and enzyme inactivation at high temperatures, resulting in reduced fermentation capacity, increased microbial contamination. This limits applications in processes such as biofuel generation, tropical beverage fermentation, and the production of industrial biochemicals. Multiomics technology enables directional breeding and mechanistic analysis of thermotolerance. Genomics identifies heat-related gene clusters; transcriptomics reveals dynamic gene expression and key pathways; proteomics analyzes differential proteins and interaction networks; and metabolomics detects metabolic changes, key nodes via LC-MS(Liquid Chromatography-Mass Spectrometry). Integrated multiomics analysis constructs a regulatory network for heat tolerance, enabling the identification of key genes and the development of improved strains. This review highlights how multiomics technology elucidates molecular mechanisms and accelerates the breeding of thermotolerant yeasts, providing a basis for industrial applications in food and bioenergy under high-temperature conditions.
articles.abstractZh: 酵母广泛应用于食品发酵、生物燃料生产、生物医药。它在高温环境中的生长严重影响生产效率和成本。传统菌株在高温下容易受到细胞损伤和酶失活，导致发酵能力降低、微生物污染增加。这限制了在生物燃料生产、热带饮料发酵和工业生物化学品生产等过程中的应用。多组学技术能够实现耐热性的定向育种和机制分析。基因组学识别与热相关的基因簇；转录组学揭示动态基因表达和关键途径；蛋白质组学分析差异蛋白质和相互作用网络；代谢组学通过LC-MS（液相色谱-质谱法）检测代谢变化、关键节点。综合多组学分析构建了耐热性调控网络，从而能够识别关键基因并开发改良菌株。这篇综述重点介绍了多组学技术如何阐明分子机制并加速耐热酵母的育种，提供了基础

articles.title: CasCADE: Cas<i>-C</i>RISPR Automated Design and Evaluation for targeted gRNA detection assays.
articles.titleZh: CasCADE：用于靶向 gRNA 检测分析的 Cas-CRISPR 自动化设计和评估。
articles.authors: Price C, Lucas JL, Davis P, Smith C, Jarvis E, Fiore J, Russell JA, Winegar R.
articles.abstract: The adaptation of CRISPR technologies for molecular detection marks a significant advancement in the field of biosurveillance and infectious disease response. CRISPR-based detection systems offer superior specificity and sensitivity compared to traditional PCR methods by directly binding and cleaving target DNA or RNA sequences, thus signaling the presence of specific pathogens. These advantages include the elimination of non-specific amplification and the reduction of required genetic material, leading to faster time to results without the need for extensive amplification cycling. However, the efficacy of CRISPR technologies heavily depends on the design of specific guide RNA (gRNA) sequences tailored for each genomic target, a process that can be intricate and time-consuming. We present Cas-CRISPR Automated Design and Evaluation (CasCADE), a state-of-the-art gRNA design software platform with a high degree of flexibility and modularity. CasCADE incorporates k-mer set operations to reduce time to answer for large data inputs when compared to computationally costly multiple sequence alignment methodologies and uses an agnostic whole genome approach to maximize gRNA discovery. CasCADE can be scaled efficiently to problems of any input sequence size and can be used for design, candidate evaluation, or both, depending on user need.ImportanceThis work describes our software pipeline Cas-CRISPR Automated Design and Evaluation (CasCADE) that allows for in silico design of Cas-CRISPR detection assays. We demonstrate the viability of our design process in the lab and report 15 successful designs across nine diverse target organisms. The rapid time to answer afforded by CasCADE, combined with the superior specificity and sensitivity offered by emergent CRISPR detection assays compared to traditional PCR methods, makes this a timely contribution to pandemic preparedness and biosurveillance interests.
articles.abstractZh: 将 CRISPR 技术应用于分子检测标志着生物监测和传染病应对领域的重大进步。与传统 PCR 方法相比，基于 CRISPR 的检测系统通过直接结合和切割目标 DNA 或 RNA 序列，提供卓越的特异性和灵敏度，从而发出特定病原体存在的信号。这些优点包括消除非特异性扩增和减少所需的遗传物质，从而无需大量的扩增循环即可更快地获得结果。然而，CRISPR 技术的功效在很大程度上取决于针对每个基因组目标定制的特定指导 RNA (gRNA) 序列的设计，这个过程可能复杂且耗时。我们推出 Cas-CRISPR 自动化设计和评估 (CasCADE)，这是一个最先进的 gRNA 设计软件平台，具有高度的灵活性和模块化。与计算成本高昂的多序列比对方法相比，CasCADE 结合了 k-mer 集操作，可减少回答大数据输入的时间，并使用不可知的全基因组方法来最大化 gRNA 发现。卡斯卡

articles.title: Efficient expression of γ-DL-glutamyl hydrolase in Komagataella phaffii and its application in modification of poly-γ-glutamic acid from Bacillus velezensis.
articles.titleZh: γ-DL-谷氨酰水解酶在Komagataella phaffii中的高效表达及其在贝莱森芽孢杆菌聚γ-谷氨酸修饰中的应用
articles.authors: Liu H, Yan Q, Li Y, Wang X, Jiang Z.
articles.abstract: The functional properties and application performance of poly-γ-glutamic acid (γ-PGA) are strongly dependent on its molecular weight (MW). However, the precise control of MW remains challenging, significantly hindering its high-value applications in the food, agricultural, cosmetic, and pharmaceutical sectors. Heterologous enzyme expression has emerged as a powerful and specific strategy for regulating the MW of γ-PGA. In this study, γ-DL-glutamyl hydrolase (BvPgdS45) from Bacillus velezensis CAU263 was heterologously expressed in Komagataella phaffii, achieving an activity of 102.7 IU/mL following high-cell-density fermentation. BvPgdS45 exhibited optimal activity at a pH of 7.0 and temperature of 50 °C. Subsequently, its effects on γ-PGA degradation property were evaluated. The weight-average molecular weight (Mw) of γ-PGA decreased from 3.3 × 106 Da to 1.1 × 105 Da after 3 h of enzymatic hydrolysis at enzyme dosages ranging from 0 IU/mL to 10 IU/mL. Furthermore, γ-PGA with different MW was produced using B. velezensis CAU263 via in situ enzymatic hydrolysis. Products with Mw ranging from 5.1 × 105 Da to 2.1 × 106 Da were generated, while the γ-PGA yield increased from 62.6 g/L to 73.7 g/L in a 5 L fermenter. Overall, this study demonstrates the effectiveness of BvPgdS45 expressed in K. phaffii for degrading γ-PGA and provides an efficient in situ hydrolysis strategy for the precise regulation of its MW.
articles.abstractZh: 聚-γ-谷氨酸（γ-PGA）的功能特性和应用性能很大程度上取决于其分子量（MW）。然而，分子量的精确控制仍然具有挑战性，严重阻碍了其在食品、农业、化妆品和制药领域的高价值应用。异源酶表达已成为调节 γ-PGA MW 的强大而具体的策略。在本研究中，来自贝莱斯芽孢杆菌 CAU263 的 γ-DL-谷氨酰水解酶 (BvPgdS45) 在 Komagataella phaffii 中异源表达，在高细胞密度发酵后达到 102.7 IU/mL 的活性。 BvPgdS45 在 pH 7.0 和温度 50 °C 时表现出最佳活性。随后，评价其对γ-PGA降解性能的影响。在酶剂量范围为 0 IU/mL 至 10 IU/mL 的酶水解 3 小时后，γ-PGA 的重均分子量 (Mw) 从 3.3 × 106 Da 降至 1.1 × 105 Da。此外，利用 B. velezensis CAU263 通过原位酶水解生产了不同分子量的 γ-PGA。生成的产物分子量范围为 5.1 × 105 Da 至 2.1 × 106 Da，而 γ-PGA 产量从 62.6 g/L t 增加

articles.title: Intersection of Sphingolipid and Sterol Metabolism at the Level of Orm Proteins in Yeast.
articles.titleZh: 酵母中 Orm 蛋白水平的鞘脂和甾醇代谢的交叉点。
articles.authors: Barone F, Cottier S, Stribny J, Visentin M, Schneiter R, Lone MA.
articles.abstract: Sterols and sphingolipids assemble into specialized membrane microdomains that are essential for membrane function, protein sorting, and signal transduction. Although coordinated regulation between sterol and sphingolipid metabolic pathways has long been recognized, the molecular mechanisms mediating this cross-talk remain incompletely defined. Here, we uncover an unanticipated role for the conserved yeast Orm proteins in controlling sterol and neutral lipid homeostasis. Deletion of ORM1 and ORM2 causes hypersensitivity to sterol biosynthesis inhibitors, accumulation of steryl esters, and an increase in lipid droplet number. Consistent with mutants lacking core neutral lipid hydrolases, orm1Δ orm2Δ cells display a marked defect in neutral lipid mobilization. These phenotypes depend on sphingolipid pathway perturbation but cannot be attributed to sphingolipid accumulation alone. Together, these findings position the Orm proteins as regulatory nodes linking sterol metabolism, lipid droplet dynamics, and sphingolipid biosynthesis.
articles.abstractZh: 甾醇和鞘脂组装成专门的膜微结构域，这对于膜功能、蛋白质分类和信号转导至关重要。尽管甾醇和鞘脂代谢途径之间的协调调节早已被认识到，但介导这种相互作用的分子机制仍未完全确定。在这里，我们发现了保守的酵母 Orm 蛋白在控制甾醇和中性脂质稳态中的意想不到的作用。 ORM1和ORM2的缺失会导致对甾醇生物合成抑制剂的过敏、甾醇酯的积累以及脂滴数量的增加。与缺乏核心中性脂质水解酶的突变体一致，orm1Δ orm2Δ 细胞在中性脂质动员方面表现出明显的缺陷。这些表型取决于鞘脂途径扰动，但不能单独归因于鞘脂积累。总之，这些发现将 Orm 蛋白定位为连接甾醇代谢、脂滴动力学和鞘脂生物合成的调节节点。

articles.title: Metabolic complementarity in LAB-yeast co-fermentation associates with enhanced ester aroma in cream cheese.
articles.titleZh: 实验室酵母共发酵中的代谢互补性与奶油干酪中酯香气的增强相关。
articles.authors: Duan B, Zhou Y, Wang S, Yan L, Lin Y, Li L, Xue B, Huang R, Zhang Y, Cui Y, Wu N, Kong X, Zhu H, Pu X.
articles.abstract: To address the limited flavor complexity of traditional cream cheese, this study systematically investigated the synergistic effects of LAB-yeast co-culture systems on its ester flavor profile. HS-SPME-GC-MS analysis revealed that among six LAB-yeast strain combinations, the K. marxianus and K. lactis co-culture was optimal, achieving total ester and alcohol contents of 71.45 μg/kg and 26.3 μg/kg, respectively; with results consistent with trends observed by E-nose and sensory evaluation. Further optimization determined 4% as the optimal total yeast inoculation level and a 1:4 (K. marxianus: K. lactis) culture broth ratio as optimal, yielding 75.6 μg/kg relative ester content and balanced flavor with acceptable texture and physiochemical properties. Fermentation dynamics revealed temporal metabolic complementarity: K. marxianus dominated ethanol synthesis, while the co-culture promoted early-phase organic acid accumulation and a late-phase shift potentially redirecting carbon flux toward ester biosynthesis. Metabolomics and KEGG pathway analysis revealed that K. lactis expanded the acetyl-CoA pool while K. marxianus generated higher alcohols, indicating a cross-feeding network potentially redirecting carbon flux from acid pathways toward acetyl-CoA synthesis and fruity ester formation. Based on metabolic complementarity, this study provides a metabolic framework for targeted ester enhancement and a clean-label technological pathway for flavor-oriented development in fermented dairy systems.
articles.abstractZh: 为了解决传统奶油干酪风味复杂性有限的问题，本研究系统地研究了 LAB-酵母共培养系统对其酯风味特征的协同效应。 HS-SPME-GC-MS分析表明，在六种LAB-酵母菌株组合中，马克斯克鲁维酵母和乳酸克鲁维酵母共培养效果最佳，总酯和醇含量分别为71.45 μg/kg和26.3 μg/kg；其结果与电子鼻和感官评价观察到的趋势一致。进一步优化确定4%为最佳酵母总接种量，1:4（马克斯酵母：乳酸酵母）培养液比例为最佳，相对酯含量为75.6 μg/kg，风味均衡，质地和理化特性可接受。发酵动力学揭示了时间代谢互补性：马克斯克鲁维酵母主导了乙醇合成，而共培养促进了早期有机酸积累和晚期阶段转变，可能将碳通量转向酯生物合成。代谢组学和 KEGG 通路分析表明，K.lactis 扩大了乙酰辅酶 A 库，而 K.marxianus 产生高级醇，表明交叉喂养网络潜力

articles.title: Microbial Detoxification of Ochratoxin A in Food.
articles.titleZh: 食品中赭曲霉毒素 A 的微生物解毒。
articles.authors: Roncero E, Andrade MJ, Álvarez M.
articles.abstract: Food contamination by ochratoxin A (OTA) constitutes a significant threat to public health and global food safety and security, a challenge increasingly intensified by climate change. Due to the high thermal and chemical stability of OTA, traditional physical and chemical decontamination methods often prove insufficient or detrimental to food quality. Consequently, microbial detoxification has emerged as a sustainable alternative. This review delves into the two primary biological mechanisms for OTA detoxification: physical adsorption-predominantly mediated by yeast and bacterial cell walls-and enzymatic biotransformation. Among the documented metabolic pathways, the hydrolysis of the amide bond by carboxypeptidases and amidohydrolases is recognised as the most reliable detoxification pathway. Conversely, alternative pathways, such as lactone ring opening, are hindered by their potential toxicity and chemical reversibility under acidic conditions. While various lactic acid bacteria, yeast, and filamentous mould species demonstrate high efficacy in OTA decontamination, their industrial implementation is currently limited by the complexity of food matrices and the lack of in vivo validation. The integration of multi-omics (proteomics and metabolomics), alongside CRISPR/Cas9 genome editing, is essential for identifying novel biocontrol agents. These precision biotechnological tools are fundamental for translating laboratory findings into industrial-scale OTA detoxification strategies.
articles.abstractZh: 赭曲霉毒素 A (OTA) 造成的食品污染对公众健康和全球食品安全构成重大威胁，气候变化使这一挑战日益加剧。由于OTA具有较高的热稳定性和化学稳定性，传统的物理和化学去污方法常常被证明是不够的或对食品质量有害。因此，微生物解毒已成为一种可持续的替代方案。本综述深入探讨了 OTA 解毒的两种主要生物学机制：物理吸附（主要由酵母和细菌细胞壁介导）和酶促生物转化。在已记录的代谢途径中，羧肽酶和酰胺水解酶对酰胺键的水解被认为是最可靠的解毒途径。相反，替代途径（例如内酯开环）因其在酸性条件下的潜在毒性和化学可逆性而受到阻碍。虽然各种乳酸菌、酵母和丝状霉菌在 OTA 净化方面表现出高效能，但其工业实施目前受到食品基质的复杂性和缺乏体内验证的限制。

articles.title: Multi-omics and functional validation reveal that fermentation filtratet of Clavispora lusitaniae P8 attenuates UVA-induced photoaging by modulating the IL-17/NF-κB axis.
articles.titleZh: 多组学和功能验证表明，Clavispora lusitaniae P8 的发酵滤液通过调节 IL-17/NF-κB 轴来减弱 UVA 诱导的光老化。
articles.journal: Journal of photochemistry and photobiology. B, Biology
articles.authors: Li W, Li Z, Zhu H, Wang J, Yuan Y, Zhang K, Wang X, Ni X, Wang J, Hao J, Wang Y.
articles.abstract: BackgroundUltraviolet A (UVA) radiation induces skin photoaging. The yeast Clavispora lusitaniae P8, isolated from the Turpan Basin, was studied as a potential source of novel natural anti-photoaging agents.ObjectiveThis study aimed to analyze the composition of its fermented filtrate (P8) and investigate its protective effects and mechanism against UVA-induced damage in human skin cells.MethodsThe chemical profile of P8 was analyzed using Liquid Chromatography-Mass Spectrometry (LC-MS). Optimal UVA dose and a protective P8 concentration were determined by MTT assay. In HaCaT and HFF-1 cells, protective effects were evaluated by measuring markers including Lactate Dehydrogenase (LDH) release, reactive oxygen species (ROS), mitochondrial membrane potential (MMP), cell migration, malondialdehyde (MDA), and antioxidant enzyme activities.ResultsP8 contained photoaging-related compounds (carboxylic acids and derivatives, organooxygen compounds, fatty acyls, and flavonoids) and significantly alleviated UVA-induced cellular damage by reducing oxidative stress markers, restoring mitochondrial function, promoting cell migration, increasing type I collagen levels, and suppressing matrix metalloproteinases expression. Transcriptomic and metabolomic analyses identified the Interleukin-17 (IL-17) signaling pathway as the key pathway. Western blotting confirmed that P8 inhibited UVA-induced activation of the IL-17 pathway, reducing expression of interleukin-17 receptor A (IL-17RA) and phosphorylated nuclear factor kappa B (p-NF-κB). Furthermore, using the IL-17 A neutralizing antibody Ixekizumab verified that the anti-photoaging effect is primarily mediated through the IL-17 A/NF-κB axis.ConclusionThis study is the first to link P8 with the inhibition of the IL-17/NF-κB axis, confirming its potential as a promising anti-photoaging candidate.
articles.abstractZh: 背景紫外线 A (UVA) 辐射会导致皮肤光老化。目的：分析吐鲁番盆地分离的酵母Clavispora lusitaniae P8作为新型天然抗光老化剂的潜在来源。目的分析其发酵滤液（P8）的组成，探讨其对UVA引起的人体皮肤细胞损伤的保护作用和机制。方法采用液相色谱-质谱（LC-MS）分析P8的化学成分。通过 MTT 测定确定最佳 UVA 剂量和保护性 P8 浓度。在 HaCaT 和 HFF-1 细胞中，通过测量标记物包括乳酸脱氢酶 (LDH) 释放、活性氧 (ROS)、线粒体膜电位 (MMP)、细胞迁移、丙二醛 (MDA) 和抗氧化酶活性来评估保护作用。结果 P8 含有光老化相关化合物（羧酸及其衍生物、有机氧化合物、脂肪酰基和黄酮类化合物），并通过减少氧化应激标记物、恢复线粒体功能，促进细胞迁移，增加 I 型胶原蛋白水平，并抑制基质元

articles.title: Sustainable waste-based fermentation for enhanced β-carotene biosynthesis by Blakeslea trispora and functional evaluation of the extracted pigment.
articles.titleZh: 基于废物的可持续发酵增强三孢布拉霉的 β-胡萝卜素生物合成以及提取色素的功能评估。
articles.authors: Ghazanfari N, Hosseini AM, Falah F, Nasiri M, Yazdi FT, Razavi MR, Vasiee A.
articles.abstract: BackgroundValorization of agri-food waste as nutrient-rich substrates provides a sustainable strategy for microbial bioprocessing. Blakeslea trispora is a well-known fungal producer of natural β-carotene; however, its performance on low-cost industrial waste streams remains underexplored.ResultsIn this study, dairy sludge and soybean meal were evaluated as alternative carbon and nitrogen sources for β-carotene biosynthesis by B. trispora. Response Surface Methodology (RSM) identified an optimized medium containing 12% dairy sludge, 2% soybean meal, and 0.4% yeast extract, yielding 65 g/L biomass and 352 μg/mL β-carotene in laboratory-scale fermentation. The pigment extracted from optimized cultures was confirmed as β-carotene through HPLC, FTIR, and 13C-NMR analyses. Biofunctional assays revealed antimicrobial activity (MIC: 250-500 mg/mL), with greater susceptibility in Gram-positive strains. Moderate antioxidant activity was observed in the DPPH assay (38% inhibition), and cytotoxic evaluation against Caco-2 cells resulted in an IC₅₀ of 400 mg/mL, indicating potential anticancer effects.ConclusionThese findings demonstrate that agri-food wastes can serve as efficient substrates for fungal β-carotene production, supporting cost-effective and sustainable microbial bioprocessing. The functional properties of the extracted β-carotene further highlight its applicability as a bioactive microbial metabolite with antimicrobial, antioxidant, and anticancer potential.
articles.abstractZh: 背景将农业食品废物作为营养丰富的底物进行增值，为微生物生物加工提供了可持续的策略。三孢布拉霉 (Blakeslea trispora) 是著名的天然 β-胡萝卜素生产真菌；然而，其在低成本工业废物流中的性能仍有待探索。结果在本研究中，对乳品污泥和豆粕作为三孢芽孢杆菌生物合成β-胡萝卜素的替代碳源和氮源进行了评估。响应面法 (RSM) 确定了一种含有 12% 乳品污泥、2% 豆粕和 0.4% 酵母提取物的优化培养基，在实验室规模发酵中产生 65 g/L 生物量和 352 μg/mL β-胡萝卜素。通过 HPLC、FTIR 和 13C-NMR 分析确认从优化培养物中提取的色素为 β-胡萝卜素。生物功能测定显示抗菌活性（MIC：250-500 mg/mL），革兰氏阳性菌株的敏感性更高。在 DPPH 测定中观察到中等抗氧化活性（抑制率为 38%），对 Caco-2 细胞的细胞毒性评估结果显示 IC₅₀ 为 400 mg/mL，表明潜在的抗癌作用。

articles.title: Targeted knockout of a host peroxisomal peptidase confers field resistance to maize lethal necrosis.
articles.titleZh: 宿主过氧化物酶体肽酶的靶向敲除赋予对玉米致死性坏死的田间抗性。
articles.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
articles.authors: Jung M, Wen Z, Humbert S, Lu F, DeLeon A, Marshall L, Hastings C, Cartwright H, Thilges K, Wang N, Breckenridge K, Wu E, Ryan L, Fengler K, Simcox K, Thatcher S, Llaca V, Woollums G, Sander J, Xu D, Beatty M, Brink K, Fedorova M, Jones M, Ohlson E, Suresh LM, Beyene Y, Olsen M, Ogugo V, Alakonya A, Murithi A, Mugo S, Karanja J, Boddupalli P, Pixley K, Albertsen M, Jones T, Meeley R, Gutterson N, Mazur B, Dhugga KS.
articles.abstract: Maize lethal necrosis (MLN) is a severe disease caused by the combined infection of maize chlorotic mottle virus (MCMV) and a potyvirus, most often sugarcane mosaic virus (SCMV). This disease seriously threatens food security across sub-Saharan Africa (SSA). We investigated a major-effect quantitative trait locus for resistance on chromosome 6, named the maize lethal necrosis susceptibility locus 1 (qMLNS1), derived from the Thai line KS23-6. Fine mapping and CRISPR-Cas9 editing of the candidate genes within the narrowed 105 kb interval revealed a peroxisomal peptidase as the underlying cause of susceptibility. Confocal microscopy confirmed the localization of the MLNS1 protein within peroxisomes. Targeted knockout of the Mlns1 gene in the susceptible elite line CML536 from SSA conferred resistance comparable to KS23-6 in field trials conducted in Naivasha, Kenya. This knockout specifically blocked MCMV accumulation without affecting SCMV. The edited lines showed no yield penalty or agronomic defects under disease-free conditions. Our findings uncover a mechanistic link between a peroxisomal enzyme and viral susceptibility. They also establish a rapid, scalable gene editing strategy for incorporating MLN resistance into elite germplasm, offering a model for combating similar viral diseases in staple crops globally.
articles.abstractZh: 玉米致死性坏死（MLN）是由玉米褪绿斑驳病毒（MCMV）和马铃薯Y病毒（最常见的是甘蔗花叶病毒（SCMV））联合感染引起的严重疾病。这种疾病严重威胁整个撒哈拉以南非洲地区（SSA）的粮食安全。我们研究了 6 号染色体上抗性的主效数量性状基因座，称为玉米致死性坏死易感性基因座 1 (qMLNS1)，源自泰国品系 KS23-6。在狭窄的 105 kb 区间内对候选基因进行精细定位和 CRISPR-Cas9 编辑揭示了过氧化物酶体肽酶是易感性的根本原因。共聚焦显微镜证实了 MLNS1 蛋白在过氧化物酶体内的定位。在肯尼亚奈瓦沙进行的田间试验中，SSA 易感优良品系 CML536 中的 Mlns1 基因的靶向敲除赋予了与 KS23-6 相当的抗性。这种敲除特异性地阻止了 MCMV 积累，而不影响 SCMV。编辑后的品系在无病条件下没有表现出产量损失或农艺缺陷。我们的研究结果揭示了过氧化物酶体酶与病毒易感性之间的机制联系。他们还建立了快速、可扩展的基因编辑策略

articles.title: Toxicological evaluation of bioengineered salidroside produced by a novel method.
articles.titleZh: 新方法生产的生物工程红景天苷的毒理学评价。
articles.authors: Liang H, Lu Z, Yang X, Liu L, Yang F, Liu S, Wang R.
articles.abstract: Salidroside is a naturally occurring phenolic glycoside primarily found in the roots and tubers of plants in the Rhodiola genus. The safety profile of the compound is a non-negotiable prerequisite for the applications of salidroside in food. No safety assessments of salidroside produced using recombinant Saccharomyces cerevisiae fermentation have been identified. To evaluate the safety of this biosynthetically derived salidroside, the research systematically assesses the potential for genetic toxicity and repeated dose oral toxicity in rats, providing the first comprehensive safety data for this novel fermentation-based product. The substance did not exhibit any evidence of genotoxicity in all three assays performed to assess this endpoint. Subsequently, the repeated oral dose toxicity of salidroside in rats was assessed over a period of 14 days and 90 days. Salidroside did not induce any significant toxicological changes in either sex at a dose of 2000 mg/kg bw/day over a 14-day period. The No Observed Adverse Effect Level (NOAEL) was determined to be 2000 mg/kg bw/day for the 14-day study. In the 90-day rat study, elevations in ALT and AST occurred in a few female rats administered salidroside at 1500 mg/kg/day. However, the group means lacked statistical significance (p > 0.05, ALT p = 0.72, AST p = 0.12). Due to a few additional sporadic idiosyncratic findings at 1500 mg/kg bw/day, the NOAEL for the 90-day study was conservatively established at 1000 mg/kg/day for both sexes of rats.
articles.abstractZh: 红景天苷是一种天然存在的酚苷，主要存在于红景天属植物的根和块茎中。该化合物的安全性是红景天苷在食品中应用不可忽视的先决条件。尚未对使用重组酿酒酵母发酵生产的红景天苷进行安全性评估。为了评估这种生物合成衍生的红景天苷的安全性，该研究系统地评估了大鼠遗传毒性和重复剂量口服毒性的可能性，为这种新型发酵产品提供了第一个全面的安全数据。在评估该终点的所有三项测定中，该物质没有表现出任何遗传毒性的证据。随后，在 14 天和 90 天的时间内评估了红景天苷对大鼠的重复口服剂量毒性。在 14 天的时间内，红景天甙在剂量为 2000 毫克/公斤体重/天的情况下，不会引起任何性别的任何显着毒理学变化。在为期 14 天的研究中，未观察到不良反应水平 (NOAEL) 确定为 2000 毫克/公斤体重/天。在为期 90 天的大鼠研究中，少数雌性大鼠的 ALT 和 AST 升高

articles.title: Trehalose improves cold tolerance of <i>Pediococcus pentosaceus</i> OL77 and enhances low-temperature oat silage fermentation.
articles.titleZh: 海藻糖提高戊糖片球菌OL77的耐寒性，增强燕麦青贮饲料的低温发酵。
articles.authors: Chai J, Liao C, Ju Z, Liu X, Qu X, Bai J, Zhao G.
articles.abstract: Low temperature remains a major bottleneck in silage fermentation, especially in cold regions and high-altitude areas. This study investigated the regulatory role of compatible solutes in enhancing the cold adaptation of Pediococcus pentosaceus OL77 and their synergistic application in oat silage under suboptimal temperatures (5°C-15°C). RT-qPCR analysis showed that expression of the cold shock protein gene CspP was sharply induced at 5°C, indicating its central role in cold-stress response. Exogenous trehalose and betaine significantly downregulated CspP expression, promoted bacterial growth, accelerated acid production, and enhanced metabolic stability. In silage trials, the OL77 + trehalose treatment resulted in improved lactic acid production, reduced ammonia nitrogen accumulation, and suppression of yeasts and molds across all tested temperatures. A random forest model identified 11 core variables critical for silage quality, highlighting the combined treatment as the most effective across all temperature conditions. These findings offer a robust theoretical and practical framework for enhancing low-temperature silage through synergistic application of compatible solutes and psychrophilic lactic acid bacteria and demonstrate the potential of machine learning in fermentation process optimization.IMPORTANCELow temperature is a major constraint on silage fermentation in cold and high-altitude regions. This study shows that trehalose improves the cold adaptation and fermentation performance of Pediococcus pentosaceus OL77, highlighting a practical strategy for improving oat silage quality under suboptimal temperatures.
articles.abstractZh: 低温仍然是青贮发酵的主要瓶颈，特别是在寒冷地区和高海拔地区。本研究探讨了相容性溶质在增强戊糖片球菌 OL77 冷适应方面的调节作用及其在次优温度（5°C-15°C）下燕麦青贮饲料中的协同应用。 RT-qPCR 分析表明，冷休克蛋白基因 CspP 的表达在 5°C 下急剧诱导，表明其在冷应激反应中发挥核心作用。外源海藻糖和甜菜碱显着下调CspP表达，促进细菌生长，加速产酸，增强代谢稳定性。在青贮饲料试验中，OL77 + 海藻糖处理可提高乳酸产量，减少氨氮积累，并在所有测试温度下抑制酵母和霉菌。随机森林模型确定了对青贮饲料质量至关重要的 11 个核心变量，强调组合处理在所有温度条件下都是最有效的。这些发现为通过相容性溶质和 p 的协同应用来增强低温青贮饲料提供了强有力的理论和实践框架。

articles.title: Unraveling the metabolic fingerprinting and improved properties of wheat dough co-fermented with Lactiplantibacillus plantarum and Saccharomyces cerevisiae at different ratios.
articles.titleZh: 揭示不同比例的植物乳杆菌和酿酒酵母共发酵小麦面团的代谢指纹图谱和改良特性。
articles.authors: Xu J, Tian T, Zhao Y.
articles.abstract: This study investigated the effects of co-fermenting Lactiplantibacillus plantarum and Saccharomyces cerevisiae at varied ratios (0:1, 1:2, 1:1, and 2:1, designed as L0S1, L1S2, L1S1, and L2S1) on physicochemical properties, protein structure, rheological and textural characteristics of wheat dough. Increasing the proportion of L. plantarum significantly enhanced exopolysaccharides and lactic acid contents in the dough. The increase proportion of L. plantarum resulted in the decreased contents of free sulfhydryl groups, ionic bond, and hydrophobic interaction of wheat dough. Untargeted metabolomics analysis revealed that co-fermentation regulated key metabolic pathways, including glycerophospholipid, amino acid, and nucleotide metabolism, and promoted the synthesis of essential amino acids and bioactive compounds. Compared with L0S1, L1S2, L1S1, and L2S1 contained 177, 180, and 273 differential metabolites, respectively. These differential metabolites were mainly attributed to glycerophospholipid, amino acid, and nucleotide metabolism. Furthermore, GC-IMS analysis identified that higher L. plantarum ratios improved volatile compound profiles, resulting in more desirable aroma profile in the bread. Overall, co-fermentation with L. plantarum and S. cerevisiae improved the flavor profile and qualities of wheat dough and resultant breads.
articles.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了植物乳杆菌和酿酒酵母以不同比例（0:1、1:2、1:1 和 2:1，设计为 L0S1、L1S2、L1S1 和 L2S1）共发酵对小麦面团理化特性、蛋白质结构、流变学和质构特性的影响。增加植物乳杆菌的比例显着提高了面团中胞外多糖和乳酸的含量。植物乳杆菌比例的增加导致小麦面团中游离巯基、离子键和疏水相互作用的含量降低。非靶向代谢组学分析表明，共发酵调节关键代谢途径，包括甘油磷脂、氨基酸和核苷酸代谢，并促进必需氨基酸和生物活性化合物的合成。与L0S1相比，L1S2、L1S1和L2S1分别包含177、180和273个差异代谢物。这些差异代谢物主要归因于甘油磷脂、氨基酸和核苷酸代谢。此外，GC-IMS 分析发现，较高的植物乳杆菌比例可改善挥发性化合物分布，从而产生更理想的香气特征。

articles.title: Volatile formation by combined cultures of yeast and homofermentative or heterofermentative lactobacilli in plant-based fermented foods.
articles.titleZh: 植物性发酵食品中酵母和同型发酵或异型发酵乳酸菌的联合培养物形成挥发物。
articles.authors: Beauséjour M, Curtis JM, Gänzle MG.
articles.abstract: Despite increasing interest of consumers in plant-based products, sales of the latter have been subtly decreasing mainly due to organoleptic challenges. Fermentation offers a sustainable option for improving flavour production in plant-based products. Yeast and lactobacilli are common food fermenting microbes, but a proper understanding of the interactions between the two microorganisms during flavour formation is lacking. This study explored the impact of a co-cultures of yeast and lactobacilli on aroma formation during fermentation of wheat and pulse-based food systems. Volatile analysis using HS-SPME GC-MS revealed that homofermentative lactobacilli produced diacetyl in both substrates and under all conditions. In the pulse-based samples, ferulic acid was converted to 4-vinylguaiacol only when Cp. paralimentarius and S. cerevisiae were used together. Additionally, heterofermentative lactobacilli reduced lipid oxidation aldehydes to the corresponding alcohols, and this was found to be a key element for increased ester formation by the yeast across all substrates.
articles.abstractZh: 尽管消费者对植物性产品的兴趣日益浓厚，但植物性产品的销量却略有下降，这主要是由于感官挑战。发酵为改善植物性产品的风味生产提供了一种可持续的选择。酵母和乳酸杆菌是常见的食品发酵微生物，但对这两种微生物在风味形成过程中之间的相互作用缺乏正确的了解。本研究探讨了酵母和乳酸菌共培养对小麦和豆类食品系统发酵过程中香气形成的影响。使用 HS-SPME GC-MS 进行的挥发性分析表明，同型发酵乳酸杆菌在两种底物和所有条件下均产生二乙酰。在基于脉冲的样品中，仅当 Cp.1 时，阿魏酸才会转化为 4-乙烯基愈创木酚。 paralimentarius 和 S. cerevisiae 一起使用。此外，异型发酵乳酸杆菌将脂质氧化醛还原为相应的醇，这被发现是酵母在所有底物中增加酯形成的关键因素。

articles.title: A New Set of Optogenetic Switches in Yeast Based on the BcWCL1 Photoreceptor.
articles.titleZh: 酵母中基于 BcWCL1 光感受器的一组新光遗传学开关。
articles.authors: Guerrero M, Oyarzún J, Ruiz D, Martínez C, Kessi-Pérez EI, Salinas F.
articles.abstract: Optogenetic switches are molecular systems enabling light-controlled gene expression. These systems are based on the reconstitution of chimeric Transcription Factors (TFs) including a DNA-binding Domain (DBD), a photoreceptor domain, and an Activation Domain (AD). Thus, depending on the light-mediated homodimerization or heteromerization of the chimeric TF, the optogenetic switches can be classified as single-component or two-component systems, respectively. In the budding yeast Saccharomyces cerevisiae, optogenetic switches have shown multiple applications in metabolic engineering and biotechnology. Here, we expand the repertory of optogenetic switches available in yeast, developing a collection of plasmids and yeast strains carrying single-component or two-component optogenetic switches based on the BcWCL1 protein, a blue-light photoreceptor from Botrytis cinerea that contains a LOV (Light Oxygen Voltage) domain. By dissecting the N-terminal, C-terminal, and both protein regions simultaneously, we developed 18 plasmids encoding the BcWCL1 versions fused to the Gal4-DBD and Gal4-AD. Assembled plasmids were combined and transformed into yeast to generate single-component and two-component optogenetic switches, whose blue-light response was measured as transcriptional activity of the luciferase reporter. In general, we observed that the two-component configuration increased the luciferase expression in response to blue-light compared to single-component switches. Importantly, BcWCL1 versions with deletions in the C-terminal region showed the highest luciferase expression upon blue-light stimulation with the lowest background in the dark condition, suggesting that the C-terminal region modulates the blue-light response of this protein. Altogether, we generated new single-component and two-component optogenetic switches, each of them achieving different levels of light-activated luciferase expression, enabling their potential applications in yeast biotechnology.
articles.abstractZh: 光遗传学开关是能够实现光控基因表达的分子系统。这些系统基于嵌合转录因子 (TF) 的重建，包括 DNA 结合域 (DBD)、光感受器域和激活域 (AD)。因此，根据嵌合TF的光介导的同二聚化或异聚化，光遗传开关可以分别分为单组分或双组分系统。在出芽酵母酿酒酵母中，光遗传学开关已在代谢工程和生物技术中显示出多种应用。在这里，我们扩展了酵母中可用的光遗传学开关库，开发了一系列携带单组分或两组分光遗传学开关的质粒和酵母菌株，这些光遗传学开关基于 BcWCL1 蛋白，BcWCL1 蛋白是来自灰葡萄孢的蓝光光感受器，含有 LOV（光氧电压）结构域。通过同时解剖 N 端、C 端和两个蛋白质区域，我们开发了 18 个编码与 Gal4-DBD 和 Gal4-AD 融合的 BcWCL1 版本的质粒。将组装好的质粒组合并转化到酵母中，产生单组分和双组分

articles.title: Biotechnological applications of D-xylose-fermenting autochthonous yeasts in lignocellulosic biorefineries.
articles.titleZh: D-木糖发酵本土酵母在木质纤维素生物精炼厂中的生物技术应用。
articles.authors: Machado DD, Martinez CB, Souza VP, Linck MM, Bonatto D.
articles.abstract: The efficient fermentation of D-xylose by yeasts remains a major bottleneck for the sustainable production of second-generation bioethanol, as this pentose represents a substantial fraction of hemicellulosic sugars in lignocellulosic biomass. While conventional industrial yeasts show limited native capacity for D-xylose utilization, numerous autochthonous (native or wild-derived) yeasts isolated from natural environments harbor metabolic traits that have been naturally selected and enable effective pentose assimilation under challenging conditions. Understanding and harnessing this diversity is essential for advancing lignocellulosic biorefineries. This review synthesizes current knowledge on D-xylose-fermenting yeasts from natural ecosystems, with emphasis on their ecological diversity, taxonomic classification, physiological traits, and biotechnological relevance. Yeasts in genera such as Scheffersomyces, Spathaspora, Candida, and Meyerozyma exhibit efficient D-xylose metabolism via distinct enzymatic strategies, although redox balance, cofactor regeneration, and sugar transport remain key constraints. Many of these yeasts exhibit intrinsic tolerance to inhibitors derived from biomass pretreatment and adaptability to variations in oxygen availability, temperature, and osmotic stress, which are critical attributes for industrial applications. In addition, several species produce hydrolytic enzymes that partially degrade lignocellulosic substrates during fermentation, thereby supporting process integration and consolidation. Beyond ethanol production, D-xylose metabolism in yeasts can be redirected toward value-added bioproducts such as xylitol and organic acids, broadening the economic potential of lignocellulosic feedstocks. Advances in molecular taxonomy, adaptive evolution, metabolic engineering, and omics-based analyses have substantially improved fermentation performance and robustness, enabling more rational strain selection and targeted improvement. By combining phylogenetic-guided strain identification, adaptive and genetic improvement, systems-level characterization, and industrial process integration, this review provides a comprehensive framework for translating natural yeast diversity into efficient platforms for second-generation bioethanol and diversified bioprocesses. Such an integrated perspective is essential for overcoming current technical limitations and for advancing sustainable, biomass-based biorefineries.
articles.abstractZh: 酵母对 D-木糖的有效发酵仍然是第二代生物乙醇可持续生产的主要瓶颈，因为这种戊糖代表了木质纤维素生物质中半纤维素糖的很大一部分。虽然传统工业酵母对 D-木糖的天然利用能力有限，但从自然环境中分离出来的许多本土（天然或野生来源）酵母具有自然选择的代谢特征，能够在挑战性条件下实现有效的戊糖同化。了解和利用这种多样性对于推进木质纤维素生物精炼厂至关重要。本综述综合了自然生态系统中 D-木糖发酵酵母的最新知识，重点关注其生态多样性、分类学分类、生理特征和生物技术相关性。尽管氧化还原平衡、辅因子再生和糖转运仍然是关键限制因素，但 Scheffersomyces、Spathaspora、Candida 和 Meyerozyma 等属的酵母通过不同的酶促策略表现出高效的 D-木糖代谢。许多这些酵母表现出对源自双的抑制剂的内在耐受性。

articles.title: Engineered live bacteria for liver diseases and gut-liver axis disorders: from genetic modification to advanced delivery systems.
articles.titleZh: 用于治疗肝脏疾病和肠肝轴疾病的工程活细菌：从基因改造到先进的输送系统。
articles.authors: Zhang Y, Zhu Y, Yang Y, Chen D, Wang J.
articles.abstract: Liver diseases, including hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD), and alcoholic liver disease (ALD), impose a significant global health burden, with over 2 million deaths annually and substantial economic losses. Current treatments, primarily pharmacological, face challenges such as insufficient efficacy, poor absorption, and drug resistance. The liver-gut axis, a critical pathway linking the liver and intestines, offers a therapeutic target for these diseases. Engineered live bacteria, modified through genetic engineering and synthetic biology, have emerged as a promising alternative. These bacteria can be designed to deliver therapeutic agents directly to the liver or gut, enhancing efficacy and reducing systemic side effects. This review explores the application of engineered live bacteria in treating liver diseases, focusing on strains such as Bifidobacterium, Escherichia coli Nissle 1917 (EcN), Bacillus subtilis (B. subtilis), Saccharomyces boulardii (S. boulardii), and Lactobacillus reuteri (L. reuteri). It also pays attention to the internal genetic modification and external covalent connection of the original live bacteria. We discuss the design of dosage forms, including capsule formulations, microencapsulation, and nanopreparations, and administration methods like oral and in situ injection. Additionally, we address the challenges and future prospects of using engineered live bacteria to target liver diseases and related conditions, aiming to advance their clinical application and reduce the global burden of liver diseases.
articles.abstractZh: 肝病，包括肝细胞癌 (HCC)、非酒精性脂肪性肝病 (NAFLD) 和酒精性肝病 (ALD)，给全球带来了巨大的健康负担，每年导致超过 200 万人死亡并造成巨大的经济损失。目前的治疗方法主要是药物治疗，面临着疗效不足、吸收差、耐药性等挑战。肝肠轴是连接肝脏和肠道的关键通路，为这些疾病提供了治疗靶点。通过基因工程和合成生物学进行改造的工程活细菌已成为一种有前途的替代品。这些细菌可以被设计为将治疗药物直接输送到肝脏或肠道，从而增强疗效并减少全身副作用。本综述探讨了工程活菌在治疗肝脏疾病中的应用，重点关注双歧杆菌、大肠杆菌 Nissle 1917 (EcN)、枯草芽孢杆菌 (B. subtilis)、布拉酵母菌 (S. boulardii) 和罗伊氏乳杆菌 (L. reuteri) 等菌株。它还注重原始活菌的内部基因修饰和外部共价连接。我们讨论的是

articles.title: Micafungin microevolution in <i>Candida auris</i> reveals resistance development without <i>in vivo</i> fitness compromise.
articles.titleZh: 耳念珠菌中的米卡芬净微进化揭示了在不影响体内适应性的情况下产生耐药性。
articles.authors: Bohner F, Szilovics Z, Veres É, Papp C, Nosanchuk JD, Gácser A.
articles.abstract: Candida auris is an emerging multidrug-resistant pathogen with high transmissibility in healthcare settings. Although echinocandin resistance in Candida is typically associated with fitness loss, we found that micafungin-resistant C. auris strains (MICAevo) generated from two distinct source isolates (AR0381 and AR0387) via experimental microevolution retained full virulence. Evolved strains developed stable resistance to multiple echinocandins, while AR0387 (B8441), originating from MICAevo strain, also acquired increased azole tolerance. Whole-genome sequencing revealed clinically relevant mutations in FKS1, as well as changes in genes involved in ergosterol biosynthesis (ERG3), amino acid metabolism, and PKA signaling. Despite in vitro sensitivity to cell wall stressors, resistant strains maintained or even enhanced colonization in a murine systemic infection model. Independently evolved strains showed similar antifungal resistance profiles, and although minor differences of pathogenic potential were noted, no consistent virulence attenuation was observed, indicating the reproducibility of phenotype changes. These findings suggest that C. auris can acquire echinocandin resistance without compromising pathogenicity, supporting its persistence and spread in clinical settings.
articles.abstractZh: 耳念珠菌是一种新兴的多重耐药病原体，在医疗机构中具有高度传播性。尽管念珠菌中的棘白菌素耐药性通常与适应性丧失相关，但我们发现，通过实验微进化从两个不同来源的分离株（AR0381 和 AR0387）产生的米卡芬净耐药耳念珠菌菌株 (MICAevo) 保留了完整的毒力。进化后的菌株对多种棘白菌素产生了稳定的耐药性，而源自 MICAevo 菌株的 AR0387 (B8441) 也获得了更高的唑类耐受性。全基因组测序揭示了 FKS1 的临床相关突变，以及参与麦角甾醇生物合成 (ERG3)、氨基酸代谢和 PKA 信号传导的基因的变化。尽管在体外对细胞壁应激源敏感，但耐药菌株在小鼠全身感染模型中维持甚至增强了定植。独立进化的菌株表现出相似的抗真菌耐药性，尽管注意到致病潜力的微小差异，但没有观察到一致的毒力减弱，表明表型变化的可重复性。这些发现表明耳念珠菌可以获得棘白菌素抗性

articles.title: Prolonged Deltamethrin Exposure Induces Dose-Dependent Glycerol Overproduction and Efficient Deltamethrin Removal by <i>Saccharomyces cerevisiae</i>.
articles.titleZh: 长期接触溴氰菊酯会导致剂量依赖性甘油过量产生，并通过酿酒酵母有效去除溴氰菊酯。
articles.authors: Yavuz M, Yavuz HG, Kaya RA, Eren O, Bereketoglu C, Turanli B.
articles.abstract: Background/Objectives: Pest management strategies rely on insecticides such as deltamethrin (DM), a commonly applied type II pyrethroid. As a natural component of food-associated microflora, Saccharomyces cerevisiae inevitably encounters DM residues in crops used for fermentation processes, including dough leavening and winemaking. However, the prolonged effect of DM exposure on yeast fermentation performance and its capacity to remove DM remained unclear. Methods: In this study, S. cerevisiae was continuously exposed to a non-lethal concentration (10 mg/L) and a low-inhibition toxic concentration (30 mg/L) of DM for 30 days. Results: Yeast exhibited high removal capacity, removing 98.05 ± 1.2% and 98.28 ± 0.4% of DM at 10 mg/L and 30 mg/L, respectively. Prolonged exposure to DM at both concentrations did not significantly affect biomass formation, glucose consumption, ethanol production, or acetic acid levels. In contrast, glycerol production increased markedly, reaching 1.1 g/L and 1.5 g/L in cultures exposed to 10 mg/L and 30 mg/L DM, respectively. Consistent with these changes, the expression levels of GPD1 and GPD2, which encode rate-limiting enzymes in glycerol biosynthesis, were upregulated in a dose-dependent manner. Conclusions: Given the fact that Saccharomyces cerevisiae is a workhorse for the biotechnological industry and has a wide range of applications, including in the food industry, elevated glycerol production in yeast under DM exposure is noteworthy in terms of yeast-based applications.
articles.abstractZh: 背景/目标：害虫管理策略依赖于杀虫剂，例如溴氰菊酯 (DM)，一种常用的 II 型拟除虫菊酯。作为食品相关微生物群的天然成分，酿酒酵母不可避免地会在用于发酵过程（包括面团发酵和酿酒）的作物中遇到DM残留物。然而，DM 暴露对酵母发酵性能及其去除 DM 能力的长期影响仍不清楚。方法：在本研究中，酿酒酵母连续暴露于非致死浓度（10 mg/L）和低抑制毒性浓度（30 mg/L）的DM 30天。结果：酵母表现出较高的去除能力，在 10 mg/L 和 30 mg/L 时分别去除 98.05 ± 1.2% 和 98.28 ± 0.4% 的 DM。长时间暴露于两种浓度的 DM 不会显着影响生物量形成、葡萄糖消耗、乙醇产量或乙酸水平。相比之下，暴露于 10 mg/L 和 30 mg/L DM 的培养物中甘油产量显着增加，分别达到 1.1 g/L 和 1.5 g/L。与这些变化一致的是，编码甘油生物合成限速酶的 GPD1 和 GPD2 的表达水平，

articles.title: <i>Brukina</i> in Focus: A Narrative Review on Metagenomic Approaches to Fermentation and Food Safety.
articles.titleZh: Brukina 焦点：发酵和食品安全宏基因组方法的叙述回顾。
articles.authors: Kwarteng A, Amedorme D, Addy HPK, Amewu EKA, Osei-Poku P, Larbi A.
articles.abstract: Brukina, a traditional fermented beverage smoothie made from milk and millet, is popular in Ghana and other West African countries due to its tasty flavor, high nutritional content, and affordability. Despite its widespread consumption, the nature of its production through artisanal fermentation processes presents concerns regarding microbial consistency, nutritional optimization, and food safety. This literature review explores the potential of metagenomic approaches to uncover microbial diversity, functional capacity, and safety profiles of Brukina. By integrating insights from amplicon-targeted and shotgun whole-genome sequencing studies on fermented foods, we highlight how next-generation sequencing technologies can characterize lactic acid bacteria, yeast, and other microorganisms that drive fermentation. Additionally, we discuss how metagenomics can identify functional genes influencing carbohydrate metabolism, flavor and aroma generation, and production of antimicrobial resistance compounds. Thus, metagenomics provides a powerful framework for assessing public health risks and nutritional benefits. Bioinformatic tools have also been highlighted, and their relevant application in analyzing sequenced data to achieve taxonomic classification, identification of biochemical pathways, and functional profiling of microbial ecology of fermented foods. This review outlines key research gaps and recommends future directions, including starter culture development, standardization of Brukina production, multi-omics integration in metagenomics, and microbiome-informed food safety standards. Metagenomic profiling of Brukina holds promise for improving product quality, consumer safety, and scientific understanding of traditional fermented foods. By tackling the challenges raised, metagenomic techniques can be extremely helpful in maximizing Brukina fermentation, guaranteeing food safety, and maintaining the customs that give this product its distinctive character.
articles.abstractZh: Brukina是一种由牛奶和小米制成的传统发酵饮料冰沙，因其味道鲜美、营养含量高、价格实惠而在加纳和其他西非国家很受欢迎。尽管其消费广泛，但其通过手工发酵过程生产的性质引起了人们对微生物一致性、营养优化和食品安全的担忧。本文献综述探讨了宏基因组方法在揭示 Brukina 的微生物多样性、功能能力和安全性方面的潜力。通过整合针对发酵食品的扩增子靶向和鸟枪法全基因组测序研究的见解，我们重点介绍了下一代测序技术如何表征乳酸菌、酵母和其他驱动发酵的微生物。此外，我们还讨论了宏基因组学如何识别影响碳水化合物代谢、风味和香气产生以及抗菌素耐药性化合物产生的功能基因。因此，宏基因组学为评估公共卫生风险和营养益处提供了强大的框架。生物信息学工具也得到了强调，及其相关应用

articles.title: Anhydrobiosis as a Model of Aging and Longevity: The Role of Autophagy and Metabolism in Yeast Cells.
articles.titleZh: 脱水作为衰老和长寿的模型：自噬和代谢在酵母细胞中的作用。
articles.authors: Jonnagiri NPKR, Kieliszek M.
articles.abstract: Anhydrobiosis, the ability of cells to endure severe dehydration, provides a valuable model for investigating cellular resilience, aging, and long-term endurance processes. Yeast species, such as Saccharomyces cerevisiae and non-conventional yeasts, are valuable tools for understanding how stress-response pathways, metabolic regulation, and proteostasis contribute to desiccation tolerance. Experimental studies show that trehalose build-up, High Osmolarity Glycerol (HOG)-MAPK signalling, mitochondrial energy maintenance, and protein quality control networks are all protective of cellular structures during water loss and facilitate the rapid recovery of cellular structures upon rehydration. In yeast, these processes are tightly linked to chronological lifespan regulation and stress resistance in non-dividing cells. Multi-omics studies, such as transcriptomics, lipidomics, and chromatin accessibility studies, indicate widespread remodelling of metabolic pathways, membrane architecture, and chromatin states, with transcriptional stress memory maintained by epigenetic mechanisms to improve survival during repeated cycles of dehydration. Anhydrobiosis has been applied in biotechnology, agriculture, and biomedical science, with yeast-based systems being used to produce active dry yeast, preserve enzymes and vaccines, and create stress-tolerant microbial inoculants to enhance crop growth. Yeast anhydrobiosis integrates genetics, biophysics, and systems biology to explain cell survival under extreme stress and to guide the engineering of more stable biological systems. Overall, this summary of recent findings on genetic determinants, molecular pathways, and yeast responses to stress during anhydrobiosis provides valuable insights into aging and resilience mechanisms and establishes anhydrobiosis as a conceptual framework for studying conserved cellular maintenance strategies rather than a direct model of organismal longevity.
articles.abstractZh: 脱水是细胞承受严重脱水的能力，为研究细胞弹性、衰老和长期耐力过程提供了一个有价值的模型。酿酒酵母和非常规酵母等酵母物种是了解应激反应途径、代谢调节和蛋白质稳态如何促进干燥耐受性的宝贵工具。实验研究表明，海藻糖的积累、高渗透压甘油 (HOG)-MAPK 信号传导、线粒体能量维持和蛋白质质量控​​制网络均可在失水期间保护细胞结构，并促进补水后细胞结构的快速恢复。在酵母中，这些过程与非分裂细胞的时间寿命调节和应激抵抗力紧密相关。多组学研究，如转录组学、脂质组学和染色质可及性研究，表明代谢途径、膜结构和染色质状态的广泛重塑，通过表观遗传机制维持转录应激记忆，以提高重复脱水周期中的存活率。脱水生物技术已应用于生物技术领域

articles.title: Block-building with yeast to elucidate an artificial pathway for de novo biosynthesis of glabridin.
articles.titleZh: 用酵母构建模块以阐明光甘草定从头生物合成的人工途径。
articles.authors: Deng H, Cao L, Li S, Zhang C, Zeng W, Zhao X, Zhou J.
articles.abstract: Prenylated phytochemicals like glabridin are valuable therapeutics and cosmetics, yet their plant scarcity and arduous synthesis hinder industrial supply. Rebuilding pathways in microbes is hampered by complex topology and carbon-cofactor competition. In this work, we design an artificial biosynthetic route using a "block-building" workflow, constructing independently optimizable upstream precursor-supply and downstream tailoring/prenylation blocks. Structure-informed retrosynthesis eliminates methylation to lock flux toward the isoflavone core, while a tunable yeast-embedded dimethylallyl pyrophosphate platform enables crucial prenylation. Screening alternative pterocarpan reductase sources resolves the rate-limiting pentacyclic ring-opening step, achieving glabridin synthesis. Hybridization serves as the block glue, enabling the diploid Saccharomyces cerevisiae strain to produce 0.24 mg/L of glabridin from glucose, with bioreactor validation reaching 1.20 mg/L. Extending this to a yeast × Escherichia coli consortium delivers 32.8 mg/L equol, confirming framework generality. In this work, the strategy converts intricate phytochemical pathways into plug-and-play genetic modules, enabling rapid fermentation-based manufacturing without extensive genome rewriting.
articles.abstractZh: 像光甘草定这样的异戊二烯化植物化学物质是有价值的治疗剂和化妆品，但它们的植物稀缺性和艰巨的合成阻碍了工业供应。复杂的拓扑结构和碳辅因子竞争阻碍了微生物通路的重建。在这项工作中，我们使用“区块构建”工作流程设计了一条人工生物合成路线，构建了可独立优化的上游前体供应和下游剪裁/异戊二烯化区块。基于结构的逆合成消除了甲基化，以锁定异黄酮核心的通量，而可调节的酵母嵌入二甲基烯丙基焦磷酸平台可实现关键的异戊二烯化。筛选替代紫檀还原酶来源解决了限速五环开环步骤，实现了光甘草定的合成。杂交作为块胶，使二倍体酿酒酵母菌株能够从葡萄糖生产 0.24 mg/L 的光甘草定，生物反应器验证达到 1.20 mg/L。将其扩展到酵母 × 大肠杆菌联盟可提供 32.8 mg/L 的雌马酚，证实了框架的通用性。在这项工作中，该策略将复杂的植物化学途径转化为即插即用的遗传模块，en

articles.title: Carbohydrate conversion and microbial community restructuring following Saccharomyces cerevisiae inoculation during Pu-erh tea fermentation.
articles.titleZh: 普洱茶发酵过程中接种酿酒酵母后的碳水化合物转化和微生物群落重组。
articles.authors: Li R, Wang T, Chen Q, Guan Y, Bo N, Wang Q, Guan Y, Yang D, Liang P, Ma Y, Ling T, Zhao M.
articles.abstract: Microbial fermentation profoundly reshapes the carbohydrate matrix of ripened Pu-erh tea, yet the chemical mechanism underlying sweetness formation remains poorly defined. Here, we show that controlled inoculation with Saccharomyces cerevisiae at the turning stage of pile fermentation induces targeted cleavage of tea cell-wall polysaccharides and redirects carbon flux toward sweetness-active carbohydrates. Compared with naturally fermented controls, yeast-inoculated teas exhibited a marked decrease in cell-wall cellulose, concomitant increases in hemicellulose-, pectin- and lignin-derived fragments, and significantly elevated levels of glucose, fructose, galactose, trehalose, ribitol and arabitol. Integrated targeted and widely targeted metabolomics, together with metatranscriptomic CAZy annotation, revealed a yeast-specific activation of β-glucosidases, α-trehalases, β-1,3-glucanases and trehalose-6-phosphate synthase, accompanied by enhanced expression of hexokinase and phosphoglucomutase. This enzyme ensemble accelerates depolymerization of β-1,4-glucan and α-1,6-glycosidic linkages in cellulose and pectin side chains, liberating neutral sugars and polyols that chemically account for the enhanced sweetness, thickness and smooth mouthfeel of inoculated teas. We propose a yeast-driven polysaccharide-monosaccharide conversion mechanism that provides a molecular basis for carbohydrate transformation in Pu-erh tea and offers a general framework for modulating carbohydrate-derived flavor attributes in fermented plant-based foods.
articles.abstractZh: 微生物发酵深刻地重塑了熟普洱茶的碳水化合物基质，但甜味形成的化学机制仍不清楚。在这里，我们表明，在堆发酵的转变阶段控制接种酿酒酵母可诱导茶细胞壁多糖的定向裂解，并将碳通量重新导向甜味活性碳水化合物。与自然发酵的对照相比，接种酵母的茶表现出细胞壁纤维素显着减少，半纤维素、果胶和木质素衍生片段随之增加，并且葡萄糖、果糖、半乳糖、海藻糖、核糖醇和阿拉伯糖醇水平显着升高。综合靶向和广泛靶向代谢组学，连同宏转录组学 CAZy 注释，揭示了 β-葡萄糖苷酶、α-海藻糖酶、β-1,3-葡聚糖酶和海藻糖 6-磷酸合酶的酵母特异性激活，并伴随着己糖激酶和磷酸葡萄糖变位酶的表达增强。该酶群加速纤维素和果胶侧链中 β-1,4-葡聚糖和 α-1,6-糖苷键的解聚，释放出化学上对应的中性糖和多元醇。

articles.title: Docking prediction, molecular dynamics and antibiofilm effect of linalool against Candida albicans strains from vulvovaginal secretions
articles.titleZh: 芳樟醇对外阴阴道分泌物白色念珠菌菌株的对接预测、分子动力学和抗菌膜作用
articles.journal: Biomedica : revista del Instituto Nacional de Salud
articles.authors: Medeiros CI, Galdino Gouveia R, Targino Gomes V, Silva G, Vasconcelos Gomes U, Alves Filho A, De Oliveira Lima E.
articles.abstract: IntroductionVulvovaginal candidiasis is a prevalent fungal infection, predominantly caused by Candida albicans. Biofilm formation plays a central role in disease persistence and therapeutic failure by enhancing fungal tolerance to conventional antifungal agents.ObjectiveTo evaluate the antibiofilm activity of linalool against C. albicans strains isolated from vulvovaginal secretions and to investigate its potential molecular interactions with 1,3-β-glucan synthase, a key enzyme involved in fungal cell wall biosynthesis.Materials and methodsThe antibiofilm effect of linalool was assessed in vitro using the crystal violet assay against a clinical isolate (C. albicans LM 129) and a reference strain (C. albicans ATCC 76485). Nystatin was included as a comparator antifungal. In parallel, molecular docking analyses were performed using AutoDock 4.2, followed by molecular dynamics simulations conducted in GROMACS 2022.3 to evaluate the stability of the linalool-enzyme complex.ResultsLinalool significantly reduced biofilm formation in both C. albicans strains, with an average inhibition of 74.65%, whereas nystatin exhibited limited antibiofilm activity. Docking studies revealed that linalool interacts with the active site of 1,3-β-glucan synthase, presenting a binding free energy (ΔG) of -6.0 kcal/mol, comparable to the control ligand castanospermine (-7.0 kcal/mol). Molecular dynamics simulations demonstrated structural stability of the linalool-enzyme complex over a 30 ns trajectory, supporting the persistence of these interactions under dynamic conditions.ConclusionsLinalool exhibits relevant antibiofilm activity against C. albicans and shows stable interactions with 1,3-β-glucan synthase, suggesting a plausible inhibitory mechanism. These findings support the potential of linalool as a natural scaffold for the development of alternative therapeutic strategies for vulvovaginal candidiasis.
