articles.title: Enhanced production of chitinase from Bacillus cereus V5331 and evaluation of anti-candidal potential of enzyme: central composite design approach.
articles.titleZh: 蜡样芽胞杆菌 V5331 提高几丁质酶的产量并评估酶的抗念珠菌潜力：中心复合设计方法。
articles.authors: Sharma A, Suttee A, Arya SK, Singh G.
articles.abstract: A chitinase-producing bacterium was isolated from a dumping ground soil sample and identified as Bacillus cereus V5331 based on 16S rRNA gene sequencing. The production of chitinase was enhanced through the application of solid-state fermentation (SSF). The effect of variables like pH, temperature, swollen chitin (SC) concentration, moisture content, inoculum size and incubation period were assessed by using a one-variable-at-a-time (OVAT) approach. A central composite design (CCD) using response surface methodology (RSM) was subsequently employed with the chitin concentration, moisture ratio, incubation period and inoculum size as found most effective independent variables. Optimization resulted in a 1.84 fold increase in chitinase production by meeting the parameters: 0.2% chitin, 1:1 moisture ratio, 1% inoculum and 120 h of incubation at 37 °C and pH 7 ± 0.2. The scanning electron microscopy (SEM) studies revealed that chitinase showed significant antifungal action against Candida albicans, causing cell wall disintegration, cell wall inhibition (1.5 cm) and substantial biofilm degradation (53.56%). Chitin breakdown was further confirmed by Fourier transform infrared spectroscopic (FTIR) analysis and p-DMAB assay of the enzyme-treated yeast, which showed the release of 211 µg mL-1 of N-acetylglucosamine (NAG). The current study demonstrates a newly isolated bacterium, which is non-hemolytic (gamma- hemolytic) and producing chitinase constitutively as well as in the presence of chitin in cost-effective locally available media. Further, its anti-fungal potential against C. albicans makes it a promising candidate for future studies to develop an antifungal topical therapeutic agent.
articles.abstractZh: 从垃圾场土壤样品中分离出一株产生几丁质酶的细菌，并根据 16S rRNA 基因测序鉴定为蜡状芽孢杆菌 V5331。通过固态发酵（SSF）的应用提高了几丁质酶的产量。通过使用一次一变量 (OVAT) 方法评估 pH、温度、膨胀几丁质 (SC) 浓度、水分含量、接种量和培养时间等变量的影响。随后采用响应面法（RSM）的中心复合设计（CCD），将几丁质浓度、水分比、培养期和接种量作为发现最有效的自变量。通过满足以下参数：0.2% 几丁质、1:1 水分比、1% 接种量以及在 37 °C 和 pH 7 ± 0.2 下孵育 120 小时，优化导致几丁质酶产量增加 1.84 倍。扫描电子显微镜 (SEM) 研究表明，几丁质酶对白色念珠菌表现出显着的抗真菌作用，导致细胞壁崩解、细胞壁抑制 (1.5 cm) 和大量生物膜降解 (53.56%)。傅里叶变换红外光谱进一步证实了甲壳素的分解

articles.title: Genome-Wide Identification and Characterization of the Key Genes for Salicylic Acid Biosynthesis in Four Cotton Species.
articles.titleZh: 四种棉花水杨酸生物合成关键基因的全基因组鉴定和表征。
articles.authors: Lin J, Zhou X, Shi S, Li X, Wang M, Wang F, Zhu L, Li H.
articles.abstract: Cotton, as a globally significant economic crop, is intricately regulated in its growth and development by the key genes for SA (Salicylic acid) biosynthesis. In the present study, a systematic analysis of genes related to SA biosynthesis was conducted across four cotton species, leading to the identification of 70 genes. Specifically, the tetraploid species Gossypium hirsutum and G. barbadense were found to harbor 22 and 23 genes, respectively, representing a substantial expansion compared to the 12 and 13 genes identified in the diploid progenitors G. arboreum and G. raimondii. Comprehensive characterization of chromosomal localization, phylogeny, domain architecture, and promoter cis-elements revealed a uniform distribution of key genes involved in SA biosynthesis across A/D sub-genomes of tetraploids with extensive interspecific collinearity; whole-genome and segmental duplication act as the dominant drivers for the expansion of this gene family, while partial gene loss following polyploidization results in non-doubled gene copy numbers in tetraploids relative to diploids, which reflects the evolutionary selection for genomic dosage balance. The key genes for SA biosynthesis demonstrate a high degree of conservation in protein sequences, protein structures, and conserved motifs, which constitute the structural basis for the stable maintenance of their core functions in the SA biosynthesis pathway during plant evolution. This is closely related to their core function in the salicylic acid (SA) synthesis pathway and serves as the structural basis for the stable maintenance of gene functions during evolution. Analysis of cis-elements revealed that the expression of key genes involved in SA biosynthesis is governed by a complex interplay of phytohormones, stress signals, and transcription factors. Yeast one-hybrid (Y1H) assays confirmed the interaction between the GhPAL and GhICS gene and predicted candidate transcription factors, specifically the binding of GhWRKY21 to GhICS2-1 promoter and GhMYB12 to GhPAL1-2 promoter, thus elucidating their stage-specific regulatory mechanisms in cotton fiber development and reflecting their evolution. This study provides a fundamental basis for investigating the role of the SA signaling pathway in cotton development and offers support for cotton molecular breeding.
articles.abstractZh: 棉花作为全球重要的经济作物，其生长发育受到SA（水杨酸）生物合成关键基因的复杂调控。在本研究中，对四个棉花品种中与 SA 生物合成相关的基因进行了系统分析，鉴定出 70 个基因。具体来说，四倍体物种陆地棉和海岛棉分别含有 22 和 23 个基因，与二倍体祖先 G. arboreum 和 G. raimondii 中鉴定的 12 和 13 个基因相比，这代表了显着的扩展。染色体定位、系统发育、结构域结构和启动子顺式元件的综合表征揭示了参与 SA 生物合成的关键基因在四倍体 A/D 亚基因组中的均匀分布，具有广泛的种间共线性；全基因组和片段重复是该基因家族扩张的主要驱动因素，而多倍化后的部分基因丢失导致四倍体相对于二倍体的基因拷贝数非加倍，这反映了基因组剂量平衡的进化选择。 SA生物合成的关键基因

articles.title: Profiling Potential Wine Yeast Starters from <i>Criolla</i> Grape Varieties from Argentina.
articles.titleZh: 分析来自阿根廷Criolla葡萄品种的潜在葡萄酒酵母发酵剂。
articles.authors: Becerra LM, Torres Palazzolo C, Chimeno SV, Lerena MC, Sari S, Prieto J, Mercado LA, Combina M.
articles.abstract: Criolla grape varieties are native South American cultivars that represent an important reservoir of genetic and microbiological diversity. This study aimed to investigate the oenological potential of Saccharomyces and non-Saccharomyces yeasts isolated from three criolla grape varieties in order to support the future design of wine starters. Yeasts were isolated at different fermentation stages from four vineyards in Mendoza, Argentina. A total of 485 isolates were recovered and molecularly identified, revealing 12 species belonging to eight genera. Saccharomyces cerevisiae, Hanseniaspora guilliermondii and Hanseniaspora uvarum were the dominant species. Isolates were screened for H2S and acetic acid production, followed by physiological and enzymatic characterisation. Selected strains were further evaluated in small-scale fermentations to assess fermentative kinetics and metabolic performance. Significant variability was observed, particularly among non-Saccharomyces isolates, which generally exhibited lower ethanol yields and acetic acid production compared to S. cerevisiae. Several isolates of H. guilliermondii showed balanced fermentative behaviour and favourable metabolic and enzymatic profiles. Through the applied selection strategy, twelve strains emerged as promising wine starter candidates. These isolates combined a low production of undesirable metabolites, relevant enzymatic activities, and favourable fermentative performance. Overall, the results highlight the oenological potential of autochthonous yeasts as a resource for innovative winemaking strategies.
articles.abstractZh: Criolla 葡萄品种是南美本土品种，代表着遗传和微生物多样性的重要库。本研究旨在研究从三个 criolla 葡萄品种中分离出来的酵母菌和非酵母菌的酿酒潜力，以支持未来葡萄酒发酵剂的设计。从阿根廷门多萨的四个葡萄园中分离出处于不同发酵阶段的酵母。总共回收了 485 个分离株并进行了分子鉴定，揭示了属于 8 个属的 12 个物种。酿酒酵母、吉里蒙汉森氏菌和葡萄色汉森氏菌为优势种。筛选分离株的 H2S 和乙酸产量，然后进行生理和酶学表征。选定的菌株在小规模发酵中进行了进一步评估，以评估发酵动力学和代谢性能。观察到显着的变异性，特别是在非酵母菌分离株中，与酿酒酵母相比，其通常表现出较低的乙醇产量和乙酸产量。 H. guilliermondii 的几个分离株表现出平衡的发酵行为和有利的代谢和

articles.title: <i>Pichia kudriavzevii</i> KKU20 and <i>Saccharomyces cerevisiae</i> Exhibit Comparable Performance in Rice Straw Ensiling for Feed Efficiency and Growth of Thai Native Beef Cattle.
articles.titleZh: Pichia kudriavzevii KKU20 和 Saccharomyces cerevisiae 在稻草青贮方面表现出相当的性能，可提高泰国本土肉牛的饲料效率和生长。
articles.authors: Cherdthong A, Kanakai N, Srichompoo P, Wanapat M, Pramotchit S, Suntara C.
articles.abstract: ObjectiveObjective: The study aimed to assess the effect of two yeast strains, Pichia kudriavzevii KKU20 and Saccharomyces cerevisiae, on the ensiling process of rice straw (RS) and its impact on nutritional digestibility, ruminal fermentation, energy utilization, and growth performance of Thai native bulls.MethodsEight Thai native bulls were randomly assigned to two groups: One group was fed RS ensiled with Pichia kudriavzevii KKU20 (n = 4), and the other group was fed RS ensiled with Saccharomyces cerevisiae (n = 4). The experiment included an 18-day adaptation period followed by a 60-day feeding period. The bulls received a concentrate diet formulated to meet their protein requirements.ResultsNo significant differences (p > 0.05) were observed between the groups in terms of daily concentrate intake, roughage intake, overall intake, average daily gain (ADG), and feed conversion ratio (FCR). Similarly, ruminal parameters showed no significant differences between the two yeast treatments, including ruminal pH, ammonia concentration, blood urea nitrogen levels, total volatile fatty acids (TVFAs), and protozoal populations. Energy efficiency and nitrogen efficiency were also unaffected by the yeast strain used (p > 0.05).ConclusionAlthough no significant differences were found, Pichia kudriavzevii KKU20, a rumen-derived yeast strain, demonstrated comparable potential to Saccharomyces cerevisiae, a widely used commercial yeast with known efficacy. This suggests that P. kudriavzevii KKU20 could be a promising alternative for ruminant nutrition.
articles.abstractZh: 【摘要】：目的:研究库德里亚毕赤酵母KKU20和酿酒酵母两种酵母菌株对稻草青贮过程的影响及其对泰国土公牛营养消化率、瘤胃发酵、能量利用率和生长性能的影响。方法将8头泰国土公牛随机分为两组:一组饲喂用毕赤酵母青贮的RS青贮饲料。 KKU20 (n = 4)，另一组饲喂用酿酒酵母青贮的 RS (n = 4)。该实验包括 18 天的适应期和随后的 60 天的喂养期。公牛接受精心配制的日粮以满足其蛋白质需求。结果在每日精料摄入量、粗饲料摄入量、总摄入量、平均日增重（ADG）和饲料转化率（FCR）方面，各组之间没有观察到显着差异（p>0.05）。同样，瘤胃参数显示两种酵母处理之间没有显着差异，包括瘤胃 pH 值、氨浓度、血液尿素氮水平、总挥发性脂肪酸 (TVFA) 和原虫种群。能源效率和氮效率也不受影响

articles.title: A genetic manipulation tool based on the GP35 recombinase for targeted gene editing in mycoplasmas of ruminants.
articles.titleZh: 一种基于 GP35 重组酶的基因操作工具，用于反刍动物支原体中的靶向基因编辑。
articles.authors: Lan S, Li Z, Jing T, Cui W, Zhang Y, Hao H, Chen R, Baz AA, Tian X, Askar H, Li B, Yan X, Gao P, Chen S, Chu Y.
articles.abstract: Pathogenic ruminant mycoplasmas are major etiological agents in cattle and small ruminants and are responsible for substantial economic losses in the livestock industry. Progress in pathogenesis research and vaccine development has been hampered by a lack of effective genetic tools. The applicability of common genome editing platforms, such as CRISPR, is inherently restricted in these organisms owing to their minimal genomes, the absence of a cell wall, and low homologous recombination efficiency. Although transposon-mediated random mutagenesis and single-base editing are currently used in the editing of bovine mycoplasma, the stochastic nature of transposons, the risk of single-base random deamination, and limitations in editing window selection hinder the genetic manipulation of bovine mycoplasma. Here, we introduce a plasmid-based methodology that employs the GP35 recombinase from bacteriophage SPP1 to mediate long single-stranded DNA (ssDNA) recombineering, thereby enabling precise gene insertions and deletions in Mycoplasma bovis, with a positive-editing rate of 77.78% - 100%. This targeted system eliminates the risk of random deamination. Leveraging this tool, we generated a panel of M. bovis mutants affecting metabolic and virulence genes and obtained key insights into Mb0564, identified as a novel adhesin. The 192 to 287 aa region of GP35 is critical for interaction with SSB. Structural conservation analysis further suggested that this GP35-ssDNA editing system possesses a high potential for translation to other ruminant pathogens. Collectively, our approach expands the existing genetic toolkit for M. bovis, advances synthetic biology and M. bovis pathobiology, facilitates vaccine development, and strengthens the control of high-impact livestock diseases in line with the One Health framework.
articles.abstractZh: 致病性反刍动物支原体是牛和小型反刍动物的主要病原体，并造成畜牧业的巨大经济损失。由于缺乏有效的遗传工具，发病机制研究和疫苗开发的进展受到阻碍。由于这些生物体基因组最小、缺乏细胞壁和同源重组效率低，常见基因组编辑平台（例如 CRISPR）的适用性本质上受到限制。虽然转座子介导的随机诱变和单碱基编辑目前用于牛支原体的编辑，但转座子的随机性、单碱基随机脱氨基的风险以及编辑窗口选择的限制阻碍了牛支原体的遗传操作。在这里，我们介绍了一种基于质粒的方法，利用噬菌体SPP1的GP35重组酶介导长单链DNA（ssDNA）重组工程，从而实现牛支原体中基因的精确插入和删除，阳性编辑率为77.78% - 100%。该目标系统消除了随机脱氨基的风险。利用这个工具，我们生成了一个

articles.title: Changes in flavor profiles and microbial community diversity throughout rice wine fermentation with Rhizopus oryzae from different sources.
articles.titleZh: 使用不同来源的米根霉发酵黄酒过程中风味特征和微生物群落多样性的变化。
articles.authors: Tong T, Hu JR, Li ZJ, Qin ZZ, Shi CH, Wang HC.
articles.abstract: This study investigates the effects of Rhizopus oryzae of different origins (liquor yeast, tobacco, and apple) on the flavor compounds and microbial community diversity during rice wine fermentation. Integrated approach analysis at 0, 3, 5, and 10 days revealed that strain origin led to distinct microbial succession patterns. At day 10, group J (liquor-derived) was dominated by Hanseniaspora and showed the highest levels of total, sweet, and umami amino acids-increases of 1.67-, 1.49-, and 3.80-fold over group P. Conversely, group Y exhibited significantly higher levels of bitter amino acids than the other two groups did. Flavor analysis indicated that groups J and P had higher ester contents than group Y did, in which context group J exhibited an ethyl butanoate concentration of 8.761 μg/mL. Correlation analysis revealed strong associations (|r| > 0.8, P < 0.05) among the abundances of key microorganisms such as Rhizopus, Bacillus, and Hanseniaspora and the formation of various amino acids and flavor compounds (e.g., 2-octanone and ethyl acetate). These findings provide a foundation for targeted flavor profiling and strain selection in rice wine production.
articles.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了不同来源的米根霉（白酒酵母、烟草和苹果）对黄酒发酵过程中风味化合物和微生物群落多样性的影响。第 0、3、5 和 10 天的综合方法分析表明，菌株起源导致了不同的微生物演替模式。第 10 天，J 组（酒源性）以 Hanseniaspora 为主，显示出最高水平的总氨基酸、甜味氨基酸和鲜味氨基酸，比 P 组增加了 1.67 倍、1.49 倍和 3.80 倍。相反，Y 组的苦味氨基酸水平显着高于其他两组。风味分析表明，J组和P组的酯含量高于Y组，其中J组的丁酸乙酯浓度为8.761 μg/mL。相关性分析显示，根霉、芽孢杆菌和汉逊酵母等关键微生物的丰度与各种氨基酸和风味化合物（例如 2-辛酮和乙酸乙酯）的形成之间存在很强的相关性（|r| > 0.8，P < 0.05）。这些发现为黄酒生产中有针对性的风味分析和菌株选择奠定了基础。

articles.title: Comparative Evaluation of Engineered Bacteria and Yeast for Oral Delivery of CRISPR/Cas9 Systems in Colon Cancer Therapy.
articles.titleZh: 结肠癌治疗中口服 CRISPR/Cas9 系统的工程细菌和酵母的比较评估。
articles.authors: Huang J, Zhang C, Li J, Ren H, Yang K, Zhang Y.
articles.abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) poses a serious threat to human health. CRISPR/Cas9 technology offers new therapeutic strategies for the management of this disease, but its oral application is severely hindered by the limitations of suitable delivery systems. Herein, we develop and compare two separate orally delivered, genetically and chemically modified CRISPR/Cas9 delivery platforms based on E. coli BL21 and P. pastoris X33, which upon colonization in the intestine, secreted extracellular vesicles carrying the Cas9 protein and ART1-targeting sgRNA for tumor-specific gene disruption. Arginine ADP-ribosyltransferase 1 (ART1) plays a crucial role in the biological regulation of colon cancer, which was for the first time to the best of our knowledge, employed in vivo as a target gene in this study. Furthermore, we employed polydopamine (PDA) coating and gastrointestinal synthetic epithelial lining systems to facilitate microbial viability and intestinal retention, establishing on site cell factories for sustained CRISPR secretion. In subcutaneous tumor-bearing murine models, both delivery systems demonstrated comparable antitumor efficacy with significant tumor suppression. Taken together, the genetically modified microbial platform using bacterial and yeast strategies shows great potential and broad therapeutic versatility, offering a promising CRISPR-based solution for CRC treatment.
articles.abstractZh: 结直肠癌（CRC）对人类健康构成严重威胁。 CRISPR/Cas9技术为治疗这种疾病提供了新的治疗策略，但其口服应用因合适的递送系统的限制而受到严重阻碍。在此，我们开发并比较了两种基于大肠杆菌 BL21 和毕赤酵母 X33 的独立口服递送、基因和化学修饰的 CRISPR/Cas9 递送平台，它们在肠道定植后，分泌携带 Cas9 蛋白和 ART1 靶向 sgRNA 的细胞外囊泡，用于肿瘤特异性基因破坏。精氨酸 ADP-核糖基转移酶 1 (ART1) 在结肠癌的生物调节中发挥着至关重要的作用，据我们所知，本研究首次在体内将其用作靶基因。此外，我们采用聚多巴胺 (PDA) 涂层和胃肠道合成上皮衬里系统来促进微生物活力和肠道保留，建立现场细胞工厂以实现 CRISPR 的持续分泌。在皮下荷瘤小鼠模型中，两种递送系统都表现出相当的抗肿瘤功效和显着的肿瘤抑制作用。综合起来，

articles.title: Cytometric proteome profiling of GFP-tagged yeast for characterizing novel antifungals.
articles.titleZh: GFP 标记酵母的细胞蛋白质组分析，用于表征新型抗真菌药物。
articles.authors: Ghazy E, Bidiuk VA, Ryabov F, Mitkevich OV, Riabova OB, Stanishevskiy YM, Levshin IB, Alexandrova LA, Jasko MV, Makarov DA, Zhgun AA, Avdanina DA, Ermolyuk AA, Kushnirov VV, Egorova AP, Agaphonov MO, Alexandrov AI.
articles.abstract: Assaying cellular responses to antimicrobial molecules is one way to understand modes of action of potential drugs. This is often achieved via transcriptomics and proteomics, but simple, inexpensive methods for rapid characterization are lacking. To bridge this gap, we assayed changes in the abundance of a panel of 64 "sentinel" proteins fused to GFP in the yeast Saccharomyces cerevisiae using flow cytometry. This method produced expected patterns for classical antifungals and allowed inference of common mechanisms between known and novel compounds. Single-cell data also revealed diverging responses in mitochondrial protein abundance in response to thiazolidine antifungals, and perturbations of the cell cycle caused by various compounds. Finally, the method provided insight into the unknown mode of action of alkylated nucleosides, which can be used against fungi residing on works of art. These substances elevate levels of proteins involved in the biosynthesis of aromatic amino acids (AAA), as well as in oxidative stress. Furthermore, deficiencies of Trp and Tyr biosynthesis increased the efficacy of these compounds, while antioxidants reduced it. Most surprisingly, antioxidant effectiveness relied on AAA biosynthesis. Thus, our approach and its possible modifications for other microbes provide an easy and reliable platform for revealing modes of action of novel compounds.
articles.abstractZh: 测定细胞对抗菌分子的反应是了解潜在药物作用模式的一种方法。这通常是通过转录组学和蛋白质组学来实现的，但缺乏简单、廉价的快速表征方法。为了弥补这一差距，我们使用流式细胞术测定了酿酒酵母中与 GFP 融合的一组 64 个“哨兵”蛋白的丰度变化。该方法产生了经典抗真菌药物的预期模式，并可以推断已知化合物和新型化合物之间的共同机制。单细胞数据还揭示了噻唑烷抗真菌药物对线粒体蛋白丰度的不同反应，以及各种化合物引起的细胞周期扰动。最后，该方法提供了对烷基化核苷未知作用模式的深入了解，可用于对抗艺术品上的真菌。这些物质会提高参与芳香氨基酸 (AAA) 生物合成以及氧化应激的蛋白质水平。此外，色氨酸和酪氨酸生物合成的缺陷增加了这些化合物的功效，而抗氧化剂则降低了其功效。最令人惊讶的是，抗氧化功效

articles.title: Development of robust dominant-metabolism compromised intermediate chassis of ethanologenic Saccharomyces cerevisiae for non-ethanol biochemical production.
articles.titleZh: 开发强大的显性代谢受损的产乙醇酿酒酵母中间底盘，用于非乙醇生化生产。
articles.authors: Zhou Q, Yan X, Wu Y, He Q, Yang S.
articles.abstract: Robust microbial cell factories (MCFs) are pivotal for sustainable biomanufacturing. The industrial model chassis Saccharomyces cerevisiae is often constrained by its dominant ethanol biosynthesis to produce other biochemicals. To overcome this limitation, we employed a dominant-metabolism compromised intermediate (DMCI) chassis strategy to reconfigure the central metabolism of S. cerevisiae. We first constructed a non-ethanol-producing DMCI chassis by integrating a heterologous 2,3-butanediol (2,3-BDO) pathway and sequentially deleting all three pyruvate decarboxylase genes (PDC1, PDC5, and PDC6). Genome-scale modeling was utilized to verify and optimize the flux distribution towards 2,3-BDO synthesis as DMCI chassis. This platform was subsequently engineered to produce various C2-C4 chemicals, including d-lactate, acetoin, and malate. Fed-batch fermentation demonstrated the industrial viability of these MCFs, achieving titers of 100, 80, 55, and 30 g/L for 2,3-BDO, d-lactate, malate, and succinate, respectively. Furthermore, to enhance the suitability for organic acid production, we employed adaptive laboratory evolution (ALE) to obtain a weak-acid tolerant mutant B3-ALE. Genomic and functional analyses of B3-ALE identified mutations in genes related to cell wall integrity, membrane trafficking, and oxidative stress response with six weak-acid tolerant biological parts. Collectively, this work establishes a versatile and robust non-ethanol producing yeast chassis with improved environmental resilience, offering a practical yeast platform and strategic guidance for the cost-effective production of value-added biochemicals.
articles.abstractZh: 强大的微生物细胞工厂（MCF）对于可持续生物制造至关重要。工业模型底盘酿酒酵母常常受到其主要的乙醇生物合成生产其他生化物质的限制。为了克服这一限制，我们采用了显性代谢受损中间体（DMCI）底盘策略来重新配置酿酒酵母的中央代谢。我们首先通过整合异源 2,3-丁二醇 (2,3-BDO) 途径并依次删除所有三个丙酮酸脱羧酶基因（PDC1、PDC5 和 PDC6）来构建不产生乙醇的 DMCI 底盘。利用基因组规模建模来验证和优化作为 DMCI 底盘的 2,3-BDO 合成的通量分布。该平台随后被设计用于生产各种 C2-C4 化学品，包括 d-乳酸、乙偶姻和苹果酸。补料分批发酵证明了这些 MCF 的工业可行性，2,3-BDO、d-乳酸、苹果酸和琥珀酸的滴度分别达到 100、80、55 和 30 g/L。此外，为了增强有机酸生产的适用性，我们采用适应性实验室进化（ALE）获得了弱酸耐受突变体B3-ALE。基因组

articles.title: Global genetic interaction network of a human cell maps conserved principles and informs functional interpretation of gene co-essentiality profiles.
articles.titleZh: 人类细胞的全局遗传相互作用网络绘制了保守原理，并为基因共必需性谱的功能解释提供了信息。
articles.authors: Billmann M, Costanzo M, Zhang X, Hassan AZ, Rahman M, Brown KR, Chan KS, Tong AHY, Pons C, Ward HN, Ross C, van Leeuwen J, Aregger M, Lawson KA, Mair B, Roth AF, Sen NE, Forster DT, Tan G, Mero P, Masud SN, Lee Y, Aguilera-Uribe M, Ušaj M, Almeida SMT, Aulakh K, Bhojoo U, Birkadze S, Budijono N, Cai X, Caumanns JJ, Chalmers JJ, Chandrashekhar M, Chang D, Climie R, Dasgupta K, Drazic A, Echenique JIR, Gacesa R, Farias AG, Habsid A, Horecka I, Kantautas K, Ji F, Kim DK, Lee SY, Liang W, Lim HJ, Lin K, Lu X, Maier M, Nami B, Nixon A, Mikolajewicz N, Mokhtaridoost M, Nedyalkova L, Rohde T, Rodrigues MS, Soste M, Schultz E, Wang W, Seetharaman A, Shuteriqi E, Sizova O, Taylor DT, Tereshchenko M, Tieu D, Turowec J, Ubhi T, Varland S, Wang KE, Wang ZY, Wei J, Xiao YX, Maass PG, Reversade B, Brown GW, Cravatt BF, Dixon SJ, Wyatt HDM, Röst HL, Roth FP, Xia T, Bader GD, Loewith R, Davis NG, Andrews B, Myers CL, Moffat J, Boone C.
articles.abstract: Deciphering how genes interact within human cells is essential for understanding their functional wiring and for developing targeted therapeutic strategies. In this study, we present a genome-scale map of genetic interactions in the human haploid cell line HAP1, based on CRISPR-based perturbation of ∼4 million gene pairs. The resulting network comprises ∼89,000 high-confidence gene-gene interactions, organizing genes into hierarchical modules corresponding to protein complexes and pathways, biological processes, and cellular compartments, mirroring principles observed in yeast and highlighting the functional architecture of a human cell. This large-scale genetic network complements the DepMap gene co-essentiality network by capturing unique functional information, uncovering roles of previously uncharacterized genes, and identifying molecular determinants of cancer-cell-line-specific genetic dependencies. This study presents a general data-driven strategy for systematically exploring the roles of genes and their functional connections in human cell lines.
articles.abstractZh: 破译基因在人类细胞内如何相互作用对于理解其功能连接和制定有针对性的治疗策略至关重要。在这项研究中，我们基于对约 400 万个基因对的 CRISPR 扰动，展示了人类单倍体细胞系 HAP1 中遗传相互作用的基因组规模图。由此产生的网络包含约 89,000 个高可信度的基因-基因相互作用，将基因组织成与蛋白质复合物和途径、生物过程和细胞区室相对应的分层模块，反映了在酵母中观察到的原理，并突出了人类细胞的功能结构。这个大规模遗传网络通过捕获独特的功能信息、揭示以前未表征的基因的作用以及识别癌细胞系特异性遗传依赖性的分子决定因素，对 DepMap 基因共本质网络进行了补充。这项研究提出了一种通用的数据驱动策略，用于系统地探索基因的作用及其在人类细胞系中的功能连接。

articles.title: Metabolic Engineering of <i>Saccharomyces cerevisiae</i> for <i>De Novo</i> Biosynthesis of Gibberellin A<sub>4</sub>.
articles.titleZh: 酿酒酵母用于De Novo赤霉素A4生物合成的代谢工程。
articles.journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
articles.authors: Dong Z, Li H, Chen Y, Zeng W, He Q, Xiong R, Zuo J, Zhou J.
articles.abstract: Gibberellin A4 (GA4), a bioactive diterpenoid phytohormone with important agricultural uses, was efficiently biosynthesized in engineered Saccharomyces cerevisiae to overcome traditional fungal fermentation limitations. We established an ent-kaurenoic acid (KA) foundation by introducing plant/fungal enzymes (e.g., XdGGPPS, GfCPS/KS, and SrKO) and enhancing the mevalonate pathway precursor supply. To optimize the metabolic flux distribution, dynamic ERG9 regulation was implemented alongside ergosterol-responsive promoter PERG1 to balance growth and production. For GA4 synthesis, fungal-derived cytochrome P450 systems demonstrated superior heterologous expression compared to plant counterparts. Multi-copy chromosomal integration and endoplasmic reticulum engineering (INO2/ICE2 overexpression and PAH1 knockout) alleviated P450 membrane saturation bottlenecks. Under optimized fermentation with nitrogen supplementation in a 5 L bioreactor, the engineered strain achieved 48.6 mg/L of GA4 production. We have established a robust platform integrating modular design, dynamic regulation, and organellar engineering for complex terpenoid biosynthesis, providing valuable insights for microbial gibberellin production.
articles.abstractZh: 赤霉素 A4 (GA4) 是一种具有重要农业用途的生物活性二萜类植物激素，在工程酿酒酵母中进行了有效的生物合成，以克服传统真菌发酵的局限性。我们通过引入植物/真菌酶（例如 XdGGPPS、GfCPS/KS 和 SrKO）并增强甲羟戊酸途径前体供应，建立了对映贝壳杉烯酸 (KA) 基础。为了优化代谢通量分布，动态 ERG9 调节与麦角甾醇响应启动子 PERG1 一起实施，以平衡生长和产量。对于 GA4 合成，与植物对应物相比，真菌来源的细胞色素 P450 系统表现出优异的异源表达。多拷贝染色体整合和内质网工程（INO2/ICE2 过表达和 PAH1 敲除）缓解了 P450 膜饱和瓶颈。在 5 L 生物反应器中补氮优化发酵下，工程菌株的 GA4 产量达到 48.6 mg/L。我们建立了一个强大的平台，集成了复杂萜类生物合成的模块化设计、动态调节和细胞器工程，为微生物提供了宝贵的见解。

articles.title: Nutritive Constituents' Variation in Main Parts of Dendrocalamus Brandisii and the Silage Fermentation for Bamboo-Based Ruminant Feed.
articles.titleZh: 布兰迪斯龙竹主要部位营养成分变化及竹基反刍动物饲料青贮发酵。
articles.authors: Guo B, Hua X, Chen Y, Zhou X, Zhang L, Yong Q, Xu Y.
articles.abstract: The booming food and feed industries strongly promote the exploration of new resources, while Dendrocalamus brandisii presents a promising potential for application for the vigorous growth and abundant harvest in Southeast Asia. To further utilize and increase the value of Dendrocalamus brandisii, firstly, main different parts were comparatively analyzed, while digestive and nutritional indexes were evaluated. As a result, bamboo shoots and leaves contain 26.3% and 20.7% of crude protein, respectively. The relative feed values of bamboo leaves, leaf stems, shoots shells and shoots all exceed 80%. As analyzed, bamboo leaves were promising for producing feed. Afterwards, the silage fermentation of bamboo leaves was carried out, during which the effects of different additives and the changes in nutritive index of bamboo leaves were investigated. By fermenting with composite bacterial inoculum of Lacticaseibacillus paracasei, Saccharomyces cerevisiae and Bacillus subtilis, neutral-detergent fiber and acid-detergent fiber in leaves were decreased significantly by 22.68%~30.36% to produce 55.03 ~ 89.47 g/kg organic acids with over 60 g/kg domination of lactic acid, while crude protein was maintained well. The exogenous cellulase assisted Lacticaseibacillus paracesei fermentation exhibited the fastest decrease in pH (3.68) and the highest lactic acid content (78.68 g/kg). This study provides foundational data on Dendrocalamus brandisii's nutritive composition and demonstrates the feasibility of bamboo leaf-based feed production with potential for scaled implementation in bunkers. Moreover, this approach can facilitate the utilization of sustainable bamboo resource by converting it into high-value feed product and reduce pressure on conventional agricultural system.
articles.abstractZh: 食品、饲料工业的蓬勃发展有力地促进了新资源的开发，而布兰氏龙竹在东南亚地区的蓬勃发展和丰收具有广阔的应用潜力。为进一步利用和提高布兰氏龙竹的价值，首先对布兰氏龙竹的主要不同部位进行了比较分析，并对消化指标和营养指标进行了评价。因此，竹笋和竹叶分别含有26.3%和20.7%的粗蛋白。竹叶、叶茎、笋壳、竹笋的相对饲料价值均超过80%。据分析，竹叶有望用于生产饲料。然后对竹叶进行青贮发酵，考察不同添加剂的效果以及竹叶营养指标的变化。采用副干酪乳杆菌、酿酒酵母和枯草芽孢杆菌复合菌剂发酵，叶片中去污纤维和酸去污纤维显着减少22.68%~30.36%，产生55.03~89.47 g/kg有机酸，其中乳酸占60 g/kg以上，粗蛋白含量降低。

articles.title: Advancing transcriptional regulation in <i>Yarrowia lipolytica</i>: from endogenous promoter discovery to synthetic promoter engineering.
articles.titleZh: 推进解脂耶氏酵母的转录调控：从内源启动子发现到合成启动子工程。
articles.authors: Yan J, Liu J, Kang F, Liang Q, Cui Z, Qi Q.
articles.abstract: As an unconventional yeast, Yarrowia lipolytica is increasingly used in biomanufacturing high-value chemicals, including organic acids, sugar alcohols, fatty acid derivatives, and terpenes, owing to its unique physiological and biochemical properties. However, fine-tuning its biosynthetic pathways requires advanced transcriptional regulatory tools, with promoters being the most essential component. Numerous studies have sought to characterize promoter sequences by breaking them into distinct functional elements, while also constructing stronger and inducible synthetic promoters through rational design, modification, and optimization. This review summarizes the progress in discovering endogenous and engineering synthetic promoters in Y. lipolytica. We highlight emerging strategies such as hybrid promoter engineering, core promoter engineering, and transcription factor-based promoter engineering, which expand the promoter toolbox with enhanced properties. Finally, we address the current state of research and identify potential future directions in this field.
articles.abstractZh: 作为一种非常规酵母，解脂耶氏酵母因其独特的生理生化特性，越来越多地应用于生物制造高价值化学品，包括有机酸、糖醇、脂肪酸衍生物和萜烯。然而，微调其生物合成途径需要先进的转录调控工具，而启动子是最重要的组成部分。许多研究试图通过将启动子序列分解成不同的功能元件来表征启动子序列，同时通过合理的设计、修饰和优化构建更强的、可诱导的合成启动子。本综述总结了在解脂耶氏酵母中发现内源和工程合成启动子的进展。我们重点介绍混合启动子工程、核心启动子工程和基于转录因子的启动子工程等新兴策略，这些策略扩展了具有增强特性的启动子工具箱。最后，我们讨论了当前的研究状况并确定了该领域未来潜在的方向。

articles.title: Structural reconfiguration of gluten-starch matrices driven by yeast fermentation and its effects on quality of fermented dried noodles.
articles.titleZh: 酵母发酵驱动的面筋-淀粉基质结构重构及其对发酵挂面品质的影响
articles.authors: Zhang G, Zhao P, Zhu L, Wang Z, Wang J, Wu Z.
articles.abstract: This study aimed to systemically investigate the effects of yeast fermentation (0-2% yeast, flour basis; 0.5-2 h) on gluten and starch structures, and cooking and textural properties of fermented dried noodles (FDN). Yeast fermentation altered gluten structure mainly through glutathione (GSH)-mediated reduction of disulfide bonds, causing a decrease in glutenin macropolymer (GMP) content (1.79%-1.47% at 2% yeast). Starch granules exhibited surface pitting and abrasions, increased short-range order, and swelling power (increased by 17%) compared with the control. These structural changes promoted porous microstructures, extended cooking time, enhanced water absorption, and reduced hardness and cooking loss. The effects varied with yeast concentration: higher levels (1.5-2%) reduced gas-holding capacity and porosity. Notably, fermentation time (0.5-2 h) had no significant impact on FDN quality attributes. Collectively, yeast concentration was found to be the dominant factor, providing new mechanistic insights and theoretical support for optimizing yeast fermentation in FDN production.
articles.abstractZh: 本研究旨在系统研究酵母发酵（0-2% 酵母，面粉基；0.5-2 小时）对发酵挂面 (FDN) 的面筋和淀粉结构以及烹饪和质地特性的影响。酵母发酵主要通过谷胱甘肽 (GSH) 介导的二硫键还原来改变面筋结构，导致麦谷蛋白大聚物 (GMP) 含量下降（2% 酵母时为 1.79%-1.47%）。与对照相比，淀粉颗粒表现出表面点蚀和磨损、短程有序性增加和溶胀力（增加17%）。这些结构变化促进了多孔微观结构，延长了蒸煮时间，增强了吸水性，并降低了硬度和蒸煮损失。效果因酵母浓度而异：较高浓度 (1.5-2%) 会降低气体保持能力和孔隙率。值得注意的是，发酵时间（0.5-2 小时）对 FDN 质量属性没有显着影响。总的来说，酵母浓度被发现是主导因素，为优化 FDN 生产中的酵母发酵提供了新的机制见解和理论支持。

articles.title: Constructing an efficient synthesis pathway in peroxisomes to boost <i>β</i>-myrcene production in yeast.
articles.titleZh: 在过氧化物酶体中构建有效的合成途径以促进酵母中β-月桂烯的生产。
articles.authors: Chang J, Wang J, Dong T, Shu Y, Wang Y, Xiao W, Yao M, Yuan Y.
articles.abstract: β-Myrcene is a key acyclic monoterpene that has been extensively applied in the agricultural pesticide, fragrance, and flavor industries; it also serves as a critical monoterpene precursor of high-value compounds. Our lab previously successfully achieved β-myrcene biosynthesis in the peroxisomes of Saccharomyces cerevisiae. However, the titer remained limited by the supply and utilization of precursors in peroxisomes. In this study, an efficient and stable β-myrcene biosynthetic pathway was constructed through the multicopy integration of the fusion protein MS-ERG20ww (β-myrcene synthase) with peroxisome localization into Ty1 loci. This approach improved the supply and utilization of geranyl pyrophosphate (GPP) precursors, resulting in a 2-fold increase in the β-myrcene titer to 82.53 ± 3.78 mg/L. A new mevalonate (MVA) pathway was subsequently constructed for β-myrcene production by localizing truncated 3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl-CoA reductase (tHMGR) to peroxisomes, resulting in a 1.2-fold increase in the titer. In addition, KAR2 (ER chaperones) and GSH2 (reduced glutathione synthase) overexpression in chassis increased the β-myrcene titer to 176.40 ± 17.56 mg/L. Finally, 15-L fed-batch fermentation optimization increased the β-myrcene titer to 4.7 g/L, which represents the highest level yet reported. This work provides a comprehensive framework for engineering yeast cell factories, highlighting the ability of integrated metabolic engineering to enhance high-value monoterpene production.

articles.title: DcMYB5 transcription factor regulates the biosynthesis of diosgenin by directly repressing CYP90B gene expression in Dioscorea composita.
articles.titleZh: DcMYB5 转录因子通过直接抑制薯蓣中 CYP90B 基因的表达来调节薯蓣皂苷元的生物合成。
articles.authors: Cao Y, Zhang J, Yu S, Zhong C, Xie J.
articles.abstract: Key messageDcMYB5 regulates diosgenin biosynthesis in Dioscorea composita by binding to the DcCYP90B promoter and repressing its transcription. Diosgenin is an important bioactive metabolite in Dioscorea with significant pharmaceutical and ecological value. However, the transcriptional regulatory mechanisms of its biosynthesis remain poorly understood. Here, we identified and characterized an SG5 subgroup R2R3-MYB transcription factor (TF) from Dioscorea composita, designated DcMYB5. Sequence and phylogenetic analyses identified DcMYB5 as a MYB5-type SG5 MYB TF with typical R2R3 conserved domains but lacking the C3 motif at the C-terminus. Functional gene silencing and overexpression experiments validated that DcMYB5 modulates the biosynthesis of diosgenin and its derivatives, along with tuber growth. Dual-luciferase and yeast one-hybrid assays further indicated that DcMYB5 binds to the DcCYP90B promoter and represses its transcription, thereby regulating diosgenin accumulation. Overall, this study provides new insights into how R2R3-MYB TFs coordinate steroidal metabolism with growth in D. composita and delivers an actionable molecular target for agricultural biotechnology to enhance high-value steroidal saponin production.
articles.abstractZh: 关键信息DcMYB5 通过与 DcCYP90B 启动子结合并抑制其转录来调节薯蓣中的薯蓣皂苷元生物合成。薯蓣皂苷元是薯蓣中重要的生物活性代谢产物，具有重要的药用和生态价值。然而，其生物合成的转录调控机制仍知之甚少。在这里，我们鉴定并表征了来自薯蓣的 SG5 亚组 R2R3-MYB 转录因子 (TF)，命名为 DcMYB5。序列和系统发育分析将 DcMYB5 鉴定为 MYB5 型 SG5 MYB TF，具有典型的 R2R3 保守结构域，但在 C 末端缺乏 C3 基序。功能基因沉默和过表达实验验证了 DcMYB5 调节薯蓣皂苷元及其衍生物的生物合成以及块茎生长。双荧光素酶和酵母单杂交检测进一步表明，DcMYB5 与 DcCYP90B 启动子结合并抑制其转录，从而调节薯蓣皂苷元的积累。总的来说，这项研究提供了关于 R2R3-MYB TF 如何协调类固醇代谢与 D. composita 生长的新见解，并为农业生物技术提供了一个可行的分子靶标，以增强

articles.title: Improved identification of Saccharomyces species and hybrids using MALDI-TOF MS.
articles.titleZh: 使用 MALDI-TOF MS 改进了酵母菌属物种和杂交种的鉴定。
articles.authors: Wang JC, Zhang XH, Shang YJ, Wang QM.
articles.abstract: Accurate identification of Saccharomyces species is critical for food fermentation and brewing, especially for closely related species and interspecific hybrids with distinct technological properties. In this study, a custom MALDI-TOF MS database was constructed to improve the identification of Saccharomyces yeasts and was systematically evaluated using laboratory collections. Compared with a commercial reference library, the customized database markedly enhanced species-level discrimination across the genus. While automated database matching showed limitations in distinguishing the hybrid Saccharomyces pastorianus from its parental species, detailed peak-level analysis revealed robust and reproducible hybrid-specific spectral patterns. Specifically, S. pastorianus consistently displayed the co-occurrence of parental diagnostic peaks (6210 m/z and 6185 m/z), providing a biologically interpretable signature that was conserved across reference strains and commercial lager yeasts. Intraspecific analysis of S. cerevisiae further revealed that mass spectral profiles are structured by phylogenetic origin, ecological niche, and fermentation context, suggesting that MALDI-TOF MS can capture signatures linked to ecological adaptation. This study demonstrates that MALDI-TOF MS, when combined with targeted database construction and informed spectral interpretation, is a powerful tool for identifying Saccharomyces species of relevance to food and fermentation systems.
articles.abstractZh: 准确鉴定酵母菌物种对于食品发酵和酿造至关重要，特别是对于密切相关的物种和具有独特技术特性的种间杂种。在本研究中，构建了定制的 MALDI-TOF MS 数据库以改进酵母菌的鉴定，并使用实验室收藏进行系统评估。与商业参考库相比，定制数据库显着增强了跨属的物种级别歧视。虽然自动数据库匹配显示了区分杂交巴斯德酵母与其亲本物种的局限性，但详细的峰水平分析揭示了稳健且可重复的杂交特异性光谱模式。具体而言，巴斯德酵母始终表现出亲本诊断峰（6210 m/z 和 6185 m/z）的共现，提供了在参考菌株和商业啤酒酵母中保守的生物学可解释的特征。酿酒酵母的种内分析进一步揭示了质谱图谱是由系统发育起源、生态位和发酵背景构建的，这表明 MALDI-TOF MS 可以捕获

articles.title: Isotope In-Phase/Opposite-Phase-Edited 2D <sup>1</sup>H-<sup>1</sup>H (<sup>12</sup>C/<sup>13</sup>C) TOCSY and Complementary 1D <sup>1</sup>H Selective NMR Experiments for Carbon Tracing in Complex Samples.
articles.titleZh: 同位素同相/异相编辑的 2D <sup>1</sup>H-<sup>1</sup>H (<sup>12</sup>C/<sup>13</sup>C) TOCSY 和互补 1D <sup>1</sup>H 选择性 NMR 实验，用于复杂样品中的碳示踪。
articles.authors: Steiner K, Bermel W, Wolff WW, Costa PM, Lysak DH, Pellizzari J, Terry C, Dowd WW, Downey K, Jenne A, Ronda K, Vander Meulen O, Jaeger E, Thompson S, Haber A, Busse V, Busse F, Simpson MJ, Simpson AJ.
articles.abstract: Nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR)-based 13C tracing is widely used in medicine, metabolomics, and environmental research. Here, we introduce a 2D 1H-1H (12C/13C) "in-phase/opposite-phase" (IP/OP) TOCSY experiment that uniquely generates 2D subspectra discriminating 13C-13C, 12C-13C, and 12C-12C connectivity. The sequence was demonstrated first on a standard mixture of 50/50 13C-phenylalanine and 1-13C-glucose, followed by an in vivo ethanol fermentation using brewer's yeast (Saccharomyces cerevisiae) with 1-13C-glucose. Finally, incorporation of 13C in marine copepods (Tigriopus californicus) was monitored ex vivo. Copepods were analyzed at natural abundance and again on 7 days of feeding >98% 13C-enriched green algae. The sequence successfully identified three carbon pools: intact fragments or molecules from the 13C diet (13C-13C), intact fragments from pre-existing biomass (12C-12C), and new bond formation between 12C and 13C molecules during metabolite turnover (12C-13C). Molecules involved in osmotic regulation, alanine, proline, glycine, choline, betaine, and TMAO, were particularly abundant in the 12C-13C pool, suggesting rapid turnover by combining 13C food with existing 12C biomass. This was supported by a quantitative 1D 1H-(12C/13C) IP/OP experiment, measuring average enrichment of the six osmolytes at 22.8 ± 0.1% 13C on day 7. A complementary "singlet-only" experiment quantified glycine at 27.4 ± 0.2% 13C and betaine at 3.7 ± 0.4% 13C, enabling detection of molecules without scalar couplings. In summary, the 2D 1H-1H IP/OP TOCSY simultaneously identified pre-existing and newly synthesized molecules, while 1D experiments provide quantitative support, offering a sensitive framework to study carbon dynamics, preservation, and transformation in complex in vivo and ex vivo processes.
articles.abstractZh: 基于核磁共振 (NMR) 的 13C 示踪广泛应用于医学、代谢组学和环境研究。在这里，我们介绍了 2D 1H-1H (12C/13C)“同相/异相”(IP/OP) TOCSY 实验，该实验独特地生成区分 13C-13C、12C-13C 和 12C-12C 连接性的 2D 子光谱。首先在 50/50 13C-苯丙氨酸和 1-13C-葡萄糖的标准混合物上验证了该序列，然后使用啤酒酵母（酿酒酵母）与 1-13C-葡萄糖进行体内乙醇发酵。最后，离体监测了海洋桡足类动物（Tigriopus californicus）中 13C 的掺入情况。在自然丰度下对桡足类进行了分析，并在喂食 >98% 富含 13C 的绿藻 7 天后再次进行了分析。该序列成功识别了三个碳库：来自 13C 饮食的完整片段或分子 (13C-13C)、来自预先存在的生物质的完整片段 (12C-12C) 以及代谢物周转过程中 12C 和 13C 分子之间新的键形成 (12C-13C)。参与渗透调节的分子、丙氨酸、脯氨酸、甘氨酸、胆碱、甜菜碱和TMAO在 12C-13C 库中特别丰富，表明通过将 13C 食物与现有 12C 结合起来可以快速周转

articles.title: Iterative evolution of <i>Saccharomyces cerevisiae</i> enhances recombinant protease secretion.
articles.titleZh: 酿酒酵母的迭代进化增强了重组蛋白酶的分泌。
articles.authors: Liu X, Lian M, Zeng J, Zheng L, Zhao M, Huang M.
articles.abstract: Efficient secretion of heterologous proteases in S. cerevisiae remains a major bottleneck due to host cytotoxicity and secretory stress. In this study, we developed a yeast chassis strain through three rounds of iterative evolution, combining ultraviolet (UV) and atmospheric and room temperature plasma (ARTP) mutagenesis with a fluorescence-based screening pipeline. The final strain, MA10Ah121, exhibited protease production nearly three times that of its parental strain LB184M and maintained genetic stability across passages. Importantly, MA10Ah121 supported enhanced expression of two structurally distinct collagenases, ColG (Class I) and ColH (Class II), demonstrating its broad utility for recombinant protease production. Whole-genome sequencing revealed substantial chromosomal remodeling, including reversion of a 151 kb duplication enriched in genes related to energy metabolism and protein synthesis, along with widespread structural variations. These changes reflect a genome-wide adaptation that rebalances biosynthetic capacity and stress tolerance. This work provides a robust and versatile S. cerevisiae chassis for the biosynthesis of proteases and other challenging recombinant enzymes in industrial biotechnology applications.
articles.abstractZh: 由于宿主细胞毒性和分泌应激，酿酒酵母中异源蛋白酶的有效分泌仍然是一个主要瓶颈。在这项研究中，我们通过三轮迭代进化，将紫外线（UV）、大气和室温等离子体（ARTP）诱变与基于荧光的筛选流程相结合，开发了一种酵母底盘菌株。最终菌株 MA10Ah121 的蛋白酶产量几乎是其亲本菌株 LB184M 的三倍，并且在传代中保持了遗传稳定性。重要的是，MA10Ah121 支持两种结构不同的胶原酶 ColG（I 类）和 ColH（II 类）的增强表达，证明了其在重组蛋白酶生产中的广泛用途。全基因组测序揭示了显着的染色体重塑，包括富含与能量代谢和蛋白质合成相关基因的 151 kb 重复的逆转，以及广泛的结构变异。这些变化反映了全基因组的适应，重新平衡了生物合成能力和应激耐受性。这项工作为蛋白酶和其他具有挑战性的重组体的生物合成提供了强大且多功能的酿酒酵母底盘

articles.title: Statistical optimization of exopolysaccharides by indigenously isolated Lactobacillus strain under submerged fermentation.
articles.titleZh: 深层发酵下本地分离的乳杆菌菌株胞外多糖的统计优化。
articles.authors: Awan MZ, Tabssum F, Nadeem M, Ullah N, Sarwar A, Mazhar N, Aziz T, Shami A, Sagini HA, Alsanie SA, Alharbi NA, Albalji M.
articles.abstract: Exopolysaccharides are classified as high molecular weight polymers of carbohydrates. The aim of the present study was the isolation of exopolysaccharides (EPS) producing strain from fruits and vegetables indigenously and optimization of physical parameters for the hyperproduction of EPS. Yeast Industrial wastewater from AB Mauri (Associated British Foods) was used as substrate for the production of EPS. Fruits and vegetables source were used for isolation of Lactobacillus strain. The morphological examination and 16 S RNA sequence analysis were used to identify the isolated Lactobacillus strain. The screening of nitrogen (organic, inorganic) was carried out for the production of EPS. A statistical approach of optimization the Response Surface Methodology (RSM) was applied to optimize the physiochemical parameters such as nitrogen concentration, pH, temperature, and incubation period in order to maximize the production. Further the effect of various parameters were studied at lab scale bioreactor to enhance the production. Isolated strain was gram positive rods and identified as Lactobacillus fermentum-MH473306.1. It was determined that urea as the best source of nitrogen. The optimized condition for maximum production of EPS the ideal pH, temperature, nitrogen supply, and incubation period were 7, 35 °C, 1.5%, and 35 h, respectively. Almost 2 folds increase in EPS production was observed after optimization of this optimal condition by RSM. Lab scale bioreactor revealed maximum production of EPS at 200 rpm and 72 h by the isolated strain of L. fermentum MH473306. It is concluded that RSM is a better technique for optimization of EPS as compared to other technique of optimization.
articles.abstractZh: 胞外多糖被归类为碳水化合物的高分子量聚合物。本研究的目的是从水果和蔬菜中分离出胞外多糖（EPS）生产菌株，并优化物理参数以实现胞外多糖的超产。 AB Mauri（英国联合食品公司）的酵母工业废水被用作 EPS 生产的底物。使用水果和蔬菜来源来分离乳酸杆菌菌株。通过形态学检查和16S RNA序列分析对分离的乳杆菌菌株进行鉴定。 EPS生产中对氮（有机、无机）进行了筛选。应用响应面法 (RSM) 优化统计方法来优化氮浓度、pH、温度和培养时间等理化参数，以最大限度地提高产量。此外，在实验室规模的生物反应器中研究了各种参数的影响，以提高产量。分离菌株为革兰氏阳性杆菌，鉴定为发酵乳杆菌-MH473306.1。确定尿素为最佳氮源。最佳选择

articles.title: Antifungal mechanism against Candida albicans and antitumor activity of phenazines produced by Pseudomonas sp. strain DH.
articles.titleZh: 针对白色念珠菌的抗真菌机制和假单胞菌产生的吩嗪的抗肿瘤活性。菌株DH。
articles.journal: International microbiology : the official journal of the Spanish Society for Microbiology
articles.authors: Zhu LY, Xue JY.
articles.abstract: Candida albicans, a commensal yeast, causes severe infections especially in immunocompromised patients, and microbial secondary metabolites offer sustainable sources for novel antifungal development. This study investigated the antifungal activity against C. albicans CMCC98001 and antitumor potential of phenazines from Pseudomonas sp. strain DH. At 20 µg/mL, 1-hydroxyphenazine (2) and phenazine-1-carboxamide (3) inhibited Aurora-A kinase (a key mitotic regulator). Conversely, they showed no inhibitory effect on JAK2, a distinct tyrosine kinase involved in cytokine signaling. This selectivity suggests that the anti-proliferative effects of these compounds are likely mediated through the induction of mitotic disruption rather than through broad off-target kinase inhibition, highlighting their potential as specific leads for anti-cancer therapy. Phenazine-1-carboxylic acid (1) displayed potent antifungal activity, showing a zone of inhibition of 25.33 ± 0.38 mm at 25 µg/mL, with an MIC of 4 µg/mL and an MFC of 8 µg/mL. It reduced dehydrogenase activity (72.05–69.51%), increased leakage of water-soluble proteins (11.18–14.18%), DNA (6.18–7.51%), and rapid K⁺efflux (5.51% within 30 min). TEM revealed severe cellular damage at 6.25 µg/mL, including membrane disruption, thinned cell walls, cytoplasmic dispersion, and cavitation. Metabolomics identified 43 differential metabolites (e.g., ergosterol) and 8 perturbed pathways (notably terpenoid backbone and steroid biosynthesis) relative to the untreated control, suggesting that treatment disrupts fungal cell membrane integrity while simultaneously impairing energy metabolism (glycolysis/gluconeogenesis, pyruvate, and methane metabolism) and nucleotide biosynthesis, including a significant reduction in ergosterol, which correlates with the observed disruption of the terpenoid backbone and steroid biosynthesis pathways. RT-PCR confirmed downregulation of ERG24 (sterol synthesis), APM1, CHS8 (cell wall), and YPT72 (vesicular transport). These findings elucidate phenazine-1-carboxylic acid’s multifaceted antifungal mechanism—disrupting membrane integrity, inducing component leakage, perturbing metabolic pathways, and downregulating key genes—and support its potential as a sustainable antifungal agent.
articles.abstractZh: 白色念珠菌是一种共生酵母，会引起严重感染，尤其是在免疫功能低下的患者中，微生物次级代谢产物为新型抗真菌药物的开发提供了可持续的来源。本研究调查了来自假单胞菌的吩嗪对白色念珠菌 CMCC98001 的抗真菌活性和抗肿瘤潜力。菌株DH。在 20 µg/mL 浓度下，1-羟基吩嗪 (2) 和吩嗪-1-甲酰胺 (3) 可抑制 Aurora-A 激酶（一种关键的有丝分裂调节剂）。相反，它们对 JAK2（一种参与细胞因子信号转导的独特酪氨酸激酶）没有显示出抑制作用。这种选择性表明这些化合物的抗增殖作用可能是通过诱导有丝分裂破坏而不是通过广泛的脱靶激酶抑制来介导的，这凸显了它们作为抗癌治疗的特定先导化合物的潜力。吩嗪-1-羧酸 (1) 显示出有效的抗真菌活性，在 25 µg/mL 浓度下的抑制区为 25.33 ± 0.38 mm，MIC 为 4 µg/mL，MFC 为 8 µg/mL。它降低了脱氢酶活性 (72.05–69.51%)，增加了水溶性蛋白质 (11.18–14.18%)、DNA (6.18–7.51%) 的泄漏，以及快速 K⁺ 流出（30 分钟内 5.51%）

articles.title: Decoding the Functional Proteome of <i>Vitis</i>: Past, Present, and Future.
articles.titleZh: 解码Vitis的功能蛋白质组：过去、现在和未来。
articles.authors: Tomaz I, Jeromel A, Vončina D, Habuš Jerčić I, Lazarević B, Šikuten I, Hofer Geušić S, Preiner D.
articles.abstract: Proteomic research in the genus Vitis has progressed from early biochemical studies of soluble proteins to high-resolution, quantitative analyses encompassing all major organs and derived products. This review provides a comprehensive synthesis of advances in grapevine and wine proteomics. In leaves, studies have revealed extensive remodeling of photosynthetic, antioxidant, and defense pathways under biotic (e.g., Plasmopara viticola, Erysiphe necator, Xylella fastidiosa, Candidatus Phytoplasma vitis) and abiotic stresses (drought, salinity, heat, light). Bud proteomics elucidated hormonal regulation and mechanisms of dormancy release, while root studies identified nitrate-dependent metabolic shifts and adaptive protein networks. Cell culture models enabled controlled investigation of elicitor responses, stilbene biosynthesis, and temperature-induced proteome changes. In berries, proteomics clarified developmental transitions from fruit set to ripening, emphasizing proteins related to secondary metabolism, vacuolar transport, and stress tolerance. Comparative analyses across cultivars and environments identified biomarkers linked to aroma, color, and texture. The wine proteome revealed selective persistence of grape-derived proteins (e.g., thaumatin-like proteins, chitinases) and yeast peptides influencing stability and sensory properties, while Botrytis cinerea infection significantly alters this balance by degrading PR proteins and introducing fungal enzymes. Altogether, the Vitis proteome emerges as a dynamic, multifunctional system crucial for understanding plant adaptation, enological quality, and biomarker discovery.
articles.abstractZh: 葡萄属的蛋白质组学研究已从可溶性蛋白质的早期生化研究发展到涵盖所有主要器官和衍生产品的高分辨率定量分析。这篇综述全面综合了葡萄和葡萄酒蛋白质组学的进展。研究表明，在生物胁迫（例如，葡萄生单轴霉、白粉菌、木霉、葡萄植原体）和非生物胁迫（干旱、盐度、热、光）下，叶子的光合作用、抗氧化和防御途径发生了广泛的重塑。芽蛋白质组学阐明了激素调节和休眠释放机制，而根研究则确定了硝酸盐依赖性代谢变化和适应性蛋白质网络。细胞培养模型能够对激发子反应、二苯乙烯生物合成和温度诱导的蛋白质组变化进行受控研究。在浆果中，蛋白质组学阐明了从坐果到成熟的发育转变，强调与次生代谢、液泡运输和胁迫耐受性相关的蛋白质。跨品种和环境的比较分析确定了与香气、颜色和质地相关的生物标志物。葡萄酒蛋白质组研究

articles.title: Effect of nitrogen status on competitive abilities between indigenous and commercial wine strains in alcoholic fermentation.
articles.titleZh: 氮状态对本土和商业葡萄酒菌株在酒精发酵中竞争能力的影响。
articles.authors: Sun X, Chen X, Lan Y, Duan C, Yan G.
articles.abstract: Nitrogen is the most limiting nutrient for yeast in alcoholic fermentation, but its roles in strain competitiveness during co-fermentation remains poorly explored. This study aimed to investigate the effects of nitrogen concentration and composition on the competitive fitness of indigenous and commercial S. cerevisiae strains in mixed fermentation from phenotypic to molecular levels. The indigenous strain G23 and the commercial strain RX60 were dominant under high‑nitrogen (HN) and low-nitrogen (LN) conditions, respectively, and single ammonium addition restored the competitiveness of G23 achieved in HN condition. Transcriptomic analysis indicated that the dominant strains at specific conditions exhibited overexpression of nitrogen permease genes (e.g., GAP1, DIP5, MEP1, MEP2, and MEP3) regulated by nitrogen catabolite repression (NCR), accompanied by activation of the positive transcriptional factor GAT1 and repression of the negative factor DAL80. Comparative genomics identified non-synonymous mutations in TOR1 between the two strains, and their differential TORC1 signaling activity (the main NCR regulator) was further verified by rapamycin tolerance assays. These findings suggested that the NCR-regulated nitrogen uptake capacity was a key determinant of the competition fitness between indigenous and commercial strains. This study sheds light on the critical function of nitrogen status on wine S. cerevisiae strain competitiveness in alcoholic fermentation, providing a new perspective for the rational selection and breeding of strains with superior colonization ability.
articles.abstractZh: 氮是酒精发酵中酵母最受限制的营养物质，但其在共发酵过程中菌株竞争力中的作用仍鲜为人知。本研究旨在从表型到分子水平研究氮浓度和组成对本地和商业酿酒酵母菌株在混合发酵中的竞争适应性的影响。本土菌株G23和商业菌株RX60分别在高氮（HN）和低氮（LN）条件下占优势，单铵添加恢复了G23在HN条件下的竞争力。转录组分析表明，特定条件下的优势菌株表现出受氮分解代谢物抑制（NCR）调节的氮渗透酶基因（例如GAP1、DIP5、MEP1、MEP2和MEP3）的过度表达，同时伴随着正转录因子GAT1的激活和负转录因子DAL80的抑制。比较基因组学鉴定了两个菌株之间 TOR1 的非同义突变，并且通过雷帕霉素耐受性测定进一步验证了它们差异的 TORC1 信号活性（主要 NCR 调节因子）。这些发现表明

articles.title: Efficient Secretory Expression of Soybean Peroxidase in <i>Saccharomyces cerevisiae</i> Through Systematic Engineering.
articles.titleZh: 通过系统工程在酿酒酵母中高效分泌表达大豆过氧化物酶。
articles.journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
articles.authors: Luo J, Hu B, Zhou J, Li J, Chen J, Du G, Zhao X.
articles.abstract: Soybean peroxidase (SBP), a thermostable and pH-robust enzyme, holds promise as a biopolymer cross-linking agent. This study pioneers the secretory expression of SBP in Saccharomyces cerevisiae, a GRAS (generally recognized as safe) microbial host. To address expression bottlenecks, a synthetic hybrid promoter was designed through modular assembly, enabling stringent glucose-dependent repression and high induction ratios. Transcriptional efficiency was further optimized via systematic terminator screening to enhance mRNA stability. Furthermore, the signal peptide was systematically redesigned by coordinating the functions of the prepeptide and pro-peptide to enhance endoplasmic reticulum transport and secretion flux. Finally, the engineered strain achieved a maximal extracellular SBP activity of 18358.03 U/L in fed-batch bioreactor cultivation. Functional validation demonstrated the ability of recombinant enzyme to mediate covalent cross-linking between α-lactalbumin and wheat arabinoxylan. This systematic engineering framework establishes a paradigm for overcoming secretion bottlenecks in heterologous protein production for food and biomanufacturing systems.
articles.abstractZh: 大豆过氧化物酶 (SBP) 是一种耐热且耐 pH 值强的酶，有望作为生物聚合物交联剂。这项研究开创了 SBP 在酿酒酵母（一种 GRAS（通常被认为是安全的）微生物宿主）中的分泌表达。为了解决表达瓶颈，通过模块化组装设计了合成杂合启动子，从而实现严格的葡萄糖依赖性抑制和高诱导率。通过系统终止子筛选进一步优化转录效率以增强 mRNA 稳定性。此外，通过协调前肽和前肽的功能，系统地重新设计了信号肽，以增强内质网转运和分泌通量。最终，工程菌株在分批补料生物反应器培养中实现了最大胞外SBP活性18358.03 U/L。功能验证证明重组酶能够介导 α-乳清蛋白和小麦阿拉伯木聚糖之间的共价交联。该系统工程框架为克服食品和生物制造系统的异源蛋白质生产中的分泌瓶颈建立了范例。

articles.title: Engineering Saccharomyces cerevisiae secretory system for recombinant protein production: strategies from signal peptides to protease control.
articles.titleZh: 用于重组蛋白生产的酿酒酵母分泌系统工程：从信号肽到蛋白酶控制的策略。
articles.authors: Sahu U, Sharma S, Pandey SC, Khare P.
articles.abstract: Saccharomyces cerevisiae remains one of the most widely used eukaryotic platforms for recombinant protein production because of its GRAS status, genetic accessibility, and ability to perform post-translational modification. Despite these advantages, secretion of heterologous proteins is frequently limited by inefficient ER folding, trafficking bottlenecks, and proteolytic degradation. This review critically examines both established and emerging strategies aimed at overcoming these barriers, with particular emphasis on signal peptide selection and design, engineering of the early secretory pathway, and control of vacuolar and Golgi-associated proteases. Rather than treating these approaches in isolation, we integrate growing evidence showing that secretion efficiency is governed by coordinated interactions between signal sequences, folding capacity, vesicular transport, and degradation pathways. Recent advances demonstrate that single genetic interventions are rarely sufficient, and that improved secretion outcomes are more consistently achieved through combinatorial strain engineering, fusion-based designs, and pathway-level optimization. Finally, we highlight emerging computational and data-driven tools, including machine learning–guided signal peptide design and predictive models for folding and trafficking bottlenecks, which offer new opportunities for rational host optimization. Together, these insights provide a framework for developing more robust yeast secretion platforms capable of supporting complex recombinant proteins.
articles.abstractZh: 由于其 GRAS 状态、遗传可及性以及进行翻译后修饰的能力，酿酒酵母仍然是最广泛使用的重组蛋白生产真核平台之一。尽管有这些优点，异源蛋白的分泌常常受到内质网折叠效率低下、运输瓶颈和蛋白水解降解的限制。这篇综述批判性地审查了旨在克服这些障碍的既定策略和新兴策略，特别强调信号肽的选择和设计、早期分泌途径的工程以及液泡和高尔基体相关蛋白酶的控制。我们不是孤立地处理这些方法，而是整合了越来越多的证据，表明分泌效率是由信号序列、折叠能力、囊泡运输和降解途径之间的协调相互作用控制的。最近的进展表明，单一的基因干预很少是足够的，并且通过组合菌株工程、基于融合的设计和途径水平优化可以更一致地实现改善的分泌结果。最后，我们强调新兴计算

articles.title: From modular engineering to practical applications: Advances in GPCR-based yeast biosensors.
articles.titleZh: 从模块化工程到实际应用：基于 GPCR 的酵母生物传感器的进展。
articles.authors: Zhang Y, Liu W, Wen S, Li Y, Lian J, Shen Y, Fu X.
articles.abstract: G protein-coupled receptors (GPCRs) are pivotal biosensing elements for biosensors due to their high ligand sensitivity and specificity. Capitalizing on these attributes, GPCR-based yeast biosensors have emerged as a powerful platform that combines conserved eukaryotic GPCR signaling with the superior genetic tractability of yeast. This synergy has accelerated the development of biosensors for diverse ligands and spurred continuous efforts to optimize their performance. This review systematically dissects engineering efforts of GPCR-based yeast biosensors through a modular framework. We summarize engineering strategies applied to the core modules-sensing (GPCRs), transduction (yeast signaling network), and output (reporters)-and highlight how these modifications enhance key performance metrics. Furthermore, we demonstrate how these engineered systems have expanded into a wide range of practical applications. Finally, we outline future directions, emphasizing the integration of artificial intelligence (AI) and synthetic biology to enable predictive and programmable design of next-generation biosensors.
articles.abstractZh: G 蛋白偶联受体 (GPCR) 因其高配体敏感性和特异性而成为生物传感器的关键生物传感元件。利用这些属性，基于 GPCR 的酵母生物传感器已成为一个强大的平台，它将保守的真核 GPCR 信号传导与酵母的卓越遗传易处理性结合在一起。这种协同作用加速了针对不同配体的生物传感器的开发，并促使人们不断努力优化其性能。这篇综述通过模块化框架系统地剖析了基于 GPCR 的酵母生物传感器的工程工作。我们总结了应用于核心模块（GPCR）、转导（酵母信号网络）和输出（报告基因）的工程策略，并重点介绍了这些修改如何增强关键性能指标。此外，我们还展示了这些工程系统如何扩展到广泛的实际应用。最后，我们概述了未来的方向，强调人工智能（AI）和合成生物学的集成，以实现下一代生物传感器的预测性和可编程设计。

articles.title: Heterologous expression of a heme-dependent catalase from Avicennia marina confers multi-stress tolerance in Escherichia coli for biotechnological applications.
articles.titleZh: 来自白骨壤的血红素依赖性过氧化氢酶的异源表达赋予大肠杆菌用于生物技术应用的多重应激耐受性。
articles.authors: Shahpiri A, Rafiei M, Sharafi SM.
articles.abstract: The study of antioxidant enzymes in Avicennia marina, a mangrove species, is crucial because of the plant's exceptional ability to survive in harsh environments. Catalase (CAT) is particularly important in reducing the damaging effects of reactive oxygen species (ROS), which are generated as a result of various stresses. In the present work, the gene encoding CAT from A. marina (AmCAT) was amplified from the full-length cDNA, cloned into pET32a and expressed as a Thioredoxin (Trx)-tagged fusion protein in E. coli. The recombinant enzyme, which was mainly soluble, exhibited 55,000 U/mg activity after purification. It showed optimal activity at 35 °C and pH 7, with high stability up to 40 °C and pH 6-8. Trx-AmCAT likely forms a homotetramer with a molecular mass of 280 kDa and incorporates four moles of Fe²⁺ per tetramer, essential for its hydrogen peroxide-decomposing activity. The expression and activity of AmCAT in A. marina seedlings were significantly upregulated under stress conditions, particularly in the leaves, indicating its role in stress tolerance. Furthermore, heterologous expression of AmCAT in E. coli enhanced its tolerance to NaCl, H2O2, butanol, high temperatures, and Pb2+ (applied as 1 mM Pb(NO3)2 in seedling treatments). These results suggest that AmCAT is a promising candidate, based on its enhanced microbial tolerance for industrial and biochemical applications and also for engineering stress-resistant microorganisms.

articles.title: Multiplex engineering of Candida tropicalis for efficient production of astaxanthin.
articles.titleZh: 用于高效生产虾青素的热带假丝酵母多重工程。
articles.authors: Gui X, Ji J, Hu S, Zhang X, Dong Y, Wu C, Xia Y, Yang H, Shen W, Cao Y, Zhou L, Chen X.
articles.abstract: Astaxanthin, a red ketocarotenoid, exhibits strong antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, pigmentation, and immunomodulatory activities. In this study, a high-β-carotene-producing Candida tropicalis strain was engineered for efficient astaxanthin biosynthesis using multiplex engineering strategies. First, promoter engineering was applied to balance the expression of β-carotene ketolase and hydroxylase, and an optimized promoter combination was identified, leading to an astaxanthin titer of 126.7 mg/L. Subsequently, subcellular compartmentalization was implemented by targeting the key enzymes to the cytosol, peroxisomes, and lipid droplets, followed by co-expression across multiple compartments, which raised the astaxanthin titer to 192.0 mg/L. Further enhancement was achieved through endoplasmic reticulum engineering to expand membrane-associated enzyme capacity and lipid engineering to improve product storage, increasing astaxanthin production to 249.8 mg/L. Finally, fermentation optimization significantly improved the shake-flask performance, yielding 320.1 mg/L astaxanthin. In a 5-L bioreactor, the astaxanthin titer reached 3096.2 mg/L, comparable to the highest reported production to date. This work represents the first efficient biosynthesis of astaxanthin in C. tropicalis and provides a novel chassis and technical framework for the industrial production of astaxanthin.
articles.abstractZh: 虾青素是一种红色酮类胡萝卜素，具有很强的抗氧化、抗炎、色素沉着和免疫调节活性。在这项研究中，利用多重工程策略对高产β-胡萝卜素的热带假丝酵母菌株进行了改造，以实现有效的虾青素生物合成。首先，应用启动子工程来平衡β-胡萝卜素酮酶和羟化酶的表达，并确定了优化的启动子组合，虾青素效价为126.7 mg/L。随后，通过将关键酶靶向胞质溶胶、过氧化物酶体和脂滴来实现亚细胞区室化，然后在多个区室中进行共表达，从而将虾青素滴度提高至 192.0 mg/L。通过内质网工程扩大膜相关酶容量和脂质工程改善产品储存，进一步增强了虾青素产量，将虾青素产量提高至 249.8 mg/L。最后，发酵优化显着提高了摇瓶性能，虾青素产量达到 320.1 mg/L。在 5 L 生物反应器中，虾青素滴度达到 3096.2 mg/L，与报道的最高产量相当。

articles.title: Structure, Biosynthesis, and Bioactivity of Nostolysamides.
articles.titleZh: 诺斯托酰胺的结构、生物合成和生物活性。
articles.authors: Weir E, Anterola I, van der Donk WA.
articles.abstract: A recent genome-mining study identified class II lanthipeptides encoded in Nostoc punctiforme PCC 73102 that contain acyl groups conjugated to Lys side chains. The structure and bioactivity of these peptides, named nostolysamides, were not determined. In this study, we produced the nostolysamides by coexpression of the NpuA precursor peptide with an N-terminal SUMO tag with the class II lanthipeptide synthetase NpuM in Escherichia coli. All four lanthionine and methyllanthionine residues were shown to have the DL configuration by Marfey's analysis. Tandem mass spectrometry and mutagenesis studies indicate an N-terminal nonoverlapping methyllanthionine ring and three overlapping rings at the C-terminus, for which the most likely ring pattern is proposed. The NpuM lanthipeptide synthetase is a member of the ProcM-clade and catalyzes ring formation with both C-to-N and N-to-C directionality. After removal of the leader peptide, the resulting lanthipeptide exhibits antibacterial as well as antifungal activity against Candida species by disrupting cell membranes. Antibacterial activity is shown not to involve lipid II. The biosynthetic gene cluster also encodes an acetyltransferase NpuN that transfers long-chain acyl groups to the side chain of a Lys residue at position 1 of the precursor peptide. In vitro studies of NpuN show relatively broad substrate specificity, with NpuN conjugating various acyl groups from acyl-CoA substrates to Lys1 in the nostolysamides. The acylation did not appreciably change the antifungal and antimicrobial activity of nostolysamide, showing that it is not required for these activities.
articles.abstractZh: 最近的一项基因组挖掘研究发现，点状发菜 PCC 73102 中编码的 II 类羊毛肽含有与赖氨酸侧链缀合的酰基。这些肽（称为 nostolysamides）的结构和生物活性尚未确定。在这项研究中，我们通过 N 端 SUMO 标签的 NpuA 前体肽与 II 类羊毛硫肽合成酶 NpuM 在大肠杆菌中共表达来生产诺斯托酰胺。 Marfey 的分析显示所有四个羊毛硫氨酸和甲基羊毛硫氨酸残基均具有 DL 构型。串联质谱和诱变研究表明，N 端有一个不重叠的甲基羊毛硫氨酸环，C 端有三个重叠的环，因此提出了最可能的环模式。 NpuM 羊毛硫肽合成酶是 ProcM 分支的成员，并催化具有 C 至 N 和 N 至 C 方向性的环形成。去除前导肽后，所得的羊毛硫肽通过破坏细胞膜而表现出针对念珠菌属的抗菌和抗真菌活性。抗菌活性与脂质 II 无关。生物合成基因簇还编码乙酰转移酶 NpuN

articles.title: Systematic engineering to enhance 3-carene production in yeast.
articles.titleZh: 提高酵母中 3-蒈烯产量的系统工程。
articles.authors: Wu F, Dong T, Gao Q, Wang H, Shan M, Guan L, Wang Y, Xiao W, Yao M.
articles.abstract: 3-Carene is a bicyclic monoterpene with a pine aroma. It is widely used as a flavoring agent, food additive, and insecticide in food and agricultural applications. Therefore, establishing an efficient microbial pathway for 3-carene is important. At present, the low activity of 3-carene synthase (CarTS) and the insufficient supply of precursors in Saccharomyces cerevisiae significantly constrain the synthesis of 3-carene. In this study, the NPP orthogonal pathway, source screening, CarTS modification, enzymatic subcellular localization, and molecular chaperone screening were used to promote 3-carene synthesis. By introducing the NPP orthogonal pathway and truncated CarTS from Salvia stenophylla (SsCarTS), the yield of 3-carene increased by 32.1-fold. Subsequently, through enzymatic subcellular localization and molecular chaperone screening, the yield of 3-carene was increased by 39.0%, reaching 50.6 mg/L in shake flask cultures. Eventually, the final titer of 3-carene reached 506.7 mg/L in a 5-L bioreactor by optimizing the culture medium containing metal ions and vitamins, which is the highest reported titer of 3-carene in microbial cell factories. In this study, we provide a cell factory for the synthesis of 3-carene as well as reference data for the biosynthesis of other bicyclic monoterpenes.
articles.abstractZh: 3-蒈烯是一种具有松树香气的双环单萜。它广泛用作食品和农业应用中的调味剂、食品添加剂和杀虫剂。因此，建立3-蒈烯有效的微生物途径非常重要。目前，酿酒酵母中3-蒈烯合酶（CarTS）活性低、前体供应不足，严重制约了3-蒈烯的合成。本研究通过NPP正交途径、来源筛选、CarTS修饰、酶促亚细胞定位和分子伴侣筛选等方法促进3-蒈烯合成。通过引入NPP正交途径和来自窄叶鼠尾草的截短CarTS（SsCarTS），3-蒈烯的产量增加了32.1倍。随后，通过酶亚细胞定位和分子伴侣筛选，摇瓶培养物中3-蒈烯的产量提高了39.0%，达到50.6 mg/L。最终，通过优化含金属离子和维生素的培养基，5L生物反应器中3-蒈烯的最终滴度达到506.7 mg/L，这是微生物细胞工厂中报道的最高3-蒈烯滴度。在这项研究中，我们提供了一种细胞

articles.title: TaGα knockout in wheat causes early heading and short organ length, with dose-dependent effects through various pathways.
articles.titleZh: 小麦中的 TaGα 敲除会导致抽穗提前和器官长度缩短，并通过各种途径产生剂量依赖性效应。
articles.journal: TAG. Theoretical and applied genetics. Theoretische und angewandte Genetik
articles.authors: Li Y, Zhao W, Peng X, Liang Y, Xue R, Liu J, Xu Z, Cao D, Liu B.
articles.abstract: Key messageTaGα regulates wheat development in a dose-dependent manner: a single mutant of TaGα solely accelerates heading, while a double mutant not only accelerates heading but also shortens organ length. The Gα subunit plays a crucial role in plant organ development and heading time; however, the exact functions in wheat are unknown. In the present study, knockout mutations in functional TaGα-7A and TaGα-7D were generated in the spring wheat cultivar 'Fielder' using the CRISPR/Cas9 system. Both single and double mutants exhibited early heading time. Reduced plant height, leaf length, and grain length were observed exclusively in the double mutant GαΔaadd, whereas leaf and grain width were unaffected. Histological sections revealed that cell length did not vary between the leaf and stem among 'Fielder,' GαΔaa, GαΔdd, and GαΔaadd, which indicated that cell number caused the leaf and stem length differences. Transcriptome analysis revealed dysregulated expression of kinesin and tubulin genes in double-mutant leaves, whereas altered oxidoreductase activity and differential expression of flowering-related genes were detected in the leaves of both single and double mutants. Immunoprecipitation coupled with mass spectrometry revealed that glutathione S-transferase (GST) physically interacted with TaGα directly, which was confirmed by luciferase complementation imaging and yeast two-hybrid assay. Furthermore, GST expression and enzyme activity were suppressed in both single and double mutants, resulting in elevated glutathione (GSH) content. The peak GSH content in wheat leaves during development corresponded to the heading time, which implied that GSH may have participated in regulation of heading time. According to the results of the present study, TaGα exerted regulatory effects on plant height, leaf length, grain length, and heading time in a dose-dependent manner via various pathways.
articles.abstractZh: 关键信息TaGα以剂量依赖性方式调节小麦发育：TaGα的单突变体仅加速抽穗，而双突变体不仅加速抽穗而且缩短器官长度。 Gα亚基在植物器官发育和抽穗期中起着至关重要的作用；然而，小麦的确切功能尚不清楚。在本研究中，使用 CRISPR/Cas9 系统在春小麦品种“Fielder”中产生了功能性 TaGα-7A 和 TaGα-7D 的敲除突变。单突变体和双突变体都表现出较早的抽穗时间。仅在双突变体 GαΔaadd 中观察到株高、叶长和粒长降低，而叶和粒宽不受影响。组织学切片显示，'Fielder'、GαΔaa、GαΔdd 和 GαΔaadd 的叶和茎之间的细胞长度没有变化，这表明细胞数量导致叶和茎长度差异。转录组分析揭示了双突变体叶片中驱动蛋白和微管蛋白基因的表达失调，而在单突变体和双突变体的叶片中均检测到氧化还原酶活性改变和开花相关基因的差异表达。免疫反应

articles.title: The industrial yeast Komagataella phaffii blooms for advanced biomanufacturing.
articles.titleZh: 工业酵母 Komagataella phaffii 在先进的生物制造领域蓬勃发展。
articles.authors: Lv W, Li Y, Wang S, Cai M.
articles.abstract: The industrial yeast Komagataella phaffii is emerging as a versatile chassis for advanced biomanufacturing. This review systematically summarizes recent progress in development and expanding applications of K. phaffii in addition to its traditional role in recombinant protein expression. This yeast demonstrates great potential as a sustainable source of single cell protein and a dominant host for bulk recombinant protein production in the fields of food, feed, biomaterial, biopharmaceutical, and industrial enzyme. Beyond protein expression, it has shown promising capabilities in the biosynthesis of diverse natural products, including flavonoids, alkaloids, terpenoids, polyketides, etc.. Its flexible metabolic network enables utilization of sustainable C1 and C2 substrates, supporting low-carbon and sustainable bioeconomy oriented biomanufacturing. These advances are underpinned by substantial innovations in genetic toolboxes, particularly CRISPR-based genome editing, synthetic promoter engineering, programmable expression systems, and genome-scale metabolic modeling, which have markedly enhanced the precision and efficiency of strain engineering. Despite these advantages, challenges remain in achieving ultra-high protein titers, developing humanized glycosylation strategies for food applications, improving cellular stress tolerance, and improving synthesis of toxic natural products. Addressing these limitations through integrated metabolic engineering and systems biology approaches will be critical to make K. phaffii a next-generation industrial workhorse for advanced biomanufacturing.
articles.abstractZh: 工业酵母 Komagataella phaffii 正在成为先进生物制造的多功能底盘。本综述系统总结了法菲酵母在重组蛋白表达中的传统作用以及其开发和扩展应用的最新进展。这种酵母作为单细胞蛋白的可持续来源和食品、饲料、生物材料、生物制药和工业酶领域大量重组蛋白生产的主要宿主表现出巨大的潜力。除了蛋白质表达之外，它在多种天然产物的生物合成方面也表现出了良好的能力，包括黄酮类、生物碱、萜类化合物、聚酮化合物等。其灵活的代谢网络能够利用可持续的C1和C2底物，支持低碳和可持续生物经济导向的生物制造。这些进步的基础是遗传工具箱的实质性创新，特别是基于 CRISPR 的基因组编辑、合成启动子工程、可编程表达系统和基因组规模代谢模型，显着提高了菌株工程的精度和效率。尽管有这些优势，挑战

articles.title: VvGA2ox8-Like from grape confers drought tolerance by activating the antioxidant defense system.
articles.titleZh: 葡萄中的 VvGA2ox8-Like 通过激活抗氧化防御系统赋予耐旱性。
articles.authors: Yang W, Yang J, Lu S, Gou H, Wang N, Yuan M, Ma W, Zeng B, Liang G, Mao J.
articles.abstract: Key messageVvGA2ox8-Like confers drought tolerance in grape by interacting with VvGRX-S7 for inhibited GA biosynthesis and upregulating antioxidant enzyme activities, proline accumulation, and stress-responsive genes. Drought stress severely limits grape productivity. Gibberellin (GA) metabolism is involved in drought responses, yet the role of specific GA catabolic genes remains unclear. In the present study, VvGA2ox8-Like, a member of the grape GA 2-β-dioxygenase (VvGA2ox) gene family, was identified to confer drought tolerance in Vitis vinifera cv. 'Pinot Noir'. As a GA catabolic enzyme, VvGA2ox8-Like expression is significantly induced by drought stress. Transient transformation of 'Pinot Noir' grape leaves showed that VvGA2ox8-Like overexpression decreased H2O2 and MDA contents, while increasing proline content, antioxidant enzyme activities, and drought-responsive gene expressions; in contrast, virus-induced gene silencing of VvGA2ox8-Like exhibited opposite results. Furthermore, VvGA2ox8-Like overexpression in 'Pinot Noir' grape calli further confirmed its positive regulatory role in drought tolerance, whereas CRISPR/Cas9-edited VvGA2ox8-Like calli showed opposite phenotypes. A drought-responsive protein VvGRX-S7 was identified as an interacting partner of VvGA2ox8-Like via yeast two-hybrid assay. RNA sequencing analysis revealed that VvGA2ox8-Like overexpression significantly affected the biosynthesis of secondary metabolites, phenylpropanoids, and flavonoids. In conclusion, VvGA2ox8-Like plays a key role in grape drought tolerance, providing theoretical support for elucidating the molecular mechanism of grape drought resistance.
articles.abstractZh: 关键信息VvGA2ox8-Like 通过与 VvGRX-S7 相互作用抑制 GA 生物合成并上调抗氧化酶活性、脯氨酸积累和胁迫响应基因，从而赋予葡萄耐旱性。干旱胁迫严重限制了葡萄的生产力。赤霉素 (GA) 代谢参与干旱反应，但特定 GA 分解代谢基因的作用仍不清楚。在本研究中，VvGA2ox8-Like 是葡萄 GA 2-β-双加氧酶 (VvGA2ox) 基因家族的成员，经鉴定可赋予葡萄品种耐旱性。 “黑皮诺”。作为一种 GA 分解代谢酶，VvGA2ox8-Like 表达受到干旱胁迫的显着诱导。 ‘Pinot Noir’葡萄叶的瞬时转化表明，VvGA2ox8-Like 过表达降低了 H2O2 和 MDA 含量，同时增加了脯氨酸含量、抗氧化酶活性和干旱响应基因表达；相反，病毒诱导的VvGA2ox8-Like基因沉默表现出相反的结果。此外，“黑皮诺”葡萄愈伤组织中VvGA2ox8-Like的过度表达进一步证实了其在耐旱性中的正调控作用，而CRISPR/Cas9编辑的VvGA2ox8-Like愈伤组织表现出相反的表型

articles.title: Community assembly and aroma contribution of <i>Hanseniaspora</i> yeasts in spontaneous fermentation of Cabernet Sauvignon grapes from four regions in Northwest China.
articles.titleZh: 西北四产区赤霞珠葡萄自然发酵中汉逊酵母菌的群落组装及香气贡献
articles.authors: Fan B, Chang Y, Zheng M, Han J, Tao Y, Zhao H, Hu K.
articles.abstract: This study investigated the community assembly and aroma contribution of Hanseniaspora yeasts during spontaneous fermentation of Cabernet Sauvignon grapes from four regions (Zhangye, Wuhai, Yinchuan, and Xianyang) in Northwest China. The resulting wines were characterized by distinct profiles of volatile compositions and aroma characteristics. High-throughput sequencing identified Hanseniaspora as the most abundant non-Saccharomyces community during fermentation, while culture-dependent isolation of 138 Hanseniaspora strains showed differential community assembly of H. uvarum, H. opuntiae, H. osmophila, and H. vineae across regions. H. osmophila and H. vineae were notably enriched in high-sugar musts from Zhangye, Wuhai, and Yinchuan with high diurnal temperature range. Such enrichment may induce longer survival of Hanseniaspora community at later fermentation stage, giving wines higher levels of acetate ester and floral aroma. Partial least squares regression of Hanseniaspora species and volatile compounds further suggested the potential impact of H. osmophila on region-driven variation in acetate ester production.
articles.abstractZh: 本研究调查了西北四个地区（张掖、乌海、银川和咸阳）赤霞珠葡萄自然发酵过程中汉逊酵母菌的群落组装和香气贡献。由此产生的葡萄酒具有独特的挥发性成分和香气特征。高通量测序鉴定出 Hanseniaspora 是发酵过程中最丰富的非酵母菌群落，而 138 个 Hanseniaspora 菌株的培养依赖性分离显示，H. uvarum、H. opuntiae、H. osmophila 和 H. vineae 的不同区域群落组装存在差异。 H. osmophila 和 H. vineae 在昼夜温度较高的张掖、乌海和银川的高糖葡萄汁中显着富集。这种富集可能会导致汉逊氏菌群落在发酵后期的存活时间更长，从而使葡萄酒具有更高水平的醋酸酯和花香。汉逊氏菌属物种和挥发性化合物的偏最小二乘回归进一步表明嗜渗汉逊氏菌对醋酸酯生产的区域驱动变化的潜在影响。

articles.title: Designing a Synthetic Microbial Community to Enhance Flavor Compound Production in Sesame Flavor-Type <i>Baijiu</i> Fermentation.
articles.titleZh: 设计合成微生物群落以提高芝麻风味型白酒发酵中风味化合物的产量。
articles.authors: Ji X, Yu X, Xu Y, Wu Q.
articles.abstract: Fuqu plays a crucial role in initiating fermentation and flavor compound production during sesame flavor-type baijiu fermentation. However, selecting microorganisms for Fuqu to enhance flavor compound production remains a challenge. This work designs a synthetic microbial community (SynCom) for Fuqu to improve the production of flavor compounds, with a focus on the diversity of flavor compounds and the content of a key flavor compound-sulfur compounds. Through multi-omics analysis, 13 genera (Aspergillus, Bacillus, Lactobacillus, Leuconostoc, Pediococcus, Pichia, Saccharomyces, Trichosporon, Weissella, Candida, Torulaspora, Clavispora, and Wickerhamomyces) were identified as core microbiota involved in the production of those flavor compounds, and these core microbiota were used to construct a SynCom to enhance flavor compound production in baijiu fermentation. The resulting SynCom exhibited the highest flavor compound diversity (0.64) and 3-(methylthio)-1-propanal content (618.14 μg/kg) in simulative fermentation. In large-scale production, Fuqu made with the SynCom achieved greater flavor compound diversity (0.56) and a higher concentration of 3-(methylthio)-1-propanal (590 μg/kg) compared to commercial Fuqu (0.40 and 324 μg/kg, respectively) (p Fuqu effectively enhances the production of flavor compounds. This work provides a strategy for constructing SynCom to improve the formation of flavor compounds in baijiu fermentation.
articles.abstractZh: 腐曲在芝麻香型白酒发酵过程中对发酵起始和风味物质的产生起着至关重要的作用。然而，选择用于福曲的微生物来提高风味化合物的产量仍然是一个挑战。这项工作为福曲设计了一个合成微生物群落（SynCom），以提高风味化合物的产量，重点关注风味化合物的多样性和关键风味化合物——硫化合物的含量。通过多组学分析，13个属（曲霉属、芽孢杆菌属、乳杆菌属、明串珠菌属、片球菌属、毕赤酵母属、酵母菌属、毛孢子菌属、魏斯氏菌属、念珠菌属、圆酵母属、棒孢菌属和威克氏酵母属）被确定为参与这些风味化合物生产的核心微生物群，这些核心微生物群被用来构建 SynCom 来增强风味化合物的生产。白酒发酵。所得的 SynCom 在模拟发酵中表现出最高的风味化合物多样性 (0.64) 和 3-(甲硫基)-1-丙醛含量 (618.14 μg/kg)。在大规模生产中，使用SynCom生产的福曲实现了更大的风味化合物多样性（0.56）和更高的3-（甲硫基）-1-丙醛浓度（590 μg/kg）

articles.title: Efficient cell factory design by combining meta-heuristic algorithm with enzyme-constrained metabolic models.
articles.titleZh: 通过将元启发式算法与酶约束代谢模型相结合来实现高效的细胞工厂设计。
articles.authors: Liao W, Gao G, Wang H, Fan X, Wang L, He S, Xiang G, Yan X, Lu H.
articles.abstract: The rational design of high-performance microbial cell factories remains a central challenge in sustainable biomanufacturing due to the complexity of metabolic networks and the difficulty of predicting synergistic genetic interventions. Despite recent advances in strain design algorithms, predicting combinatorial targets remains computationally prohibitive due to the combinatorial explosion. Here, we present MetaStrain, a unified computational framework that integrates enzyme-constrained models (ecModels) with meta-heuristic algorithms to identify non-intuitive combinatorial gene targets for improving product yields. MetaStrain first performs pre-screening through a modified enforced objective flux scanning algorithm to reduce the dimensionality of candidate genes and annotate editing strategies. The subsequent search module translates combinatorial editing strategies into numerical encodings compatible with diverse meta‑heuristic algorithms. It then simulates mutant phenotypes by directly modulating enzyme bounds within the ecModels, enabling efficient exploration of the combinatorial design space. Integrated redundancy analysis tools further identify single and fixed‑size combinatorial strategies, facilitating direct experimental implementation. Computational simulation in Saccharomyces cerevisiae reveals significant enhancements in 2-phenylethanol and spermidine biosynthesis, while controlling target count and covering experimentally validated targets. Experimental validation in Escherichia coli further confirmed the algorithm's predictive power, achieving up to a 61.25% increase in L‑tryptophan titer of the five-target combination strain. Overall, MetaStrain achieves high computational efficiency, stable convergence, and broad adaptability across diverse metabolic targets. This study provides a powerful tool for metabolic engineering, bridging computational prediction and experimental realization, and highlighting the potential of meta-heuristic optimization in synthetic biology.
articles.abstractZh: 由于代谢网络的复杂性和预测协同遗传干预的困难，高性能微生物细胞工厂的合理设计仍然是可持续生物制造的核心挑战。尽管应变设计算法最近取得了进展，但由于组合爆炸，预测组合目标在计算上仍然令人望而却步。在这里，我们提出了 MetaStrain，这是一个统一的计算框架，它将酶约束模型 (ecModels) 与元启发式算法相结合，以识别非直观的组合基因目标，从而提高产品产量。 MetaStrain首先通过改进的强制客观通量扫描算法进行预筛选，以降低候选基因的维度并注释编辑策略。随后的搜索模块将组合编辑策略转换为与各种元启发式算法兼容的数字编码。然后，它通过直接调节 ecModel 内的酶边界来模拟突变表型，从而能够有效探索组合设计空间。集成冗余分析工具进一步识别单一和固定大小的组合
