articles.title: Microbial diversity and production of milk spirit using traditional Buryat fermentation and distillation technologies.
articles.titleZh: 微生物多样性以及使用传统布里亚特发酵和蒸馏技术生产白酒。
articles.authors: Namsaraev Z, Nanzatov B, Kozlova A, Barkhutova D, Izotova A, Vlaskina A, Petrenko D, Kamaev A, Lukashevich S, Pozhidaev V, Filimonova A, Tsyrenova D, Dambaev V, Novikova V, Rozanov A, Sazonov A, Patrushev M, Toshchakov S.
articles.abstract: Distilled fermented milk beverages are rare in food technology, despite the global prevalence of plant-based spirits. Currently, the production of distilled strong alcoholic beverages from fermented milk using traditional technologies is known only among Mongolic-speaking peoples and their Siberian neighbors. This study provides the first interdisciplinary analysis of darasun, a traditional Buryat spirit made from fermented milk beverage khurenge in Southern Siberia. Archival research shows deep historical roots of darasun dating back to the 13th-14th centuries in the period of the Mongol Empire. Low content of fermentable carbohydrates in milk limits the maximum ethanol concentration in the fermented product, which reaches 1.5-2.1%. To increase the beverage's strength, a traditional multi-stage distillation is used, allowing sequential increases in ethanol concentration to 11%, 40%, and 75%. ITS and 16S rRNA gene sequence analysis identified diverse microbial community in khurenge dominated by representatives of Lactobacillus genus among lactic acid bacteria and Trichosporon or Monosporozyma genera among yeasts. Comparison of home-produced and industrially produced khurenge revealed that pasteurization significantly affects microbial composition with non-pasteurized khurenge showing greater microbial diversity and lower ethanol content than pasteurized. Functional analysis showed that pathway composition differed significantly between samples suggesting that final ethanol concentration in fermented milk reflects the balance between competing fermentation and respiration pathways. This study demonstrates that Buryat milk fermentation and distillation represents a unique biotechnological system that exemplifies decentralized, low-input, circular bioeconomy principles adapted to pastoral settings, providing a contrast to industrial whey-to-ethanol processes and contributing to the preservation of endangered cultural heritage.
articles.abstractZh: 尽管植物性烈酒在全球盛行，但蒸馏发酵乳饮料在食品技术中很少见。目前，只有蒙古语民族及其西伯利亚邻居知道使用传统技术从发酵乳中生产蒸馏烈性酒精饮料。这项研究首次对 darasun 进行了跨学科分析，darasun 是一种传统的布里亚特烈酒，由西伯利亚南部的发酵乳饮料 khurenge 制成。档案研究表明，达拉顺的深厚历史根源可以追溯到 13 至 14 世纪的蒙古帝国时期。牛奶中可发酵碳水化合物含量较低，限制了发酵产品中乙醇的最高浓度，可达1.5-2.1%。为了提高饮料的浓度，采用了传统的多级蒸馏，使乙醇浓度依次增加至 11%、40% 和 75%。 ITS 和 16S rRNA 基因序列分析确定了库伦格中多样化的微生物群落，其中以乳酸菌中的乳杆菌属和酵母中的毛孢子菌属或单孢子菌属为代表。国产和工业生产的胡伦格对比揭示

articles.title: Multi-level Integrated Engineering Enhances Neutral β-Glucanase Production in Komagataella phaffii.
articles.titleZh: 多层次集成工程提高了 Komagataella phaffii 中中性 β-葡聚糖酶的产量。
articles.authors: Xu H, Shao X, Peng Y, Liu X, Liu C, Bai Z, Yang Y.
articles.abstract: Neutral β-1,3-glucanase (BgA) is a vital enzyme in the food industry, widely used to reduce viscosity in brewing mashes, improve dough rheology in baking, and clarify fruit juices. However, its industrial application is currently hindered by low secretion titers and high production costs. In this study, we established a systematic, multi-layered engineering framework for Streptococcus equinus neutral BgA in the Generally Recognized as Safe (GRAS) host K. phaffii (Komagataella phaffii). Utilizing a modular BioBrick assembly approach, we first performed a combinatorial screening of promoter and signal peptide libraries, identifying PDAS1 and the alpha-mating factor (MFα) signal peptide as the optimal secretion module, achieving an initial activity of 5.5 U/mL·OD600. Subsequently, we implemented a synergistic regulation strategy targeting both transcriptional and translational levels. Co-overexpression of the transcription factors Mxr1 and Mit1 enhanced BgA titers by 72% across strains with varying gene dosages. Further engineering of the translation initiation complex (eIF4G, eIF4E, eIF4A, and Pab1) resulted in a further 1.9-fold increase in yield. To validate the industrial scalability of the engineered strain, high-density fed-batch fermentation was conducted in a 5-L bioreactor, achieving a final BgA titer of 1.1 g/L. This study demonstrates a robust, integrated engineering strategy that effectively resolves secretory bottlenecks, establishing K. phaffii as a competitive platform for neutral β-glucanase production.
articles.abstractZh: 中性 β-1,3-葡聚糖酶 (BgA) 是食品工业中的重要酶，广泛用于降低酿造浆料的粘度、改善烘焙中的面团流变性以及澄清果汁。然而，目前其工业应用受到低分泌滴度和高生产成本的阻碍。在这项研究中，我们在公认安全 (GRAS) 宿主法菲克酵母 (Komagataella phaffii) 中建立了一个系统的、多层的马马链球菌中性 BgA 工程框架。利用模块化BioBrick组装方法，我们首先对启动子和信号肽库进行组合筛选，确定PDAS1和α交配因子（MFα）信号肽作为最佳分泌模块，实现5.5 U/mL·OD600的初始活性。随后，我们实施了针对转录和翻译水平的协同调控策略。转录因子 Mxr1 和 Mit1 的共过表达使具有不同基因剂量的菌株的 BgA 效价提高了 72%。翻译起始复合物（eIF4G、eIF4E、eIF4A 和 Pab1）的进一步改造使产量进一步增加了 1.9 倍。验证工业可扩展性

articles.title: Technological and In Vitro Probiotic Characterization of Yeasts Isolated from Makdous for Plant-Based Fermentations.
articles.titleZh: 从 Makdous 中分离出的用于植物发酵的酵母的技术和体外益生菌表征。
articles.authors: Aydın F, Kahve Hİ, Koçan D.
articles.abstract: Traditional fermented foods represent an underexplored reservoir of non-Saccharomyces yeasts with potential technological and probiotic relevance. This study aimed to isolate, identify, and functionally characterize multifunctional yeasts from traditional makdous, a spontaneously fermented eggplant product. Yeasts were isolated from 20 makdous samples and identified using SCoT polymorphism-based fingerprinting combined with ITS sequencing. Technological characterization included growth index (GI) in different temperatures, salt and acetic acid concentrations, acidic pH, carbon assimilation profiles, and enzymatic activities, followed by multivariate analyses to select technologically relevant strains. Selected isolates were further evaluated for in vitro probiotic properties, including simulated gastrointestinal survival, autoaggregation capacity, cell surface hydrophobicity, antibacterial activity, and antioxidant activity. A total of 39 endogenous yeasts were identified as P. kudriavzevii (n = 16), 14 P. manshurica (n = 14), P. membranifaciens (n = 7), P. fermentans (n = 1), and W. anomalus (n = 1). Multivariate analyses highlighted P. kudriavzevii SY5 and SY15, P. manshurica SY34, and W. anomalus SY60 as distinct and relevant candidates for further probiotic evaluation, mainly due to their moderate to high GI under multiple stress conditions (25 75), non-aggressive lactic acid assimilation patterns, and low esterase activity. Among them, P. kudriavzevii SY5 and SY15 showed superior performance, with high viability under simulated gastrointestinal conditions (> 70%), stronger autoaggregation (> 60%), greater surface hydrophobicity (> 30%), and enhanced ABTS radical scavenging activity (> 50%) (P < 0.05). The results demonstrate that makdous is a valuable source of multifunctional non-Saccharomyces yeasts. In particular, P. kudriavzevii SY5 and SY15 are promising candidates for enhancing technological suitability for plant-based fermentations and for health-related functional properties.
articles.abstractZh: 传统发酵食品代表了尚未开发的非酵母菌库，具有潜在的技术和益生菌相关性。本研究旨在从传统的 makdous（一种自然发酵的茄子产品）中分离、鉴定和功能表征多功能酵母。从 20 个 makdous 样品中分离出酵母，并使用基于 SCoT 多态性的指纹识别结合 ITS 测序进行鉴定。技术表征包括不同温度、盐和乙酸浓度、酸性 pH 值、碳同化曲线和酶活性下的生长指数 (GI)，然后进行多变量分析以选择技术相关的菌株。进一步评估所选分离株的体外益生菌特性，包括模拟胃肠道存活、自动聚集能力、细胞表面疏水性、抗菌活性和抗氧化活性。共有 39 种内源酵母被鉴定为 P. kudriavzevii (n = 16)、14 种 P. manshurica (n = 14)、P. membranifaciens (n = 7)、P. Fermentans (n = 1) 和 W. anomalus (n = 1)。多变量分析突出了 P. kudriavzevii SY5 和 SY15、P. manshurica SY3

articles.title: The potential of metabolic engineering for sustainable phytosterol production.
articles.titleZh: 代谢工程可持续生产植物甾醇的潜力。
articles.authors: Hu R, Di X, Li G, Schaller H, Hemmerlin A, Liao P.
articles.abstract: Phytosterols, essential components pivotal to plant membrane stability and celebrated for their extensive pharmacological benefits, have garnered considerable attention across industries, including food fortification, nutraceuticals, and pharmaceuticals. The escalating demand for phytosterols, fueled by their myriad health advantages, underscores the urgent need for more efficient synthesis methodologies. Among these, metabolic engineering stands out as a promising approach due to its biologically driven process, which operates under stable conditions, thereby enhancing reaction specificity and drastically reducing the production of undesirable by-products. This review consolidates the latest research endeavors focused on enhancing phytosterol accumulation, providing a comprehensive analysis of strategies including gene manipulation, enzyme engineering, metabolic engineering, and the utilization of diverse host organisms such as bacteria, algae, and yeast. We explore recent advancements in phytosterol biosynthesis and engineering, providing a comprehensive overview of the field's current state and examining promising methodologies for future research and applications.
articles.abstractZh: 植物甾醇是植物膜稳定性的关键成分，因其广泛的药理功效而闻名，已引起食品强化、营养保健品和制药等行业的广泛关注。由于其无数的健康优势，对植物甾醇的需求不断增加，这凸显了对更有效的合成方法的迫切需要。其中，代谢工程因其生物驱动过程而脱颖而出，成为一种有前景的方法，该过程在稳定的条件下运行，从而提高反应特异性并大幅减少不良副产物的产生。这篇综述整合了专注于增强植物甾醇积累的最新研究成果，对基因操作、酶工程、代谢工程以及细菌、藻类和酵母等多种宿主生物的利用等策略进行了全面分析。我们探索植物甾醇生物合成和工程的最新进展，全面概述该领域的现状，并研究未来研究和应用的有前景的方法。

articles.title: Toward sustainable production of bulnesol and elemol enabled by synthetic biology in Saccharomyces cerevisiae.
articles.titleZh: 通过酿酒酵母中的合成生物学实现布尼醇和榄香醇的可持续生产。
articles.authors: Narayanan AK, Rao KRR, Megha K, Nehaa DR, Nagegowda DA.
articles.abstract: Guaiac oil obtained from the heartwood of the Bulnesia sarmentoi tree native to South America is prized for its characteristic woody-rosy aroma. The aroma is primarily attributed to bulnesol, which makes up ~ 40% of the oil. B. sarmentoi is classified as an endangered species by the International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN) Red List, its sensitivity to climate change and challenges associated with its cultivation hinder the production of guaiac oil. We had previously characterized a unique sesquiterpene synthase (StBUS/ELS) from potato that produced a mixture of bulnesol and elemol when incubated with farnesyl pyrophosphate. It was shown that elemol was a thermal rearrangement product of bulnesol. The present study sought to engineer yeast, Saccharomyces cerevisiae, for the sustainable production of bulnesol using StBUS/ELS. Yeast expressing StBUS/ELS was found to produce a mixture of elemol, γ-eudesmol, α-eudesmol, β-eudesmol and bulnesol with pH of the fermentation medium having a significant influence on the product profile. A pH of 7.5 favored the production of bulnesol/elemol, whereas an acidic pH (2.5 − 5.5) formed eudesmols. Further metabolic engineering for enhanced precursor and co-factor supply while also eliminating the need for galactose inducers resulted in a 1.85-fold improvement in bulnesol/elemol titers. Finally, fed-batch fermentation with the best engineered strain resulted in a combined bulnesol/elemol titer of 103.92 ± 7.41 mg/L, while total sesquiterpene titers exceeded 460 mg/L. This study, for the first time, demonstrates the influence of pH on the product profile of a terpene synthase in vivo and provides a foundation toward the sustainable production of bulnesol in microbial host platforms.
articles.abstractZh: 从原产于南美洲的 Bulnesia sarmentoi 树的心材中提取的愈创木油因其特有的木质玫瑰香气而备受推崇。香气主要来自布呢醇，约占油的 40%。 B. sarmentoi 被国际自然保护联盟 (IUCN) 红色名录列为濒危物种，其对气候变化的敏感性以及与其种植相关的挑战阻碍了愈创木油的生产。我们之前已经从马铃薯中鉴定出一种独特的倍半萜合酶（StBUS/ELS），当与法尼基焦磷酸一起孵育时，该酶会产生丁呢醇和榄香醇的混合物。结果表明，榄香酚是布呢醇的热重排产物。本研究试图对酵母（酿酒酵母）进行改造，以利用 StBUS/ELS 可持续生产布尼醇。研究发现表达 StBUS/ELS 的酵母可产生榄香醇、γ-桉树醇、α-桉树醇、β-桉树醇和布呢醇的混合物，发酵培养基的 pH 值对产品特性具有显着影响。 7.5 的 pH 值有利于 bulnesol/elemol 的产生，而酸性 pH 值 (2.5 – 5.5) 则形成 eudesmols。 Enha 的进一步代谢工程

articles.title: Flavour-enhancement mechanisms in pineapple wine revealed by sequential inoculation of an aroma-active, acid-tolerant Hanseniaspora uvarum with Saccharomyces cerevisiae.
articles.titleZh: 通过连续接种具有香气、耐酸的葡萄汉逊酵母和酿酒酵母，揭示了菠萝酒的风味增强机制。
articles.authors: Sun Q, Miao Y, Zeng R, Li J, Su Y, Li Q.
articles.abstract: This study investigated the mechanisms underlying limited aroma diversity and inefficient precursor conversion in high-acidity pineapple wine by screening aroma-producing, acid-tolerant non-Saccharomyces yeasts for sequential inoculation with Saccharomyces cerevisiae. Through multi-dimensional screening combining GC-olfactometry-MS analysis, and 26S rDNA sequencing, Hanseniaspora uvarum P15 was selected for its acid tolerance (survival at pH 1.5), high-sugar stress resistance and high aroma-producing capacity, yielding 67 significantly enriched volatile flavour compounds (VFCs) with a distinct fruity-vinous profile (p 1, attained a sensory score of 64.74 ± 4.95 and achieved a total antioxidant capacity of 26.37 ± 0.87 mmol TE/L, significantly surpassing other combinations (p < 0.01). Transcriptomic and flavouromic analyses revealed that this combination markedly increased the abundance of esters and terpenoids (p < 0.05) in association with metabolic reprogramming, contributing to a distinct aromatic profile characterised by linalool and ethyl hexanoate. Specifically, H. uvarum P15 upregulated key pathways in S. cerevisiae C12, including pyruvate metabolism, amino acid degradation and terpenoid biosynthesis, thereby redirecting acetyl-CoA flux towards the preferential synthesis of active VFCs. Principal component analysis confirmed a quantitative relationship between differentially expressed genes related to ester synthesis and amino acid metabolism in S. cerevisiae C12 and key VFC accumulation (p < 0.05), suggesting that coordinated metabolic network remodelling is associated with flavour enhancement. This study provides a technological paradigm for the flavour-oriented development of high-acidity fruit wine.
articles.abstractZh: 本研究通过筛选产香、耐酸的非酿酒酵母并连续接种酿酒酵母，研究了高酸度菠萝酒中有限的香气多样性和低效前体转化的机制。通过GC-嗅觉-MS分析和26S rDNA测序相结合的多维筛选，筛选出具有耐酸（pH 1.5下存活）、高糖胁迫和高产香能力的Hanseniaspora uvarum P15，产生了67种显着丰富的挥发性风味化合物（VFC），具有独特的果酒风味（p 1，感官得分为64.74 ± 4.95）并实现了 26.37 ± 0.87 mmol TE/L 的总抗氧化能力，显着超过其他组合（p < 0.01），转录组学和风味组学分析表明，该组合显着增加了与代谢重编程相关的酯和萜类化合物的丰度（p < 0.05），从而形成了以芳樟醇和己酸乙酯为特征的独特芳香特征，具体而言，H. uvarum P15 上调。酿酒酵母 C12 的关键途径，包括丙酮酸代谢、氨基酸降解

articles.title: From microbial succession to precision fermentation: Enhancing Yunnan coffee flavor with a defined native yeast starter guided by multi-omics.
articles.titleZh: 从微生物演替到精准发酵：在多组学指导下，使用特定的天然酵母发酵剂增强云南咖啡的风味。
articles.authors: Quan C, Wu Z, Hu G, Liu X, Shu Y, Peng X, Zhou L, Xiong W, Qiu M.
articles.abstract: Yunnan coffee possesses distinct quality potential, yet the systematic use of indigenous microbes to enhance its flavor remains largely unexplored. This study integrated microbial succession analysis with functional screening to isolate key yeasts from spontaneous fermentations. A prominent abundance peak of Kurtzmaniella observed at 36 h enabled the targeted isolation of six strains. Among these, Hanseniaspora uvarum (J1) and Pichia kluyveri (J2) were selected for detailed kinetic profiling due to their superior aroma production and pectinase activity. The two strains exhibited contrasting sugar utilization strategies: J1 rapidly consumed mannose, while J2 displayed a slower, flavor-oriented assimilation pattern. Metabolomic analysis identified 48 h as the optimal time for flavor precursor formation. Through a multimodal analytical platform combining 1H NMR, HS-SPME/GC-MS, electronic nose, and sensory evaluation, J2 consistently emerged as the most promising starter culture, achieving a sensory score of 82.42 out of 100. Its enhanced flavor profile was driven by synergistic metabolic effects, including the production of maltol (76.77 μg/g; OAV > 1), an 18% reduction in formic acid (p < 0.001), and a distinctive muskmelon-raspberry aromatic character. Multi-omics analysis further revealed 26 biomarkers capable of differentiating strain performance. This work provides both a valuable microbial resource for improving the flavor of Yunnan coffee and a targeted framework for developing region-specific starter cultures in fermented food systems.
articles.abstractZh: 云南咖啡具有独特的品质潜力，但系统地利用本土微生物来增强其风味的方法在很大程度上尚未得到探索。这项研究将微生物演替分析与功能筛选相结合，从自发发酵中分离出关键酵母。在 36 小时观察到 Kurtzmaniella 的显着丰度峰使得能够有针对性地分离六株菌株。其中，Hanseniaspora uvarum (J1) 和 Pichia kluyveri (J2) 由于其优异的香气产生和果胶酶活性而被选择进行详细的动力学分析。两种菌株表现出截然不同的糖利用策略：J1 快速消耗甘露糖，而 J2 表现出较慢的、以风味为导向的同化模式。代谢组学分析确定 48 小时是风味前体形成的最佳时间。通过结合 1H NMR、HS-SPME/GC-MS、电子鼻和感官评估的多模式分析平台，J2 始终成为最有前途的发酵剂，感官得分为 82.42（满分 100）。其增强的风味特征是由协同代谢效应驱动的，包括产生麦芽酚（76.77 μg/g；OAV > 1），甲酸减少 18%

articles.title: Integrative metabolomic and transcriptomic analyses reveal the regulatory mechanisms underlying the biosynthesis of flavonoid and terpenoid metabolites in different tissues of <i>Canavalia gladiata</i>.
articles.titleZh: 综合代谢组学和转录组学分析揭示了刀豆不同组织中类黄酮和萜类代谢物生物合成的调控机制。
articles.authors: Gao Y, Yang Y, Zhang Y, Zhao Y, Fan Z.
articles.abstract: IntroductionCanavalia gladiata (C. gladiata) is an important medicinal and edible plant. However, systematic research on the distribution of metabolites in different tissues of C. gladiata and their potential transcriptional regulatory mechanisms remain poorly understood.MethodsWe performed integrated metabolomic and transcriptomic analyses across five tissues (roots, stems, leaves, seeds, and fruit pericarps) of C. gladiata, combined with antioxidant capacity and bioactive component content assays, to dissect the regulatory networks of flavonoid and terpenoid biosynthesis.ResultsSeeds exhibited the highest antioxidant activity and total phenolic content, whereas leaves accumulated the highest levels of total flavonoids and terpenic acids. A total of 4,405 DAMs and 25,597 DEGs were identified, revealing pronounced tissue-specific metabolic and transcriptional divergence. Flavonoid and terpenoid biosynthesis pathways were significantly enriched in comparisons between seeds and other tissues. Key structural genes, including 4CL, CHS, FLS, HMGR, and DXS, displayed strong tissue-specific expression patterns. Co-expression network analysis identified candidate regulatory modules, highlighting MYB, bHLH, and MYC2 transcription factors as central regulators of flavonoid and terpenoid metabolism in seeds and fruit pericarps.DiscussionThis study provides the first comprehensive landscape of tissue-specific flavonoid and terpenoid metabolism in C. gladiata, offering a theoretical foundation and valuable genetic resources for the targeted exploitation of its bioactive components and molecular breeding.
articles.abstractZh: 简介刀豆（C.gladiata）是一种重要的药食两用植物。然而，对角斗士不同组织中代谢产物的分布及其潜在转录调控机制的系统研究仍知之甚少。方法对角斗士5个组织（根、茎、叶、种子和果皮）进行综合代谢组学和转录组学分析，结合抗氧化能力和生物活性成分含量测定，剖析类黄酮和萜类生物合成的调控网络。结果种子表现出最高的抗氧化能力活性和总酚含量，而叶子积累的总黄酮和萜酸含量最高。总共鉴定了 4,405 个 DAM 和 25,597 个 DEG，揭示了明显的组织特异性代谢和转录差异。与种子和其他组织相比，类黄酮和萜类化合物的生物合成途径显着丰富。关键结构基因，包括 4CL、CHS、FLS、HMGR 和 DXS，表现出强烈的组织特异性表达模式。共表达网络分析确定了候选调控模块，highli

articles.title: Interpreting the asymmetric interaction between yeast and acetic acid bacteria in kefir grains from a metabolic perspective.
articles.titleZh: 从代谢角度解释开菲尔粒中酵母和醋酸菌之间的不对称相互作用。
articles.authors: Xu C, Zhang Z, Bai Y.
articles.abstract: As a naturally complex mixed microbial system, the intricate microbial interactions within kefir grains remain poorly understood, particularly regarding the relationships between yeasts and acetic acid bacteria. To elucidate the strain interaction mechanisms in kefir grains, this study systematically investigated the interactions between kefir-derived yeast (Kluyveromyces marxianus Y7) and acetic acid bacteria (Acetobacter fabarum A26) by integrating species-specific primer-based qPCR quantification, growth status analysis, biofilm formation, exopolysaccharide (EPS) measurement, and non-targeted metabolomics. The results demonstrated that co-culture established an asymmetric interaction pattern dominated by A26, with Y7 continuously adapting. Metabolomics and pathway enrichment analyses (KEGG) revealed that the interactions specifically activated core pathways such as ABC transporters, amino acid biosynthesis, and protein digestion and absorption. Dynamic changes in key metabolites elucidated their functional roles in the interaction: Y7 upregulated phenyllactic acid (as an antagonistic and signaling molecule) and hexylglutathione (antioxidant) in response to stress; the riboflavin secreted by Y7 may provide metabolic assistance to A26; the accumulation of (S)-2-hydroxyglutarate suggested energy metabolism remodeling in Y7; while the upregulation of 12-hydroxydodecanoic acid was associated with biofilm formation. This study is the first to discover a unique EPS metabolic cycle during co- culture: early synthesis followed by degradation, accompanied by the re-accumulation of sucrose, which constitutes a key internal carbon resource recycling strategy. In summary, from the perspective of metabolites and pathways, this research reveals that the two strains establish an efficient symbiotic metabolic system by defining functional roles, driving metabolic division of labor, and achieving resource cycling.
articles.abstractZh: 作为一个天然复杂的混合微生物系统，开菲尔粒内复杂的微生物相互作用仍然知之甚少，特别是关于酵母和醋酸菌之间的关系。为了阐明开菲尔颗粒中的菌株相互作用机制，本研究通过整合基于物种特异性引物的 qPCR 定量、生长状态分析、生物膜形成、胞外多糖 (EPS) 测量和非靶向代谢组学，系统地研究了开菲尔衍生酵母 (Kluyveromyces marxianus Y7) 和乙酸菌 (Acetobacter fabarum A26) 之间的相互作用。结果表明，共培养建立了一种以A26为主、Y7不断适应的不对称相互作用模式。代谢组学和通路富集分析 (KEGG) 表明，相互作用特异性激活了核心通路，例如 ABC 转运蛋白、氨基酸生物合成以及蛋白质消化和吸收。关键代谢物的动态变化阐明了它们在相互作用中的功能作用：Y7 在应激反应中上调苯基乳酸（作为拮抗剂和信号分子）和己基谷胱甘肽（抗氧化剂）；核黄素

articles.title: Quality Enhancement of Riesling Wine Through Co-Fermentation of Non-Saccharomyces Yeasts with β-Glucosidase Activity and Saccharomyces cerevisiae.
articles.titleZh: 通过具有 β-葡萄糖苷酶活性的非酵母菌和酿酒酵母共同发酵提高雷司令葡萄酒的品质。
articles.authors: Nzoyisaba D, Yu Y, Liu J, Ndayishimiye L, Zhang X.
articles.abstract: Co-fermentation with Saccharomyces cerevisiae (SC) and non-Saccharomyces (NS) yeasts is currently one of the most used strategies for improving wine quality. To investigate the effects of simultaneous and sequential co-fermentations with SC and NS yeast, Pichia kudriavzevii F2-24, Metschnikowia pulcherrima HX-13, and Issatchenkia terricola SLY-4 on flavor and quality of Riesling wine, the oenological characteristics and aroma indexes of different wine samples were evaluated. The results indicated a reduced alcohol content in all co-fermented wines (12.39%, v/v-12.55%, v/v), except for simultaneous co-fermentation using P. kudriavzevii F2-24/SC (12.83%, v/v), compared to the SC fermentation (12.82%, v/v); and a lower volatile acidity in all co-fermented wines (0.19 g/L-0.35 g/L), compared to SC fermentation (0.40 g/L), which positively impacted the wine quality. All co-fermented wines exhibited higher content of esters (406.29 mg/L-649.62 mg/L), compared to SC fermentation (313.71 mg/L), with distinct flavor compound profiles. Sequential co-fermentations with F2-24/SC and SLY-4/SC had the highest content of C13-norisoprenoids and esters, recognized as essential flavor contributors. Simultaneous co-fermentation using M. pulcherrima HX-13/SC (406.29 mg/L) exhibited a lower content of total esters compared to other co-fermentations. The sensory attributes of Riesling wine were improved in all co-fermentations, except for simultaneous co-fermentation using M. pulcherrima HX-13/SC. Furthermore, sequential co-fermentation with P. kudriavzevii F2-24/SC and I. terricola SLY-4/SC proved to be the most suitable in improving Riesling wine quality. This study provides a valuable reference for improving the flavor and quality of Riesling wine through co-fermentation of NS yeasts and SC.
articles.abstractZh: 酿酒酵母（SC）和非酿酒酵母（NS）共发酵是目前提高葡萄酒品质最常用的策略之一。为研究SC和NS酵母、Pichia kudriavzevii F2-24、Metschnikowia pulcherrima HX-13和Issatchenkia terricola SLY-4同时和序贯共发酵对雷司令葡萄酒风味和品质的影响，评价了不同酒样的酿酒学特征和香气指标。结果表明，与 SC 发酵（12.82%，v/v）相比，除了使用 P. kudriavzevii F2-24/SC 同时共发酵（12.83%，v/v）外，所有共发酵葡萄酒的酒精含量均降低（12.39%，v/v-12.55%，v/v）；与 SC 发酵 (0.40 g/L) 相比，所有共发酵葡萄酒的挥发性酸度较低 (0.19 g/L-0.35 g/L)，这对葡萄酒品质产生了积极影响。与 SC 发酵 (313.71 mg/L) 相比，所有共发酵葡萄酒的酯类含量更高 (406.29 mg/L-649.62 mg/L)，且具有独特的风味化合物特征。 F2-24/SC 和 SLY-4/SC 的连续共发酵具有最高含量的 C13-降异戊二烯和酯，被认为是重要的风味贡献者。

articles.title: Shikimate crosstalk enables record-level homogentisic acid production in <i>Yarrowia lipolytica</i>.
articles.titleZh: 莽草酸串扰使解脂耶氏酵母产生创纪录水平的尿黑酸。
articles.authors: Xu C, Zhang W, Zhao Q, Lin X, Wang K, Wang M, Tan T.
articles.abstract: Homogentisic acid (HGA; 2,5-dihydroxyphenylacetic acid) is an aromatic compound with diverse applications in pharmaceuticals, food, and functional materials. Industrial HGA production still relies mainly on multistep chemical synthesis routes, which are associated with safety risks and environmental burdens. Here, we report that truncated HMG-CoA reductase (tHMGR), a key enzyme of the mevalonate pathway, unexpectedly serves as a dominant metabolic driving force that enhances shikimate-derived HGA biosynthesis in Yarrowia lipolytica. Through a targeted single-gene screen of the mevalonate pathway, tHMGR emerged as the determinant of HGA overproduction, and copy-number optimization increased the shake-flask titer 2.65-fold to 1766.43 mg/L. Transcriptomic analysis and metabolic network evaluation revealed that the massive NADPH consumption driven by tHMGR perturbs the intracellular redox balance. This cofactor depletion triggers a compensatory upregulation of l-tryptophan biosynthesis and shikimate-associated genes, uncovering a previously unrecognized mevalonate-shikimate metabolic crosstalk. The generality of this tHMGR-driven effect was further validated using p-coumaric acid as a shikimate-derived reporter. Finally, fed-batch fermentation achieved 33.71 g/L HGA in a 2-L bioreactor, representing the highest titer reported to date, and establishing tHMGR as a powerful metabolic lever for enhancing shikimate-derived aromatic production in Y. lipolytica.
articles.abstractZh: 均龙胆酸（HGA；2,5-二羟基苯乙酸）是一种芳香族化合物，在药物、食品和功能材料中具有多种应用。工业HGA生产仍然主要依赖多步化学合成路线，存在安全风险和环境负担。在此，我们报道截短的 HMG-CoA 还原酶 (tHMGR)（甲羟戊酸途径的关键酶）出人意料地充当了主要的代谢驱动力，增强了解脂耶氏酵母中源自莽草酸的 HGA 生物合成。通过甲羟戊酸途径的靶向单基因筛选，tHMGR 成为 HGA 过量生产的决定因素，拷贝数优化将摇瓶滴度提高了 2.65 倍，达到 1766.43 mg/L。转录组分析和代谢网络评估表明，tHMGR 驱动的大量 NADPH 消耗扰乱了细胞内氧化还原平衡。这种辅因子的消耗触发了 L-色氨酸生物合成和莽草酸相关基因的补偿性上调，揭示了以前未被识别的甲羟戊酸-莽草酸代谢串扰。使用对香豆酸作为进一步验证了这种 tHMGR 驱动效应的普遍性。

articles.title: Synthetic chromosomes for 3D functional genomics: from principles to AI-guided design.
articles.titleZh: 用于 3D 功能基因组学的合成染色体：从原理到 AI 指导设计。
articles.authors: Perrot M, Serizay J, Koszul R.
articles.abstract: The role of genome 3D organization for fundamental chromatin processes, such as long-range promoter-activator regulatory interactions, remains ambiguous. Synthetic genomics, defined as the rational design of kilobase-scale genomic sequences and their assembly into chromosomal segments spanning up to hundreds of kb (and ultimately, entire genomes), provides powerful solutions to lift this ambiguity and directly test structure-function relationships through controlled perturbations. In this review, we highlight how synthetic genomics approaches overcome traditional experimental constraints by creating simplified but functional systems that isolate specific organizational principles, so far mostly in budding yeast and mammalian cells. Combined with AI-based sequence design, these approaches not only provide unprecedented insight into the organizational logic governing genome function but also open new avenues for therapeutic genomic engineering.
articles.abstractZh: 基因组 3D 组织对于基本染色质过程（例如远程启动子-激活子调控相互作用）的作用仍然不明确。合成基因组学被定义为对千碱基级基因组序列的合理设计，并将其组装成跨越数百 kb 的染色体片段（最终是整个基因组），它提供了强大的解决方案来消除这种模糊性，并通过受控扰动直接测试结构功能关系。在这篇综述中，我们重点介绍了合成基因组学方法如何通过创建简化但功能性的系统来克服传统的实验限制，这些系统隔离了特定的组织原则，到目前为止主要是在芽殖酵母和哺乳动物细胞中。与基于人工智能的序列设计相结合，这些方法不仅为控制基因组功能的组织逻辑提供了前所未有的洞察力，而且为治疗性基因组工程开辟了新的途径。

articles.title: The PpERF3 promotes ethylene-induced anthocyanin biosynthesis in peach.
articles.titleZh: PpERF3 促进桃子中乙烯诱导的花青素生物合成。
articles.journal: Plant science : an international journal of experimental plant biology
articles.authors: You Q, Mu J, Wang Q, Xiao T, Chang M, Liu Y.
articles.abstract: Ethylene is a key hormone regulating fruit ripening; however, the mechanism by which it controls anthocyanin biosynthesis during peach fruit ripening remains a pivotal question in the field. In this study, physiological observations showed that exogenous ethylene treatment influences anthocyanin accumulation, but the specific molecular mechanism underlying this process remains unclear. Transcriptome analysis of peach mesocarp from red-fleshed and white-fleshed varieties at different developmental stages, combined with exogenous ethylene treatment and RT-qPCR, revealed that the ethylene response factor PpERF3 is likely involved in anthocyanin biosynthesis. Overexpression of PpERF3 in tobacco leaves and peach exocarp significantly induced coloration. Yeast two-hybrid (Y2H) and bimolecular fluorescence complementation (BiFC) assays confirmed that PpERF3 interacts with PpMYB10.1, and that the PpMYB10.1-bHLH3 module activates the transcription of anthocyanin biosynthesis genes PpCHI/F3H/DFR/UFGT. Furthermore, yeast one-hybrid (Y1H) and dual-luciferase (Dual-LUC) assays demonstrated that PpERF3 activates the transcription of PpCHI/F3H/DFR/UFGT/MYB10.1, thereby promoting anthocyanin biosynthesis. This study demonstrates that PpERF3 promotes anthocyanin accumulation during peach ripening through direct gene activation or its involvement in a transcription factor complex, uncovering a synergistic ERF-MYB regulatory mechanism for fruit coloration.
articles.abstractZh: 乙烯是调节果实成熟的关键激素；然而，它控制桃果实成熟过程中花青素生物合成的机制仍然是该领域的关键问题。在本研究中，生理学观察表明，外源乙烯处理会影响花青素的积累，但该过程的具体分子机制仍不清楚。对不同发育阶段的红肉和白肉品种的桃中果皮进行转录组分析，结合外源乙烯处理和RT-qPCR，揭示乙烯反应因子PpERF3可能参与花青素的生物合成。 PpERF3 在烟叶和桃外果皮中的过度表达显着诱导着色。酵母双杂交 (Y2H) 和双分子荧光互补 (BiFC) 测定证实 PpERF3 与 PpMYB10.1 相互作用，并且 PpMYB10.1-bHLH3 模块激活花青素生物合成基因 PpCHI/F3H/DFR/UFGT 的转录。此外，酵母单杂交 (Y1H) 和双荧光素酶 (Dual-LUC) 检测表明，PpERF3 激活 PpCHI/F3H/DFR/UFGT/MYB10.1 的转录，从而促进花青素生物合成

articles.title: Transcriptional Regulation of the Novel Theacrine Synthase Gene CsTcS2 by the CsTINY-CsWRKY33 Module Underpins Theacrine Biosynthesis in Camellia sinensis.
articles.titleZh: CsTINY-CsWRKY33 模块对新型茶碱合成酶基因 CsTcS2 的转录调控支撑了茶树的茶碱生物合成。
articles.authors: Wu T, Zhu L, Shao C, Xie S, Li N, Li X, Wang F, Peng L, Jin H, Shang F, Huang J, Liu Z, Tian N, Liu S.
articles.abstract: Theacrine (1,3,7,9-tetramethyluric acid) is a purine alkaloid detected in multiple wild and specialised tea germplasms (Camellia sinensis) from South China, including Kucha. However, the molecular mechanisms governing its biosynthesis remain poorly understood. Here, we identify CsTcS2 as a novel theacrine synthase in tea plant. Functional assays involving heterologous expression in Nicotiana benthamiana, antisense oligonucleotide-mediated gene silencing, transient overexpression in tea plants and co-expression with caffeine dehydrogenase (CsCDH) confirm its catalytic role in converting caffeine to theacrine. Transcription factors CsTINY and CsWRKY33 directly bind the CsTcS2 promoter and activate its transcription, as demonstrated by yeast one-hybrid, dual-luciferase reporter and electrophoretic mobility shift assays. Further molecular docking, yeast two-hybrid, bimolecular fluorescence complementation, luciferase complementation, co-immunoprecipitation and antisense inhibition experiments reveal a synergistic interaction between CsTINY and CsWRKY33 that regulates CsTcS2 expression and thus controls theacrine biosynthesis. Together, our findings unravel the transcriptional regulatory network underlying theacrine biosynthesis and provide a molecular foundation for breeding tea cultivars with elevated theacrine levels for health-promoting applications.
articles.abstractZh: 茶碱（1,3,7,9-四甲基尿酸）是一种嘌呤生物碱，在中国南方（包括龟兹）的多种野生和特化茶种质（Camellia sinensis）中检测到。然而，控制其生物合成的分子机制仍然知之甚少。在这里，我们将 CsTcS2 鉴定为茶树中的一种新型茶碱合酶。功能测定涉及烟草中的异源表达、反义寡核苷酸介导的基因沉默、茶树中的瞬时过表达以及与咖啡因脱氢酶（CsCDH）的共表达，证实了其在将咖啡因转化为茶碱中的催化作用。转录因子 CsTINY 和 CsWRKY33 直接结合 CsTcS2 启动子并激活其转录，如酵母单杂交、双荧光素酶报告基因和电泳迁移率变动测定所证明的那样。进一步的分子对接、酵母双杂交、双分子荧光互补、荧光素酶互补、免疫共沉淀和反义抑制实验揭示了CsTINY和CsWRKY33之间的协同相互作用，调节CsTcS2表达，从而控制茶碱生物合成。总之，我们的发现揭示了转录调节因子

articles.title: Evolving natural yeast to protein-rich micro-grain adaptable for non-sterile low-carbon biomanufacturing.
articles.titleZh: 将天然酵母进化为富含蛋白质的微粒，适用于非无菌低碳生物制造。
articles.authors: Wang X, Xu Z, Shi Z, Rong W, He H, Zhou H, Liu L, Liu Z, Sui W, Wang G, Ma Y.
articles.abstract: A stable protein supply is essential for both human and planetary health. Low-carbon microbial manufacturing provides an arable land-independent and carbon-neutral route for protein supply, while it is limited by the natural capacity for cellular protein synthesis and high energy consumption for sterile fermentation. To address these challenges, a robust system was established for efficient protein synthesis from low-carbon acetic acid under non-sterile conditions. Yeast strains naturally capable of utilizing acetic acid under acid and high-salinity conditions were isolated from traditional fermented vegetables, and their unique ability to enable microbial protein production in non-sterile conditions, mineral medium containing acetic acid as the sole carbon source at pH = 5 or with additional 100 g/L NaCl, was validated. To further improve the protein yield, a high-throughput single cell screening method was developed to monitor the cellular macromolecule composition, and acid- and salt-tolerant strains were evolved for higher protein content, achieving an up to 7% improvement. Cultivation of the evolved strain under non-sterile conditions resulted in micro-grains with a protein content of 46 ± 2%. The robustness of the strain and process was further demonstrated through the valorization of low-cost industrial by-product acetic acid into protein. This work explores the potential of natural and artificial evolution and establishes a superior platform for protein-rich micro-grain synthesis through low-cost and low-carbon microbial manufacturing.
articles.abstractZh: 稳定的蛋白质供应对于人类和地球的健康至关重要。低碳微生物制造为蛋白质供应提供了一条不依赖耕地和碳中性的途径，但它受到细胞蛋白质合成的自然能力和无菌发酵的高能耗的限制。为了应对这些挑战，建立了一个强大的系统，用于在非无菌条件下从低碳乙酸高效合成蛋白质。从传统发酵蔬菜中分离出天然能够在酸性和高盐度条件下利用乙酸的酵母菌株，并验证了它们在非无菌条件下、在 pH = 5 下以乙酸为唯一碳源或添加 100 g/L NaCl 的矿物培养基中实现微生物蛋白质生产的独特能力。为了进一步提高蛋白质产量，开发了高通量单细胞筛选方法来监测细胞大分子组成，并进化出耐酸和耐盐菌株以获得更高的蛋白质含量，实现了高达7%的提高。在非无菌条件下培养进化菌株产生了带有蛋白质辅酶的微颗粒。

articles.title: PHYCUT: Scalable Multiplex CRISPR/Cas9 Editing for Genome Engineering in the Diatom <i>Phaeodactylum tricornutum</i>.
articles.titleZh: PHYCUT：硅藻三角褐指藻基因组工程的可扩展多重 CRISPR/Cas9 编辑。
articles.authors: Stuckless EE, Gai LS, Slattery SS, Dempsey KH, Browne TS, Gloor GB, Edgell DR.
articles.abstract: Diatoms are globally significant microalgae that contribute ∼20% of oxygen production and exhibit remarkable metabolic diversity. The marine diatom Phaeodactylum tricornutum has emerged as a promising synthetic biology platform for the bioproduction of recombinant proteins, supported by a human-like N-linked glycosylation pathway. However, its α(1,3)-linked core fucose is potentially immunogenic in humans and thus limits its biopharmaceutical applications. One hurdle to efficient genome engineering in P. tricornutum is the lack of a robust system for simultaneous CRISPR/Cas9 editing at multiple sites. To overcome this limitation, we develop PHYCUT (Phaeodactylum tricornutum Csy4-Cas9 multiplex tool), a versatile plasmid-based CRISPR/Cas9 system that uses the Csy4 endoribonuclease to process multiguide RNA arrays. To highlight PHYCUT applications, we demonstrate multiplex editing of all three FucT genes responsible for α(1,3) fucosylation in P. tricornutum, yielding strains with reduced fucosylation of secreted proteins. PHYCUT enables facile, multiplexed genome engineering in diatoms and provides a foundation for humanizing the P. tricornutum glycosylation pathway to support next-generation algal biotechnology.
articles.abstractZh: 硅藻是全球重要的微藻，贡献约 20% 的氧气产量，并表现出显着的代谢多样性。海洋硅藻三角褐指藻 (Phaeodactylum tricornutum) 已成为一种有前途的合成生物学平台，用于重组蛋白的生物生产，并得到类人 N 连接糖基化途径的支持。然而，其α(1,3)连接的核心岩藻糖在人体中具有潜在的免疫原性，因此限制了其生物制药应用。三角藻高效基因组工程的一大障碍是缺乏可在多个位点同时进行 CRISPR/Cas9 编辑的强大系统。为了克服这一限制，我们开发了 PHYCUT（三角褐指藻 Csy4-Cas9 多重工具），这是一种基于质粒的多功能 CRISPR/Cas9 系统，使用 Csy4 核糖核酸内切酶处理多引导 RNA 阵列。为了突出 PHYCUT 应用，我们演示了对三角褐藻中负责 α(1,3) 岩藻糖基化的所有三个 FucT 基因进行多重编辑，产生分泌蛋白岩藻糖基化减少的菌株。 PHYCUT 能够在硅藻中进行简便、多重的基因组工程，并为人源化三角角藻糖基化途径提供基础，以支持下一代

articles.title: Comparative characterization of Cas12f orthologs reveals mechanistic features underlying enhanced genome editing efficiency.
articles.titleZh: Cas12f 直系同源物的比较表征揭示了增强基因组编辑效率的机制特征。
articles.authors: Guan K, Ocampo RF, Matheus Carnevali PB, Castelle CJ, Gonzalez-Osorio L, Castanzo DT, Thomas NC, Brothers M, Dangerfield TL, Hooper MM, West MS, Appleby NM, Krudop I, Lamothe RC, Aliaga Goltsman DS, Alexander LM, Butterfield CN, Johnson KA, Brown CT, Taylor DW.
articles.abstract: Miniature CRISPR-Cas12f nucleases are attractive candidates for therapeutic genome editing because of their compact size and compatibility with adeno-associated virus (AAV) delivery. However, editing efficiencies in mammalian cells are lower than those of larger systems. The extensive phylogenetic diversity of Cas12f suggests unexplored mechanistic variation with the potential for optimization. Here we identify and characterize a naturally occurring Cas12f ortholog discovered through metagenomics, Alistipes sp. Cas12f (Al3Cas12f), which supports robust genome editing in human cells. Through structural, biochemical and kinetic analyses, we compare Al3Cas12f to two recently described orthologs, Oscillibacter sp. Cas12f and Ruminiclostridium herbifermentans Cas12f. These orthologs present divergent architectures and regulatory features governing protospacer-adjacent motif recognition, guide RNA (gRNA) binding, dimerization and DNA cleavage. Notably, Al3Cas12f achieves efficient R-loop formation through a stable dimer interface and a naturally optimized gRNA. Leveraging these structural insights, we generate an engineered Al3Cas12f variant (RKK) that increases editing and improves activity across several tested genomic loci. By overcoming locus-dependent variability and an apparent potency threshold, this engineered compact editor seems to expand the feasibility of low-dose, AAV-compatible therapeutic genome editing. Our results elucidate mechanistic determinants of Cas12f activity and offer a framework for engineering compact genome editors that may bear therapeutic potential.
articles.abstractZh: 微型 CRISPR-Cas12f 核酸酶因其紧凑的尺寸和与腺相关病毒 (AAV) 传递的兼容性而成为治疗性基因组编辑的有吸引力的候选者。然而，哺乳动物细胞的编辑效率低于较大系统的编辑效率。 Cas12f 广泛的系统发育多样性表明其存在尚未探索的机制变异，具有优化的潜力。在这里，我们鉴定并表征了通过宏基因组学发现的天然存在的 Cas12f 直系同源物 Alitipes sp。 Cas12f (Al3Cas12f)，支持人类细胞中强大的基因组编辑。通过结构、生化和动力学分析，我们将 Al3Cas12f 与最近描述的两种直向同源物 Oscillibacter sp. 进行比较。 Cas12f 和瘤胃梭状芽胞杆菌 Cas12f。这些直系同源物呈现出不同的结构和调控特征，控制着原型间隔子相邻基序识别、引导RNA (gRNA) 结合、二聚化和DNA 切割。值得注意的是，Al3Cas12f 通过稳定的二聚体界面和自然优化的 gRNA 实现了高效的 R 环形成。利用这些结构见解，我们生成了一种工程化的 Al3Cas12f 变体 (RKK)，它可以增加编辑并改善活性

articles.title: Design of the biosensor-dependent coupling system stabilizes the high-synthesis phenotype of cell factory.
articles.titleZh: 生物传感器依赖性偶联系统的设计稳定了细胞工厂的高合成表型。
articles.authors: Qin L, Yang B, Huang R, Zhang H, Li Q, Li X, Tan Y, Sun W, Jia H, Hu B, Lv B, Li C.
articles.abstract: Microbial cell factories offer a sustainable route to plant-derived natural products, but yield drift and strain degeneration persist. Growth-coupled biosynthesis can continuously enrich high producers, yet specific product-responsive biosensors remain scarce and their population-level effects are unclear. Here, we describe a rapid transcriptome-mining workflow that, as proof-of-concept, delivers yeast biosensors for glycyrrhetinic acid and medicarpin. By fine-tuning PDR5 promoter, we expand the dynamic range of the glycyrrhetinic acid sensor and wire it to an essential gene, establishing a growth-addiction circuit that increases titer by 46.8 % after subculture. Single-cell transcriptome reveals that the evolved strain population exhibits a completely different division of labor compared to the initial strain. Coupling does not eliminate phenotypic heterogeneity; instead, it amplifies a dedicated sub-population marked by discrete transcriptional signatures. Deletion of genes highly expressed in non-producing cells or enrichment of high-producing cell clusters can further boost population-level production. This study provides both a generalizable biosensor-discovery platform and single-cell-guided strategies for stabilizing and optimizing natural-product cell factories.
articles.abstractZh: 微生物细胞工厂为生产植物源性天然产品提供了一条可持续的途径，但产量漂移和菌株退化仍然存在。生长耦合生物合成可以不断丰富高生产者，但特定产品响应的生物传感器仍然稀缺，其群体水平的影响尚不清楚。在这里，我们描述了一种快速转录组挖掘工作流程，作为概念验证，它提供了甘草次酸和麦卡平的酵母生物传感器。通过微调 PDR5 启动子，我们扩大了甘草次酸传感器的动态范围，并将其连接到必需基因，建立了生长成瘾回路，继代培养后滴度增加了 46.8%。单细胞转录组揭示，与初始菌株相比，进化后的菌株群体表现出完全不同的分工。偶联并不能消除表型异质性；相反，它放大了由离散转录特征标记的专用亚群。删除非生产细胞中高表达的基因或富集高生产细胞簇可以进一步提高群体水平的生产。这项研究提供了一个通用的生物传感器发现平台和系统

articles.title: Development of a GMO-free de novo lager yeast with reduced phenolic off-flavor production through interspecific hybridization and UV mutagenesis.
articles.titleZh: 通过种间杂交和紫外线诱变开发一种不含转基因生物的从头啤酒酵母，减少酚类异味的产生。
articles.authors: Nasuti C, Iannuzziello G, Ceramelli Papiani V, Tagliazucchi D, Krogerus K, Solieri L.
articles.abstract: Lager beers are traditionally brewed using Saccharomyces pastorianus, a natural hybrid between S. cerevisiae and S. eubayanus that combines robust fermentation with cold tolerance. However, commercial lager yeasts originate from a narrow genetic pool, limiting strain diversity and aromatic complexity. To meet growing demand for new lager beer profiles, the development of novel non-GMO strains is increasingly important. Many wild yeasts from non-brewing environments can ferment wort but produce phenolic off-flavor (POF+) by converting ferulic acid (FA) into 4-vinyl guaiacol (4-VG), restricting their industrial applicability. In this study, a de novo POF+ lager-like hybrid (FM1) generated by spore-to-spore mating between a monosporic culture of the sourdough strain S. cerevisiae Y15 and S. eubayanus x S. uvarum NBRC1948, was submitted to UV mutagenesis to reduce POF formation. Screening on FA-supplemented medium identified a POF-reduced mutant, FM1.45, showing lower ferulic acid conversion and higher cinnamic acid sensitivity than FM1. Wort microfermentation trials demonstrated that FM1 and FM1.45 both outperformed the parental strains in fermentation kinetics and produced similar aroma profiles, with FM1.45 generating substantially less 4-VG than FM1. Sanger sequencing results were consistent with a loss of the S. eubayanus PAD1-FDC1 gene cluster and a frameshift mutation in the S. cerevisiae FDC1 gene, leading to a non-functional ferulic acid decarboxylase. Flow cytometry supported a ploidy increase from 3n to 4n in FM1.45, which likely accounts for the restored spore viability observed in this mutant compared with the sterile FM1. Overall, this work demonstrates that combining interspecific hybridization with UV mutagenesis represents an effective GMO-free strategy for generating novel lager yeast strains with robust fermentation performance and reduced POF production.
articles.abstractZh: 传统上，贮藏啤酒是使用巴斯德酵母（Saccharomyces Pastorianus）酿造的，它是酿酒酵母（S. cerevisiae）和酵母酵母（S. eubayanus）的天然杂交种，结合了强劲的发酵能力和耐寒性。然而，商业啤酒酵母源自狭窄的遗传库，限制了菌株多样性和芳香复杂性。为了满足对新型啤酒特性不断增长的需求，新型非转基因菌株的开发变得越来越重要。许多来自非酿造环境的野生酵母可以发酵麦芽汁，但通过将阿魏酸 (FA) 转化为 4-乙烯基愈创木酚 (4-VG) 产生酚类异味 (POF+)，限制了其工业应用。在这项研究中，通过酵母菌株 S. cerevisiae Y15 和 S. eubayanus x S. uvarum NBRC1948 的单孢子培养物之间的孢子与孢子交配产生了从头 POF+ 啤酒样杂种 (FM1)，并进行了紫外线诱变以减少 POF 的形成。在添加 FA 的培养基上进行筛选，鉴定出 POF 减少的突变体 FM1.45，与 FM1 相比，该突变体显示出较低的阿魏酸转化率和较高的肉桂酸敏感性。麦芽汁微发酵试验表明，FM1 和 FM1.45 在发酵动力学方面均优于亲本菌株，并产生相似的发酵效果。

articles.title: Divergent Roles of SmHMGR2 and a Novel SmHMGR5 in Tanshinone Biosynthesis Revealed by CRISPR/Cas9-Mediated Knockout in <i>Salvia miltiorrhiza</i>.
articles.titleZh: CRISPR/Cas9 介导的丹参敲除揭示了 SmHMGR2 和新型 SmHMGR5 在丹参酮生物合成中的不同作用。
articles.authors: Lan Z, Tian M, Liu J, Shi W, Chen T, Ma Q, Jin B, Zhao Y, Zhang H, Lai CJ, Cui G.
articles.abstract: 3-Hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl coenzyme A reductase (HMGR) serves as a key rate-limiting enzyme in the mevalonate pathway and plays a central regulatory role in the biosynthesis of tanshinones. To date, four HMGR family members (SmHMGR1-4) have been identified in Salvia miltiorrhiza. Here, we cloned and identified a novel member, SmHMGR5, by integrating multiple genomic datasets. Genomically, SmHMGR5 formed an inverted repeat with SmHMGR3 (98.04% homology) and phylogenetically clustered with SmHMGR2. Based on the expression patterns of the five HMGR genes, we further generated SmHMGR2 and SmHMGR5 knockout mutants using CRISPR/Cas9 technology and compared their effects on the accumulation of 12 tanshinones and 4 phenolic acids via UPLC-MS-based metabolomic analysis. Knockout of SmHMGR2 significantly suppressed the accumulation of seven tanshinones, whereas SmHMGR5 knockout downregulated only three tanshinones, and neither mutation affected phenolic acids. Notably, the major compound tanshinone IIA remained stable across different mutants, but tanshinone IIB was markedly reduced upon SmHMGR2 knockout, suggesting complex regulatory mechanisms in tanshinone biosynthesis. These findings provide new insights into the biosynthetic network of tanshinones and establish a theoretical foundation for metabolic engineering strategies aimed at enhancing the production of bioactive constituents in S. miltiorrhiza.

articles.title: Effects of Prepartum Supplementation and Yeast Fermentation Products on the Progesterone-Modulated Transfer of Passive Immunity in Bos indicus Cows.
articles.titleZh: 产前补充剂和酵母发酵产品对黄体酮调节牛被动免疫转移的影响。
articles.journal: Journal of animal physiology and animal nutrition
articles.authors: Coimbra LGS, Cowley FC, Fordyce G, Silva LFP.
articles.abstract: Inadequate colostrum intake increases risks of calf morbidity and mortality. This study investigated the effects of prepartum and early postpartum supplementation and yeast fermentation products on late-pregnant Bos indicus cows, and the role of progesterone in mediating passive immunity transfer. Thirty-six Brahman cows were allocated to three treatment groups: Control (ad libitum Rhodes grass hay), Supp (Control plus 1 kg/day supplement) and SCFP (Supp plus 14 g/day Saccharomyces cerevisiae fermentation products). Treatments started 30 days before the expected calving date and continued until 14 days postpartum. Cow plasma samples were collected three times a week (Monday, Wednesday and Friday), and modelled to reflect daily changes in progesterone leading up to calving. Calf plasma samples were taken twice within the first 5 days of life, and colostrum samples were collected 6-12 h post-calving. Live weights of both cows and calves were measured three times a week for 14 days before and after calving. Data were analysed using a linear mixed-effects model, and plasma progesterone concentration was assessed with a segmented mixed model. Supplementation (Supp vs. Control) improved cow nutritional status during the prepartum period, increasing dry matter, protein and metabolizable energy intake (p < 0.05), resulting in higher plasma urea (p < 0.01) and lower plasma non-esterified fatty acids (p < 0.01) and beta-hydroxybutyrate (p = 0.01) during the last week before calving. Supplementation reduced plasma progesterone concentration during the 3 days before calving (p < 0.05), which was associated with enhanced transfer of maternal IgG into colostrum (p = 0.03) and improved calf growth (p = 0.01). Yeast fermentation products (SCFP) further improved passive immunity transfer to calves (p = 0.02). These findings highlight the effectiveness of short-term prepartum supplementation, especially with yeast fermentation products, and the important role of progesterone in mediating passive immunity transfer.
articles.abstractZh: 初乳摄入不足会增加犊牛发病和死亡的风险。本研究调查了产前和产后早期补充和酵母发酵产品对妊娠晚期红牛的影响，以及黄体酮在介导被动免疫转移中的作用。将 36 头婆罗门奶牛分配到三个处理组：对照（随意采食罗德草干草）、Supp（对照加 1 kg/天的补充剂）和 SCFP（Supp 加 14 g/天的酿酒酵母发酵产品）。治疗从预产期前 30 天开始，一直持续到产后 14 天。每周收集三次奶牛血浆样本（周一、周三和周五），并进行建模以反映产犊前黄体酮的每日变化。在出生后 5 天内采集两次犊牛血浆样本，并在产犊后 6-12 小时采集初乳样本。在产犊前后 14 天，每周测量 3 次母牛和犊牛的活重。使用线性混合效应模型分析数据，并使用分段混合模型评估血浆孕酮浓度。补充剂（补充与对照）得到改善

articles.title: Enhanced production and biodeinking application of β-glucosidase from Aspergillus niger S1 via submerged fermentation using office paper waste through conventional and statistical approaches.
articles.titleZh: 通过常规和统计方法，利用办公用纸废物进行深层发酵，增强黑曲霉 S1 β-葡萄糖苷酶的生产和生物脱墨应用。
articles.authors: Ali D, Hasanin MS, Abdelraof M, Othman AM, Abdel Karim GSA, Elsayed AM.
articles.abstract: BACKGROUND: β-glucosidases are highly versatile catalysts with significant potential in various industries, including wastepaper deinking, which is a sustainable alternative due to its high effectiveness and minimal environmental impact. RESULTS: In this study, the optimal conditions for using submerged fermentation (SmF) to produce β-glucosidase from a newly isolated soil fungal species (Aspergillus niger S1) were improved. The main variables that influence the formation of β-glucosidase were examined, including temperature, pH, incubation period, nitrogen source, emulsifier concentration, and carbon source concentration. The production of β-glucosidase by the recently isolated Aspergillus niger S1 using office paper waste (OPW) as feedstock is encouraging because it reached its maximum production after just 3 days of incubation at pH 6.5 and 30 °C with office paper waste (15 g/L) serving as a carbon source at 1.5% (w/v), Tween 80 at 1.5% (v/v), and yeast extract as a nitrogen source. Using the CCD-based optimization approach, an enzyme yield of 3.35 U/mL β-galactosidase was achieved after 3 days of incubation at pH 6.0, with 1.5% (w/v) office paper waste and 1 g/L yeast extract. It was confirmed by the results that the β-glucosidase activity eliminated the ink particles and that this action improved the ash content, whiteness, and tensile strength. CONCLUSION: The findings showed that the investigated enzyme was a suitable green substitute for office paper waste deinking in the direction of sustainable waste management.
articles.abstractZh: 背景：β-葡萄糖苷酶是用途广泛的催化剂，在各个行业中具有巨大潜力，包括废纸脱墨，由于其高效性和对环境影响最小，废纸脱墨是一种可持续的替代品。结果：本研究改进了利用深层发酵（SmF）从新分离的土壤真菌（黑曲霉 S1）中生产 β-葡萄糖苷酶的最佳条件。考察了影响β-葡萄糖苷酶形成的主要变量，包括温度、pH、培养时间、氮源、乳化剂浓度和碳源浓度。最近分离的黑曲霉 S1 以办公废纸 (OPW) 为原料生产 β-葡萄糖苷酶，这是令人鼓舞的，因为在 pH 6.5 和 30 °C 下，以办公废纸 (15 g/L) 为 1.5% (w/v) 的碳源，Tween 80 为 1.5% (v/v)，酵母提取物为氮源，仅培养 3 天就达到了最大产量。使用基于 CCD 的优化方法，在 pH 6.0 下孵育 3 天后，使用 1.5% (w/v) 办公用纸废料和 1 g/L 酵母提取物，β-半乳糖苷酶的酶产量达到 3.35 U/mL β-半乳糖苷酶。

articles.title: Multifaceted antifungal and antibiofilm activities of Mo-CBP<sub>2</sub> against Candida species: Structural disruption, cell membrane, cell wall interaction, and synergistic potential.
articles.titleZh: Mo-CBP<sub>2</sub> 针对念珠​​菌属的多方面抗真菌和抗生物膜活性：结构破坏、细胞膜、细胞壁相互作用和协同潜力。
articles.authors: da Silva Neto JX, da Silva APA, Guedes MIF, de Oliveira Bezerra de Sousa D.
articles.abstract: Clinically relevant species of Candida are opportunistic pathogens capable of forming complex and resilient biofilms, which contribute to antifungal resistance and poor clinical outcomes. In the search for alternative therapeutic agents, plant-derived proteins with antifungal properties have gained attention. This study investigates the antifungal and antibiofilm activities of Mo-CBP2, a chitin-binding protein isolated from Moringa oleifera seeds, against clinically relevant Candida species. Mo-CBP2 effectively inhibited planktonic cells, biofilm formation, and mature biofilms of C. albicans, C. tropicalis, C. parapsilosis, and C. krusei. Scanning electron microscopy revealed significant morphological alterations, including collapsed cells, porosity, and cytoplasmic leakage. Mechanistic assays suggested that Mo-CBP2 does not act on cell wall biosynthesis, as osmoprotective rescue with sorbitol was ineffective. Additionally, Mo-CBP2 did not inhibit ergosterol biosynthesis but showed partial activity reversal in the presence of exogenous ergosterol, suggesting membrane interaction. The antifungal effect was also attenuated by ascorbic acid, indicating potential involvement of reactive oxygen species (ROS). Furthermore, Mo-CBP2 displayed strong synergism with conventional antifungals, reducing their inhibitory concentrations against biofilms. The protein's lack of cytotoxicity, combined with its multitargeted antifungal profile, supports its potential as a safe and effective bioactive compound. These findings underscore the value of Mo-CBP2 as a candidate for developing novel antifungal strategies, particularly against biofilm-associated infections.
articles.abstractZh: 临床相关的念珠菌属是机会性病原体，能够形成复杂且有弹性的生物膜，从而导致抗真菌耐药性和不良的临床结果。在寻找替代治疗剂的过程中，具有抗真菌特性的植物源性蛋白质引起了人们的关注。本研究调查了 Mo-CBP2（一种从辣木种子中分离出的几丁质结合蛋白）针对临床相关念珠菌属的抗真菌和抗生物膜活性。 Mo-CBP2 有效抑制白色念珠菌、热带念珠菌、近平滑念珠菌和克柔念珠菌的浮游细胞、生物膜形成和成熟生物膜。扫描电子显微镜显示显着的形态变化，包括细胞塌陷、孔隙度和细胞质渗漏。机理分析表明，Mo-CBP2 不作用于细胞壁生物合成，因为山梨醇的渗透保护救援无效。此外，Mo-CBP2 不抑制麦角甾醇生物合成，但在外源麦角甾醇存在的情况下表现出部分活性逆转，表明膜相互作用。抗坏血酸也减弱了抗真菌作用，表明反应活性的潜在参与

articles.title: Oenological Characteristics of Selected <i>Saccharomyces</i> and Non-<i>Saccharomyces</i> Isolates Obtained from Polish Grape Wines of Spontaneous Fermentation and Their Potential as Wine Starter Cultures.
articles.titleZh: 从自发发酵的波兰葡萄酒中获得的精选Saccharomyces和非Saccharomyces分离物的酿酒学特征及其作为葡萄酒发酵剂培养物的潜力。
articles.authors: Kordowska-Wiater M, Stój A, Komoń-Janczara E, Pytka M, Staniszewski A, Walasek M, Czernecki T, Kapłan M.
articles.abstract: Spontaneously fermented wines are a habitat for many Saccharomyces and non-Saccharomyces strains that are typical for a given region. The isolates obtained can serve as regional starter cultures for winemaking. The aim of this study was to isolate, identify and evaluate the oenological properties and fermentation suitability of selected yeast isolates obtained from Polish spontaneously fermented grape wines. The isolated yeasts were genetically identified and characterised in terms of ethanol tolerance, enzymatic activities, H2S production, and preliminary killer activity. In small-scale fermentations conducted in CDGJ medium and grape juice, the fermentation rate, pH, number of yeast, content of sugars, ethanol, organic acids and volatile compounds were determined. Genetic identification revealed the species: Saccharomyces cerevisiae, S. paradoxus, Metschnikowia pulcherrima, M. ziziphicola, Hanseniaspora uvarum, and Pichia kluyveri. Non-Saccharomyces and Saccharomyces strains grew poorly in the presence of 4-6% (v/v) and 14-16% (v/v) ethanol, respectively. The yeasts had varied enzymatic activities in API ZYM tests, and production of H2S, but did not exhibit killer activity. The monocultures showed differences in fermentation rates. The best growth was recorded for all strains during grape juice fermentation, up to 109 cfu/mL, producing ethanol and glycerol in the range of 53.92-86.54 g/L and 0.0-4.48 g/L. Yeasts produced characteristic volatile compounds, e.g., esters: 2-phenylethyl acetate and ethyl decanoate. The monocultures of isolated yeasts can be used in fermentation of grape must, yielding wines with diverse characteristics in terms of ethanol, organic acids and volatile compounds.
articles.abstractZh: 自然发酵的葡萄酒是特定地区典型的许多酵母菌和非酵母菌菌株的栖息地。获得的分离物可以作为酿酒的区域发酵剂。本研究的目的是分离、鉴定和评估从波兰自然发酵葡萄酒中获得的选定酵母分离物的酿酒特性和发酵适宜性。对分离的酵母进行了遗传鉴定，并对其乙醇耐受性、酶活性、H2S 产生和初步杀灭活性进行了表征。在 CDGJ 培养基和葡萄汁中进行的小规模发酵中，测定了发酵速率、pH、酵母数量、糖、乙醇、有机酸和挥发性化合物的含量。基因鉴定揭示了该物种：酿酒酵母、奇异酵母、Metschnikowia pulcherrima、M. ziziphicola、Hanseniaspora uvarum 和 Pichia kluyveri。非酵母属和酵母属菌株分别在 4-6% (v/v) 和 14-16% (v/v) 乙醇存在下生长不良。这些酵母在 API ZYM 测试中具有不同的酶活性，并产生 H2S，但没有表现出杀伤活性。他们

articles.title: Sequential fermentation with immobilized Hanseniaspora opuntiae in fungal pellets and Saccharomyces cerevisiae for reduced-ethanol wine production.
articles.titleZh: 使用真菌颗粒中固定化的仙人掌汉森氏菌和酿酒酵母进行连续发酵，用于减少乙醇的葡萄酒生产。
articles.authors: Alcalá-Jimenez MT, Sánchez-Suárez F, Brunet S, Muñoz-Castells R, Moreno J, Peinado RA, Moreno-García J, García-Martínez T.
articles.abstract: Increased grape sugar concentrations associated with climate change are contributing to higher ethanol levels in wines (up ∼2% v/v), potentially affecting sensory balance. This study investigates a controlled microbiological approach to modulate ethanol concentration and enhance aromatic complexity during alcoholic fermentation through sequential inoculation with Hanseniaspora opuntiae TR-5, a non-commercialnon-Saccharomyces yeast, immobilized in inactive Aspergillus oryzae pellets (Microbial Biocapsules), followed by inoculation with a commercial Saccharomyces cerevisiae strain (Opale). The performance of the immobilized system was compared with sequential fermentation using free (suspended) cells and with spontaneous fermentation. Sequential fermentation with immobilized H. opuntiae TR-5 resulted in a final ethanol concentration of 13.0 ± 0.02% (v/v), lower than that observed in spontaneous fermentation (13.5 ± 0.01% v/v) and in sequential fermentation with free cells (13.2 ± 0.02% v/v). The immobilization strategy enabled the physical removal of the non-Saccharomyces yeast at a defined stage, limiting its metabolic contribution, the interference with S. cerevisiae and allowing controlled ethanol modulation. Wines produced under immobilized conditions exhibited increased concentrations of certainvolatile compounds, including isoamyl alcohols and 2-phenylethanol, as well as higher glycerol levels, which exceeded its sensory perception threshold only in this treatment. Sensory evaluation indicated improved fruity and floral attributes and better gustatory balance in sequential fermentations, particularly in the immobilized system, compared to the spontaneous control. These results demonstrate that the immobilization of H. opuntiae TR-5 in inactive fungal pellets provides a precise and effective strategy to modulate ethanol concentration and enhance the wine's aroma profile, yielding an ethanol reduction of 0.5 ± 0.02% (v/v), which, although representing 25% of the initial target and thus not the optimal result, is nonetheless an encouraging outcome considering the simultaneous attainment of an improved sensory profile.
articles.abstractZh: 与气候变化相关的葡萄糖浓度增加导致葡萄酒中乙醇含量升高（约 2% v/v），可能影响感官平衡。本研究研究了一种受控的微生物方法，通过顺序接种仙人掌汉森氏菌 TR-5（一种非商业非酿酒酵母），固定在非活性米曲霉颗粒（微生物生物胶囊）中，然后接种商业酿酒酵母菌株（Opale），从而在酒精发酵过程中调节乙醇浓度并增强芳香复杂性。将固定化系统的性能与使用游离（悬浮）细胞的连续发酵和自发发酵进行比较。使用固定化仙人掌 TR-5 进行连续发酵，最终乙醇浓度为 13.0 ± 0.02% (v/v)，低于自然发酵 (13.5 ± 0.01% v/v) 和游离细胞连续发酵 (13.2 ± 0.02% v/v) 中观察到的浓度。固定化策略能够在特定阶段物理去除非酿酒酵母，限制其代谢贡献、对酿酒酵母的干扰并允许 c

articles.title: Sulfur signalling in Saccharomyces cerevisiae: From H<sub>2</sub>S to S-persulfidation.
articles.titleZh: 酿酒酵母中的硫信号传导：从 H<sub>2</sub>S 到 S-过硫化。
articles.authors: Ramírez-Robles D, Espinoza-Simón E, López-Miranda M, Torres-Quiroz F.
articles.abstract: Hydrogen sulfide (H2S) is a gasotransmitter that regulates multiple cellular processes, such as carbon metabolism, endoplasmic reticulum stress response, redox homeostasis, and cellular survival. Saccharomyces cerevisiae is one of the few organisms capable of producing H2S through both major pathways-sulfur assimilation and transsulfuration-making it a unique model to study the cellular impact of H2S. Because this compound can be lethal at high concentrations by inhibiting cellular respiration, its production must be tightly regulated. However, at physiological levels, H2S can regulate protein activity, localization, and function, as well as protect against oxidative stress. The mechanism through which this compound acts on proteins is S-persulfidation, a post-translational modification (PTM) on cysteine residues characterized by the formation of a disulfide-like bond on cysteine thiols. Research on S-persulfidation has progressed thanks to techniques capable of distinguishing it from other oxidative states in cysteine residues. Proteins involved in carbon metabolism (such as GAPDH and Pyk1), amino acid biosynthesis (for example, Cys4), the translation machinery, and stress-response pathways have been shown to undergo S-persulfidation, and these cysteines play an important regulatory role. Despite these advances, information on S. cerevisiae remains limited, leaving this field with many possibilities for discovering new processes regulated by H2S and S-persulfidation.
articles.abstractZh: 硫化氢 (H2S) 是一种气体递质，可调节多种细胞过程，例如碳代谢、内质网应激反应、氧化还原稳态和细胞存活。酿酒酵母是少数能够通过硫同化和转硫这两个主要途径产生 H2S 的生物体之一，这使其成为研究 H2S 细胞影响的独特模型。由于这种化合物在高浓度下可通过抑制细胞呼吸而致命，因此必须严格控制其生产。然而，在生理水平上，H2S 可以调节蛋白质活性、定位和功能，并防止氧化应激。该化合物作用于蛋白质的机制是 S-过硫化，这是一种半胱氨酸残基的翻译后修饰 (PTM)，其特征是在半胱氨酸硫醇上形成二硫键样键。由于能够将 S-过硫化与半胱氨酸残基中的其他氧化状态区分开来的技术，S-过硫化的研究取得了进展。参与碳代谢（例如 GAPDH 和 Pyk1）、氨基酸生物合成（例如 Cys4）、翻译机制和应激反应的蛋白质

articles.title: Bioconversion of the C1 substrate methanol to succinic acid with engineered Komagataella phaffii.
articles.titleZh: 使用工程 Komagataella phaffii 将 C1 底物甲醇生物转化为琥珀酸。
articles.authors: Bachleitner S, Lutz L, Lutz G, Mattanovich D.
articles.abstract: Succinic acid is a versatile platform chemical produced either by petrochemistry or via microbial fermentation of sugars. In light of increasing anthropogenic CO2 emissions, sustainable alternatives using non-food, carbon-neutral substrates are urgently needed. Here, we report the efficient biosynthesis of succinic acid from methanol-a promising C1 feedstock derivable from CO2-using the native methylotrophic yeast Komagataella phaffii. By integrating dicarboxylic acid transporters from Aspergillus niger and Schizosaccharomyces pombe, alongside a heterologous cytosolic reductive tricarboxylic acid pathway we achieved titers exceeding 100 g·L-1. Further, by employing a top down approach, we could show that the expression of a transporter is crucial for succinic acid export in K. phaffii, combined with the expression of a fumarase and fumarate reductase, while expression of a malate dehydrogenase contributed minimally to pathway flux. Our work establishes K. phaffii as a robust host for C1-based bioproduction of succinic acid and highlights the potential of methanol in building a more sustainable future of bioprocesses.
articles.abstractZh: 琥珀酸是一种多功能平台化学品，通过石油化学或通过糖的微生物发酵生产。鉴于人为二氧化碳排放量不断增加，迫切需要使用非食品、碳中性基材的可持续替代品。在这里，我们报告了使用天然甲基营养酵母 Komagataella phaffii 从甲醇（一种有前景的 CO2 衍生 C1 原料）中高效生物合成琥珀酸。通过整合来自黑曲霉和粟酒裂殖酵母的二羧酸转运蛋白，以及异源胞质还原三羧酸途径，我们实现了超过 100 g·L-1 的效价。此外，通过采用自上而下的方法，我们可以证明转运蛋白的表达对于法菲酵母中的琥珀酸输出至关重要，结合延胡索酶和延胡索酸还原酶的表达，而苹果酸脱氢酶的表达对途径通量的贡献最小。我们的工作使 K. phaffii 成为基于 C1 的琥珀酸生物生产的强大宿主，并强调了甲醇在构建更可持续的生物过程未来方面的潜力。

articles.title: Homologous recombination-mediated assembly of multiple DNA fragments in Bacillus subtilis via protoplast transformation and inducible RecA expression.
articles.titleZh: 通过原生质体转化和诱导型 RecA 表达，在枯草芽孢杆菌中同源重组介导的多个 DNA 片段的组装。
articles.authors: Kaneko S, Nakahama M, Hashimoto H, Aizawa Y.
articles.abstract: We establish Bacillus subtilis (B. subtilis) as an alternative host for gap-repair cloning (GRC), a methodology that has been predominantly applied in Saccharomyces cerevisiae (S. cerevisiae), which requires recovery of assembled constructs and subsequent re-transformation into Escherichia coli for plasmid amplification. To overcome limitations of the native competence system in B. subtilis, which can lead to loss of DNA termini during uptake, we employed a protoplast transformation approach. Protoplasts were prepared under conditions in which the homologous recombinase RecA is upregulated, and the endogenous recA promoter was further replaced with a xylose-inducible promoter to enable controlled RecA expression. Using this system, we achieved efficient and accurate assembly of multiple DNA fragments with homologous overlaps in a single transformation event. Assembly accuracy was validated by junction PCR and full-length nanopore sequencing. Using this approach, we successfully constructed plasmids of up to 26.5 kb, including assemblies containing fragments of the human MYC locus. These results demonstrate that RecA induction enhances homologous recombination after DNA uptake and that B. subtilis provides a practical and efficient chassis for the construction of large DNA molecules, offering a streamlined alternative to existing GRC methodologies in synthetic genomics.
articles.abstractZh: 我们建立枯草芽孢杆菌（B. subtilis）作为缺口修复克隆（GRC）的替代宿主，这种方法主要应用于酿酒酵母（S. cerevisiae），需要回收组装的构建体并随后重新转化到大肠杆菌中进行质粒扩增。为了克服枯草芽孢杆菌天然能力系统的局限性（可能导致摄取过程中 DNA 末端丢失），我们采用了原生质体转化方法。在同源重组酶RecA上调的条件下制备原生质体，并且内源recA启动子进一步被木糖诱导型启动子取代以实现受控的RecA表达。使用该系统，我们在单个转化事件中实现了具有同源重叠的多个 DNA 片段的高效、准确组装。通过连接 PCR 和全长纳米孔测序验证了组装准确性。使用这种方法，我们成功构建了长达 26.5 kb 的质粒，包括含有人类 MYC 基因座片段的组装体。这些结果表明，RecA 诱导增强了 DNA 摄取和 t 后的同源重组。

articles.title: A novel Azospirillum vistecanum strain from methane digestate promotes plant growth via indole-3-acetic acid biosynthesis.
articles.titleZh: 来自甲烷沼渣的新型固氮螺菌菌株通过吲哚-3-乙酸生物合成促进植物生长。
articles.authors: Moomthong S, Woraruthai T, Tirapanampai C, Rungjroenchaiwat S, Kruasuwan W, Uthaipaisanwong P, Kusonmano K, Jenjaroenpun P, Wongsurawat T, Wongnate T.
articles.abstract: The urgent need for sustainable agricultural inputs has accelerated the search for microbial alternatives to synthetic agrochemicals. In this study, we report the isolation and comprehensive characterization of a novel strain, Azospirillum vistecanum VT-I1, obtained from a methane-enriched digestate system. This strain demonstrated exceptional plant growth-promoting potential through the biosynthesis of indole-3-acetic acid (IAA), a key phytohormone. Genome sequencing and annotation revealed the presence of genes associated with the indole-3-pyruvate (IPyA) pathway, aro9, ipdC, and aldA, with no detectable IAA-degrading gene clusters, supporting a high net auxin yield. Under optimized culture conditions, VT-I1 produced up to 1.206 mM of IAA, significantly surpassing the levels observed in A. brasilense. Functional assays confirmed the bioactivity of this microbial IAA, which enhanced root development in Exacum affine and improved seed germination in Andrographis paniculata. Collectively, these results establish A. vistecanum VT-I1 as a promising candidate for next-generation biofertilizers, offering a scalable, eco-friendly alternative to chemically synthesized auxins. This work expands our understanding of auxin biosynthesis in rhizobacteria and provides a strong foundation for future field applications and microbiome-based crop enhancement strategies. KEY POINTS: • A novel Azospirillum vistecanum was isolated from methane digestate. • The strain produces high levels of indole-3 acetic acid via the IPyA pathway. • Microbial IAA enhances root growth and seed germination in model plants.
articles.abstractZh: 对可持续农业投入的迫切需求加速了对合成农用化学品的微生物替代品的寻找。在这项研究中，我们报告了从富含甲烷的消化系统中获得的新型菌株 Azospirillum vistecanum VT-I1 的分离和综合表征。该菌株通过生物合成一种关键的植物激素吲哚-3-乙酸 (IAA)，表现出非凡的植物生长促进潜力。基因组测序和注释揭示了与吲哚-3-丙酮酸 (IPyA) 途径、aro9、ipdC 和 aldA 相关的基因的存在，没有检测到 IAA 降解基因簇，支持高净生长素产量。在优化的培养条件下，VT-I1 产生高达 1.206 mM 的 IAA，显着超过在 A. brasilense 中观察到的水平。功能分析证实了这种微生物 IAA 的生物活性，它可以增强 Exacum affine 的根系发育并改善穿心莲种子的萌发。总的来说，这些结果表明 A. vistecanum VT-I1 是下一代生物肥料的有前途的候选者，为化学合成的生长素提供了一种可扩展的、环保的替代品。这项工作前

articles.title: Cross-kingdom metabolic coordination enhances flavor formation in Sauce-aroma Baijiu fermentation using a defined synthetic consortium.
articles.titleZh: 使用特定的合成联合体，跨界代谢协调可增强酱香白酒发酵中的风味形成。
articles.authors: Ge C, Zhang Y, Jiang W, Si G, Huang Q, Xu B, Zhang W, Yang L.
articles.abstract: Cross-kingdom microbial interactions, particularly between bacteria and yeast, play a central role in shaping flavor formation in complex solid-state fermented foods, yet the underlying causal mechanisms remain insufficiently resolved. In this study, a defined three-strain synthetic consortium-Bacillus halotolerans G47, Lactiplantibacillus plantarum F15, and Pichia kudriavzevii K44-was constructed to elucidate metabolic cooperation during sauce-aroma Baijiu fermentation. A simplified laboratory-scale solid-state sorghum model was used to characterize microbial dynamics, physicochemical changes, and volatile metabolite formation, while a nutritionally equivalent liquid system enabled multi-species transcriptomic profiling. Mixed-culture fermentation substantially increased the production of key odor-active compounds, particularly ethyl esters, acetate esters, and phenolic derivatives, which showed the most pronounced enhancement. Transcriptomic integration revealed coordinated metabolic reprogramming across the three species, redirecting carbon and nitrogen fluxes toward flavor-related pathways. G47 enhanced aromatic amino acid degradation and phenolic acid decarboxylation; F15 intensified carbohydrate catabolism and organic acid biosynthesis; and K44 activated fatty-acid turnover, alcohol metabolism, and ester-associated pathways. These complementary metabolic shifts collectively promoted ester biosynthesis and phenolic aroma formation. This work demonstrates that enhanced flavor formation arises from interaction-driven metabolic coordination rather than additive single-strain activity. The defined consortium provides a tractable platform for mechanistic investigation and offers a rational basis for designing functional microbial communities to improve flavor quality in solid-state fermented foods.
articles.abstractZh: 跨界微生物相互作用，特别是细菌和酵母之间的相互作用，在复杂固态发酵食品风味形成中发挥着核心作用，但潜在的因果机制仍未得到充分解决。在本研究中，构建了一个明确的三菌株合成菌群——耐盐芽孢杆菌 G47、植物乳杆菌 F15 和库德里亚毕赤酵母 K44——来阐明酱香白酒发酵过程中的代谢协作。使用简化的实验室规模固态高粱模型来表征微生物动力学、理化变化和挥发性代谢物形成，而营养等效的液体系统则能够实现多物种转录组分析。混合培养发酵显着增加了关键气味活性化合物的产量，特别是乙酯、醋酸酯和酚类衍生物，其增强最为显着。转录组整合揭示了这三个物种之间的协调代谢重编程，将碳和氮通量重新导向风味相关途径。 G47增强芳香族氨基酸降解和酚酸脱羧作用； F15整合体

articles.title: Effects of <i>Saccharomyces cerevisiae</i> fermented citric waste inclusion in the diet on animal performance.
articles.titleZh: 饮食中添加酿酒酵母发酵柠檬酸废物对动物生产性能的影响。
articles.authors: Supapong C, Khonkhaeng B, Sangkaew B, Seephueak W, Sriperm C, Cherdthong A.
articles.abstract: This study aimed to evaluate the efficacy of yeast-fermented citric waste (YFCW) as a protein source in the concentrate diet of Brahman crossbred cattle. Citric waste, a by-product from the fruit juice industry, was fermented using Saccharomyces cerevisiae (1.0 × 108 CFU/g) to improve its nutritional value and digestibility. The experiment lasted for 84 days and was conducted using a 4 × 4 Latin square design, consisting of four periods of 21 days each. Four Brahman crossbred cattle were assigned to receive concentrate diets in which soybean meal was replaced with YFCW at 0, 33, 66, and 100% levels. The findings showed that while rice straw intake was unaffected (P > 0.05), increasing levels of YFCW linearly reduced concentrate intake, nutrient intake (including crude protein, NDF, and ADF), and nutrient digestibility (P < 0.05). Temperature and pH levels during rumen fermentation were within ideal ranges. However, cattle fed higher levels of YFCW (66-100%) showed a decrease in the population of protozoa and the concentration of total volatile fatty acids, particularly acetic and butyric acids. With the exception of platelet counts and specific red blood cell indices, the majority of hematological and biochemical parameters did not differ significantly between treatments. In conclusion, YFCW can be used as a protein source in beef cattle diets without adverse effects on animal health. However, replacement levels above 66% may negatively affect feed intake and nutrient digestibility. Appropriate inclusion levels should be considered to ensure sustainable ruminant production.
articles.abstractZh: 本研究旨在评估酵母发酵柠檬酸废物（YFCW）作为婆罗门杂交牛浓缩饲料中蛋白质来源的功效。柠檬酸废物是果汁工业的副产品，使用酿酒酵母（1.0 × 108 CFU/g）进行发酵，以提高其营养价值和消化率。实验持续84天，采用4×4拉丁方设计，分为四期，每期21天。四头婆罗门杂交牛被分配接受浓缩日粮，其中豆粕被 YFCW 替代，含量分别为 0%、33%、66% 和 100%。研究结果表明，虽然稻草摄入量不受影响（P > 0.05），但增加YFCW水平会线性降低精料摄入量、养分摄入量（包括粗蛋白、NDF和ADF）和养分消化率（P < 0.05）。瘤胃发酵过程中的温度和 pH 水平处于理想范围内。然而，饲喂较高水平 YFCW（66-100%）的牛表现出原生动物数量和总挥发性脂肪酸（尤其是乙酸和丁酸）浓度的减少。除血小板计数和特定红细胞指数外，大多数

articles.title: Metabolic Engineering for Biotechnological Production of Bioactive Methylated Flavonoids and Stilbenes: Progress and Perspectives.
articles.titleZh: 生物活性甲基化黄酮类化合物和芪的生物技术生产的代谢工程：进展和前景。
articles.authors: Shrestha SK, Oh TJ.
articles.abstract: Flavonoids and stilbenes are phenylpropanoid-derived secondary metabolites found in plants, fungi, and microorganisms. They serve important physiological functions and offer a range of pharmacological benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, anticancer, and antimicrobial effects. However, many native flavonoids and stilbenes have limited pharmacology and industrial use due to poor bioavailability and low metabolic stability. O-methylation is a key post-biosynthetic modification that improves the physicochemical and pharmacokinetic properties of these compounds. This process, catalyzed by S-adenosyl-L-methionine [SAM]-dependent O-methyltransferases [OMTs], increases lipophilicity, chemical stability, and membrane permeability, often resulting in greater bioactivity. As a result, methylated derivatives such as sakuranetin, acacetin, isorhamnetin, and pterostilbene frequently show enhanced therapeutic efficacy, even though they are less abundant in nature. Advances in metabolic engineering and synthetic biology have enabled efficient biosynthesis of methylated flavonoids and stilbenes in microbial hosts such as Escherichia coli, Saccharomyces cerevisiae, and Streptomyces species. Strategies including pathway optimization, SAM regeneration, enzyme engineering, and CRISPR-based genome editing have significantly improved production yields and regioselectivity, with some systems surpassing native producers. Despite this progress, challenges remain in enzyme specificity, metabolic bottlenecks, and downstream processing. This review summarizes recent developments in understanding methylation biosynthetic pathways, OMT diversity, and microbial engineering strategies. It also highlights the pharmacological significance of methylation and the potential of engineered microbial platforms for sustainable, scalable production of methylated flavonoids and stilbenes for pharmaceutical and nutraceutical use.
articles.abstractZh: 类黄酮和芪是在植物、真菌和微生物中发现的苯丙素衍生的次级代谢产物。它们具有重要的生理功能，并提供一系列药理益处，包括抗氧化、抗炎、抗癌和抗菌作用。然而，许多天然黄酮类和二苯乙烯类化合物由于生物利用度差和代谢稳定性低，其药理学和工业用途受到限制。 O-甲基化是一种关键的生物合成后修饰，可改善这些化合物的理化和药代动力学特性。该过程由 S-腺苷-L-甲硫氨酸 [SAM] 依赖性 O-甲基转移酶 [OMT] 催化，增加亲脂性、化学稳定性和膜通透性，通常会产生更大的生物活性。因此，樱草素、金合欢素、异鼠李素和紫檀芪等甲基化衍生物经常表现出增强的治疗功效，尽管它们在自然界中含量较少。代谢工程和合成生物学的进步使得甲基化类黄酮和二苯乙烯在大肠杆菌、酿酒酵母和链霉菌等微生物宿主中高效生物合成成为可能

articles.title: Photoprotective Potential of a Yeast/Rice Fermentation Filtrate and Sialic Acid in Mitigating UVA-Induced Oxidative Stress and Mitochondrial Dysfunction in Skin Fibroblasts.
articles.titleZh: 酵母/大米发酵滤液和唾液酸在减轻 UVA 诱导的皮肤成纤维细胞氧化应激和线粒体功能障碍方面的光保护潜力。
articles.authors: Yang F, Li M, Zuo Y, Guo M, Liu Z, Wang H.
articles.abstract: Ultraviolet A (UVA) radiation induces oxidative stress and mitochondrial dysfunction in dermal fibroblasts, contributing to photodamage and skin aging. This study investigated the protective effects of Yeast/rice fermentation filtrate (RFF) and sialic acid (SA), both individually and in combination, against UVA-induced damage in human dermal fibroblasts. Cell viability, reactive oxygen species (ROS) levels, intracellular ATP and NAD+ contents, and mitochondrial membrane potential (ΔΨm) were evaluated following treatment. RFF, SA, and their combination significantly improved cell viability in UVA-damaged fibroblasts and reduced ROS generation. Notably, the combined treatment increased intracellular ATP levels by 201.2% (p + levels and effectively preserved mitochondrial membrane potential. Transcriptomic analysis revealed modulation of pathways related to cellular energy metabolism, particularly AMPK, and upregulation of SIRT1, SIRT3, and SIRT5 expression. The RFF-SA combination confers robust UVA photoprotection by enhancing mitochondrial resilience, providing a foundation for the development of protective cosmetic formulations.
articles.abstractZh: 紫外线 A (UVA) 辐射会诱发真皮成纤维细胞的氧化应激和线粒体功能障碍，从而导致光损伤和皮肤老化。本研究调查了酵母/大米发酵滤液 (RFF) 和唾液酸 (SA) 单独或组合对 UVA 引起的人真皮成纤维细胞损伤的保护作用。治疗后评估细胞活力、活性氧 (ROS) 水平、细胞内 ATP 和 NAD+ 含量以及线粒体膜电位 (ΔΨm)。 RFF、SA 及其组合显着提高了 UVA 损伤的成纤维细胞的细胞活力并减少了 ROS 的产生。值得注意的是，联合治疗使细胞内 ATP 水平提高了 201.2%（p + 水平），并有效保留了线粒体膜电位。转录组分析揭示了与细胞能量代谢相关的途径的调节，特别是 AMPK，以及 SIRT1、SIRT3 和 SIRT5 表达的上调。RFF-SA 组合通过增强线粒体弹性，赋予强大的 UVA 光防护能力，为开发保护性化妆品配方奠定了基础。

articles.title: Transcriptomics-guided identification of engineering targets for improving salt tolerance in Saccharomyces cerevisiae.
articles.titleZh: 转录组学指导识别提高酿酒酵母耐盐性的工程靶标。
articles.authors: Li MT, Wang L, Xie CY, Gou M, Tang YQ.
articles.abstract: BackgroundHigh-salinity conditions frequently impair the fermentation performance of Saccharomyces cerevisiae in industrial processes involving high-osmolarity substrates. Identifying genetic determinants that enhance salt tolerance is therefore essential for the development of robust yeast cell factories. In this study, a comparative transcriptomic analysis was performed to investigate the transcriptional responses of a salt-tolerant strain, E-158, and its parental strain, KF-7, under 1.25 M NaCl stress, with the aim of identifying potential targets for strain engineering.ResultsComparative transcriptomic analysis revealed extensive transcriptional differences between E-158 and KF-7 under high-salt conditions, involving central carbon and nitrogen metabolism, peroxisome-associated oxidative stress responses, ion transport, cell wall-related processes, and sporulation-related pathways. Based on these profiles, two transcription factors (CUP9 and ZNF1) and three functional genes (DAL1, IDP2, and CTA1) were selected for functional validation. Overexpression or deletion of the transcription factors, as well as overexpression of the functional genes, was carried out in KF-7. Fermentation experiments under 1.25 M NaCl demonstrated that all engineered strains outperformed the parental strain. Among them, overexpression of CTA1 resulted in the greatest improvement, with glucose consumption and ethanol production increased by 35.04% and 45.66%, respectively, after 96 h of fermentation.ConclusionsThis study demonstrates that comparative transcriptomics can serve as an effective strategy for identifying engineering targets associated with salt tolerance in S. cerevisiae. The evaluated genes provide potential targets for strain improvement and offer insights for the rational design of yeast cell factories suited for high-salinity biofuel and bioproduct fermentation processes.
articles.abstractZh: 背景高盐条件经常损害涉及高渗透压底物的工业过程中酿酒酵母的发酵性能。因此，识别增强耐盐性的遗传决定因素对于发展强大的酵母细胞工厂至关重要。本研究通过比较转录组分析研究耐盐菌株 E-158 及其亲本菌株 KF-7 在 1.25 M NaCl 胁迫下的转录反应，旨在确定菌株工程的潜在靶标。结果比较转录组分析揭示了高盐条件下 E-158 和 KF-7 之间广泛的转录差异，涉及中心碳和氮代谢、过氧化物酶体相关的氧化应激反应、离子转运、细胞壁相关过程和孢子形成相关途径。根据这些图谱，选择两个转录因子（CUP9 和 ZNF1）和三个功能基因（DAL1、IDP2 和 CTA1）进行功能验证。在KF-7中进行转录因子的过表达或缺失，以及功能基因的过表达。发酵
