articles.title: Emerging Sustainable Bioprocess for the Valorization of Agave Bagasse for Single-Cell Protein Production.
articles.titleZh: 用于单细胞蛋白质生产的龙舌兰甘蔗渣增值的新兴可持续生物工艺。
articles.authors: Leal-Urbina E, Dufoo-Hurtado E, Gaytán-Martínez M, Tec-Caamal EN, Ramírez-Jiménez AK.
articles.abstract: In this work, a food-compatible bioprocess was evaluated for the production of yeast single-cell protein from mezcal agave bagasse. Bagasse was enzymatically hydrolyzed at 10% (w/v) solids (pH 4.8, 50 °C, 24 h) using commercial enzymes. The resulting liquid was clarified by activated charcoal adsorption and filtration to obtain a hydrolysate suitable for submerged fermentation. Enzymatic hydrolysis released reducing sugars in the range of 11-17 g/L. Saccharomyces cerevisiae was cultivated on the clarified hydrolysate under submerged conditions using both flask-scale and 2 L stirred-tank bioreactor experiments. Trials were performed at flask scale with initial sugars at 8, 17, and 50 g/L, and at 2 L stirred-tank bioreactor scale with initial sugars at 20.68 g/L (R1) and 16.30 (R2) g/L. At the flask scale, final biomass concentrations increased with initial sugar level. Values reached 6.18 ± 0.27, 8.02 ± 0.55, and 9.28 ± 0.10 g/L, while crude protein remained below 10% (3.40 ± 0.15 to 8.69 ± 0.09 g/100 g dry weight). In contrast, bioreactor cultivation resulted in higher protein enrichment, with protein contents over 40% under both oxygen regimes (41.71 ± 0.47 to 45.80 ± 0.43 g/100 g dry weight). Overall, the findings support enzymatic hydrolysis coupled with controlled submerged fermentation as a scalable approach for valorizing agave bagasse into protein-enriched yeast biomass.
articles.abstractZh: 在这项工作中，评估了一种食品相容的生物工艺，用于从梅斯卡尔龙舌兰甘蔗渣生产酵母单细胞蛋白。使用商业酶对甘蔗渣进行酶水解，固体含量为 10%（w/v）（pH 4.8，50 °C，24 小时）。所得液体通过活性炭吸附和过滤澄清，得到适合深层发酵的水解液。酶水解释放的还原糖范围为 11-17 g/L。使用烧瓶规模和 2 L 搅拌罐生物反应器实验在浸没条件下在澄清的水解产物上培养酿酒酵母。试验在烧瓶规模下进行，初始糖浓度为 8、17 和 50 g/L，在 2 L 搅拌罐生物反应器规模下进行，初始糖浓度为 20.68 g/L (R1) 和 16.30 (R2) g/L。在烧瓶规模上，最终生物量浓度随着初始糖水平的增加而增加。值达到 6.18 ± 0.27、8.02 ± 0.55 和 9.28 ± 0.10 g/L，而粗蛋白仍低于 10%（3.40 ± 0.15 至 8.69 ± 0.09 g/100 g 干重）。相比之下，生物反应器培养导致更高的蛋白质富集，在两种氧气状态下蛋白质含量均超过 40%（41.71 ± 0.47 至 45.80 ± 0.43 g/100 g）

articles.title: Production and characterization of low-cost superfine bacterial cellulose from coculture fermentation of <i>Komagataeibacter oboediens</i> RC30-15 with <i>Saccharomyces bayanus</i> and its antibacterial activities.
articles.titleZh: Komagataeibacter oboedens RC30-15与Saccharomyces bayanus共培养发酵生产低成本超细细菌纤维素及其抗菌活性。
articles.authors: Lertsirirut P, Tippayasak U, Puangsin B, Theeragool G.
articles.abstract: We aim to produce and characterize superfine bacterial cellulose (BC) obtained from cost-effective fermentation at 37 °C in coconut water (CW) using table sugar instead of sucrose as a carbon source. The low-cost BC with antibacterial activities was produced from the coculture fermentation of Komagataeibacter oboediens RC30-15 with Saccharomyces bayanus at 37 °C in CW0.5A3S0.5N containing 0.5% acetic acid, 3% table sugar or sucrose and 0.5% ammonium sulfate. Scanning electron microscopic (SEM) analysis of BC film indicated no significant differences in BC fibrils' average diameter between BC produced from sucrose or sugar as a carbon source at either 30 or 37 °C. Moreover, there are no significant differences in the XRD patterns, FTIR spectra, and thermograms of BC produced from sucrose and sugar as carbon sources. Evaluation of antibacterial activities against Staphylococcus aureus, Escherichia coli, and Pseudomonas aeruginosa indicated that BC produced from sugar exhibited a similar inhibitory effect to that produced from sucrose. Coculture fermentation of K. oboediens RC30-15 with S. bayanus in CW containing sugar not only reduces the medium cost from 1.12 USD/L to 0.20 USD/L (1 USD=32 baht) but also enhances the antibacterial activities of BC. Additionally, BC produced by coculture fermentation showed a higher inhibitory effect than that by mixed-culture fermentation of K. oboediens RC30-15, S. bayanus, and Pediococcus pentosaceus DMKU 14-7. Antibacterial activity of BC against a chloramphenicol resistant strain of P. aeruginosa is interesting and might be applied as a natural antimicrobial agent, providing an alternative to antibiotics in the future.
articles.abstractZh: 我们的目标是使用食糖代替蔗糖作为碳源，在椰子水 (CW) 中以经济有效的方式在 37°C 下发酵，生产并表征超细细菌纤维素 (BC)。具有抗菌活性的低成本BC是由Komagataeibacter oboediens RC30-15与Saccharomyces bayanus在37℃下在含有0.5％乙酸、3％食糖或蔗糖和0.5％硫酸铵的CW0.5A3S0.5N中共培养发酵产生的。 BC 膜的扫描电子显微镜 (SEM) 分析表明，在 30 或 37 °C 下以蔗糖或糖作为碳源生产的 BC 之间，BC 纤维的平均直径没有显着差异。此外，以蔗糖和糖为碳源生产的BC的XRD图谱、FTIR光谱和热分析图没有显着差异。对金黄色葡萄球菌、大肠杆菌和铜绿假单胞菌的抗菌活性评价表明，由糖产生的BC表现出与蔗糖产生的相似的抑制效果。 K. oboedens RC30-15 与 S. bayanus 在含糖 CW 中共培养发酵不仅将培养基成本从 1.12 USD/L 降低至 0.20 USD/L (1

articles.title: The role of L-type amino acid transporter 1 in the pathogenicity of <i>Candida albicans</i>.
articles.titleZh: L型氨基酸转运蛋白1在白色念珠菌致病性中的作用。
articles.authors: Lan Y, Wu C, Du P, Jiao J, Li C, Chu K, Zhang T, Chen P, Li A, Xu W, Ying X, Zhou J, Lin W, Ma L, Huang Y.
articles.abstract: Our recent study showed that lat1, which encodes L-type amino acid transporter 1 (Lat1) was centrally positioned in the gene co-expression network of a Candida albicans (C. albicans) infection model of cell culture and suggested that this gene might play a critical role in the pathogenesis of C. albicans infections. In the current work, we used CRISPR-Cas9 to generate a C. albicans lat1 mutant strain (lat1Δ/Δ), using C. albicans SC5314 as the wild-type (WT) strain. An in vitro Candida infection model using vaginal epithelial cells and a murine model of vulvovaginal candidiasis was used to investigate the role of lat1 in the pathogenicity of C. albicans. It was found that lat1 played important roles in cell proliferation, morphogenesis, early adherence, and biofilm formation of C. albicans. VK2-E6E7 human vaginal epithelial cells infected with the lat1Δ/Δ mutant strain also showed significantly lower activation of Toll-like receptor 2/4 (TLR2/4) and the downstream MyD88/NF-κB signaling pathway, accompanied by an attenuated secretion of inflammatory cytokines. In the murine model of vulvovaginal candidiasis, infection caused by lat1Δ/Δ showed a lower fungal burden in the vaginal lavage fluid, reduced production of inflammatory cytokines, and diminished recruitment of neutrophils to the vaginal epithelium, relative to that caused by the WT strain. Based on these findings, we conclude that lat1 plays an important role in the host-pathogen interactions in C. albicans infections by impacting the virulence of C. albicans and host inflammatory responses; the latter was possibly via the TLR2/4-MyD88-NF-κB pathway.IMPORTANCEEffective management of vulvovaginal candidiasis requires a comprehensive understanding of virulence genes in C. albicans and their role in the host-pathogen interactions. Our study identified lat1 as an important virulence factor of C. albicans, impacting fungal adaptations, including morphogenesis and biofilm formation, virulence, and host immune responses, such as the epithelial TLR2/4-MyD88-NF-κB activation in the murine model of vulvovaginal candidiasis. Lat1-mediated amino acid transport may serve as a key metabolic constraint during early infection. Further research is warranted to validate the clinical importance of lat1 in vulvovaginal candidiasis and its potential as a therapeutic target.
